title: Similarity search generalisation in contrastive learning with InfoNCE loss
abstract: Similarity search is a primary application of embedding models trained by contrastive learning. For one of the most popular contrastive learning loss functions, InfoNCE, we show that the population risk with $k$ negative samples is $O(1/k)$ close to an expected cross-entropy which quantifies deviation between i) a softmax similarity search over unseen data using the learned embedding function, and ii) an idealised softmax search over the same data but using similarity implicitly represented in the positive sample generator. This complements existing interpretations of InfoNCE in the $k\to\infty$ limit which are phrased in terms of mutual information, and alignment versus uniformity in embeddings. To quantify generalisation performance, we introduce a new continuity bound for the InfoNCE loss, obtained via Gâteaux differentiation. The bound preserves the structure of averaging over negative samples present in the loss function and features an ``inverse temperature'' parameter which can be tuned to account for the algorithmic temperature. For embedding functions which are Lipschitz in a parameter, this yields a simple demonstration that the averaging effect of $k$ negative samples in the InfoNCE loss carries over to stabilisation of the generalisation error as $k$ grows.
tldr: 该论文从理论上分析了InfoNCE损失在相似性搜索中的泛化性能，证明了负样本数量k对泛化误差的稳定作用，并提出了新的连续性界。
abstract_cn: 相似性搜索是通过对比学习训练的嵌入模型的主要应用。针对最流行的对比学习损失函数之一InfoNCE，我们证明，使用k个负样本的总体风险与期望交叉熵之间的差距为O(1/k)，该交叉熵量化了以下两者之间的偏差：i) 使用学习到的嵌入函数对未见数据进行软最大相似性搜索，以及ii) 对相同数据使用正样本生成器中隐含表示的相似性进行理想化软最大搜索。这补充了现有关于InfoNCE在k→∞极限下的解释，这些解释以互信息以及嵌入中的对齐性与均匀性为表述。为了量化泛化性能，我们通过Gâteaux微分引入了一个新的InfoNCE损失连续性界。该界保留了损失函数中对负样本进行平均的结构，并包含一个“逆温度”参数，该参数可调整以考虑算法温度。对于在参数上满足Lipschitz条件的嵌入函数，这简单证明了InfoNCE损失中k个负样本的平均效应会随着k的增长而延续到泛化误差的稳定性上。

title: SYNRARE: Synthetic Rare Disease EHR Generation for ML Benchmarking
abstract:
Motivation: Rare disease (RD) diagnosis is frequently delayed due to the similarities in symptoms to common disease variants. Machine Learning Algorithms applied to Electronic Health Records show promise for accelerating the diagnosis; however, legal and privacy concerns pose significant barriers. To address these issues, Synthetic Data Generation is an alternative method for obtaining Electronic Health Records and can be applied with any Machine Learning algorithm for benchmarking and development purposes. Despite the availability of Synthetic Data Generation algorithms, support for generating a subset of patients that differ in a definable degree from the majority to simulate patients with RD is often lacking.
  Results: We present SYNRARE, a graphical user interface based on the Synthea framework that enables easier modification and generation of synthetic Electronic Health Records of RD patients, which differ only to a definable degree from patients with common diseases, thereby enabling the benchmarking and testing of algorithms under controlled technical conditions. SYNRARE enables researchers to rapidly benchmark their Machine Learning algorithms across any scenario.
  Availability and implementation: SYNRARE, including detailed instructions for installing, is available at https://gitlab.sdu.dk/screen4care/synrare.
tldr: SYNRARE是一个基于Synthea的图形界面工具，用于生成罕见病患者的合成电子健康记录，以便在受控条件下对机器学习算法进行基准测试。
abstract_cn:
**动机：** 罕见病（Rare Disease, RD）的诊断常因症状与常见疾病变体相似而延迟。将机器学习（Machine Learning, ML）算法应用于电子健康记录（Electronic Health Records, EHR）有望加速诊断进程，但法律与隐私问题构成了重大障碍。为解决这些问题，合成数据生成（Synthetic Data Generation）成为获取电子健康记录的替代方法，并可配合任何机器学习算法用于基准测试与开发。尽管已有多种合成数据生成算法，但现有方法通常缺乏对生成一个与多数患者群体存在可定义程度差异的亚组（以模拟罕见病患者）的支持。

**结果：** 我们提出了SYNRARE——一个基于Synthea框架的图形用户界面（Graphical User Interface, GUI），能够更便捷地修改并生成罕见病患者的合成电子健康记录。这些记录仅在与常见疾病患者存在可定义程度的差异，从而支持在受控技术条件下对算法进行基准测试与验证。SYNRARE使研究人员能够快速在任何场景下对其机器学习算法进行基准测试。

**可用性与实现：** SYNRARE（含详细安装说明）可通过以下链接获取：https://gitlab.sdu.dk/screen4care/synrare。

title: Learning Physics-Informed Surrogate Model of Linear Elastic Displacement Fields from Geometry
abstract: This work aims to develop a fast and physically consistent surrogate model for real-time structural health monitoring of fractured elastic domains. We propose a physics-informed DeepONet framework that predicts displacement fields from both boundary conditions and fracture geometry, using a dedicated encoding strategy for the latter and without relying on finite-element-generated training data. The traction-free condition on the fracture boundary is imposed weakly through a localized penalty term. The presented numerical example focuses on one representative fracture geometry, demonstrating the feasibility of the formulation and laying the groundwork for extensions to surrogate modeling across diverse fracture geometries.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种物理信息驱动的DeepONet框架，用于从边界条件和断裂几何预测位移场，无需有限元训练数据，实现了实时结构健康监测。
abstract_cn: 本研究旨在开发一种快速且物理一致的代理模型，用于含裂缝弹性域的实时结构健康监测。我们提出了一种基于物理信息的DeepONet框架，该框架能够根据边界条件和裂缝几何形状预测位移场，其中对裂缝几何形状采用专门的编码策略，且无需依赖有限元生成的训练数据。裂缝边界上的无牵引条件通过局部惩罚项以弱形式施加。本文给出的数值示例聚焦于一种代表性裂缝几何形状，验证了该公式的可行性，并为扩展至多种裂缝几何形状的代理建模奠定了基础。

title: Data-Efficient Deep Learning: Empirical Guidelines for Training Set Size Estimation in Inertial Sensor Classification
abstract: Deep learning models dependency on large-scale inertial datasets presents a significant bottleneck in inertial sensor-based classification tasks, such as human activity recognition and smartphone location recognition. In these domains, data collection requires massive recording campaigns that are complex, time-consuming, and difficult to scale. Currently, data-driven guidelines for determining the minimum sample size required to reach a desired accuracy level do not exist. To address this gap, this study presents a systematic empirical evaluation of learning curve convergence rates in inertial classification. We introduce a unified framework that analyzes classification performance under both binary and multi-class scenarios, and derive an empirical formula to estimate performance relative to dataset size. Testing across six diverse, real-world datasets totaling 102.7 hours of inertial measurements demonstrates that accuracy follows a consistent logarithmic growth pattern, regardless of task complexity. Leveraging this finding, we propose a quantitative stability point metric, defined as the sample size required for the learning curve to stabilize within a predefined mean absolute percentage deviation of its asymptotic maximum. Our analysis reveals that models often reach practical stability with substantially fewer samples than traditional heuristics suggest. Ultimately, we offer a generalizable framework to extrapolate total data requirements from small-scale pilot studies, optimizing the tradeoff between recording effort and model reliability. These findings shift the prevailing paradigm from maximizing data volume toward optimizing data efficiency, offering concrete, data-backed guidelines for planning recording campaigns in inertial sensing applications.
tldr: 该论文通过实证研究提出惯性传感器分类任务中基于学习曲线收敛的样本量估计方法，发现准确率随数据量呈对数增长，并定义了稳定性点指标以优化数据效率。
abstract_cn: 深度学习模型对大规模惯性数据集的依赖，在基于惯性传感器的分类任务（如人类活动识别和智能手机位置识别）中构成了显著瓶颈。在这些领域，数据采集需要开展大规模记录活动，这些活动复杂、耗时且难以扩展。目前，尚无数据驱动的指导准则来确定达到预期准确率所需的最小样本量。为填补这一空白，本研究对惯性分类中学习曲线的收敛速率进行了系统的实证评估。我们引入了一个统一框架，用于分析二分类和多分类场景下的分类性能，并推导出一个经验公式来估计性能与数据集规模的关系。在六个多样化的真实世界数据集（总计102.7小时的惯性测量数据）上进行的测试表明，无论任务复杂度如何，准确率均遵循一致的对数增长模式。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种定量稳定性点指标，定义为学习曲线在其渐近最大值的预定义平均绝对百分比偏差内趋于稳定所需的样本量。我们的分析表明，模型通常能在远少于传统启发式方法所建议的样本量下达到实际稳定性。最终，我们提供了一个可推广的框架，用于从小规模试点研究中推断总数据需求，从而优化记录工作量与模型可靠性之间的权衡。这些发现将主流范式从最大化数据量转向优化数据效率，为惯性传感应用中的记录活动规划提供了具体且基于数据的指导准则。

title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
abstract: We present Mach-Mind-4-Flash, a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic model with 3B activated parameters. Through post-training optimization alone without scaling pre-training compute, the model achieves performance on par with or surpassing that of 100B-parameter-class models. By introducing scalable agentic interaction environments for large-scale reinforcement learning, the model attains significant performance gains on real-world application tasks. Our pipeline comprises three stages: (1) a unified RL/OPD training infrastructure with dynamic multi-teacher scheduling and operator-level acceleration, delivering 17\% end-to-end training speedup; (2) multiple domain-specific RL experts trained in parallel across Reasoning, General, and Agent tracks, then fused into a single generalist via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) -- a routed reverse-KL objective that eliminates the see-saw degradation of mixed-reward RL; (3) Hybrid Median-length Policy Optimization (HMPO), a single-stage token-efficiency method that compresses reasoning chains by 19--46\% with $\le$0.7 percentage-point accuracy loss. Mach-Mind-4-Flash scores 92.70 on AIME'26, 82.82 on IFBench, 80.74 on Behavioral-SafetyBench, 75.80 on BFCL-v4, 72.31 on BrowseComp-zh, and 84.20 on ClawBench -- leading or matching models with 10--30$\times$ its activated size at a fraction of the inference cost.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种35B参数的MoE智能体模型Mach-Mind-4-Flash，通过后训练优化（包括多教师强化学习蒸馏和混合长度策略优化）在多个基准上达到与100B参数模型相当的性能，但论文不涉及推荐系统领域。
abstract_cn: 我们提出Mach-Mind-4-Flash，一个具有35B参数、3B激活参数的混合专家（MoE）智能体模型。仅通过后训练优化，无需扩展预训练计算量，该模型即可达到或超越100B参数级别模型的性能。通过引入可扩展的智能体交互环境进行大规模强化学习，模型在真实应用任务上取得了显著的性能提升。我们的流程包含三个阶段：（1）统一的RL/OPD训练基础设施，采用动态多教师调度与算子级加速，实现17%的端到端训练加速；（2）在推理（Reasoning）、通用（General）和智能体（Agent）三个轨道上并行训练多个领域专用的强化学习专家，随后通过多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）——一种采用路由化反向KL散度目标的方法——将其融合为单一通用模型，从而消除混合奖励强化学习中的跷跷板退化现象；（3）混合中长策略优化（HMPO），一种单阶段令牌效率方法，可将推理链压缩19%至46%，同时准确率损失不超过0.7个百分点。Mach-Mind-4-Flash在AIME'26上得分为92.70，在IFBench上为82.82，在Behavioral-SafetyBench上为80.74，在BFCL-v4上为75.80，在BrowseComp-zh上为72.31，在ClawBench上为84.20——在推理成本仅为激活规模大10至30倍的模型的极小部分的情况下，领先或持平于这些模型。

title: Graph Neural Networks for Scalable and Transferable Node Centrality Approximation
abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) provide a learning-based framework for approximating graph quantities that are expensive to compute exactly. This paper investigates GNNs for scalable approximation of betweenness and closeness centrality, formulated as a node-ranking problem. Exact centrality values are used as supervision, and ranking quality is evaluated using Kendall's tau rank correlation. We study whether message-passing GNNs can learn transferable structural representations across different graph topologies rather than only fitting the distribution used during training. On unseen Erdos renyi graphs, the proposed models achieve tau = 0.851 for betweenness and tau = 0.894 for closeness. A large-scale betweenness model trained on graphs with N = 5,000 nodes achieves tau = 0.938, demonstrating scalability. Mixed-distribution training on Erdos renyi, Barabasi-Albert, and Gaussian Random Partition graphs improves betweenness transfer across graph families. In contrast, closeness centrality remains more sensitive to community-structured graphs and shows reduced transfer to real-world topologies. Finally, GNN inference achieves up to a 97.7x speedup over exact computation. These results show that mixed-distribution training can improve structural transfer in GNN-based centrality approximation, while identifying closeness centrality's sensitivity to topology as an open challenge.
tldr: 该论文研究使用图神经网络近似介数中心性和接近中心性，通过混合分布训练提升跨图拓扑的迁移能力，在未见图上达到高Kendall tau相关系数，并实现97.7倍加速。
abstract_cn: 图神经网络（Graph Neural Networks, GNNs）提供了一种基于学习的框架，用于近似计算那些精确求解成本较高的图量。本文研究将GNN用于介数中心性（betweenness centrality）和紧密中心性（closeness centrality）的可扩展近似，并将其形式化为节点排序问题。以精确的中心性值作为监督信号，并使用肯德尔秩相关系数（Kendall's tau）评估排序质量。我们探究消息传递型GNN是否能够学习跨不同图拓扑的可迁移结构表征，而不仅仅是拟合训练时所用的数据分布。在未见过的埃尔德什-雷尼（Erdos-Renyi）图上，所提模型在介数中心性上达到tau = 0.851，在紧密中心性上达到tau = 0.894。一个在节点数N = 5000的图上训练的介数中心性大规模模型取得了tau = 0.938，展示了其可扩展性。在埃尔德什-雷尼、巴拉巴西-阿尔伯特（Barabasi-Albert）和高斯随机划分（Gaussian Random Partition）图上进行的混合分布训练，提升了介数中心性在不同图族间的迁移能力。相比之下，紧密中心性对社区结构图仍更为敏感，且向真实世界拓扑的迁移能力有所下降。最后，GNN推理相较于精确计算实现了高达97.7倍的加速。这些结果表明，混合分布训练能够改善基于GNN的中心性近似中的结构迁移，同时揭示了紧密中心性对拓扑的敏感性仍是一个有待解决的挑战。

title: Spectrally Deconfounded Gradient Boosting
abstract: Flexible machine-learning methods can be sensitive to hidden confounding: they may learn associations induced by unobserved confounders rather than stable signals. Spectral deconfounding mitigates this problem by shrinking high-variance directions of the covariate matrix that, under dense confounding, carry latent confounder information. Existing work has largely focused on linear models. We develop a nonlinear spectral deconfounding framework for gradient boosting. Our approach replaces the ordinary squared-error loss by a spectral loss, which alters the boosting dynamics by slowing down learning in confounding-aligned directions. We show that deconfounding is not achieved by the spectral loss alone, but by the interaction between spectral shrinkage and regularization, especially in terms of early stopping. Moreover, we provide a mixed-model interpretation that connects LAVA-type shrinkage to random-effects adjustment and yields an empirical-Bayes procedure for tuning the spectral loss. We also extend the method to general likelihoods and nonlinear confounding using Laplace approximations and kernel random effects. Across synthetic and real-world experiments, spectrally deconfounded boosting improves estimation of the target function under hidden confounding and is substantially more scalable than existing nonlinear spectral deconfounding baselines.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种谱去混杂梯度提升方法，通过谱损失和正则化交互来减轻隐藏混杂对非线性模型的影响，提高了目标函数估计的准确性。
abstract_cn: 灵活的机器学习方法可能对隐藏混杂敏感：它们可能学习由未观测混杂因素引发的关联，而非稳定信号。谱去混杂通过收缩协变量矩阵中承载潜在混杂信息的高方差方向（在密集混杂条件下）来缓解这一问题。现有研究主要聚焦于线性模型。我们针对梯度提升开发了一种非线性谱去混杂框架。该方法用谱损失替代标准平方误差损失，通过减缓混杂对齐方向上的学习速度来改变提升动态。研究表明，去混杂效果并非仅由谱损失单独实现，而是谱收缩与正则化（尤其是早停机制）相互作用的结果。此外，我们提供了一种混合模型解释，将LAVA型收缩与随机效应调整相关联，并推导出用于谱损失调参的经验贝叶斯程序。我们还利用拉普拉斯近似和核随机效应将方法扩展至一般似然函数与非线性混杂场景。在合成与真实实验中的结果表明，谱去混杂提升在隐藏混杂条件下能改进目标函数的估计，且其可扩展性显著优于现有非线性谱去混杂基线方法。

title: From Classification to Localization and Clinical Validation: Large-Scale Development of a Deep Learning System for Thoracic Disease Detection on Chest Radiographs in Thailand
abstract: Chest radiography (CXR) remains the most widely used thoracic imaging modality, yet expert interpretation is constrained by a severe shortage of radiologists in Thailand and across Southeast Asia. Local adaptation of deep learning models to Thai data has been shown to substantially improve accuracy on Thai populations. Here we present the development and comprehensive validation of the chest radiograph analysis model in Inspectra CXR version 5, a deep learning system that performs multi-label thoracic disease classification and weakly supervised lesion localization within a single model. The architecture couples a DenseNet-121 backbone with Attend-and-Compare Modules (ACM) and a Probabilistic Class Activation Map (PCAM) aggregation layer, producing a per-condition classification score and heatmap simultaneously. The model was developed on 874,858 frontal chest radiographs with paired radiologist reports from Siriraj Hospital, Bangkok. On a held-out, radiologist-verified in-domain test set of 19,871 cases, it achieved a mean AUROC of 0.994 (mean sensitivity 92.4%, specificity 98.6%) across nine clinically important conditions. On an independent generalization set of 5,992 cases from 13 hospitals across Thailand, the mean AUROC was 0.970, indicating robust transfer across sites. For localization, evaluated on 4,549 radiologist-annotated cases, the model attained a mean lesion-localization fraction (LLF) of 77.9% at 0.59 non-lesion localizations per image. In a usability evaluation with five thoracic radiologists, the system reached a classification concordance of 93.6%, a localization concordance of 94.7%, and a mean System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 89. These results indicate that a locally developed, localization-capable CXR system can deliver high accuracy, generalize across heterogeneous Thai hospitals, and earn the trust of practicing radiologists.
tldr: 该论文开发了一个深度学习系统用于胸部X光片的疾病分类和病灶定位，在泰国多中心数据上取得了高准确率和良好的泛化性能。
abstract_cn: 胸部X线摄影（CXR）仍是最广泛使用的胸部影像学检查手段，然而在泰国及整个东南亚地区，放射科医生的严重短缺制约了专家判读。针对泰国数据对深度学习模型进行本地化适配已被证实能显著提升其在泰国人群中的准确性。本文介绍了Inspectra CXR版本5中胸部X线影像分析模型的开发与全面验证，该深度学习系统可在单一模型内实现多标签胸部疾病分类及弱监督病灶定位。其架构将DenseNet-121骨干网络与注意力比较模块（ACM）及概率类激活图（PCAM）聚合层相结合，可同时生成每个病变的分类评分与热力图。该模型基于来自曼谷Siriraj医院的874,858张正面胸部X线影像及其配对放射科报告进行开发。在由放射科医生验证的19,871例独立域内测试集上，模型在九种临床重要病变中实现了平均AUROC为0.994（平均敏感性92.4%，特异性98.6%）。在来自泰国13家医院的5,992例独立泛化测试集上，平均AUROC达到0.970，表明模型在不同机构间具有稳健的迁移能力。在定位性能评估中，基于4,549例经放射科医生标注的病例，模型在每张图像0.59个非病灶定位点的条件下，实现了平均病灶定位分数（LLF）为77.9%。在由五位胸部放射科医生参与的可操作性评估中，系统分类一致率为93.6%，定位一致率为94.7%，平均系统可用性量表（SUS）评分为89分。这些结果表明，本地开发的、具备定位能力的CXR系统能够实现高精度，在泰国不同医院间具备泛化能力，并赢得执业放射科医生的信任。

title: Leveraging Interpretable Tsetlin Machine for PDF Malware Detection
abstract: In the digital era, Portable Document Format (PDF) is one of the most widely used file formats for storing and exchanging digital documents due to its platform independence and rich functionality. However, these same capabilities have also made PDF files an attractive attack vector for cyberattackers, who embed malicious code within seemingly legitimate documents to compromise target systems. This paper presents a novel interpretable Tsetlin Machine (TM)-based framework for PDF malware detection. The proposed framework extracts salient features from PDF documents through static analysis without executing the files and employs rule-based learning to accurately classify benign and malicious PDF documents. Numerical evaluation on the RIT-PDFMal-2026 dataset demonstrates that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance, attaining an accuracy of 98.02% compared with several ML classifiers and existing methods. Moreover, the proposed framework provides intrinsic interpretability by transparently explaining its classification decisions. The combination of competitive detection performance, computational efficiency, and intrinsic interpretability makes the proposed framework a promising solution for practical PDF malware detection.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于可解释Tsetlin Machine的PDF恶意软件检测框架，通过静态分析和规则学习实现98.02%的准确率。
abstract_cn: 在数字时代，便携式文档格式（PDF）因其平台无关性和丰富的功能，成为存储和交换数字文档最广泛使用的文件格式之一。然而，这些特性也使得PDF文件成为网络攻击者青睐的攻击载体，他们通过将恶意代码嵌入看似合法的文档中，以入侵目标系统。本文提出了一种新颖的、基于可解释Tsetlin机器（TM）的PDF恶意软件检测框架。该框架通过静态分析从PDF文档中提取显著特征，无需执行文件，并采用基于规则的学习方法准确分类良性PDF文档与恶意PDF文档。在RIT-PDFMal-2026数据集上的数值评估表明，与多种机器学习分类器及现有方法相比，该框架取得了具有竞争力的性能，准确率达到98.02%。此外，该框架通过透明解释其分类决策，提供了内在的可解释性。竞争性的检测性能、计算效率与内在可解释性的结合，使得该框架成为实际PDF恶意软件检测中一种有前景的解决方案。

title: Super-Tuning: From Activation-Aware Pruning to Sparse Fine-Tuning
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain expensive to fine-tune because full-parameter updates require substantial memory, compute, and per-task storage. We study whether saliency signals originally developed for pruning can be reused to choose where a model should adapt. We propose Super, a sparse parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method that fixes a small trainable support using a Wanda-style activation-weighted magnitude score [Sun et al., 2023] computed from a calibration pass. We then introduce Supra, a hybrid adapter that combines this sparse update with LoRA while preserving a matched trainable-parameter budget through a simple budget-splitting rule. In single-seed Math17K arithmetic experiments on Llama-3.2-1B and Meta-Llama-3-8B, the best Super/Supra variants achieve the highest average accuracy among the tested schedule-selected adapter configurations. We also include a PaFi-style magnitude-only support as a closest training-free sparse baseline and find that low-score supports under both magnitude and Wanda-style orderings can be effective. These results suggest that simple pruning-inspired orderings can provide useful fixed sparse supports for PEFT, especially when combined with low-rank adapters.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于激活感知剪枝的稀疏微调方法Super和混合适配器Supra，用于高效微调大语言模型，实验表明简单的剪枝启发式排序可为参数高效微调提供有效的固定稀疏支持。
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLMs）的全参数微调仍成本高昂，因为全参数更新需要大量内存、计算资源及每任务存储空间。我们研究了最初为剪枝设计的显著性信号是否可复用于选择模型应适应的区域。我们提出Super方法，这是一种稀疏参数高效微调（PEFT）方法，它通过校准过程计算Wanda风格的激活加权幅度分数[Sun等人，2023]，从而固定一个较小的可训练支撑集。随后我们引入Supra混合适配器，该适配器将这种稀疏更新与LoRA相结合，并通过简单的预算分割规则保持匹配的可训练参数预算。在基于Llama-3.2-1B和Meta-Llama-3-8B的单种子Math17K算术实验中，最优的Super/Supra变体在测试的调度选择适配器配置中取得了最高平均准确率。我们还纳入了PaFi风格的纯幅度支撑集作为最接近的无训练稀疏基线，并发现基于幅度和Wanda风格排序的低分支撑集均能有效工作。这些结果表明，受剪枝启发的简单排序可为PEFT提供有用的固定稀疏支撑集，尤其是当与低秩适配器结合使用时。

title: Autoregressive latent diffusion for 3D molecule generation
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) molecule generation has been dominated by diffusion models, which achieve strong generation quality but typically require the molecular size to be specified a priori. Recent autoregressive approaches have substantially narrowed the performance gap while naturally supporting variable-length generation and conditioning on partial molecular context. However, balancing unconditional and context-conditioned generation remains challenging. We introduce KRONOS, a latent autoregressive diffusion framework that generates molecules in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, jointly modeling molecular graph topology and geometry, while retaining the flexibility of autoregressive generation. We further introduce a mixed training strategy inspired by Fill-in-the Middle (FIM) paradigm, enabling both unconditional and fragment-conditioned molecular generation within a single left-to-right autoregressive model. Experiments on QM9 and GEOM-Drugs demonstrate that KRONOS achieves leading unconditional generation performance among autoregressive methods, while remaining competitive with diffusion models. Moreover, fragment-conditioned generation is achieved with negligible impact on unconditional generation performance, demonstrating that both generation paradigms can be supported within a single architecture.
tldr: KRONOS提出了一种自回归潜在扩散框架，在预训练自编码器的潜在空间中生成3D分子，同时支持无条件生成和片段条件生成，在QM9和GEOM-Drugs数据集上取得了领先性能。
abstract_cn: 三维（3D）分子生成领域长期由扩散模型主导，这类模型虽能实现优异的生成质量，但通常需要预先指定分子尺寸。近期自回归方法在自然支持变长生成与基于部分分子上下文的条件生成的同时，已大幅缩小了性能差距。然而，平衡无条件生成与上下文条件生成仍具挑战性。我们提出KRONOS——一种潜在自回归扩散框架，该框架在预训练自编码器的潜在空间中生成分子，联合建模分子图拓扑结构与几何构型，同时保留自回归生成的灵活性。我们进一步引入受填充中间（Fill-in-the Middle, FIM）范式启发的混合训练策略，使单一从左至右的自回归模型既能实现无条件分子生成，也能实现片段条件分子生成。在QM9与GEOM-Drugs数据集上的实验表明，KRONOS在自回归方法中达到了领先的无条件生成性能，同时与扩散模型保持竞争力。此外，片段条件生成对无条件生成性能的影响可忽略不计，证明两种生成范式可在单一架构内同时实现。

title: LionVote: Per-Layer Learning Rate Adaptation for Lion
abstract: Per-layer diagnostics reveal that, at the prescribed learning rate, Lion's effective scale is 2.6-2.8x too high for attention and MLP parameters and ~2x too high for normalization layers on ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100; this 32% cross-layer-type disparity cannot be reproduced by a single global rate. The measurement comes from LionVote, a per-layer learning rate mechanism in which each parameter tensor maintains a compound level, a persistent integer updated every c epochs by two diagnostics (gradient direction stability and momentum health) resolved by a validation loss tiebreaker. Voting thresholds derive from geometric identities, the EMA time constant, and a noise-floor estimate; cadence is bounded structurally and selected by ablation. On ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100, LionVote achieves 69.7% top-1 accuracy vs. Lion's 69.0% (p < 0.02, Welch's t-test) and AdamW's 68.8%. Per-layer adaptation value depends on both architectural heterogeneity and task; on uniform CNN architectures tuned SGD with cosine annealing remains dominant, and on ViT architectures gains are task-dependent.
tldr: 该论文提出LionVote，一种针对Lion优化器的逐层学习率自适应机制，通过梯度方向稳定性和动量健康度诊断调整每层学习率，在ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100上提升了分类准确率。
abstract_cn: 逐层诊断表明，在预设学习率下，Lion优化器对注意力层和MLP参数的有效缩放比例过高（2.6-2.8倍），而对ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100归一化层的缩放比例约为2倍；这种32%的跨层类型差异无法通过单一全局学习率复现。该测量结果源于LionVote——一种逐层学习率机制，其中每个参数张量维持一个复合层级（compound level），该层级为持久整数，每c个训练周期通过两项诊断指标（梯度方向稳定性与动量健康度）进行更新，并由验证损失平局判定器（tiebreaker）裁决。投票阈值基于几何恒等式、指数移动平均（EMA）时间常数及噪声基底估计推导得出；更新节奏在结构上受约束并通过消融实验选定。在ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100上，LionVote达到69.7%的Top-1准确率，优于Lion的69.0%（p < 0.02，Welch's t检验）与AdamW的68.8%。逐层自适应机制的价值取决于架构异质性与任务特性：在均匀CNN架构中，经余弦退火调优的SGD仍占主导地位；而在ViT架构上，性能增益则因任务而异。

title: Influence Diagnostics in High-dimensional M-estimation: Precise Asymptotics
abstract: The impact of a given training point on a statistical model is classically measured through its leave-one-out influence, which quantifies the effect of its removal from the training set on the model accuracy. While the statistics of leave-one-out influences are well understood in the low-dimensional, large sample limit $n\to \infty, d=O(1)$, they become more intricate in high dimensions, as the influence of a given sample develops non-trivial dependencies on all other training samples. For convex M-estimation under Gaussian design, in the high-dimensional limit $n\asymp d$, we show that the distribution of the influences across the training set converges to a limiting measure which we sharply characterize. Building on these results, we provide evidence that influential samples tend to lie close to the decision boundary, thereby making contact with a standard data selection heuristic in active learning.
tldr: 该论文研究了高维M估计中训练样本影响诊断的渐近分布，发现高维下影响统计量呈现非平凡依赖，并证明有影响的样本倾向于靠近决策边界。
abstract_cn: 给定训练点对统计模型的影响通常通过其留一法影响来度量，该指标量化了将该点从训练集中移除对模型准确性的影响。虽然在低维、大样本极限（$n\to \infty, d=O(1)$）下，留一法影响的统计特性已得到充分理解，但在高维情形下，由于给定样本的影响会与所有其他训练样本产生非平凡的依赖关系，这些特性变得更加复杂。针对高斯设计下的凸M估计，在高维极限（$n\asymp d$）中，我们证明了训练集上影响的分布收敛于一个极限测度，并对其进行了精确刻画。基于这些结果，我们提供了证据表明，具有较大影响的样本往往位于决策边界附近，从而与主动学习中一种标准的数据选择启发式方法建立了联系。

title: Forget Narrowly, Retain Broadly: Unlearning as an Asymmetric Generalization Problem
abstract: Machine unlearning in LLMs is the targeted removal of specific knowledge while preserving all other capabilities, critical for privacy and safety. Yet existing benchmarks measure it unreliably. They miss knowledge that resurfaces under paraphrased or indirect queries, a failure we call under-forgetting, and lack the semantic, syntactic, and lexical probes needed to verify that unrelated knowledge is preserved, a failure we call over-forgetting. Both failures reflect an asymmetric generalization problem. Forget evaluation must cover diverse query formulations of the same target facts, testing whether forgetting holds beyond exact training prompts. Retain evaluation must probe a far larger and implicitly defined set, namely every fact disjoint from the forget target. The retain set thus defines the effective forget set, yet current datasets provide no fine-grained annotation of this forget-retain boundary. We address this with SUITE, an evaluation protocol and training corpus that captures forget-retain structure for real-world factual domains. Methods trained on SUITE improve substantially, showing that training data is as important as algorithmic design. Building on the obtained insights, we introduce JensUn++, an unlearning algorithm that achieves the best forget-retain utility trade-off across three LLMs, in both sequential and joint unlearning settings. Code and datasets are available at https://amitpeleg.github.io/forget-narrowly-retain-broadly
tldr: 该论文提出SUITE评估协议和JensUn++算法，解决LLM机器遗忘中欠遗忘和过遗忘的不对称泛化问题。
abstract_cn: 大语言模型中的机器遗忘是指针对性地移除特定知识，同时保留所有其他能力，这对隐私与安全至关重要。然而，现有基准测试对其评估并不可靠。这些基准测试未能检测到在释义或间接查询下重新浮现的知识——我们将这种失败称为“欠遗忘”，同时也缺乏用于验证无关知识是否得以保留的语义、句法和词汇探测手段——我们将这种失败称为“过遗忘”。这两种失败均反映了不对称泛化问题。遗忘评估必须覆盖同一目标事实的多种查询表述，检验遗忘是否在精确训练提示之外依然成立。保留评估则必须探测一个规模更大且隐式定义的集合，即所有与遗忘目标不相交的事实。因此，保留集定义了有效的遗忘集，但现有数据集并未提供对这种遗忘-保留边界的细粒度标注。我们通过SUITE（一套评估协议与训练语料库）解决了这一问题，该协议能够捕捉现实世界事实领域中的遗忘-保留结构。基于SUITE训练的方法取得了显著改进，表明训练数据与算法设计同等重要。基于所获得的洞见，我们提出了JensUn++，一种遗忘算法，在三个大语言模型上，无论是顺序遗忘还是联合遗忘场景下，均实现了最佳的遗忘-保留效用权衡。代码与数据集可在 https://amitpeleg.github.io/forget-narrowly-retain-broadly 获取。

title: Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting under Distribution Shifts: A Synthetic Evaluation
abstract: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) represent evolving relational systems, whose underlying data-generating processes often change over time. Yet, TKG forecasting models are commonly evaluated only on empirical benchmark datasets that provide limited insight into the models' robustness to such distribution shifts. Recognising this issue, we study TKG forecasting under controlled shift environments using a synthetic TKG generator that encodes three temporal and structural properties -- recurrence, homophily, and periodicity -- as data-generating mechanisms. This allows us to evaluate seven forecasting architectures under stationary and shifting regimes. Our experiments suggest that robustness in TKG forecasting is highly signal-dependent. Recurrence-based and periodic regularities are largely recoverable under stationary conditions, and simple memory-based baselines can be competitive when recurrence dominates the data. However, structural breaks reveal limitations in model adaptivity, with shifts in latent entity-community structure posing the strongest challenge in our study. Overall, our findings improve the understanding of the capabilities and limitations of current TKG models confronted with temporal distribution shifts.
tldr: 该论文通过合成时序知识图谱生成器，系统评估了七种预测架构在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，发现模型对信号类型高度依赖，且结构偏移是最具挑战性的。
abstract_cn: 时序知识图谱（Temporal Knowledge Graphs, TKGs）表征不断演化的关系系统，其底层数据生成过程常随时间变化。然而，TKG预测模型通常仅在经验性基准数据集上评估，这些数据集对模型应对此类分布偏移的鲁棒性所提供的洞察有限。针对这一问题，我们利用合成TKG生成器在受控偏移环境下研究TKG预测，该生成器将三种时间与结构属性——重复性（recurrence）、同质性（homophily）和周期性（periodicity）——编码为数据生成机制。这使我们能够在平稳与偏移机制下评估七种预测架构。实验表明，TKG预测的鲁棒性高度依赖于信号特征。基于重复性和周期性的规律在平稳条件下基本可恢复，而当重复性主导数据时，简单的基于记忆的基线方法可具备竞争力。然而，结构性突变揭示了模型适应性的局限，其中潜在实体-社区结构的偏移构成了本研究中最大的挑战。总体而言，我们的发现加深了对当前TKG模型面对时间分布偏移时能力与局限性的理解。

title: Complexity-Guided Component-wise Initialization for Language Model Pretraining
abstract: Pretrained language models often exhibit structured weight spectra, suggesting that training may repeatedly produce similar layerwise and component-wise organization. We ask whether these recurring spectral patterns can be reused as an initialization signal for GPT-2-style language-model pretraining. First, we analyze eleven pretrained GPT-2-style checkpoints that vary in size, language, tokenizer, and training corpus, measuring Frobenius norm and effective-rank entropy across layers and Transformer subcomponents. The checkpoints show shared depth trends, especially increasing scale and stronger spectral concentration in residual-writing matrices. We then construct initialization schemes that imitate the component-wise magnitudes and spectral profiles of pretrained models, and compare them with several weight initialization methods. These initializers visibly change the model's structural spectral patterns, but the evaluation results do not show a corresponding performance advantage. Pretrained-weight reuse remains competitive, while coarse spectral matching alone is not a reliable optimization strategy. Our results suggest that pretrained spectra are useful diagnostics of trained model structure, but that effective reuse likely requires preserving richer information than component-wise scale and singular-value shape.
tldr: 论文研究是否可以利用预训练语言模型中重复出现的结构化权重谱作为初始化信号，实验表明仅匹配分量尺度和奇异值形状不足以提升性能。
abstract_cn: 预训练语言模型通常展现出结构化的权重谱，这表明训练过程可能反复产生相似的逐层与逐组件组织模式。我们探究这些重复出现的谱模式能否被复用为GPT-2风格语言模型预训练的初始化信号。首先，我们分析了十一个在规模、语言、分词器及训练语料上各异的预训练GPT-2风格检查点，测量了各层及Transformer子组件上的Frobenius范数与有效秩熵。这些检查点呈现出共同的深度趋势，尤其在残差写入矩阵中表现出尺度递增与更强的谱集中性。随后，我们构建了模仿预训练模型组件级幅度与谱分布的初始化方案，并将其与多种权重初始化方法进行比较。这些初始化器显著改变了模型的结构性谱模式，但评估结果并未显示相应的性能优势。预训练权重复用仍具竞争力，而单纯的粗粒度谱匹配并非可靠的优化策略。我们的结果表明，预训练谱是训练模型结构的有用诊断工具，但有效的复用可能需要在组件级尺度与奇异值形状之外保留更丰富的信息。

title: When Does Order Flow Matter? State-Dependent L2 Liquidity-State Transitions in Crypto Futures
abstract: Building event-conditioned market models requires separating macro-event labels from persistent microstructure state. We study this distinction in Binance BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT futures from 2023-2026, combining top-20 L2 order book data, trade-flow records, and macro-event windows. We define a supervised discrete L2 liquidity-state transition task, distinct from latent-regime detection and price-direction prediction, and evaluate models in rolling monthly out-of-sample folds with event-clustered validation and blocked permutation tests, admitting each feature layer only if it improves on the layer below it on the same panel. Within these event windows, the first-order predictive signal is the pre-event L2 liquidity state: a coarse pre-event state baseline strongly predicts post-event liquidity regimes, interpretable logit models over continuous L2 features fail to improve on it, and a shallow nonlinear L2 model adds a robust further gain of comparable size to the state baseline's own. The macro-event calendar enters only by locating the windows and supplying matched non-event controls; we use event timing but not the event's label content, so pre-event state competes against an uninformed within-window baseline, not against the event type. Order flow adds further value only when layered on top of the L2 state model, not as a replacement. This value is not robustly cross-symbol: for ETH it is present across calm, mixed, and stressed regimes and largest under stressed pre-event liquidity, whereas BTC shows only isolated five-minute passes and no regime that clears at both horizons. These findings motivate a state-first design principle for market microstructure models. We provide a liquidity-state transition baseline and evaluation protocol that reinforcement-learning, execution-policy, or LLM-based context layers should exceed before their added value is credited.
tldr: 该论文研究在加密货币期货市场中，事件前L2流动性状态如何预测事件后流动性制度，并发现订单流仅在L2状态模型之上才有附加价值，但跨符号不稳健。
abstract_cn: 构建事件条件市场模型需要将宏观事件标签与持续性微观结构状态相分离。本研究基于2023-2026年币安BTCUSDT和ETHUSDT期货数据，结合前20档L2订单簿数据、交易流记录及宏观事件窗口，对这一区分进行探讨。我们定义了一个有监督的离散L2流动性状态转换任务，该任务区别于潜在状态检测与价格方向预测，并通过滚动月度样本外折叠、事件聚类验证及分块置换检验对模型进行评估，仅当某一特征层在相同面板上优于其下层特征时方予采纳。在这些事件窗口内，一阶预测信号为事件前L2流动性状态：粗略的事件前状态基线能够强有力地预测事件后流动性状态，基于连续L2特征的可解释逻辑模型未能对此加以改进，而浅层非线性L2模型则在此基础上增加了与状态基线自身幅度相当且稳健的额外增益。宏观事件日历仅用于定位窗口并提供匹配的非事件对照组；我们使用事件时间而非事件标签内容，因此事件前状态与窗口内无信息基线进行竞争，而非与事件类型竞争。订单流仅在叠加于L2状态模型之上时才能增加额外价值，而非作为替代。这一价值在跨品种上并不稳健：对于ETH而言，其在平静、混合及压力状态下均存在，且在压力事件前流动性条件下最为显著，而BTC仅显示出孤立的五分钟通过窗口，且无任何状态能在两个时间跨度上均通过检验。这些发现为市场微观结构模型提出了状态优先的设计原则。我们提供了一个流动性状态转换基线及评估协议，强化学习、执行策略或基于大语言模型的上下文层在获得其附加值认可之前，应首先超越该基线。

title: Application of machine learning to monster level prediction in tabletop RPG game design
abstract: Designing balanced adversaries is a central but labor-intensive task in tabletop role-playing game (TTRPG) development. In systems such as Pathfinder, each monster is described by many numerical attributes that jointly determine its power, summarized as an ordinal level. We investigate whether machine learning can support designers by predicting this level from a monster's attributes, framing the task as tabular ordinal regression. We introduce what is, to our knowledge, the first dataset built specifically for TTRPG monster-level prediction, derived from publicly available Pathfinder Second Edition data. Using it, we compare classical regression models with rounding schemes, dedicated tabular ordinal regression algorithms, and neural networks with ordinal-aware losses. To mirror real design workflows, we evaluate all models under chronological and expanding-window protocols with several complementary metrics. Results show that tree-based ensembles outperform linear models and neural approaches, achieving near-perfect ordinal ranking and high predictive accuracy. Explainable AI analyses, such as feature importance and error distributions, show that the model is aligned with human intuition and follows patterns grounded in game rules. Together, these results show that machine learning can reliably approximate designer judgments and serve as an effective computer-aided tool for monster balancing and broader TTRPG system design.
tldr: 该论文探索了使用机器学习（如树集成模型）从怪物属性预测其等级，以辅助桌游设计中的怪物平衡，实验表明树集成模型表现最佳且符合人类直觉。
abstract_cn: 在桌面角色扮演游戏（TTRPG）开发中，设计平衡的敌对角色是一项核心但劳动密集型的工作。在诸如《开拓者》（Pathfinder）等系统中，每个怪物都由多个数值属性描述，这些属性共同决定其强度，并汇总为一个序数等级。我们研究机器学习能否通过从怪物属性预测其等级来支持设计者，并将该任务构建为表格序数回归问题。我们引入了据我们所知首个专门为TTRPG怪物等级预测构建的数据集，该数据集源自公开的《开拓者第二版》（Pathfinder Second Edition）数据。利用该数据集，我们比较了带有取整方案的经典回归模型、专用表格序数回归算法以及采用序数感知损失的神经网络。为模拟真实设计工作流程，我们在时序协议和扩展窗口协议下使用多种互补指标对所有模型进行了评估。结果表明，基于树的集成模型优于线性模型和神经方法，实现了近乎完美的序数排序和高预测精度。可解释人工智能分析（如特征重要性和误差分布）显示，该模型与人类直觉一致，并遵循基于游戏规则的模式。综上所述，这些结果表明机器学习能够可靠地近似设计者的判断，并可作为怪物平衡及更广泛的TTRPG系统设计的有效计算机辅助工具。

title: GenVid2Robot: From Video Generation to Robot Manipulation via Rigid-Geometric Consistency
abstract: Generated videos provide useful visual motion priors for robot manipulation, but their visual plausibility does not imply physical executability. A generated video usually lacks metric geometry, grasp grounding, robot kinematic feasibility, and execution-time feedback, which makes direct trajectory replay unreliable in real-world manipulation. This paper presents GenVid2Robot, a rigid-geometric consistency framework that converts generated video motion into executable real-robot manipulation trajectories. Given an initial RGB-D observation and a task instruction, GenVid2Robot samples task-relevant semantic anchors from the real first frame, tracks these anchors through generated video candidates, and verifies whether the resulting 2D motion can be explained by first-frame RGB-D anchors under a sparse relative $SE(3)$ model. In this way, generated videos are treated as uncertain visual motion hypotheses rather than direct robot demonstrations. Only geometrically consistent motion is transferred to the robot. The accepted relative motion is then applied to the real grasp-time TCP pose selected by mask-constrained grasping, producing a grasp-conditioned execution trajectory that is consistent with both the visual motion prior and the physical grasp configuration. To reduce execution mismatch caused by RGB-D noise, calibration residuals, and small contact-induced displacement, a bounded depth-compensation module corrects local depth-direction errors without assuming full online replanning. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that GenVid2Robot improves the reliability of generated-video-guided manipulation by grounding visual motion priors with sparse metric geometry, grasp constraints, robot feasibility checking, and bounded execution feedback.
tldr: 该论文提出GenVid2Robot框架，利用刚性几何一致性将生成的视频运动转换为可执行的机器人操作轨迹，提高了视频引导操作的可靠性。
abstract_cn: 生成视频为机器人操作提供了有用的视觉运动先验，但其视觉合理性并不等同于物理可执行性。生成的视频通常缺乏度量几何、抓取基础、机器人运动学可行性以及执行时的反馈，这使得直接轨迹重放在真实操作中不可靠。本文提出GenVid2Robot，一个刚性几何一致性框架，可将生成的视频运动转换为可执行的真实机器人操作轨迹。给定初始RGB-D观测和任务指令，GenVid2Robot从真实首帧中采样与任务相关的语义锚点，通过生成的视频候选帧追踪这些锚点，并验证在稀疏相对$SE(3)$模型下，所得二维运动是否可由首帧RGB-D锚点解释。通过这种方式，生成视频被视为不确定的视觉运动假设，而非直接的机器人演示。只有几何一致的运动被传递给机器人。随后，将接受的相对运动应用于由掩码约束抓取选择的真实抓取时刻TCP位姿，生成与视觉运动先验和物理抓取配置一致的、以抓取为条件的执行轨迹。为减少由RGB-D噪声、标定残差及微小接触位移引起的执行失配，一个有限深度补偿模块在不假设完全在线重规划的情况下，校正局部深度方向误差。真实机器人实验表明，GenVid2Robot通过将视觉运动先验与稀疏度量几何、抓取约束、机器人可行性检查及有限执行反馈相结合，提升了生成视频引导操作的可靠性。

title: Understanding Schedule-Free Methods in Nonconvex Optimization: Rate Guarantees and Escaping Saddles
abstract: Schedule-Free methods have attracted growing interest for alleviating the burden of designing and tuning a learning rate scheduler, while matching and sometimes even outperforming optimizers with tuned schedulers. Despite their strong empirical results, their convergence theory in nonconvex optimization, where modern machine learning objectives typically arise, has remained largely unexplored. In this paper, we provide worst-case analyses of Schedule-Free gradient descent and Schedule-Free stochastic gradient descent, in their standard form and without auxiliary modifications or restrictive conditions, for smooth but possibly nonconvex objectives. Based on a Lyapunov analysis derived from the continuous-time limiting ordinary differential equation associated with these methods, we show that Schedule-Free gradient descent and Schedule-Free stochastic gradient descent achieve the optimal worst-case convergence rates attainable among first-order methods. We further formulate Schedule-Free gradient descent as a nonautonomous dynamical system and prove strict-saddle avoidance under an arbitrarily small one-time perturbation. These theoretical results provide a better understanding of the strong performance that Schedule-Free methods demonstrate.
tldr: 论文证明了Schedule-Free梯度下降和随机梯度下降在非凸优化中达到最优最坏情况收敛率，并证明了其能逃逸严格鞍点。
abstract_cn: 无调度方法（Schedule-Free methods）因能够减轻设计及调整学习率调度器（learning rate scheduler）的负担，同时达到甚至有时超越配备经过调优调度器的优化器之性能，而日益受到关注。尽管这些方法在实证中表现强劲，但其在非凸优化（现代机器学习目标函数通常所属的领域）中的收敛理论仍基本未被探索。本文针对平滑但可能非凸的目标函数，对标准形式且无辅助修改或限制性条件的无调度梯度下降法（Schedule-Free gradient descent）与无调度随机梯度下降法（Schedule-Free stochastic gradient descent）进行了最坏情况分析。基于从这些方法所关联的连续时间极限常微分方程（ordinary differential equation）导出的李雅普诺夫分析（Lyapunov analysis），我们证明了无调度梯度下降法与无调度随机梯度下降法能够达到一阶方法（first-order methods）中可实现的最优最坏情况收敛速率。我们进一步将无调度梯度下降法构建为非自治动力系统（nonautonomous dynamical system），并证明在任意小的单次扰动下该方法可避免严格鞍点（strict-saddle）。这些理论结果有助于更深入地理解无调度方法所展现出的优异性能。

title: COAST: Context-Aware Differential Learning for Gene Expression Prediction in Spatial Transcriptomics
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics enables profiling of spatial gene expression but is limited by high cost and low throughput, motivating prediction from H&E histopathology images. Existing context-aware methods mainly supervise absolute expression, while relative expression relationships between spots are rarely used explicitly. We propose COAST, a context-aware differential learning framework for spatial gene expression prediction. COAST conditions the local and global context features with type-specific modulation and aggregates the target and context spot tokens using a Transformer encoder to capture both fine-grained local patterns and slide-level structure. It is trained with a joint objective that combines absolute expression regression with signed differential regression between the target and context spots. Experiments on multiple spatial transcriptomics datasets show consistent improvements in correlation- and distribution-based metrics, demonstrating the effectiveness of context-aware differential learning for histology-based spatial gene expression prediction.
tldr: 该论文提出COAST框架，通过上下文感知差分学习从H&E图像预测空间基因表达，结合绝对和相对表达回归，在多个数据集上取得一致改进。
abstract_cn: 空间转录组学能够解析基因表达的空间分布，但受限于高成本和低通量，因此推动了基于H&E组织病理学图像的预测研究。现有上下文感知方法主要监督绝对表达量，而不同检测点之间的相对表达关系鲜少被显式利用。我们提出COAST——一种用于空间基因表达预测的上下文感知差分学习框架。COAST通过类型特异性调制对局部和全局上下文特征进行条件化处理，并利用Transformer编码器聚合目标检测点与上下文检测点的标记，从而同时捕获细粒度局部模式与全切片级结构。该框架采用联合目标函数进行训练，该函数将绝对表达回归与目标及上下文检测点之间的有符号差分回归相结合。在多个空间转录组学数据集上的实验表明，基于相关性和分布的评价指标均取得一致性提升，验证了上下文感知差分学习在基于组织学的空间基因表达预测中的有效性。

title: Control Laguerre Tessellation: Semi-discrete Optimal Transport Over Control Systems
abstract: We study the optimal transport of optimally controlled agents from a compactly supported absolutely continuous source to a discrete target measure. The ground cost for the transport is induced by the optimal cost of the agents' motion. When this ground cost satisfies the twist condition, the optimal transport map is given almost everywhere in terms of a Laguerre tessellation of the state space. We refer to this control-theoretic generalization of Laguerre tessellation as Control Laguerre Tessellation (CLT), and illustrate it for two ground costs induced by linear controlled agents with minimum energy and minimum time objectives.
tldr: 该论文提出了控制Laguerre镶嵌（CLT），用于解决控制系统中从连续源到离散目标测度的最优传输问题，并在线性受控代理的最小能量和最小时间目标下进行了验证。
abstract_cn: 我们研究从紧支撑绝对连续源测度到离散目标测度的最优控制智能体的最优输运问题。输运的地面成本由智能体运动的最优成本诱导。当地面成本满足扭曲条件时，最优输运映射几乎处处由状态空间的拉盖尔镶嵌给出。我们将这种拉盖尔镶嵌在控制论中的推广称为控制拉盖尔镶嵌（Control Laguerre Tessellation, CLT），并针对由线性控制智能体在最小能量和最小时间目标下诱导的两种地面成本进行了实例说明。

title: Present but Rescaled: Chat-to-Agent Transfer of Additive Activation Steering
abstract: Additive activation steering (injecting a scaled residual-stream direction during generation) is calibrated almost entirely in single-turn chat, yet the models it targets are increasingly deployed as tool-using ReAct agents. We present the first systematic chat-to-agent transfer study of additive steering, coupling behavioral measurement with a representation read-out in a matched-information design: the same items rendered as plain chat or as a ReAct tool-use episode, with matched-norm random-direction controls and the transcript re-encoded every turn to exclude KV-cache contamination. Transfer is real but rescaled, and the right description is a dissociation: the injected direction reaches the late layers at near-full strength in every setting and model tested (install-site agent-over-chat ratios 0.83-1.16 across three families), while the behavioral coupling is reset per model and context. On Qwen2.5-7B a refusal bypass vector amplifies in the agent (T = 1.45, CI [1.20, 1.78], N = 300); across a powered uniform-protocol distribution the coupling spans amplification (Gemma-2-9B T = 2.00) to attenuation (Yi-1.5-9B T = 0.43, CI [0.29, 0.60]), with no universal constant and a single clean attenuator against a universal sign. Directional ablation of the same axis does not amplify (T = 0.93, CI including 1) while additive injection amplifies (T = 1.50), a 20.1-point gain difference (CI [13.4, 26.8]) that identifies an additive-specific mechanism. Two pre-registered instruments converge to localize the rescaling to the ReAct format scaffold, before any tool observation, rather than to the observation boundary where a dilution account would predict it. The safety implication is immediate and unpredictable: agentic deployment amplifies steering-based refusal bypass by up to 2.00x on some models while others attenuate, so a deployment cannot assume a given model is safe under additive steering.
tldr: 该论文研究将对话中的加法激活转向技术迁移到工具使用的ReAct智能体场景，发现迁移效果存在缩放且不可预测，对模型安全性有重要影响。
abstract_cn: 加法激活引导（在生成过程中注入缩放后的残差流方向）几乎完全在单轮对话中完成校准，但其目标模型正越来越多地被部署为使用工具的ReAct智能体。我们首次对加法引导进行了系统的从对话到智能体的迁移研究，将行为测量与匹配信息设计中的表征读取相结合：相同项目分别以纯对话形式或ReAct工具使用片段形式呈现，并采用匹配范数的随机方向对照，同时每轮对话重新编码转录以排除KV缓存污染。迁移是真实存在的但发生了重新缩放，而正确的描述是一种分离：注入的方向在每种设置和测试模型（三个模型家族的安装点智能体与对话比率在0.83-1.16之间）中几乎以全强度到达深层，而行为耦合则随每个模型和上下文重置。在Qwen2.5-7B上，拒绝绕过向量在智能体中放大（T = 1.45，置信区间[1.20, 1.78]，N = 300）；在功率均匀协议分布中，耦合范围从放大（Gemma-2-9B T = 2.00）到衰减（Yi-1.5-9B T = 0.43，置信区间[0.29, 0.60]），不存在通用常数，且只有一个干净的衰减器与通用符号相对。同一轴的方向消融不会放大（T = 0.93，置信区间包含1），而加法注入则放大（T = 1.50），两者相差20.1个点（置信区间[13.4, 26.8]），这表明存在一种加法特异性机制。两个预注册工具一致地将重新缩放定位到ReAct格式框架（在任何工具观测之前），而非稀释解释所预期的观测边界。其安全影响是直接且不可预测的：智能体部署在某些模型上将基于引导的拒绝绕过放大至多2.00倍，而其他模型则衰减，因此部署不能假定给定模型在加法引导下是安全的。

title: Toward Real-Time Sentence-Level Sign Language Translation
abstract: Most sign language understanding systems operate at the level of isolated signs, limiting their usefulness in natural communication. We study sentence-level sign language translation (SLT) with the primary goal of real-time deployment rather than proposing a new translation architecture. We fine-tune a SHuBERT-ByT5 translation stack on a uniformly sampled 9,872-example subset of How2Sign, selected because of compute and storage constraints, using QLoRA while keeping SHuBERT frozen. The model obtains a validation BLEU of 16.7 and, on the test split, BLEU 15.9 and BLEURT 44.7. The main contribution is a hardware-aware streaming system: a Raspberry Pi 4B reference client provides camera capture, local text display, and speech output, while compute-intensive perception and translation run on a CPU/GPU backend. The capture protocol remains client-agnostic, so the same backend can serve a browser, phone, or laptop. Chunked ingestion, bounded queues, parallelized perception, temporal reordering, and a sentence-boundary state machine reduce mean post-finalization response latency from 1.873 to 1.354 seconds (27.71%) and P95 latency from 2.919 to 2.130 seconds (27.03%) over the complete 9,872-example working subset.
tldr: 该论文研究实时句子级手语翻译系统，通过微调SHuBERT-ByT5模型并设计硬件感知的流式系统，在How2Sign数据集上实现了BLEU 15.9，并将延迟降低27%。
abstract_cn: 大多数手语理解系统仅在孤立手势层面运行，这限制了其在自然交流中的实用性。本文研究句子级手语翻译（SLT），主要目标是实现实时部署，而非提出新的翻译架构。我们在How2Sign数据集中均匀采样的9,872个样本子集上（因计算与存储限制而选取），采用QLoRA方法对SHuBERT-ByT5翻译栈进行微调，同时保持SHuBERT冻结。模型在验证集上获得BLEU 16.7，在测试集上获得BLEU 15.9与BLEURT 44.7。主要贡献在于提出一种硬件感知的流式系统：树莓派4B（Raspberry Pi 4B）参考客户端负责摄像头采集、本地文本显示与语音输出，而计算密集型的感知与翻译任务运行于CPU/GPU后端。采集协议保持客户端无关性，因此同一后端可服务于浏览器、手机或笔记本电脑。通过分块摄入、有界队列、并行化感知、时序重排及句子边界状态机，在完整9,872个样本工作子集上，平均最终响应延迟从1.873秒降至1.354秒（降幅27.71%），P95延迟从2.919秒降至2.130秒（降幅27.03%）。

title: Tokenizer Transplantation: Mitigating Autoregressive Collapse in Edge-Efficient Bengali ASR
abstract: Lightweight speech recognition models are critical for edge deployment, yet highly optimized architectures like Moonshine often fail on morphologically rich, non-Latin languages such as Bengali. This study identifies the root cause of this failure as the model's English-centric byte-level tokenizer, which fragments Bengali words into high-fertility byte chains and triggers catastrophic autoregressive collapse during inference. To resolve this, a novel vocabulary transplantation pipeline is proposed to replace the decoder vocabulary with the native-script BanglaBERT WordPiece vocabulary and resize the corresponding token embedding matrix. Experimental results demonstrate a reduction in token fertility from 9.16 to 1.30. By decreasing autoregressive sequence length by 85.8%, decoding instability is entirely mitigated. When evaluated on the 882-hour Lipi-Ghor dataset, the modified architecture achieves a competitive 21.54% Word Error Rate (WER) and a Real-Time Factor (RTF) of 0.0053. Ultimately, this research provides a scalable, reproducible blueprint for cross-script adaptation of compact ASR models without the need for resource-intensive pre-training.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种分词器移植方法，通过替换英文中心的分词器为孟加拉语原生WordPiece分词器，解决了轻量级ASR模型在孟加拉语上的自回归崩溃问题，显著降低了词错误率和实时因子。
abstract_cn: 轻量级语音识别模型对于边缘端部署至关重要，然而像Moonshine这类高度优化的架构在处理形态丰富、非拉丁语系语言（如孟加拉语）时往往表现不佳。本研究将这一失败的根源归结为模型以英语为中心的字节级分词器（tokenizer），该分词器将孟加拉语单词分割为高生育率（high-fertility）字节链，并在推理过程中引发灾难性的自回归崩溃（catastrophic autoregressive collapse）。为解决此问题，本文提出了一种新颖的词汇移植（vocabulary transplantation）流程，用原生文字的BanglaBERT WordPiece词汇替换解码器词汇表，并相应调整词嵌入矩阵的尺寸。实验结果表明，词元生育率（token fertility）从9.16降至1.30。通过将自回归序列长度减少85.8%，解码不稳定性被完全消除。在882小时的Lipi-Ghor数据集上评估时，改进后的架构实现了具有竞争力的21.54%词错误率（Word Error Rate, WER）和0.0053的实时因子（Real-Time Factor, RTF）。最终，本研究为紧凑型ASR模型的跨文字适配提供了一种可扩展、可复现的蓝图，且无需进行资源密集型的预训练。

title: FreyaTTS Technical Report
abstract: We introduce Freya-TTS, a compact, tokenizer-free, Turkish-first text-to-speech model designed for highly reliable and efficient conversational synthesis. Freya-TTS is a 183.2M-parameter non-autoregressive conditional flow-matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that operates in the frozen continuous latent space of AudioVAE2 (16 kHz encode, 48 kHz decode), allowing the model to focus its capacity on text-to-latent mapping while inheriting high-quality 48 kHz reconstruction. We advance the framework along three key dimensions: (1) rule-free end-to-end modeling from a 92-symbol Turkish character vocabulary without a phonemizer, grapheme-to-phoneme frontend, or discrete speech tokenizer; (2) non-autoregressive parallel denoising, which predicts the entire latent sequence simultaneously over a predicted duration; and (3) a production-oriented two-stage post-training recipe consisting of single-speaker voice locking and short-utterance coverage, improving speaker consistency and robustness on short inputs. On the Freya-TR-Eval benchmark, Freya-TTS achieves a band-matched word error rate (WER) of 8.0% and character error rate (CER) of 3.0%, outperforming substantially larger open-source systems while using a fraction of their parameters. The model achieves a real-time factor of 0.11 on consumer GPUs and runs faster than real time on a laptop CPU, making it well suited for resource-constrained edge deployment. We release the model weights, training and inference code, and evaluation benchmark under the Apache-2.0 license.
tldr: 该论文提出了Freya-TTS，一个紧凑的、无分词器的土耳其语文本到语音模型，采用非自回归条件流匹配扩散变换器，在低资源下实现了高可靠性和高效率的语音合成。
abstract_cn: 我们提出Freya-TTS，一种紧凑、无分词器、以土耳其语优先的文本转语音模型，专为高可靠性和高效率的对话式合成而设计。Freya-TTS是一个1.832亿参数的非自回归条件流匹配扩散变换器（Diffusion Transformer, DiT），在AudioVAE2（16 kHz编码，48 kHz解码）的冻结连续潜空间中运行，使模型能够将其能力集中于文本到潜空间的映射，同时继承48 kHz的高质量重建。我们从三个关键维度推进该框架：（1）基于92个符号的土耳其语字符词汇表进行无规则端到端建模，无需音素化器、字素到音素前端或离散语音分词器；（2）非自回归并行去噪，在预测的时长上同时预测整个潜序列；（3）面向生产的两阶段后训练方案，包括单说话人语音锁定和短语句覆盖，从而提升说话人一致性和对短输入的鲁棒性。在Freya-TR-Eval基准测试上，Freya-TTS实现了8.0%的频带匹配词错误率（Word Error Rate, WER）和3.0%的字符错误率（Character Error Rate, CER），在仅使用其参数一小部分的情况下，性能优于规模大得多的开源系统。该模型在消费级GPU上达到0.11的实时因子，并在笔记本电脑CPU上实现超实时运行，使其非常适合资源受限的边缘部署。我们以Apache-2.0许可证发布模型权重、训练与推理代码以及评估基准。

title: Normalisation-Based Likelihood Ratio Estimation for Forensic Authorship Verification
abstract: Authorship verification (AV) is the task of determining whether two texts were written by the same author. In a forensic context, the strength of AV evidence can be quantified using likelihood ratios. Most AV methods are score-based and deriving well-calibrated likelihood ratios from these scores requires a separate calibration model. This, in turn, requires additional amounts of case-relevant data, which is often time-consuming to obtain and prepare. This study proposes two novel normalisation techniques, the Square Root Correction and the Hapax Correction, for deriving likelihood ratios from the AV method LambdaG without the need of a calibration model (Nini et al. 2026). These corrections are designed to mitigate the overestimation of evidential strength that may result from long or highly repetitive texts. Performance is evaluated against logistic regression calibration across fifteen corpora and a range of text lengths (100-9,500 tokens), using the log-likelihood ratio cost (Cllr). The proposed methods achieve performance comparable to logistic regression calibration, with the Hapax Correction outperforming it in approximately 45% of tests (weighted by corpora). Furthermore, performance was more frequently close (within 5%) when the Hapax Correction was outperformed by logistic regression calibration, compared with the reverse comparison. Eliminating the need to train a calibration model reduces data-requirements, time and complexity, thereby increasing the accessibility and transparency of forensic text comparison. This combination of empirical performance and practical advantages supports the adoption of the proposed methods in forensic settings.
tldr: 该论文提出两种归一化技术（平方根校正和Hapax校正），用于从LambdaG方法中推导似然比，无需校准模型，在法医作者身份验证中表现与逻辑回归校准相当。
abstract_cn: 作者身份验证（Authorship Verification, AV）是判断两篇文本是否由同一作者撰写的任务。在法医语境下，AV证据的强度可通过似然比（likelihood ratios）进行量化。大多数AV方法基于评分，而从这些评分中推导出校准良好的似然比需要单独的校准模型。这反过来又需要额外数量的案件相关数据，而获取和准备这些数据通常耗时费力。本研究提出了两种新颖的归一化技术——平方根校正（Square Root Correction）与罕用词校正（Hapax Correction），用于从AV方法LambdaG中推导似然比，而无需校准模型（Nini等，2026）。这些校正旨在减轻因文本过长或高度重复可能导致的证据强度高估问题。通过使用对数似然比成本（log-likelihood ratio cost, Cllr），在十五个语料库及一系列文本长度（100-9,500个词元）上，将性能与逻辑回归校准（logistic regression calibration）进行了比较。所提出的方法实现了与逻辑回归校准相当的性能，其中罕用词校正在大约45%的测试中（按语料库加权）表现更优。此外，当罕用词校正被逻辑回归校准超越时，其性能更频繁地接近（差异在5%以内），而反向比较中则较少出现这种情况。消除训练校准模型的需求降低了数据需求、时间和复杂度，从而提高了法医文本比较的可及性与透明度。这种实证性能与实践优势的结合，支持了所提方法在法医场景中的应用。

title: DKCD: Domain Knowledge-Enhanced Causal Discovery from Unstructured Data
abstract: Causal discovery from unstructured data is a challenging yet underexplored task in high-expertise domains such as healthcare, finance, and education. Existing methods typically leverage the general knowledge of large language models (LLMs) to identify causal factors from unstructured data and annotate them into structured data for causal graph construction. However, they remain limited by two key challenges (CHs): (CH1) insufficient identification of latent factors, which are implicit in the data yet essential for causal discovery, due to the lack of domain-specific knowledge; and (CH2) unreliable factor annotation, caused by the lack of domain-grounded reasoning, which propagates errors to the resulting causal graphs. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel Domain Knowledge-enhanced Causal Discovery framework (DKCD) for causal discovery from unstructured data in high-expertise domains with three interconnected components: (1) Knowledge Mining: It retrieves relevant domain knowledge based on observable factors to support subsequent causal reasoning. (2) Knowledge-guided Causal Reasoning: Reasoning with relevant knowledge, it discovers latent causal factors to address CH1 and generates key causal clues for more accurate data annotation to address CH2. (3) Causal Structure Discovery: It constructs the final causal graphs based on a more complete factor set and accurate annotations. Experiments on two domain-specific datasets show that DKCD significantly improves both causal factor identification and causal graph construction.
tldr: 该论文提出DKCD框架，利用领域知识增强从非结构化数据中发现因果关系，解决了潜在因素识别不足和标注不可靠的问题。
abstract_cn: 从非结构化数据中进行因果发现是一项具有挑战性且在高专业度领域（如医疗、金融和教育）中尚未充分探索的任务。现有方法通常利用大语言模型（LLMs）的通用知识，从非结构化数据中识别因果因素，并将其标注为结构化数据以构建因果图。然而，这些方法仍受到两个关键挑战（CHs）的限制：（CH1）由于缺乏领域特定知识，对潜在因素（即数据中隐含但对因果发现至关重要的因素）的识别不足；（CH2）由于缺乏基于领域的推理，导致因素标注不可靠，从而将错误传播至最终生成的因果图。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的领域知识增强型因果发现框架（DKCD），用于在高专业度领域从非结构化数据中进行因果发现，该框架包含三个相互关联的组件：（1）知识挖掘：基于可观测因素检索相关领域知识，以支持后续因果推理。（2）知识引导的因果推理：通过相关知识进行推理，发现潜在因果因素以应对CH1，并生成关键因果线索以实现更准确的数据标注，从而应对CH2。（3）因果结构发现：基于更完整的因素集和准确的标注构建最终因果图。在两个领域特定数据集上的实验表明，DKCD在因果因素识别和因果图构建方面均取得了显著改进。

title: Towards Detecting Inconsistencies in End-to-end Generated TODs
abstract: Generative AI is profoundly transforming the core technologies behind conversational systems, shifting from component-based to end-to-end approaches. However, Large Language Models (LLMs) may still generate inconsistencies, a critical issue particularly in Task-Oriented Dialogues (TODs), where system responses must strictly adhere to information from a domain knowledge base (e.g., restaurants in a city). A single hallucination (e.g., suggesting a non-existent restaurant) can lead to severe task failures. We investigate a method for automatically detecting inconsistencies by conceptualizing TODs as a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP), where variables represent dialogue segments referencing the conversational domain, and constraints among variables capture dialogue properties such as turn coherence and adherence to domain knowledge. We propose a pipeline that first identifies variables in a target dialogue and then applies a CSP solver to identify valid solutions. By comparing the target dialogue with valid variable assignments, we can detect inconsistencies and suggest minimal changes to ensure dialogue consistency. We demonstrate the high accuracy of the CSP-based approach in detecting inconsistencies, and provide a detailed analysis of our findings.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于约束满足问题的方法来检测端到端生成的任务导向对话中的不一致性，通过将对话建模为CSP并求解，有效识别并建议修正对话中的矛盾。
abstract_cn: 生成式人工智能正深刻变革对话系统的核心技术，推动其从基于组件的架构向端到端方法演进。然而，大语言模型仍可能产生不一致性问题，这在任务导向型对话中尤为关键——此类系统的响应必须严格遵循领域知识库（例如某城市的餐厅信息）中的内容。单一幻觉（如推荐一家不存在的餐厅）就可能导致严重的任务失败。我们研究了一种自动检测不一致性的方法，通过将任务导向型对话概念化为约束满足问题，其中变量代表引用对话领域的语段，变量间的约束则捕捉对话属性（如话轮连贯性与领域知识遵循度）。我们提出一个流水线：首先识别目标对话中的变量，随后应用约束满足问题求解器寻找有效解。通过对比目标对话与有效变量赋值，可检测不一致性并建议最小化修改方案以确保对话一致性。我们验证了基于约束满足问题的方法在检测不一致性方面的高准确性，并对研究结果进行了详细分析。

title: Letter Lemmatization: One-to-one and Banded RNNs for Reversing Character-Set Simplification and Abbreviation in Medieval Text
abstract: Medieval document transcribers have very different practices; on top of that, heterogeneous digitization policies have resulted in corpora where the character-set must be viewed as fluid. In this paper we address the problem of changing between character-sets in a flexible manner. We focus on one-to-one character mappings and train characterlevel one-to-one RNNs to undo them with self-supervision; recovering half the CER even with 20 text lines. We analyse the use of these one-to-one networks for HTR post-correction and we see that they obtain significant improvements while totally ignoring ins-dels. We then use the exact same networks with character-level alignment groundtruth compiled from parallel corpora in a training and inference mode we call Banded RNNs. We use such networks to successfully expand abbreviations in medieval charter transcriptions. Finally we introduce an elaborate heuristic which takes the characters of two arbitrary character-sets and defines a metric encapsulating what we consider to be semantic similarity of characters. We call the construction of such mappings letter lemmatization and present a rich Python library that efficiently performs all presented methods.
tldr: 论文提出了一种称为字母词元化的方法，使用一对一的RNN和带状RNN来逆转中世纪文本中的字符集简化和缩写，通过自监督和并行语料库实现有效的后校正和缩写扩展。
abstract_cn: 中世纪文献抄写员的实践方式差异显著；此外，异构的数字化政策导致语料库中的字符集必须被视为动态变化的。本文探讨了如何在字符集之间灵活切换的问题。我们聚焦于一对一字符映射，并训练字符级的一对一循环神经网络（RNN）通过自监督方式撤销这些映射；即便仅使用20行文本，也能恢复一半的字符错误率（CER）。我们分析了这些一对一网络在手写文本识别（HTR）后校正中的应用，发现它们在完全忽略插入-删除（ins-dels）的情况下仍能取得显著改进。随后，我们利用完全相同的网络，结合从平行语料库中编译的字符级对齐真实数据，采用一种我们称为带状RNN（Banded RNNs）的训练与推理模式。我们使用此类网络成功扩展了中世纪宪章转录中的缩写词。最后，我们引入了一种精细的启发式方法，该方法通过两个任意字符集的字符定义了一种度量标准，用以封装我们认为的字符语义相似性。我们将此类映射的构建称为词形归并（letter lemmatization），并提供了一个功能丰富的Python库，可高效执行所有提出的方法。

title: Generative Recommendation: Towards Personalized Multimodal Content Generation
abstract: Traditional recommender systems primarily retrieve items from a pre-defined item corpus for personalized recommendations. However, this a retrieval-based paradigm faces two major constraints: 1) the existing item corpus with human-generated items may not adequately satisfy users' diverse information needs, and 2) users often rely on passive and noisy feedback (e.g., clicks) to refine the recommendations. To overcome the limitations, the rapid advancement of AI-Generated Content (AIGC) presents significant potential: 1) generative AI promotes the creation of personalized multimodal content as new items to satisfy users' information needs, and 2) large language models reduce the efforts of users to express information needs proactively in natural language. In this light, we propose a novel Generative Recommender paradigm named GeneRec with two objectives: 1) generating personalized multimodal content, and 2) integrating proactive user instructions to guide content generation. To achieve the objectives, GeneRec introduces an AI generator to personalize multimodal content generation and leverages user instructions to obtain users' information needs. Specifically, GeneRec first employs an instructor to pre-process users' instructions and traditional feedback (e.g., clicks) to extract generation guidance. Following the guidance, we develop the AI generator with an AI editor to edit existing items and an AI creator to create new items, respectively. Lastly, we study the feasibility of implementing the AI creator in the fashion domain, showing promising results. Furthermore, to ensure the trustworthiness of the generated items, we emphasize various trustworthiness checks such as fairness and safety checks.

abstract_cn: 传统推荐系统主要从预定义的项目库中检索内容以进行个性化推荐。然而，这种基于检索的范式面临两大限制：1）现有由人工生成的项目库可能无法充分满足用户多样化的信息需求；2）用户通常依赖被动且带有噪声的反馈（例如点击）来优化推荐结果。为克服这些局限，人工智能生成内容（AI-Generated Content, AIGC）的快速发展展现出巨大潜力：1）生成式AI能够促进创建个性化多模态内容作为新项目，以满足用户的信息需求；2）大型语言模型降低了用户主动用自然语言表达信息需求的难度。基于此，我们提出一种名为GeneRec的新型生成式推荐范式，其目标包括：1）生成个性化多模态内容；2）整合用户主动指令以指导内容生成。为实现这些目标，GeneRec引入AI生成器来个性化生成多模态内容，并利用用户指令获取其信息需求。具体而言，GeneRec首先使用指令处理器对用户指令及传统反馈（如点击）进行预处理，以提取生成指导信息。随后，我们开发了包含AI编辑器和AI创建器的AI生成器，分别用于编辑现有项目与创建新项目。最后，我们在时尚领域验证了AI创建器的可行性，并取得了令人鼓舞的结果。此外，为确保生成内容的可信度，我们强调了多种可信度检查机制，例如公平性检查与安全性检查。

title: Conf-GNNRec: Quantifying and Calibrating the Prediction Confidence for GNN-based Recommendation Methods
abstract: Recommender systems based on graph neural networks perform well in tasks such as rating and ranking. However, in real-world recommendation scenarios, noise such as user misuse and malicious advertisement gradually accumulates through the message propagation mechanism. Even if existing studies mitigate their effects by reducing the noise propagation weights, the severe sparsity of the recommender system still leads to the low-weighted noisy neighbors being mistaken as meaningful information, and the prediction result obtained based on the polluted nodes is not entirely trustworthy. Therefore, it is crucial to measure the confidence of the prediction results in this highly noisy framework. Furthermore, our evaluation of the existing representative GNN-based recommendation shows that it suffers from overconfidence. Based on the above considerations, we propose a new method to quantify and calibrate the prediction confidence of GNN-based recommendations (Conf-GNNRec). Specifically, we propose a rating calibration method that dynamically adjusts excessive ratings to mitigate overconfidence based on user personalization. We also design a confidence loss function to reduce the overconfidence of negative samples and effectively improve recommendation performance. Experiments on public datasets demonstrate the validity of Conf-GNNRec in prediction confidence and recommendation performance.
semantic_scholar_tldr: A rating calibration method that dynamically adjusts excessive ratings to mitigate overconfidence based on user personalization is proposed and a confidence loss function is designed to reduce the overconfidence of negative samples and effectively improve recommendation performance.
topics: Radiomics and Machine Learning in Medical Imaging
tldr: 针对图神经网络推荐系统存在的过自信问题，提出Conf-GNNRec方法，通过评分校准和置信度损失函数量化并校准预测置信度，提升推荐性能。
abstract_cn: 基于图神经网络的推荐系统在评分与排序等任务中表现优异。然而，在真实推荐场景中，用户误操作与恶意广告等噪声会通过消息传播机制逐渐累积。尽管现有研究通过降低噪声传播权重来减轻其影响，但推荐系统严重的稀疏性仍会导致低权重噪声邻居被误判为有效信息，且基于受污染节点获得的预测结果并非完全可信。因此，在高噪声框架下衡量预测结果的置信度至关重要。此外，我们对现有代表性基于图神经网络的推荐方法进行评估后发现，其存在过度自信问题。基于上述考量，我们提出了一种量化与校准基于图神经网络的推荐预测置信度的新方法（Conf-GNNRec）。具体而言，我们提出了一种评分校准方法，该方法基于用户个性化动态调整过度评分以缓解过度自信；同时设计了一种置信度损失函数，以降低负样本的过度自信程度，从而有效提升推荐性能。在公开数据集上的实验验证了Conf-GNNRec在预测置信度与推荐性能方面的有效性。

title: Score-Only Distillation for Compact Dense Retrieval
abstract: Large embedding models improve retrieval quality, but serving large encoders online is expensive. We study whether a compact retriever can learn teacher ranking behavior from score vectors without access to teacher hidden states. The student trains on rows built from ground-truth positives and negative candidates produced by our data generation pipeline; we evaluate student-teacher hard-negative mining separately as an extension. We use a row-centered score-vector objective, a memory-efficient implementation of uniform all-pairs PairMSE loss. On a fixed eight-task evaluation panel, our distillation protocol recovers up to 50\% of the base-to-teacher gap. The distilled 0.6B student is 4.7$\times$ faster for query encoding and 9.7$\times$ faster for document encoding than sequential online teacher fusion. External-transfer performance after distillation remains mixed, so our evidence supports compression of teacher rankings under matched retrieval protocols.
tldr: 论文研究如何通过分数蒸馏训练紧凑的密集检索器，以在保持检索质量的同时提升推理速度，实验表明该方法能恢复教师模型性能差距的50%。
abstract_cn: 大型嵌入模型能够提升检索质量，但在线部署大型编码器的成本高昂。本文研究紧凑型检索器能否在不访问教师模型隐藏状态的情况下，通过得分向量学习教师模型的排序行为。学生模型基于由真实正例及我们数据生成流水线产生的负例候选所构成的行进行训练；我们将学生-教师难负例挖掘作为扩展任务单独评估。我们采用以行为中心的得分向量目标函数，该函数是统一全配对PairMSE损失的一种内存高效实现。在固定的八任务评估面板上，我们的蒸馏协议可恢复基线与教师模型之间差距的50%。蒸馏后的0.6B参数学生模型在查询编码速度上比顺序在线教师融合快4.7倍，在文档编码速度上快9.7倍。蒸馏后的外部迁移性能仍存在差异，因此我们的证据支持在匹配的检索协议下对教师排序进行压缩。

title: PaperRouter-Agent: A Content-Grounded LLM Agent for Personalized Hierarchical Paper Routing
abstract: Researchers organize the papers they collect into personal folder hierarchies in reference managers, and route each new paper into the folder where it belongs. This task differs from standard hierarchical text classification. A user's folder hierarchy is not a fixed, shared taxonomy but a private and evolving folksonomy whose folder meanings may be topical, shorthand, venue-based, or process-oriented, and are often defined by the papers already stored inside them. We formalize this setting as personalized hierarchical paper routing (PHPR): assigning an incoming paper to folders in a user-specific hierarchy without per-user training. We propose PaperRouter-Agent, a training-free LLM agent that grounds routing decisions in folder members rather than folder names alone. The agent first narrows the candidate hierarchy, retrieves folder-specific evidence, verifies fit by inspecting member papers, and incorporates similarity-gated feedback from past user rejections. A formative study on real personal libraries shows that PaperRouter-Agent raises overall Recall@1 from 0.39 to 0.61 and Recall@3 from 0.57 to 0.83, with the largest gains on organizational folders defined by metadata such as venue or year, where single-shot methods collapses (Recall@1 0.09 to 0.50). On the public LaMP-2 benchmark, the same approach improves accuracy from 44.5% to 51.5% (+9.0 macro-F1) over a single-shot baseline, while remaining low-cost for practical use.
tldr: 论文提出PaperRouter-Agent，一个无需训练的LLM代理，通过利用文件夹内论文内容而非仅名称，实现个性化层次化论文路由，在真实个人库和公共基准上显著提升路由准确率。
abstract_cn: 研究人员将其收集的论文在文献管理工具中组织成个人文件夹层级结构，并将每篇新论文归入其所属文件夹。该任务不同于标准的分层文本分类。用户的文件夹层级并非固定共享的分类体系，而是一种私有的、不断演化的分众分类法（folksonomy），其文件夹含义可能涉及主题、简写、来源或流程导向，且通常由已存储其中的论文所定义。我们将这一场景形式化为个性化分层论文路由（personalized hierarchical paper routing, PHPR）：在无需针对每个用户进行训练的情况下，将新论文分配到用户特定层级中的文件夹。我们提出PaperRouter-Agent，一种无需训练的大语言模型（LLM）智能体，其路由决策不仅基于文件夹名称，更以文件夹成员为依据。该智能体首先缩小候选层级范围，检索文件夹特定证据，通过检查成员论文来验证匹配度，并整合来自用户过去拒绝记录的相似度门控反馈。一项基于真实个人文献库的形成性研究表明，PaperRouter-Agent将整体Recall@1从0.39提升至0.61，Recall@3从0.57提升至0.83，其中在由来源或年份等元数据定义的组织性文件夹上提升最为显著——单次方法在此类文件夹上的Recall@1从0.09降至0.50。在公开的LaMP-2基准测试中，相较于单次基线方法，相同方法将准确率从44.5%提升至51.5%（宏F1值提升9.0），同时保持实际应用中的低成本。

title: FAIR GraphRAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Approach for Semantic Data Analysis
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses the limitations of Large Language Models (LLMs) when providing responses to domain-specific questions. Graph-based RAG approaches, such as GraphRAG, enhance retrieval by capturing semantic relationships within knowledge graphs (KGs). While the FAIR principles (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reusability) are becoming prevalent for scientific data management, especially in complex domains such as medicine, existing RAG approaches lack a structured FAIRification of the underlying knowledge resources. This lack limits their potential for FAIR information retrieval in these domains. To address this gap, we introduce FAIR GraphRAG, a novel framework that integrates FAIR Digital Objects (FDOs) as the fundamental units of a graph-based retrieval system. Each graph node represents an FDO that incorporates core data, metadata, persistent identifiers, and semantic links. We leverage LLMs to support schema construction and automated extraction of content and metadata from data sources. The framework was co-designed by physicians and computer scientists to ensure technical and clinical relevance. We apply FAIR GraphRAG to a biomedical dataset in gastroenterology, demonstrating its applicability to RNA-sequencing data. Beyond ensuring adherence to the FAIR principles, FAIR GraphRAG significantly improves question answering accuracy, coverage, and explainability, particularly for complex queries involving metadata and ontology links. This work shows the feasibility of combining FAIR data practices with graph-based retrieval techniques. We see potential for applying our approach to other specialized fields such as education and business.
tldr: 该论文提出FAIR GraphRAG框架，将FAIR数字对象集成到图检索增强生成中，以提升生物医学数据问答的准确性、覆盖率和可解释性。
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）解决了大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在回答特定领域问题时存在的局限性。基于图的RAG方法（如GraphRAG）通过捕获知识图谱（Knowledge Graphs, KGs）中的语义关系来增强检索能力。尽管FAIR原则（可发现性、可访问性、互操作性和可重用性）在科学数据管理（尤其是医学等复杂领域）中日益普及，但现有的RAG方法缺乏对底层知识资源的结构化FAIR化处理。这一不足限制了它们在这些领域实现FAIR信息检索的潜力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了FAIR GraphRAG——一种将FAIR数字对象（FAIR Digital Objects, FDOs）作为基于图的检索系统基本单元的新型框架。每个图节点代表一个FDO，其中包含核心数据、元数据、持久标识符和语义链接。我们利用LLMs支持模式构建以及从数据源中自动提取内容和元数据。该框架由医生和计算机科学家共同设计，以确保其技术相关性和临床相关性。我们将FAIR GraphRAG应用于胃肠病学生物医学数据集，展示了其在RNA测序数据上的适用性。除了确保遵循FAIR原则外，FAIR GraphRAG还显著提升了问答的准确性、覆盖率和可解释性，尤其适用于涉及元数据和本体链接的复杂查询。本研究表明，将FAIR数据实践与基于图的检索技术相结合是可行的。我们预计该方法可推广至教育、商业等其他专业领域。

title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Encoding Business-Value Ranking into Document Identifiers for Generative Retrieval
abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) formulates retrieval as a sequence-to-sequence generation task, assigning each document a document identifier (DocID) and retrieving it through autoregressive decoding, making DocID design a critical factor in retrieval quality. However, existing schemes based on discrete representation learning suffer from inherent collision issues and create a mismatch between the DocID's encoding objective and the system's business optimization target. To address these limitations, we propose Cluster-Ranked Identifier (CRID), which decouples DocID into semantic clustering and business-value ranking, yielding collision-free identifiers that support incremental updates via intra-cluster reranking. We further introduce an analytical framework that decomposes retrieval gains into personalized preference and statistical prior generalization, revealing how semantic cluster size governs the balance between the two components. Experiments on a 300M-item Taobao e-commerce corpus show that CRID surpasses the strongest embedding-based retrieval baseline on top-K Hitrate, and delivers +1.06% GMV in full-traffic deployment.
tldr: 提出Cluster-Ranked Identifier (CRID)方法，通过将文档标识符解耦为语义聚类和业务价值排序，解决生成式检索中的标识符冲突和优化目标不匹配问题，在淘宝300M商品数据集上提升检索效果和GMV。
abstract_cn: 生成式检索（Generative Retrieval, GR）将检索任务构建为序列到序列的生成任务，为每个文档分配一个文档标识符（DocID），并通过自回归解码实现检索，这使得DocID的设计成为影响检索质量的关键因素。然而，现有基于离散表示学习的方案存在固有的冲突问题，并导致DocID的编码目标与系统的业务优化目标之间产生不匹配。为解决这些局限，我们提出聚类排序标识符（Cluster-Ranked Identifier, CRID），将DocID解耦为语义聚类与业务价值排序，从而生成无冲突的标识符，并支持通过簇内重排序实现增量更新。我们进一步引入一个分析框架，将检索增益分解为个性化偏好与统计先验泛化，揭示语义聚类规模如何调控两者间的平衡。在包含3亿商品的淘宝电商语料库上的实验表明，CRID在top-K命中率上超越了最强的基于嵌入的检索基线，并在全流量部署中实现了+1.06%的GMV增长。

analysis.chinese_title: 超越语义ID：将业务价值排序编码到文档标识符中用于生成式检索
analysis.summary: 生成式检索（GR）将检索建模为序列到序列生成任务，为每个文档分配文档标识符（DocID），并通过自回归解码进行检索。然而，现有基于离散表示学习的方案存在固有的冲突问题，并导致DocID的编码目标与系统的业务优化目标不匹配。为了解决这些限制，本文提出Cluster-Ranked Identifier (CRID)，将DocID解耦为语义聚类和业务价值排序，生成无冲突的标识符，并支持通过簇内重排序进行增量更新。本文进一步引入分析框架，将检索增益分解为个性化偏好和统计先验泛化，揭示语义簇大小如何控制两者之间的平衡。在包含3亿商品的淘宝电商语料上的实验表明，CRID在top-K命中率上超越了最强的基于嵌入的检索基线，并在全流量部署中带来了+1.06%的GMV提升。
innovations: 首次将业务价值作为序数排序编码到DocID的最后一个码本层级中，实现无冲突标识符和增量更新。
提出将检索增益分解为个性化偏好和统计先验泛化的分析框架，揭示语义簇大小如何控制两者平衡。
在3亿商品规模的淘宝电商语料上，CRID在top-K命中率上超越最强嵌入检索基线，并带来显著业务提升。
analysis.methodology: 使用对比学习在查询-商品对上训练商品嵌入，通过RQ-KMeans进行语义聚类，然后在每个语义簇内根据业务价值（如转化率）对商品进行排序，将排序作为DocID的最后一个层级。GR模型使用Qwen2.5-0.5B作为骨干，通过两阶段训练（DocID记忆和SFT）以及DPO优化。推理时使用带约束的束搜索。
analysis.key_results: CRID在in-search和out-of-search转化命中率上均优于所有基线，包括最强EBR系统。在in-search转化上，HR@20提升3.72个百分点，HR@1000提升9.10个百分点。在线A/B测试显示IPV提升0.18%，订单数提升0.54%，GMV提升1.06%。
strengths: 方法简单有效，仅改变最后一个码本层级即带来显著提升。
提供深入的分析框架，解释业务价值排序的有效性。
支持增量更新，无需重新训练码本。
在工业级大规模数据集上验证，并取得线上业务提升。
limitations: 实验仅在淘宝电商搜索场景进行，其他领域（如推荐）的有效性待验证。
业务价值排序依赖历史统计，存在冷启动偏差。
使用单一业务价值信号，多信号融合是开放方向。
所有实验使用0.5B参数模型，更大模型可能改变容量-语料平衡。
analysis.relevance_to_keywords: 论文与生成式推荐、LLM与推荐系统结合、工业落地高度相关。CRID是生成式检索中的DocID设计方法，直接应用于电商搜索推荐场景，并在淘宝全流量部署。论文还涉及序列推荐（用户历史行为）和排序（业务价值排序）。

title: Boolean queries are all you need?
abstract: We equipped an LLM-based search agent with access to a Boolean retrieval engine to search the MS MARCO V2.1 deduped segment collection used by the TREC 2024 RAG track. Over a standard track subset of 86 topics, and operating under a budget of 100 model calls/topic, the agent achieved an NDCG@10 of 0.6863, which would place it above many dense, sparse, and learned-sparse first-stage retrievers. Ranking is based solely on the density of corpus substrings matching a query, with no requirement for supervised learning, global statistics, or term weights. Formally, the query language expresses a strict subset of the regular languages, with a document's score based on the number and length of matches it contains. Although the results are more exploratory than definitive, because they are based on a single test collection that was publicly available during model training, they suggest that simple pattern matching may be sufficient for agentic search.
tldr: 该论文探讨了使用布尔查询的LLM搜索代理在TREC RAG任务中的表现，发现简单模式匹配足以实现有效的检索，但未涉及推荐系统。
abstract_cn: 我们为基于LLM的搜索智能体配备了布尔检索引擎的访问权限，用于检索TREC 2024 RAG赛道所使用的MS MARCO V2.1去重段落集合。在标准赛道子集的86个主题上，以每个主题100次模型调用的预算运行，该智能体取得了0.6863的NDCG@10分数，这一成绩优于许多稠密型、稀疏型及学习型稀疏（learned-sparse）的第一阶段检索器。其排序完全依据语料库子串与查询匹配的密度，无需监督学习、全局统计或词项权重。形式上，该查询语言表达了正则语言的一个严格子集，文档得分基于其所包含的匹配项数量与长度。尽管这些结果更多是探索性而非结论性的——因为它们仅基于模型训练期间公开可用的单一测试集合——但它们表明，简单的模式匹配可能足以支持智能体搜索。
