title: ATLAS: Learning to Recommend Across Unseen Domains
abstract: Recommender systems remain domain-bound: a model trained on one interaction environment typically requires retraining or target-domain adaptation before it can operate on a new catalogue. A recommender trained on movies cannot be directly deployed to recommend groceries or video games. Existing approaches mitigate this by transferring restricted forms of recommendation knowledge, adapting to the target domain, or leveraging large language models (LLMs) for transferable representations. We instead ask whether recommendation-specific knowledge learned solely from multiple heterogeneous domains can generalize to entirely unseen domains without target-domain adaptation or language-model pretraining. We introduce ATLAS, a multi-source recommendation domain generalization framework that learns a shared, domain-invariant user-item representation from disjoint source domains, enabling zero-shot recommendation on unseen domains. ATLAS combines a Gromov-Wasserstein alignment that preserves how users relate to one another across domains, an adversarial objective that makes item representations indistinguishable across domains, and residual vector quantization (RVQ) codebooks that compress user and item embeddings into a discrete latent space, capturing hierarchical interaction patterns while suppressing domain-specific variation. Trained on five Amazon domains and applied directly to ten unseen domains, ATLAS outperforms state-of-the-art sequential, graph-based, cross-domain, quantization-based, and LLM-based baselines on most unseen domains, with an average relative gain in HitRate of 24%. Ablations and representation analyses validate each component, and we identify a pronounced source-domain diversity effect: increasing source heterogeneity substantially improves zero-shot transfer. ATLAS establishes recommendation domain generalization as a promising paradigm for zero-shot recommendation.
tldr: ATLAS通过多源域学习共享的用户-物品表示，实现无需目标域适配的零样本推荐，在多个未见域上显著优于现有方法。
abstract_cn: 推荐系统仍然受限于领域：在一个交互环境上训练的模型，通常需要重新训练或进行目标领域适配，才能在新的目录上运行。在电影上训练的推荐器无法直接部署用于推荐杂货或电子游戏。现有方法通过迁移受限形式的推荐知识、适配目标领域，或利用大型语言模型（LLMs）获取可迁移表示来缓解这一问题。我们转而探讨一个不同的问题：仅从多个异构领域学到的推荐特定知识，能否在无需目标领域适配或语言模型预训练的情况下，泛化到完全未见过的领域。我们提出了ATLAS，一个多源推荐领域泛化框架，它从不相交的源领域学习共享的、领域不变的用户-物品表示，从而在未见过的领域上实现零样本推荐。ATLAS结合了Gromov-Wasserstein对齐（保留用户跨领域间的相互关系）、对抗性目标（使物品表示跨领域不可区分），以及残差向量量化（RVQ）码本（将用户和物品嵌入压缩到离散潜在空间中，捕获层次化交互模式，同时抑制领域特定变异）。在五个Amazon领域上训练并直接应用于十个未见领域，ATLAS在大多数未见领域上优于最先进的基于序列、基于图、跨领域、基于量化和基于LLM的基线方法，平均HitRate相对提升24%。消融实验和表示分析验证了每个组件的有效性，并且我们发现了显著的源领域多样性效应：增加源领域的异构性可大幅提升零样本迁移性能。ATLAS将推荐领域泛化确立为零样本推荐的一个有前景的范式。

analysis.chinese_title: ATLAS：跨未见领域的推荐学习
analysis.summary: 本文提出推荐域泛化（RDG）问题，即模型仅在多个异构源域上训练，然后直接应用于完全未见的目标域，无需任何参数更新。为此，作者提出ATLAS框架，通过对抗性对齐和Gromov-Wasserstein对齐分别统一物品和用户的表示空间，并使用残差向量量化（RVQ）码本将连续表示离散化，以抑制域特定变异。在五个Amazon源域上训练，在十个未见目标域上评估，ATLAS在零样本设置下优于多种基线，平均HR提升24%。消融实验和表示分析验证了各组件的有效性，并发现源域多样性显著提升迁移性能。
innovations: 首次提出推荐域泛化（RDG）问题，要求模型在多个源域上训练后直接部署到完全未见的目标域，无需目标域适应。
提出ATLAS框架，结合对抗性对齐和Gromov-Wasserstein对齐，分别统一物品和用户的表示空间。
使用残差向量量化（RVQ）码本将连续表示离散化，抑制域特定变异，提升零样本迁移能力。
通过实验发现源域多样性效应，即增加源域数量和异构性可显著提升零样本迁移性能。
analysis.methodology: ATLAS采用三阶段训练：1）物品语义对齐：使用冻结的Sentence-BERT编码物品文本，通过共享投影网络映射到统一空间，并用对抗性损失（梯度反转层）使物品表示域不可区分；2）用户几何对齐：用户表示由LightGCN协作表示和语义表示拼接而成，通过共享投影网络映射，并用Gromov-Wasserstein下界对齐不同域的用户距离分布；3）离散化：使用RVQ码本对用户和物品表示进行量化，结合推荐损失（采样softmax）和量化损失（承诺、码本、熵）进行训练。推理时，冻结模型，对目标域用户和物品进行投影和量化，通过内积进行Top-K检索。
analysis.key_results: 在五个源域上，ATLAS在HR和NDCG上均优于所有基线。在十个未见目标域上，ATLAS在零样本设置下在七个域上取得最佳HR，平均相对提升24%。消融实验表明，对抗性对齐和Gromov-Wasserstein对齐均有效，且组合最佳。RVQ码本相比连续投影平均提升HR@10 45%。源域多样性实验显示，随着源域数量从2增加到5，目标域性能单调提升。
strengths: 提出新颖的RDG问题，具有实际意义。
方法设计合理，结合多种对齐技术，消融实验充分。
实验规模大，覆盖多个域，与多种基线对比。
发现源域多样性效应，对实践有指导意义。
limitations: 零样本性能在部分目标域上仍低于微调版本，说明完全零样本仍有挑战。
依赖物品文本描述，对于缺乏文本的域可能不适用。
实验仅基于Amazon数据集，泛化性有待验证。
未与更多最新的LLM推荐方法对比。
analysis.relevance_to_keywords: 该论文与序列推荐、生成式推荐、LLM与推荐系统结合、推荐智能体、多模态推荐、对话式推荐、排序与重排、用户建模、CTR/CVR预测、因果性、公平性、鲁棒性和工业落地等关键词均有一定相关性，但主要聚焦于跨域推荐和域泛化，与序列推荐、生成式推荐、LLM结合等方向有交叉。

title: Assessment of Conditional Diffusion Model for Synthetic Histopathology Image Generation
abstract: Synthetic histopathology image generation has emerged as an approach that may address data scarcity in computational pathology, yet current evaluation methodologies may not fully assess synthetic data quality for medical applications. This work investigates and addresses limitations in existing evaluation metrics, investigating an approach for assessing synthetic histopathology image quality through domain-specific metrics and downstream task validation. We show that conventional synthetic data evaluation metrics such as Frechet Inception Distance (FID) and Inception Score (IS) may have limitations when applied to histopathology images due to their reliance on ImageNet-pretrained feature extractors. To address these limitations, we propose for consideration modified FID and IS approaches utilizing foundation models pretrained on digital pathology datasets, supplemented by precision-recall based metrics as part of an additional quality assessment. Using conditional denoising diffusion models trained on four benchmark datasets, with a two-step training approach, we generated synthetic datasets with systematically varied quality characteristics. We also measured the correlation between the synthetic data quality metrics with downstream nuclei segmentation performance using common metrics including the aggregated Jaccard index (AJI+) and the Dice coefficient. The study results suggest that pathology-specific metrics may provide improved discriminative power. Specifically, the modified Inception Score indicates higher correlation with downstream task performance (r=0.6096 with AJI+, p=0.0122), compared to the original IS (r=0.0708, p=0.7944). Our observations indicate that increasing the variety of generated training data has a higher positive correlation with segmentation model performance than improving the visual fidelity of individual generated images.
tldr: The paper proposes modified evaluation metrics for synthetic histopathology images and shows that pathology-specific metrics correlate better with downstream segmentation performance than conventional metrics.
abstract_cn: 合成组织病理学图像生成已成为一种可能解决计算病理学中数据稀缺问题的方法，然而当前的评估方法可能无法充分评估合成数据在医学应用中的质量。本研究探讨并解决了现有评估指标的局限性，提出了一种通过领域特定指标和下游任务验证来评估合成组织病理学图像质量的方法。我们表明，传统的合成数据评估指标（如弗雷歇初始距离（FID）和初始分数（IS））在应用于组织病理学图像时可能存在局限性，原因在于它们依赖于在ImageNet上预训练的特征提取器。为解决这些局限性，我们提出考虑采用基于在数字病理学数据集上预训练的基础模型改进的FID和IS方法，并辅以基于精确率-召回率的指标作为额外质量评估的一部分。使用在四个基准数据集上训练的条件去噪扩散模型，并采用两步训练方法，我们生成了具有系统性变化质量特征的合成数据集。我们还测量了合成数据质量指标与下游细胞核分割性能之间的相关性，使用了包括聚合Jaccard指数（AJI+）和Dice系数在内的常用指标。研究结果表明，病理学特定指标可能提供更好的区分能力。具体而言，改进的初始分数与下游任务性能的相关性更高（与AJI+的r=0.6096，p=0.0122），而原始IS的相关性为（r=0.0708，p=0.7944）。我们的观察表明，增加生成训练数据的多样性比提高单个生成图像的视觉保真度对分割模型性能具有更高的正相关性。

title: Information-Geometric Forward Policy Training in GFlowNets
abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) have emerged as a flexible framework for amortised inference over discrete and mixed discrete-continuous objects, requiring only an unnormalised target density specified through a reward. In this work, we formulate forward-policy training in GFlowNets through the information geometry of the induced trajectory sampler. Treating the forward policy as an induced trajectory sampler, we show that its intrinsic first-order geometry is given by the Fisher-Rao metric of the trajectory family, and that the associated natural gradient provides the canonical local update whenever the corresponding Fisher information is computable or accurately approximable. We derive an exact decomposition of the trajectory Fisher into per-step conditional second moments, which clarifies when temporal score interactions vanish and when dense couplings remain under shared parameterisation. This leads to three computational regimes: settings with tractable exact Fisher information, settings where Monte Carlo estimators of the expected Fisher are sufficient, and structure-exploitable settings in which target locality or factorisation yields accurate approximations of the Fisher expectation. In the latter case, graphical-model tools such as exact marginalisation, separator methods, and belief propagation provide principled surrogates for natural-gradient updates. The resulting framework turns target structure into optimisation geometry and yields a tractable route to structure-aware forward-policy training in GFlowNets. We illustrate the framework empirically through examples comparing convergence and exploration behaviour under Riemannian and Euclidean optimisation.
tldr: The paper proposes an information-geometric framework for training forward policies in GFlowNets, deriving natural gradient updates based on the Fisher-Rao metric and demonstrating improved convergence and exploration.
abstract_cn: 生成流网络（GFlowNets）已成为对离散及混合离散-连续对象进行摊销推断的灵活框架，仅需通过奖励指定一个未归一化的目标密度即可。在本工作中，我们通过诱导轨迹采样器的信息几何来形式化GFlowNets中的前向策略训练。将前向策略视为诱导轨迹采样器，我们表明其内在一阶几何由轨迹族的Fisher-Rao度量给出，并且相应的自然梯度在对应的Fisher信息可计算或可精确近似时提供了规范的局部更新。我们推导出轨迹Fisher信息关于每步条件二阶矩的精确分解，这阐明了何时时间得分交互消失，以及何时在共享参数化下仍存在密集耦合。这引出了三种计算情形：具有可处理精确Fisher信息的设置、蒙特卡洛估计期望Fisher信息即可满足的设置，以及可利用结构特性的设置——其中目标局部性或因子分解能够提供Fisher期望的精确近似。在后一种情形中，图模型工具（如精确边缘化、分隔符方法和置信传播）为自然梯度更新提供了有原则的替代方案。所提出的框架将目标结构转化为优化几何，并为GFlowNets中结构感知的前向策略训练提供了一条可处理的路径。我们通过比较黎曼优化与欧几里得优化下的收敛性和探索行为的实例，实证展示了该框架的有效性。

title: Muon Meets Mamba: Spectral Optimization for State Space Models
abstract: Muon is a recent optimizer that orthogonalizes the update to each weight matrix with a Newton-Schulz iteration, which performs steepest descent under the spectral norm. Almost all the evidence for it comes from Transformer models, and its behavior on state-space models is largely unreported. We compare Muon with AdamW on Mamba-2 130M under a controlled protocol that varies only which weight groups are trained with Muon. The benefit is localized. Muon on the output projection alone beats Muon on the input projection or on both. The advantage is mainly one of token efficiency. It holds on two corpora and two token budgets, and persists when training continues well past the compute-optimal point. Conditioning does not explain the gain. Muon lowers the condition number of whichever projection it trains, but the better-conditioned input projection is not the one that helps.
tldr: 该论文研究Muon优化器在Mamba-2状态空间模型上的表现，发现仅在输出投影上使用Muon能提升token效率，但该工作与推荐系统无关。
abstract_cn: Muon是一种近期提出的优化器，它通过Newton-Schulz迭代对每个权重矩阵的更新进行正交化，从而在谱范数下执行最陡下降。几乎所有支持其有效性的证据都来自Transformer模型，而它在状态空间模型上的表现则鲜有报道。我们在一个受控协议下将Muon与AdamW在Mamba-2 130M模型上进行比较，该协议仅改变使用Muon训练的权重组。其收益具有局部性。仅在输出投影上使用Muon的效果优于在输入投影或同时在两者上使用Muon的效果。该优势主要体现为token效率的提升。这一结论在两种语料库和两种token预算下均成立，并且在训练远超计算最优点时依然持续。条件数并不能解释这一增益。Muon降低了其所训练投影的条件数，但条件数更优的输入投影并非带来收益的那个。

title: Logic Before Language: Pre-pretraining on Formal Derivations Fosters Skill Acquisition and Compressibility
abstract: Pre-pretraining language models (LMs) on symbolic data can accelerate and improve natural language acquisition. However, existing pre-pretraining tasks, such as Dyck and procedural algorithms, rely on narrow primitives that fail to capture the expressive capacity of natural language. Moreover, prior studies remain restricted to relatively small token budgets, offering limited insight into skill emergence and representational dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose logic pre-pretraining (Logic-PPT) as a principled initialization strategy, leveraging formal derivations to impart richer structural and linguistic biases. Formal derivations require abstract mechanisms that are central to natural language, simultaneously binding variables, connecting quantifiers and relational dependencies, and composing predicate-argument structures over long contexts. Scaling our evaluation to a 100B-token regime, logic pre-pretraining substantially accelerates skill acquisition in LMs, achieving 80\% accuracy on linguistic tasks with 36B fewer tokens than standard initialization, and outperforming alternative pre-pretraining baselines. Mechanistically, formal derivations induce persistent structural reorganization, distinctively characterized by a lower-rank, spectrally concentrated representation space. Crucially, we show that this internal geometry enables improved model compressibility via pruning, matching the dense baseline performance even at $\approx$33\% sparsity.
tldr: The paper proposes logic pre-pretraining on formal derivations to accelerate skill acquisition and improve compressibility in language models, demonstrating significant token savings and structural reorganization.
abstract_cn: 在符号数据上对语言模型（LMs）进行预预训练（pre-pretraining）能够加速并改善自然语言习得。然而，现有的预预训练任务，如Dyck语言和程序化算法，依赖于狭窄的原始操作，无法捕捉自然语言的表达能力。此外，先前的研究仍局限于相对较小的词元预算，对技能涌现和表征动态的洞察有限。为应对这些局限，我们提出逻辑预预训练（Logic-PPT）作为一种原则性的初始化策略，利用形式化推导来赋予模型更丰富的结构和语言偏置。形式化推导需要自然语言中核心的抽象机制，同时绑定变量、连接量词与关系依赖，并在长上下文中组合谓词-论元结构。将评估规模扩展至1000亿词元区间，逻辑预预训练显著加速了语言模型中的技能习得，在语言任务上以比标准初始化少360亿词元的代价达到80%的准确率，并优于其他预预训练基线。在机制层面，形式化推导诱导了持续的结构重组，其独特特征表现为低秩、谱集中的表征空间。关键在于，我们表明这种内部几何结构通过剪枝提升了模型的可压缩性，即使在约33%稀疏度下仍能匹配密集基线的性能。

title: Latent Reward Registers for Diffusion Preference Alignment
abstract: Aligning diffusion models with human preferences usually relies on a sparse terminal reward evaluated on the final generated samples, presenting a severe temporal credit-assignment challenge across the multi-step denoising process. We propose Latent Reward Registers, a mechanism that estimates terminal preference directly from intermediate noisy latents by prepending learnable, position-free register tokens to the input sequence of a frozen Diffusion Transformer (DiT). This independent readout mechanism extracts latent reward evidence without altering the generator's hidden states or velocity field. The resulting dense, differentiable reward signal throughout the full denoising process facilitates two alignment strategies. For training, Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD) distills reward-guided updates along on-policy trajectories, bypassing the computationally expensive rollouts of standard policy gradients. For inference, Reward-Guided Sampling (RGS) steers trajectories via magnitude-matched reward gradients without parameter updates. Empirically, at high noise levels (u = 0.8), the registers reach the highest pairwise accuracy among the evaluated latent reward models. Furthermore, RG-OPD outperforms online reinforcement learning baselines while reducing GPU hours by up to 33x, and RGS establishes a new state-of-the-art among training-free methods, strictly enhancing both alignment and perceptual metrics. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/Guanys-dar/latent-reward-register
tldr: The paper proposes Latent Reward Registers to estimate terminal preferences from intermediate noisy latents in diffusion models, enabling efficient training and inference-time alignment without altering the generator, and demonstrates improved alignment and perceptual quality with significant computational savings.
abstract_cn: 将扩散模型与人类偏好对齐通常依赖于在最终生成样本上评估的稀疏终端奖励，这在多步去噪过程中带来了严重的时间信用分配挑战。我们提出潜在奖励寄存器（Latent Reward Registers）机制，该机制通过向冻结的扩散Transformer（DiT）输入序列中前置可学习的、与位置无关的寄存器令牌，直接从中间噪声潜在表示中估计终端偏好。这种独立的读出机制在不改变生成器隐藏状态或速度场的情况下提取潜在奖励证据。由此产生的在整个去噪过程中密集且可微的奖励信号促进了两种对齐策略。在训练方面，奖励梯度在线策略蒸馏（Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation, RG-OPD）沿在线策略轨迹蒸馏奖励引导的更新，绕过了标准策略梯度中计算成本高昂的 rollout 过程。在推理方面，奖励引导采样（Reward-Guided Sampling, RGS）通过幅度匹配的奖励梯度引导轨迹，无需参数更新。实验上，在高噪声水平（u = 0.8）下，寄存器在评估的潜在奖励模型中达到了最高的成对准确率。此外，RG-OPD 在性能上优于在线强化学习基线，同时将 GPU 小时数减少高达 33 倍，而 RGS 在无训练方法中确立了新的最先进水平，严格提升了对齐指标和感知指标。代码和权重可在 https://github.com/Guanys-dar/latent-reward-register 获取。

title: Robust Low-Tubal-Rank Tensor Completion under Cross-Concentrated Sampling
abstract: Tensor cross-concentrated sampling (t-CCS) bridges entrywise sampling and t-CUR slice-wise sampling by observing entries only within selected horizontal and lateral slices. Existing t-CCS completion methods, however, assume that the observations are free of gross corruption. In this work, we study robust recovery of a third-order low-tubal-rank tensor from partial t-CCS observations contaminated by sparse, arbitrarily large outliers. We propose Robust Iterative t-CUR (R-ItCUR), a tensor-native algorithm that partitions the sampled tensor cross into two exterior blocks and an intersection block, applies adaptive blockwise Welsch correction for outlier suppression, and updates the low-rank component through projected blockwise gradient descent. By operating directly on the sampled cross, R-ItCUR avoids reconstructing the full tensor throughout the iterations, resulting in substantial memory and computational savings. Experiments on synthetic tensors, cardiac MRI data, and three-dimensional seismic data demonstrate accurate recovery and strong robustness to sparse gross corruptions. The results further highlight the importance of explicitly exploiting the cross-concentrated sampling structure in robust tensor completion.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种鲁棒的迭代t-CUR算法（R-ItCUR），用于在交叉集中采样下从含有稀疏异常值的部分观测中恢复低tubal秩张量，实验证明其在合成数据和真实数据上的有效性和鲁棒性。
abstract_cn: 张量交叉集中采样（t-CCS）通过仅观测选定的水平切片与侧向切片内的元素，将逐元素采样与t-CUR逐切片采样联系起来。然而，现有的t-CCS补全方法假设观测数据不含严重污染。在本工作中，我们研究了在部分t-CCS观测受到稀疏、任意大幅值异常值污染的情况下，三阶低管秩张量的鲁棒恢复问题。我们提出了鲁棒迭代t-CUR（R-ItCUR），这是一种张量原生算法，将采样张量交叉划分为两个外部块和一个交集块，采用自适应分块Welsch校正以抑制异常值，并通过投影分块梯度下降更新低秩分量。通过在采样交叉上直接操作，R-ItCUR在迭代过程中避免了重构完整张量，从而大幅节省内存和计算开销。在合成张量、心脏磁共振成像数据和三维地震数据上的实验表明，该方法能够实现精确恢复，并对稀疏严重污染表现出强鲁棒性。实验结果进一步凸显了在鲁棒张量补全中显式利用交叉集中采样结构的重要性。

title: A Physics-Flavored Transformer Network for Parametrizing Contraction Dynamics of Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues
abstract: Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues (ESMs) have become a key structure for biomedical disease modeling and pharmacological screening, yet their functional characterization often relies on simplistic metrics like peak force, discarding critical kinetic information. This is partially due to the high level of mathematical complexity which mechanistic models introduce to capture these dynamics. Hence, exactly the complexity prevents scalable application and widespread adaptation in the field. Here we present a Physics-Flavored Neural Network (PFNN) that automates the kinetic phenotyping of ESMs. Our architecture integrates a stretched-exponential physical model into a CNN-Transformer, enabling the extraction of physically meaningful parameters directly from force-time profiles. To address the scarcity of labeled biological data, we employ a hybrid training paradigm: the model develops a "physical intuition" on synthetic data before undergoing unsupervised self-alignment on unlabeled real-world measurements. Our results demonstrate that this physics-flavored approach achieves high-fidelity parameterization across diverse contractile phenotypes and cell lines, including Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy models. Our scalable, self-improving pipeline bridges the gap between idealized biophysics and noisy \emph{in vitro} data, providing a robust tool for high-throughput biophysical research.
tldr: 该论文提出一种物理启发的Transformer网络，用于从力-时间曲线中提取工程化骨骼肌组织的动力学参数，以解决传统方法忽略动力学信息的问题。
abstract_cn: 工程化骨骼肌组织（Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues, ESMs）已成为生物医学疾病建模和药理学筛选的关键结构，然而其功能表征往往依赖于诸如峰值力等简化指标，忽略了关键的动力学信息。这在一定程度上是由于机制模型为捕捉这些动态特性而引入的高度数学复杂性所致。因此，正是这种复杂性阻碍了该领域内可扩展应用和广泛采用。在此，我们提出了一种物理风味神经网络（Physics-Flavored Neural Network, PFNN），用于自动化ESMs的动力学表型分析。我们的架构将拉伸指数物理模型集成到CNN-Transformer中，从而能够直接从力-时间曲线中提取具有物理意义的参数。为解决标记生物数据稀缺的问题，我们采用了一种混合训练范式：模型先在合成数据上建立“物理直觉”，随后在未标记的真实世界测量数据上进行无监督自对齐。我们的结果表明，这种物理风味方法在多种收缩表型和细胞系（包括杜氏肌营养不良症模型）中实现了高保真参数化。我们可扩展、自优化的流程弥合了理想化生物物理与嘈杂的体外数据之间的鸿沟，为高通量生物物理研究提供了稳健的工具。

title: PRISM: Powerful Time Series to Image (TS2I) Representations for Multivariate Anomaly Detection
abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) underpins applications in predictive maintenance, finance, and cloud computing, however performance remains sensitive to representation choices, especially in multivariate settings. While transforming time series into images has shown success in forecasting and classification, it remains unclear how multivariate, high-dimensional series should be mapped to multi-channel images and whether vision backbones can match time-domain baselines in TSAD. We introduce PRISM, a plug-and-play meta-workflow enabling systematic construction and evaluation of image-based representations for multivariate TSAD. Our evaluation spanning over 7,000 experiments shows that well-designed PRISM configurations are competitive with 24 time-domain baselines, achieving the best VUS-PR on 10 of 14 datasets, with an average improvement of 41% over the best competing method on those datasets. Further, we identify channelization - how the channel dimension of multi-channel images is constructed - as a critical and previously understudied design dimension, and introduce MSM, a novel statistics-based scheme achieving 11-27% gains over PCA-based alternatives. Finally, ImageNet-pretrained encoders transfer effectively to TSAD, with frozen encoders retaining 92% of fine-tuned performance while training 1.8 times faster. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Smendowski/PRISM.
tldr: This paper introduces PRISM, a meta-workflow for constructing image-based representations for multivariate time series anomaly detection, demonstrating competitive performance against time-domain baselines and identifying channelization as a key design dimension.
abstract_cn: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）支撑着预测性维护、金融和云计算等领域的应用，然而其性能对表示选择仍然敏感，尤其是在多变量场景中。尽管将时间序列转换为图像已在预测和分类中显示出成功，但对于多变量、高维序列应如何映射为多通道图像，以及视觉骨干网络能否在TSAD中匹敌时域基线，目前仍不清楚。我们提出PRISM，一种即插即用的元工作流，能够系统性地构建和评估基于图像的多变量TSAD表示。我们的评估涵盖超过7,000个实验，结果表明设计良好的PRISM配置可与24种时域基线竞争，在14个数据集中的10个上取得了最佳VUS-PR，并在这些数据集上相较于最佳竞争方法平均提升41%。此外，我们识别出通道化——即多通道图像中通道维度的构建方式——是一个关键且此前未被充分研究的设计维度，并引入MSM，一种新颖的基于统计的方案，相较于基于PCA的替代方案实现了11-27%的提升。最后，ImageNet预训练编码器可有效迁移至TSAD，冻结编码器保留了微调性能的92%，同时训练速度提升1.8倍。我们的代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/Smendowski/PRISM。

title: Trajectory inference via Acceleration Matching
abstract: Trajectory inference is a fundamental problem in many scientific domains: given a collection of unpaired snapshots of observations at discrete time points, the goal is to generate smooth trajectories that best resemble and interpolate the data. Existing algorithms exhibit computational challenges: they either rely on preprocessing subroutines to enforce smoothness or on simulation-based training objectives, both of which can be expensive. In order to overcome these limitations, we propose a new algorithm called Acceleration Matching (\texttt{AM}). Our approach consists of lifting the original interpolation problem to phase space and then regressing onto an explicit conditional acceleration field that induces random, smooth trajectories that agree with the prescribed marginals. Importantly, our resulting training algorithm only requires positional data, avoids trajectory simulation during training, and is devoid of expensive preprocessing. We provide ample numerical evidence suggesting that \texttt{AM} is competitive with or superior to existing algorithms on several benchmark problems from the existing literature.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Acceleration Matching的算法，用于从离散时间快照中推断平滑轨迹，通过回归条件加速度场避免昂贵的模拟和预处理。
abstract_cn: 轨迹推断是众多科学领域中的一个基本问题：给定一组在离散时间点上观测到的未配对快照集合，目标是生成与数据最为相似并能对其进行插值的光滑轨迹。现有算法面临计算上的挑战：它们要么依赖预处理子程序来强制光滑性，要么依赖基于模拟的训练目标，这两种方式都可能代价高昂。为克服这些局限，我们提出了一种名为加速度匹配（\texttt{AM}）的新算法。我们的方法包括将原始插值问题提升到相空间，然后回归到一个显式的条件加速度场上，该场可诱导出符合给定边际分布的随机、光滑轨迹。重要的是，我们最终得到的训练算法仅需位置数据，在训练过程中避免了轨迹模拟，且无需昂贵的预处理。我们提供了充分的数值证据，表明\texttt{AM}在现有文献中的多个基准问题上与现有算法相比具有竞争力或更优表现。

title: Sparse Weight Decomposition for Efficient Circuit Extraction
abstract: Dense pretrained transformers do not naturally expose interpretable units for circuit extraction. Existing approaches obtain such units by learning auxiliary sparse representations or training sparse models, incurring substantial additional computation while potentially introducing a fidelity gap between the representation being analyzed and the original pretrained model. We propose Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD), which reparameterizes pretrained linear projections by factorizing each weight matrix into two sparse factors whose shared intermediate coordinates serve as individually addressable circuit units. Without training a separate replacement network, this parametric representation supports the same scoring, selection, and ablation circuit extraction workflow used for methods that learn sparse features. Across single-matrix replacements, SWD matches the held-out fidelity achieved by Transcoder and other strong baselines while using less than 1% of the data that those baselines use to train their replacements. For matched replacement fidelity, SWD reaches the same circuit sufficiency and necessity targets with fewer active read/write edges and selected units across tasks on GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and Qwen3.5-27B. We further show that SWD remains effective for full-model replacement of all attention and MLP weight matrices after fine-tuning the nonzero factor values. Finally, SWD also features a zero-data variant, allowing broader use of mechanistic interpretability analysis (e.g., per-step analysis).
tldr: 该论文提出稀疏权重分解（SWD）方法，通过将预训练模型的权重矩阵分解为两个稀疏因子来提取可解释的电路单元，在保持保真度的同时显著降低计算成本，但该方法与推荐系统无关。
abstract_cn: 密集预训练Transformer并不会自然地暴露可用于电路提取的可解释单元。现有方法通过学习辅助稀疏表示或训练稀疏模型来获得此类单元，这会产生大量额外计算，同时可能在所分析的表示与原始预训练模型之间引入保真度差距。我们提出稀疏权重分解（Sparse Weight Decomposition, SWD），该方法通过将每个权重矩阵分解为两个稀疏因子来重新参数化预训练线性投影，这两个因子共享的中间坐标可作为独立可寻址的电路单元。无需训练单独的替代网络，这种参数化表示即可支持与学习稀疏特征的方法相同的评分、选择和消融电路提取工作流程。在单矩阵替换中，SWD在保持与Transcoder及其他强基线相当的留出保真度的同时，所使用的训练数据不足这些基线训练其替代网络所用数据的1%。在匹配替换保真度的条件下，SWD在GPT-2、Qwen2.5和Qwen3.5-27B上的任务中，以更少的活跃读/写边和选定单元达到了相同的电路充分性与必要性目标。我们进一步证明，在对非零因子值进行微调后，SWD对于所有注意力层和MLP权重矩阵的全模型替换依然有效。最后，SWD还提供了一种零数据变体，使得机制可解释性分析（例如逐步分析）得以更广泛地应用。

title: Socially Grounded Agentic AI: Coordinating Plural Perspectives through Social Theory
abstract: As AI systems are deployed across increasingly diverse social contexts, alignment can no longer be framed as the optimization of a single, unified set of values. Instead, systems must be able to recognize, represent, and respond to multiple legitimate perspectives. This has led to growing interest in pluralistic alignment, which seeks to move beyond one-size-fits-all models of appropriate behaviour. However, current approaches often lack a clear account of how values are socially organized, contested, and coordinated in practice. In this paper, we argue that social theory provides essential conceptual and design resources for addressing these challenges. Drawing on established traditions in sociology, we show how perspectives can be understood as structured by roles, shaped through interaction, and distributed across fields of power and expertise. We translate these insights into concrete implications for AI system design, including role-based representations, structured coordination among perspectives, and context-sensitive evaluation. For agentic systems, this requires aligning not only final outputs, but also the role activations, deliberative traces, aggregation rules, and feedback loops through which those outputs are produced. Our contribution is to reposition pluralistic alignment as a problem of socially grounded coordination rather than output diversification. We outline a design space for systems that engage multiple perspectives in structured and accountable ways, and we identify directions for future work to implement and empirically evaluate these approaches in real-world settings.
tldr: 该论文提出将多元对齐重新定位为社会协调问题，并利用社会理论为AI系统设计提供角色表示、结构化协调和情境化评估等指导，但未涉及推荐系统相关研究。
abstract_cn: 随着人工智能系统在日益多样化的社会情境中部署，对齐（alignment）不能再被框定为对单一、统一价值集的优化。相反，系统必须能够识别、表征并回应多种合法的视角。这引发了人们对多元对齐（pluralistic alignment）日益浓厚的兴趣，其目标在于超越“一刀切”式的适当行为模型。然而，当前的方法往往缺乏对价值在实践中如何被社会性地组织、争论和协调的清晰阐释。在本文中，我们论证社会理论为应对这些挑战提供了关键的概念与设计资源。借鉴社会学中既有的学术传统，我们展示了视角如何被理解为由角色所结构化、通过互动所塑造，并分布于权力与专业知识的场域之中。我们将这些洞见转化为对AI系统设计的具体启示，包括基于角色的表征、视角间的结构化协调以及情境敏感的评价。对于智能体系统（agentic systems）而言，这不仅要求对齐最终输出，还要求对齐产生这些输出的角色激活、审议轨迹、聚合规则及反馈回路。我们的贡献在于将多元对齐重新定位为一个社会性扎根的协调问题，而非输出多样化问题。我们勾勒了一个设计空间，使系统能够以结构化和可问责的方式参与多种视角，并指出了未来在实际环境中实施和实证评估这些方法的研究方向。

title: Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer in LLM Families: A Closed-Form Linear Mapping for Prefill Reuse
abstract: Production deployments often swap between different-sized models in a family for cost-quality cascading, mid-conversation switching, and routing, and each swap forces the receiver to repay the prefill from scratch. We propose cross-model KV cache transfer, where the receiver reuses the source's KV cache, skipping prefill. We find that cross-model KV has substantial linear structure across matched-KV pairs, where source and target share KV head count and per-head dimension. On Qwen3 14B->32B, one source layer explains 56% of variance in the target's keys and 32% in values, rising to 79% and 65% with multiple source layers. Building on this, we design a closed-form ridge mapper that operates per head and proceeds in three steps. First, for each target layer we select the top-k most predictive source layers and concatenate their KV as input. Second, we strip RoPE from the keys before mapping, so the fit is position-free and reusable across context lengths. Third, we fit ridge regression on a small calibration set of 500 FineWeb-Edu sequences of 1,024 tokens each. Surprisingly, across six pairs in three families, this linear mapper retains 73-98% of the receiver's standalone-prefill accuracy on four pairs, while two degrade sharply. A nonlinear MLP recovers up to +37 pp HellaSwag retention on the failures. The mapper runs 2.7-25x faster than re-prefill and remains stable across multi-turn handoff, making cross-model KV cache transfer practical.
tldr: The paper proposes a closed-form linear mapping to transfer KV caches across different-sized LLMs in a family, enabling prefill reuse and faster inference, but it is not related to recommendation systems.
abstract_cn: 生产部署中经常会在同一模型家族内不同规模的模型之间进行切换，以实现成本-质量级联、对话中途切换和路由，而每次切换都迫使接收方从头开始重新进行预填充。我们提出跨模型KV缓存迁移方法，使接收方能够复用源模型的KV缓存，从而跳过预填充。我们发现，在匹配的KV对（源模型与目标模型共享KV头数和每头维度）之间，跨模型KV具有显著的线性结构。在Qwen3 14B→32B的迁移中，单个源层可解释目标键中56%的方差和值中32%的方差，而使用多个源层时，这一比例分别提升至79%和65%。基于此，我们设计了一种闭式岭映射器，该映射器按头操作，分三步进行。首先，对于每个目标层，我们选择最具预测性的前k个源层，并将其KV拼接作为输入。其次，在映射前去除键中的RoPE（旋转位置编码），从而使拟合结果与位置无关，并可在不同上下文长度间复用。第三，我们在包含500条FineWeb-Edu序列（每条1,024个token）的小型校准集上拟合岭回归。令人惊讶的是，在三个模型家族的六组配对中，该线性映射器在四组配对上的准确率保留了接收方独立预填充的73%–98%，而另外两组则急剧下降。对于失败案例，非线性MLP可将HellaSwag保留率最多提升37个百分点。该映射器的运行速度比重新预填充快2.7–25倍，并在多轮交接中保持稳定，从而使跨模型KV缓存迁移切实可行。

title: Omega-S: A Functional Resilience Index for LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract:
Fine-tuning a large language model on new data degrades what it previously learned. We present Omega-S, a drop-in penalty computed from the weight matrix alone: it needs no previous-task data, no Fisher matrix and no stored copy of the old weights. It is three lines in an existing training loop and adds under 4% to the cost of a step.
  Retention. On Llama-3-8B with LoRA, fine-tuned from code to prose and measured by HumanEval over ten seeds, Omega-S retains more of the original capability than no regularisation on 9 of 10 seeds (0.173 -> 0.238 absolute pass@1; sign test one-sided p=0.011, Wilcoxon p=0.006), as a retention ratio, 62.9% -> 84.1%. It also beats tuned weight decay on 10 of 10 seeds (p=0.002) and tuned EWC on 8 of 10 (p=0.014), every arm re-measured in the same session.
  Mechanism, measured rather than asserted. Omega-S is topological by construction, its objective built from Tr(A^3), but we measured which of its four factors actually moves and three do not: their elasticity with respect to the weights is at or below 1e-4, against 9e-3 for the degree-variance term. As implemented, the composite reduces to a penalty on the variance of node degrees, which means row magnitude in square modules and directional alignment in non-square ones. We report this because a method whose name promises one thing and whose gradient does another should say so. We also enumerate the open design choices, including a contrast-preserving construction that does what it was designed to do and makes retention worse on all ten seeds.
  Repeating an identical configuration, same seed and same hardware, gives a standard deviation of 0.104 in retention ratio. We have not found this quantified for low-rank fine-tuning of language models, and it bounds every seed-paired comparison in this literature, ours included.
  Code, per-seed results and the full record of negative results are available.
tldr: The paper introduces Omega-S, a penalty term for LLM fine-tuning that reduces catastrophic forgetting without requiring previous-task data, and demonstrates its effectiveness on Llama-3-8B with LoRA.
abstract_cn:
在大语言模型上对新数据进行微调会削弱其先前学到的能力。我们提出Omega-S，一种仅由权重矩阵计算得到的即插即用惩罚项：它不需要先前任务的数据、不需要Fisher矩阵，也不需要存储旧权重的副本。它只需在现有训练循环中添加三行代码，且每一步的额外开销不足4%。

**保持能力。** 在Llama-3-8B上使用LoRA，从代码微调到散文，并以HumanEval在十个随机种子下进行测量，Omega-S在10个种子中的9个上比无正则化保留了更多原始能力（0.173 -> 0.238绝对pass@1；符号检验单侧p=0.011，Wilcoxon检验p=0.006），以保留率计，从62.9%提升至84.1%。它还在10个种子中的全部10个上优于调参后的权重衰减（p=0.002），并在10个中的8个上优于调参后的EWC（p=0.014），所有实验组均在相同会话中重新测量。

**机制，经测量而非臆断。** Omega-S在构造上是拓扑性的，其目标函数由Tr(A³)构建，但我们测量了其四个因子中究竟哪一个实际起作用，结果显示其中三个并未起作用：它们对权重的弹性系数低至或低于1e-4，而度方差项的弹性系数为9e-3。按当前实现，该复合项实际上等效于对节点度方差的惩罚，即方阵模块中的行幅度以及非方阵模块中的方向对齐。我们报告这一点，是因为一个名称承诺了某种机制而梯度却另有所为的方法应当如实说明。我们还列举了开放的设计选择，包括一种对比保持构造，它确实实现了其设计目标，但在全部十个种子上使保留率变得更差。

在完全相同的配置、相同种子和相同硬件下重复实验，保留率的标准差为0.104。我们尚未发现这一数值在语言模型低秩微调文献中被量化过，而它限定了该领域所有基于种子配对比较的结论范围，包括我们自己的结果。

代码、每个种子的结果以及完整的负面结果记录均已公开。

title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
abstract: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) enables LLMs to solve complex tasks through iterative tool interactions. However, existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on trajectory-level supervision, limiting fine-grained credit assignment in long-horizon TIR scenarios. On-policy self-distillation offers denser signals through teacher branches with privileged context, but existing approaches typically derive such context from ground-truth answers or retrieved skills, which may not reflect the states actually visited by the agent. Moreover, token-level supervision fails to capture the turn-level structure of tool interactions. To address this, we propose TurnSight, a turn-level hindsight self-distillation framework that derives supervision directly from execution-conditioned hindsight. It then constructs multiple hindsight views with different lookahead horizons and selects reliable supervision through cross-horizon directional agreement. Finally, the selected hindsight signal is normalized across sibling rollouts and used to adaptively modulate RL advantages while preserving their original optimization direction. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of TurnSight. Our codes are available at https://github.com/quchangle1/TurnSight.
tldr: The paper proposes TurnSight, a turn-level hindsight self-distillation framework for tool-integrated reasoning in LLMs, which improves credit assignment and achieves state-of-the-art results on three benchmarks.
abstract_cn: 工具集成推理（Tool-Integrated Reasoning, TIR）使大语言模型（LLMs）能够通过迭代式工具交互来解决复杂任务。然而，现有的强化学习方法通常依赖于轨迹级别的监督，这限制了在长时程TIR场景中的细粒度信用分配。在线策略自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation）通过具有特权上下文的教师分支提供更密集的监督信号，但现有方法通常从真实答案或检索到的技能中获取此类上下文，这可能无法反映智能体实际访问的状态。此外，令牌级别的监督无法捕捉工具交互的回合级结构。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TurnSight，一种回合级事后自蒸馏框架，其监督信号直接来源于执行条件化的事后（execution-conditioned hindsight）。该框架进一步构建多个具有不同前瞻视野的事后视图，并通过跨视野方向一致性（cross-horizon directional agreement）选择可靠的监督信号。最后，所选的事后信号在兄弟轨迹（sibling rollouts）之间进行归一化，并用于自适应地调节强化学习优势值，同时保持其原有的优化方向。在三个基准上的大量实验证明了TurnSight的有效性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/quchangle1/TurnSight 获取。

title: Can Large Language Models Recover Semantic Optimization Opportunities That Compilers Miss?
abstract: Optimizing compilers miss profitable transformations when their enabling semantics are absent from the analyzed program representation. We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can recover such semantics from heterogeneous C/C++ context and realize them as validated, contract-preserving artifacts. We introduce SeGaBench, an executable benchmark containing 100 synthetic and 20 source-backed cases spanning low-level assumptions, data-structure invariants, and high-level semantic lifting. Each case includes hidden enabling semantics, an oracle artifact, correctness and semantic validators, and a reproducible performance protocol. We evaluate five LLMs using five independent responses per case. The strongest model produces correct artifacts in 94.8% of responses, achieves at least 1.05x speedup in 83.3%, and obtains a performance success on 93.3% of cases. Nevertheless, correct artifacts often close only part of the oracle gap. These results show that LLMs can complement compiler analysis as speculative semantic proposers, provided that their artifacts are validated and evaluated.
tldr: 该论文提出SeGaBench基准，评估LLM在编译器优化中恢复语义的能力，发现LLM能作为语义推测器，但需验证和评估。
abstract_cn: 优化编译器在分析的程序表示中缺乏使能语义时，会错失有利可图的变换机会。我们探究大语言模型（LLMs）能否从异构的C/C++上下文中恢复此类语义，并将其实现为经过验证的、保持契约的构件。我们引入了SeGaBench，一个可执行的基准测试，包含100个合成案例和20个基于源代码的案例，涵盖底层假设、数据结构不变量以及高层语义提升。每个案例都包含隐藏的使能语义、一个预言构件、正确性与语义验证器，以及一个可复现的性能协议。我们使用每个案例的五个独立响应来评估五个LLM。最强的模型在94.8%的响应中生成了正确的构件，在83.3%的响应中实现了至少1.05倍的加速，并在93.3%的案例中取得了性能成功。然而，正确的构件往往仅弥合了预言差距的一部分。这些结果表明，只要其构件经过验证和评估，LLMs可以作为推测性语义提议者来补充编译器分析。

title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
abstract: We introduce Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR), extending multimodal agents from static images to continuous video streams, a setting that demands dense spatiotemporal grounding coupled with open-web exploration. Preliminary evaluations reveal two critical bottlenecks in current models: (1) modality bias, where agents bypass visual tools in favor of textual search, and (2) parametric knowledge leakage, where models rely on internal memory rather than genuine tool-augmented execution. To address these challenges, we propose Video-DR, featuring a decoupled perception-exploration pipeline with stage-wise tool unlocking that compels exhaustive cross-frame visual grounding prior to web retrieval. Our framework adopts a two-stage training recipe: supervised fine-tuning followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), enabling autonomous exploration that breaks the imitation-learning ceiling. Furthermore, we curate Video-DR-Bench, a human-AI collaborative benchmark comprising 200 complex, multi-hop VQA instances. Empirical results demonstrate that our Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B establishes a new state-of-the-art of 64.0% average accuracy, surpassing proprietary Claude-4.5-Sonnet (59.0%) by 5.0 points and significantly outperforming GPT-5 (52.5%) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (57.5%). The 30B-A3B variant achieves 59.3%, competitive with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and demonstrating the effectiveness of our training paradigm even at compact scale. Code: https://github.com/Osilly/Vision-DeepResearch.
tldr: 该论文提出Video-DeepResearch，一种多模态深度研究智能体，通过解耦感知-探索流程和两阶段训练（SFT+GRPO）解决视频流中的模态偏差和参数知识泄漏问题，在Video-DR-Bench基准上达到64.0%的准确率，超越Claude-4.5-Sonnet等模型。
abstract_cn: 我们提出了Video-DeepResearch（Video-DR），将多模态智能体从静态图像扩展到连续视频流，这一设定要求密集的时空定位与开放式网络探索相结合。初步评估揭示了当前模型的两个关键瓶颈：（1）模态偏差，即智能体绕过视觉工具而倾向于文本搜索；（2）参数化知识泄漏，即模型依赖内部记忆而非真正的工具增强执行。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了Video-DR，其特点是采用解耦的感知-探索流水线，并配合分阶段工具解锁机制，在网络检索之前强制进行全面的跨帧视觉定位。我们的框架采用两阶段训练方案：监督微调后接组相对策略优化（GRPO），从而实现自主探索，突破模仿学习的上限。此外，我们构建了Video-DR-Bench，这是一个人类与AI协作的基准测试集，包含200个复杂的多跳VQA实例。实验结果表明，我们的Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B模型达到了64.0%的平均准确率，创下新的最先进水平，比专有的Claude-4.5-Sonnet（59.0%）高出5.0个百分点，并显著优于GPT-5（52.5%）和Gemini 2.5 Pro（57.5%）。30B-A3B变体达到59.3%的准确率，与Claude-4.5-Sonnet相当，证明了我们的训练范式即使在紧凑规模下也具备有效性。代码：https://github.com/Osilly/Vision-DeepResearch。

title: ReflectRL: Learning from Golden Negative Trajectories via Reflective-to-Direct Reasoning
abstract: On-policy training has emerged as a powerful post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, and is often enhanced by golden trajectories from stronger expert models. However, when the expert fails on harder problems, existing trajectory-guided methods lose their main source of supervision, and these failed trajectories are typically discarded as negative samples. We argue that such failures, which we call Golden Negative Trajectories, can still provide valuable reasoning signals when treated not as demonstrations to imitate, but as flawed trajectories to reflect upon. We identify a Reflection Advantage: for hard problems, reflecting on a flawed trajectory can be easier and more effective than solving the problem directly from scratch. Motivated by this, we propose ReflectRL, a lightweight plug-and-play framework that learns from Golden Negative Trajectories during on-policy training. ReflectRL first uses these trajectories to elicit Reflective Reasoning, then applies Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition to transfer the acquired reasoning behavior back to Direct Reasoning. Experiments across 9 benchmarks, 4 LLM backbones, and 4 on-policy training methods show that ReflectRL consistently improves reasoning performance with minimal overhead.
tldr: The paper proposes ReflectRL, a framework that leverages golden negative trajectories to enhance LLM reasoning via reflective-to-direct policy transition, achieving consistent improvements across benchmarks.
abstract_cn: 基于策略的训练已成为提升大型语言模型推理能力的一种强大的后训练范式，并且通常通过来自更强专家模型的金标准轨迹来增强。然而，当专家在更难的问题上失败时，现有的轨迹引导方法便失去了其主要监督来源，而这些失败的轨迹通常作为负样本被丢弃。我们认为，这些失败——我们称之为金标准负轨迹——如果不被视为需要模仿的示范，而是作为需要反思的有缺陷轨迹，仍然可以提供有价值的推理信号。我们识别出一种反思优势：对于难题，反思一条有缺陷的轨迹可能比从头直接解决问题更容易且更有效。基于此，我们提出了ReflectRL，一种轻量级即插即用框架，在基于策略的训练过程中从金标准负轨迹中学习。ReflectRL首先利用这些轨迹引发反思性推理，然后应用反思到直接策略迁移，将所学到的推理行为迁移回直接推理。在9个基准、4个大型语言模型骨干和4种基于策略的训练方法上的实验表明，ReflectRL以最小的开销持续提升了推理性能。

title: Should We Type or Talk to LLM Agents? A Comprehensive Study of Voice and Keyboard Input Perturbations
abstract: Human input reaches language models by typing or speaking, and each channel leaves a distinct signature: orthographic noise for keyboards; for voice, disfluency from conventional transcription and restructuring from AI-backed dictation tools. How do they impact an LLM's performance? In this paper we present HIVE (Human Input-Variation Engine), a suite of voice transcription perturbations and QWERTY keyboard perturbations. We use HIVE to evaluate how robust models are to these perturbations. We present seven findings. (i) Voice transcription perturbations lower accuracy across every instruction-tuned model we test, and it is the structure of the transcription rather than its fillers that carries the cost. (ii) QWERTY keyboard perturbations cost less, and a model absorbs a lot of them before accuracy falls away. (iii) Both trace back to one cause, how many of the question's tokens survive the perturbation: destroying a token is what hurts, while adding new ones alongside it costs little. (iv) The gap between the two channels appears only where the answer must be constructed or deduced; on multiple choice there is none. (v) The harm does not solely come from test-set contamination. (vi) It cannot be trained away with lightweight adaptation. (vii) A thinking budget recovers the keyboard channel almost entirely but leaves the spoken registers untouched, and compressed speech is worse with it.
tldr: This paper studies how voice and keyboard input perturbations affect LLM performance, finding that voice transcription perturbations are more harmful than keyboard perturbations, and that the damage is primarily due to token destruction.
abstract_cn: 人类输入通过打字或语音到达语言模型，每种渠道都会留下独特的印记：键盘产生拼写噪声；语音则带来传统转录中的不流畅以及AI辅助听写工具造成的结构重组。这些因素如何影响大语言模型的性能？在本文中，我们提出了HIVE（人类输入变异引擎），一套包含语音转录扰动和QWERTY键盘扰动的工具集。我们使用HIVE来评估模型对这些扰动的鲁棒性。我们提出了七项发现。（i）语音转录扰动降低了我们测试的所有指令微调模型的准确率，且造成损失的主要是转录的结构而非其中的填充词。（ii）QWERTY键盘扰动造成的损失较小，模型在准确率下降之前能够吸收大量此类扰动。（iii）两者都可追溯至同一个原因，即问题中有多少词元在扰动后幸存：破坏一个词元才会造成伤害，而在其旁边添加新词元则代价甚微。（iv）两种渠道之间的差距仅出现在需要构造或推导答案的任务中；在选择题上则没有差异。（v）这种损害并非仅来自测试集污染。（vi）轻量级适配无法将其训练消除。（vii）思考预算几乎能完全恢复键盘渠道的性能，但对语音渠道几乎没有改善，且压缩语音在加入思考预算后表现更差。

title: Separating quantum circuits from classical LLMs
abstract:
Modern large language models - transformers and diffusion language models - are built around two canonical algorithmic tasks: prediction and generation. We prove unconditional separations between low-depth quantum computation and the corresponding bounded-resource classical language-model architectures in both regimes. Concretely, we exhibit the following:
  1. Distributional separation. We give a distribution that is sampleable by $\textsf{QNC}^0$ circuits (i.e., a family of constant-depth quantum circuits consisting of bounded fan-in gates) that no constant-round diffusion language model ($\textsf{DLM}$) with shallow scheduling and denoising can sample within constant distance, even when allowed sublinear chain-of-thought and output-token revision/remasking events, the very features modern $\textsf{DLM}$s rely on.
  2. Functional separation. We exhibit a function computable in $\land \circ \textsf{QNC}^0[\log\log n]$ (i.e., a family of O$(\log\log n)$-depth $\textsf{QNC}^0$ circuits, where $n$ is the input length, followed by a single classical $\mathsf{AND}$ gate) such that any constant-depth decoder-only transformer computing the function must be large: it would have to have width $n^{Ω(1)}$.
  Together, our work initiates the study of quantum advantage in the era of large language models.
tldr: 该论文证明了低深度量子计算与有界资源经典语言模型在预测和生成任务上的无条件分离，展示了量子优势在LLM时代的可能性。
abstract_cn:
现代大型语言模型——包括Transformer和扩散语言模型——是围绕两个经典算法任务构建的：预测与生成。我们证明了在这两种机制下，低深度量子计算与相应的有界资源经典语言模型架构之间存在无条件分离。具体而言，我们展示了以下结果：

1. 分布性分离。我们给出一个可由$\textsf{QNC}^0$电路（即由有界扇入门组成的常数深度量子电路族）采样的分布，使得任何具有浅层调度和去噪过程的常数轮扩散语言模型（$\textsf{DLM}$）都无法在常数距离内对其进行采样，即使允许亚线性链式思维和输出令牌修订/重掩码事件——这些正是现代$\textsf{DLM}$所依赖的特性。

2. 功能性分离。我们展示了一个可在$\land \circ \textsf{QNC}^0[\log\log n]$中计算的函数（即由$O(\log\log n)$深度$\textsf{QNC}^0$电路族组成，其中$n$为输入长度，后接一个经典$\mathsf{AND}$门），使得任何计算该函数的常数深度仅解码器Transformer都必须规模庞大：其宽度必须达到$n^{\Omega(1)}$。

综合而言，我们的工作开启了大语言模型时代量子优势的研究。

title: Interpretable Adaptive Sampling for LLM Test-Time Scaling
abstract: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by generating and aggregating multiple candidate answers, yet many pipelines use fixed per-query budgets that spend the same compute on easy and difficult prompts. These fixed budgets are also difficult to inspect because they do not explain why a given prompt receives a particular number of samples. We propose adaptive} test-time scaling with a lightweight fuzzy controller that maps interpretable signals, including estimated prompt complexity and model confidence, to a per-query sampling budget. The controller assigns fewer samples to easier or more confident prompts and more samples to harder or less certain prompts, making inference-time compute inspectable rather than fixed or opaque. We evaluate under a fair-alignment protocol with matched decoding settings and controlled answer selection, and compare against best-of-$N$, compute-aware scaling, and self-certainty-based baselines on question-answering and mathematical reasoning tasks. Across models and datasets, adaptive fuzzy control improves over several standard baselines and remains close to a selector-matched full-budget control while reducing the average number of samples. These findings suggest that interpretable adaptive sampling is a practical direction for more efficient test-time reasoning in large language models.
tldr: The paper proposes an interpretable adaptive sampling method for LLM test-time scaling, using a fuzzy controller to allocate sampling budgets based on prompt complexity and confidence, improving efficiency while maintaining performance.
abstract_cn: 测试时扩展通过生成并聚合多个候选答案来提升大语言模型的推理能力，然而许多流程采用固定的每查询预算，对简单和困难的提示词分配相同的计算量。这些固定预算也难以检查，因为它们无法解释为何某个给定提示词会获得特定数量的样本。我们提出了一种自适应的测试时扩展方法，采用轻量级模糊控制器，将可解释的信号（包括估计的提示词复杂度和模型置信度）映射到每查询的采样预算。该控制器为较简单或置信度较高的提示词分配较少的样本，而为较困难或置信度较低的提示词分配更多的样本，从而使推理时的计算量变得可检查，而非固定或不可透明。我们在公平对齐协议下进行评估，匹配解码设置并控制答案选择，并与最佳N（best-of-\(N\)）、计算量感知扩展以及基于自置信度的基线在问答和数学推理任务上进行对比。跨模型和数据集，自适应模糊控制在多个标准基线上有所改进，并在减少平均样本数的同时，保持与选择器匹配的全预算控制相近的性能。这些发现表明，可解释的自适应采样是大语言模型中更高效测试时推理的一个实用方向。

title: A game theory for foundation models shows new paths to rational cooperation through similarity inference
abstract: As autonomous agents powered by foundation models are increasingly integrated into social and economic systems, understanding the principles governing their collective behavior is essential for ensuring safety and cooperation. Classical game theory, the dominant framework for modeling rational interaction, is built upon the assumption of `decoupled agency,' where agents treat their own decision-making as independent of the environment and other actors. Modern AI agents, however, jointly predict their own future actions alongside external observations. Here, we report a striking finding: when interacting in stylized social dilemmas, foundation model agents engaging in optimal planning consistently converge to stable cooperation, directly contradicting classical game-theoretic predictions of mutual defection. To understand this phenomenon, we introduce the `embedded Bayesian agent,' a theoretical model for foundation model agents. By shifting from decoupled to embedded agency, these agents model themselves as part of the universe they inhabit, maintaining epistemic uncertainty about their own decision-making algorithms. We show that by inferring whether others are behaviorally similar, an embedded agent treats its own deliberation during planning as evidence: a decision to cooperate predicts a similar decision by a similar partner. We formalize this mechanism of similarity inference through the `embedded equilibrium,' a novel solution concept replacing the Nash equilibrium to provide a foundational game theory for the social behavior of modern AI agents.
tldr: 该论文提出嵌入式贝叶斯智能体模型，通过相似性推断机制解释了基础模型智能体在博弈中实现稳定合作的现象，并引入嵌入式均衡替代纳什均衡。
abstract_cn: 由基础模型驱动的自主智能体日益融入社会和经济系统，理解其集体行为所遵循的规律对于确保安全与合作至关重要。经典博弈论作为模拟理性互动的主导框架，建立在“解耦能动性”假设之上，即智能体将其自身决策视为独立于环境及其他行动者。然而，现代人工智能智能体在预测外部观测的同时，会联合预测自身未来的行动。在此，我们报告一项引人注目的发现：在风格化的社会困境中互动时，进行最优规划的基础模型智能体始终趋向于稳定合作，这与经典博弈论关于相互背叛的预测直接相悖。为理解这一现象，我们引入“嵌入式贝叶斯智能体”作为基础模型智能体的理论模型。通过从解耦能动性转向嵌入式能动性，这些智能体将自身建模为其所栖居宇宙的一部分，并对其自身决策算法保持认知不确定性。我们证明，通过推断他人是否在行为上相似，嵌入式智能体在规划过程中将其自身 deliberation 视为证据：合作的决定预示着相似伙伴会做出类似决定。我们通过“嵌入式均衡”这一新颖解概念形式化了这一相似性推断机制，该概念取代纳什均衡，为现代人工智能智能体的社会行为提供了基础博弈论。

title: TACT: Taxonomy-Aligned Post-Training for Pedagogically Adaptive English Tutoring
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to provide conversational practice for English-as-a-second-language (ESL) learners. Effective ESL tutoring, however, requires more than fluent response generation: a tutor must select an appropriate pedagogical action based on learner behavior and dialogue context. Human-tutoring research offers principles for adaptive support, but they are often task-specific and remain insufficiently integrated into LLM-based ESL tutor training and evaluation. We present TACT (Taxonomy-Aligned Conversational Tutor), a human-grounded framework for post-training and evaluating pedagogically adaptive ESL tutors. Drawing on established literature, we develop two complementary taxonomies: the Tutor-Strategy Taxonomy with 13 tutor response strategies and the Student-Move Taxonomy characterizing learner behavior by move type and status. Using these taxonomies, we construct TACTCorpus, which enriches 260 authentic teacher-student conversations with 32,379 annotations and quality-controlled augmented training data. We then post-train Qwen3.5-4B through supervised fine-tuning followed by taxonomy-aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization, producing TACTutor and optimizing it for scaffolding quality rather than reference imitation alone. On TACTBench, a strategy-balanced diagnostic benchmark comprising 78 authentic tutoring contexts, TACTutor improves over its backbone by 20.30% and outperforms all evaluated proprietary baselines under the same protocol, while maintaining backbone performance on established external educational benchmarks; in a blinded study with 50 learners, it also receives the highest overall mean rating among the evaluated tutors. We release the data, benchmark, and model weights, providing an open foundation for developing pedagogically adaptive ESL tutors.
tldr: The paper introduces TACT, a framework for post-training LLMs to provide pedagogically adaptive English tutoring, improving scaffolding quality over baselines.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用于为英语作为第二语言（ESL）学习者提供对话练习。然而，有效的ESL辅导不仅仅需要流畅的回复生成：辅导者必须根据学习者的行为和对话情境选择合适的教学行动。人类辅导研究为适应性支持提供了原则，但这些原则往往针对特定任务，且尚未充分整合到基于LLM的ESL辅导者训练和评估中。我们提出TACT（Taxonomy-Aligned Conversational Tutor，基于分类学对齐的对话辅导者），一个以人为基础、用于后训练和评估教学适应性ESL辅导者的框架。基于既有文献，我们开发了两个互补的分类体系：包含13种辅导者回应策略的辅导者策略分类体系，以及按动作类型和状态刻画学习者行为的学员动作分类体系。利用这些分类体系，我们构建了TACTCorpus，该语料库为260段真实师生对话补充了32,379条标注，并包含经过质量控制增强的训练数据。随后，我们通过监督微调并结合分类学对齐的组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization）对Qwen3.5-4B进行后训练，生成TACTutor，并针对脚手架质量而非单纯的参考模仿进行优化。在TACTBench（一个包含78个真实辅导情境的策略均衡诊断基准）上，TACTutor相较于其基础模型提升了20.30%，并在相同协议下优于所有被评估的专有基线模型，同时在既有外部教育基准上保持了基础模型的性能；在一项包含50名学习者的盲评研究中，TACTutor在所有被评估的辅导者中获得了最高的总体平均评分。我们公开了数据、基准和模型权重，为开发教学适应性的ESL辅导者提供了开放基础。

title: The Transformer Revolution, Part 1: Dynamic Processing through Output- Weight Interconnections
abstract: This paper offers a new interpretation of the Transformer during inference. Against the "stochastic parrot" view that large language models merely reproduce statistical regularities learned in training, we argue that Transformers construct and apply prompt-dependent transformations whose parameters are generated during inference. We call this form of computation SIDPP: Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing. The Transformer is interpreted as a system that transforms concepts by means of concepts. Token vectors are the concepts to be transformed; parameterized transformations defined by matrices and vectors are the transforming concepts. These may be static, when fixed through training, or dynamic, when generated from the input sequence. Mechanically, they correspond to groups of simple neural networks. The Transformer's architectural novelty lies in output-weight interconnections, through which the outputs of some networks determine the weights of others, alongside ordinary output-input interconnections. By means of these interconnections, the system constructs transformations from the prompt and uses them to modify token representations. The contribution of dynamic processing grows with prompt length and may equal or exceed that of static processing, a phenomenon we call strong prompt sensitivity. This account bears on interpretability, predictability, control, and the design of smaller, more sustainable systems. Finally, since the human neural system possesses the mechanisms required to implement SIDPP, we argue that a form of SIDPP may, in principle, be neurally realized in the cerebral cortex. We therefore conjecture that human language processing may itself be a form of SIDPP produced by a functional architecture relevantly similar to that of the Transformer.
tldr: The paper proposes a new interpretation of the Transformer as a system that dynamically constructs and applies prompt-dependent transformations during inference, and conjectures that human language processing may similarly operate.
abstract_cn: 本文对Transformer在推理阶段的工作机制提出了一种新的解释。针对“随机鹦鹉”观点——即大语言模型仅仅复现训练中所学到的统计规律——我们主张，Transformer构建并应用依赖于提示（prompt）的变换，而这些变换的参数是在推理过程中生成的。我们将这种计算形式称为SIDPP：序列级交互式动态并行处理（Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing）。Transformer被解释为一个通过概念来变换概念的系统。词元向量（token vectors）是被变换的概念；由矩阵和向量定义的参数化变换则是进行变换的概念。这些变换可以是静态的（在训练中固定），也可以是动态的（从输入序列中生成）。在机制上，它们对应于若干简单神经网络的组合。Transformer在架构上的新颖之处在于输出-权重互连（output-weight interconnections），即某些网络的输出决定其他网络的权重，此外还有普通的输出-输入互连（output-input interconnections）。通过这些互连，系统从提示中构建变换，并利用这些变换来修改词元表示。动态处理的贡献随提示长度增加而增长，并可能等于或超过静态处理的贡献，我们将这一现象称为强提示敏感性（strong prompt sensitivity）。这一解释对可解释性、可预测性、可控性以及设计更小、更可持续的系统具有重要意义。最后，由于人类神经系统具备实现SIDPP所需的机制，我们认为，原则上SIDPP的一种形式可以在大脑皮层中以神经方式实现。因此，我们推测，人类语言处理本身可能就是一种SIDPP，其产生所依赖的功能架构与Transformer具有相关相似性。

title: Equivariant Music Transformer
abstract: Humans recognize a musical passage even when it is shifted in time or transposed in pitch, indicating a notion of equivariance in the representation space. Our analysis, however, shows that standard music transformers map such time-shifted or pitch-transposed inputs onto uncorrelated representations: these models become progressively less equivariant as they scale in size or train longer. This suggests that in standard music transformers, additional model capacity is allocated to memorizing absolute patterns rather than capturing shared musical structures. In this paper, we propose the Equivariant Music Transformer (EMT), which enforces equivariance through self-distillation by jointly optimizing a next-token-prediction and an auxiliary equivariance regularization loss. We find that the additional equivariance loss acts as a beneficial regularizer, simultaneously improving next-token prediction and producing equivariant latent representations. Through both objective and subjective evaluations, EMT demonstrates superior equivariance and generative capability compared to data augmentation, feature engineering, and state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines. More broadly, our findings reveal that standard language modeling methods alone do not capture music's translational symmetries, and dedicated inductive biases are required to produce better music representations. The code, weights and demos are available online.
tldr: The paper proposes the Equivariant Music Transformer (EMT) to enforce equivariance in music representations via self-distillation, improving next-token prediction and generative capability, but it is unrelated to recommender systems.
abstract_cn: 人类即使在音乐片段发生时间平移或音高转调时，仍能识别出该片段，这表明表征空间中存在等变性的概念。然而，我们的分析显示，标准音乐变换器会将此类时间平移或音高转调的输入映射到不相关的表征上：这些模型随着规模增大或训练时间延长，其等变性逐渐减弱。这表明，在标准音乐变换器中，额外的模型容量被用于记忆绝对模式，而非捕捉共享的音乐结构。在本文中，我们提出了等变音乐变换器（Equivariant Music Transformer, EMT），该模型通过自蒸馏强制实现等变性，联合优化下一词元预测（next-token-prediction）和辅助等变正则化损失。我们发现，额外的等变损失起到了有益的正则化作用，同时提升了下一词元预测的性能并产生了等变的潜在表征。通过客观和主观评估，EMT在等变性和生成能力方面均优于数据增强、特征工程以及最先进（state-of-the-art, SOTA）基线方法。更广泛地说，我们的研究结果表明，仅靠标准语言建模方法无法捕捉音乐的平移对称性，需要专门的归纳偏置才能生成更好的音乐表征。代码、权重和演示均可在网上获取。

title: When and Where to Look: Adaptive Visual Evidence Scheduling for Efficient Long Video Understanding
abstract: Efficient long-video understanding requires vision--language models (VLMs) to reason over a small number of frames selected as sparse visual evidence. Existing relevance-based methods rely on static one-shot selection with fixed frame budgets and candidate pools, while agent-based schedulers achieve adaptivity through costly multi-round reasoning and interactive search. We propose EcoFrame, a training-free framework for low-overhead query-adaptive visual evidence scheduling. EcoFrame leverages the VLM's inference feedback to determine when to increase the frame budget and where to search for additional candidate evidence. Specifically, entropy-gated budget scheduling uses output uncertainty to stop early when the current evidence is sufficient or progressively expand the frame budget otherwise. Meanwhile, attention-guided candidate proposal converts frame-level attention into a temporal prior, enabling dense local search in informative regions while preserving global coverage when attention is diffuse. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate that EcoFrame achieves a better accuracy--efficiency trade-off across multiple VLM backbones. On Qwen2.5-VL, EcoFrame achieves an average accuracy of 64.4, surpassing BOLT at 63.5, while providing a $1.85\times$ speedup over AKS and BOLT. Compared with the agent-based A.I.R., EcoFrame maintains comparable accuracy with up to a $13.5\times$ inference speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/EcoFrame.
tldr: The paper proposes EcoFrame, a training-free framework for adaptive visual evidence scheduling in long-video understanding, achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs than existing methods.
abstract_cn: 高效的长视频理解要求视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在少量被选为稀疏视觉证据的帧上进行推理。现有的基于相关性的方法依赖于静态的一次性选择，并采用固定的帧预算和候选池，而基于智能体的调度器则通过代价高昂的多轮推理和交互式搜索来实现自适应性。我们提出EcoFrame，一个无需训练的低开销查询自适应视觉证据调度框架。EcoFrame利用VLM的推理反馈来决定何时增加帧预算以及在哪里搜索额外的候选证据。具体而言，熵门控预算调度利用输出不确定性，在当前证据充分时提前停止，否则逐步扩大帧预算。同时，注意力引导的候选提议将帧级注意力转换为时间先验，从而在信息丰富的区域实现密集局部搜索，同时在注意力分散时保持全局覆盖。在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和MLVU上的实验表明，EcoFrame在多种VLM骨干网络上实现了更好的精度-效率权衡。在Qwen2.5-VL上，EcoFrame的平均精度达到64.4，超过了BOLT的63.5，同时相比AKS和BOLT提供了1.85倍的加速。与基于智能体的A.I.R.相比，EcoFrame在保持相当精度的同时，实现了高达13.5倍的推理加速。代码将在https://github.com/AK-DREAM/EcoFrame提供。

title: Implementing Causal Perception: Competing SCMs and Situated Fairness
abstract: Causal perception occurs when agents with competing Structural Causal Models (SCMs) of the same system infer different probability distributions, including the hypothetical distributions implied by each agent's SCM under the same set of interventions. It shapes how agents reason about the system and how they perceive its fairness. Causal perception is a promising probabilistic framework, but it has remained purely theoretical. This work provides the first implementation of the causal perception framework of Álvarez and Ruggieri (2025). We operationalize structural (agents disagree on the causal graph) and parametrical (agents agree on the causal graph but disagree on its weights) causal perception. We design algorithms for computing interventional and counterfactual distributions and propose suitable distance measures to quantify the disagreement. Using the German Credit dataset, we illustrate how causal perception affects accuracy and fairness in a multi-expert decision setting. We show that the perception verdict is sensitive to the choice of distance metric and threshold. We also show that causal perception changes fairness assessments and threshold-based decisions. Bias proves situated with respect to the agent's SCM, demonstrating that competing worldviews in fairness problems cannot be ignored.
tldr: 该论文首次实现了因果感知框架，通过竞争性结构因果模型量化智能体间的分歧，并展示了因果感知如何影响多专家决策中的准确性和公平性，强调公平性是情境化的。
abstract_cn: 因果感知发生在当对同一系统持有竞争性结构因果模型（SCMs）的智能体推断出不同概率分布时，包括每个智能体的SCM在相同干预集下所隐含的假设分布。它塑造了智能体如何推理该系统以及如何感知其公平性。因果感知是一个有前景的概率框架，但此前一直停留在纯理论层面。本研究首次实现了Álvarez和Ruggieri（2025）的因果感知框架。我们操作化了结构性（智能体对因果图存在分歧）和参数性（智能体对因果图一致但对权重存在分歧）因果感知。我们设计了用于计算干预分布和反事实分布的算法，并提出了合适的距离度量来量化分歧。利用德国信用数据集，我们展示了因果感知如何在多专家决策情境中影响准确性和公平性。我们表明，感知判定对距离度量和阈值的选择敏感。我们还表明，因果感知会改变公平性评估和基于阈值的决策。偏见被证明是相对于智能体的SCM而情境化的，这表明公平性问题中竞争性的世界观不可忽视。

title: When Efficiency Becomes Fragility: Exploiting Dynamic Routing Vulnerabilities in Adaptive UAV Tracking
abstract: Resource constraints on UAV platforms have driven a paradigm shift in aerial tracking, from pursuing performance toward balancing accuracy with efficiency. Adaptive Transformer Trackers, which leverage an input-dependent dynamic routing architecture, have emerged as a representative solution to this challenge. However, we reveal that behind this computation-on-demand flexibility hides a critical structural flaw: the Lipschitz singularity of computational path decisions, which has an unbounded local Lipschitz constant at discrete layer-skipping decision boundaries. This mathematical discontinuity renders adaptive tracking networks inherently unstable: tiny input perturbations can be amplified at the gating modules, causing dramatic changes in the inference topology. We formally characterize this singularity in the context of adaptive tracking architectures and, for the first time, identify it as a directly exploitable new attack surface. This insight reveals a previously overlooked and highly vulnerable topological path space attack surface. Based on this, we propose the Adversarial Path-Inversion (API) framework. API generates imperceptible perturbations to precisely manipulate the gating decisions, forcing the inference onto altered computational paths. The severe inconsistency between the original and the inverted paths dismantles the representation capability of the model. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art adaptive trackers demonstrate that API achieves superior perturbation stealthiness, more effective attack, and faster inference speeds. This work opens a new dimension for the security analysis of dynamic tracking networks and provides a theoretical warning for constructing robust adaptive tracking architectures in the future.
tldr: 该论文揭示了自适应Transformer跟踪器中动态路由的Lipschitz奇异性，并提出对抗性路径反转（API）框架来利用这一漏洞，实现高效且隐蔽的攻击。
abstract_cn: 无人机平台上的资源约束推动了对空天跟踪的研究范式转变，从追求性能转向在精度与效率之间寻求平衡。自适应Transformer跟踪器利用输入依赖的动态路由架构，已成为应对这一挑战的代表性解决方案。然而，我们揭示出，在这种按需计算灵活性背后隐藏着一个关键的结构性缺陷：计算路径决策的Lipschitz奇异性，其在离散的层跳决策边界处具有无界的局部Lipschitz常数。这种数学上的不连续性使得自适应跟踪网络本质上不稳定：微小的输入扰动可在门控模块处被放大，导致推理拓扑发生剧烈变化。我们在自适应跟踪架构的背景下正式刻画了这一奇异性，并首次将其识别为一个可直接利用的新型攻击面。这一发现揭示了一个此前被忽视且高度脆弱的拓扑路径空间攻击面。基于此，我们提出了对抗性路径反转（Adversarial Path-Inversion, API）框架。API生成不可感知的扰动以精确操控门控决策，迫使推理沿被改变的路径进行。原始路径与反转路径之间的严重不一致性瓦解了模型的表示能力。在最新自适应跟踪器上的大量实验表明，API在扰动隐蔽性、攻击有效性和推理速度方面均表现更优。这项工作为动态跟踪网络的安全分析开辟了新维度，并为未来构建鲁棒的自适应跟踪架构提供了理论警示。

title: Intertemporal Preference Steering in Qwen3 via Contrastive Activation Addition
abstract: We study linear representations of temporal horizon in the large language model Qwen3-32B and use them to change the model's time-related preferences, recommendations, and capabilities. We train contrastive linear probes on teacher-forced temporal-choice answers to find a short-term versus long-term direction in the model's residual stream, and evaluate contrastive activation-addition steering on a held-out binary temporal-choice task, an out-of-distribution monetary intertemporal-choice task, and a TravelPlanner capability benchmark. The central result is that temporal-horizon directions can be identified with simple contrastive linear probes and then used for steering to induce large, bidirectional preference changes. On an out-of-distribution monetary choice task that varies reward size and delay, steering strongly shifts the model's indifference threshold between smaller-sooner and larger-later rewards in both directions. We further show improvements on a planning-related capability metric under moderate temporal steering. These results suggest that model intertemporal preferences are measurable and steerable, which is relevant for AI systems that give advice involving delayed costs and benefits, and for safety questions about long-horizon planning.
tldr: 该论文通过对比线性探针识别Qwen3-32B中的时间视野方向，并利用对比激活添加进行双向偏好引导，显著改变模型在时间选择任务上的偏好，并提升规划能力。
abstract_cn: 我们研究了大型语言模型Qwen3-32B中时间视野的线性表示，并利用这些表示来改变模型与时间相关的偏好、建议及能力。我们在教师强制的时间选择答案上训练对比线性探针，以在模型的残差流中找到短期与长期方向，并在一个留出的二元时间选择任务、一个分布外货币跨期选择任务以及一个TravelPlanner能力基准上评估对比激活添加引导的效果。核心结果表明，时间视野方向可以通过简单的对比线性探针识别，并用于引导以引发大幅度的双向偏好变化。在一个改变奖励大小和延迟的分布外货币选择任务中，引导显著地双向移动了模型在较小更早奖励与较大更晚奖励之间的无差异阈值。我们进一步展示了在适度时间引导下，规划相关能力指标有所提升。这些结果表明，模型的跨期偏好是可测量且可引导的，这对于涉及延迟成本与收益建议的人工智能系统，以及关于长视野规划的安全性问题具有重要意义。

title: CARE-X: Towards Clinically Useful Radiology VLMs with Auxiliary Supervision, Reward-Aligned Learning, and Tool-Augmented Measurement
abstract: A clinically useful chest X-ray system must go beyond fluent report generation: it should classify findings with tunable decision thresholds, localize them spatially, and derive the anatomical measurements upon which many diagnoses depend. Today's Vision-Language Models (VLMs) treat these as separate problems, if they address them at all, leaving a gap between what radiologists need and what generative models provide. We introduce CARE-X, a chest X-ray VLM that narrows this gap by unifying auxiliary discriminative supervision with reward-aligned generation. CARE-X augments its generative backbone with focal-loss classification and composite-loss grounding heads, co-trained alongside the language-modeling objective. This auxiliary supervision produces discriminative diagnostic predictions with tunable decision thresholds and precise spatial localization while also improving report quality, providing evidence that structured prediction and generation reinforce one another. Building on this foundation, Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization (DAPO) leverages task-specific reward signals for report generation, visual question answering (VQA), and spatial grounding, directly optimizing the clinical quality metrics that matter in practice. The result is state-of-the-art performance on the majority of metrics across four report-generation benchmarks, 94.0% VQA accuracy on ReXVQA (+6.0 pp over the next-best baseline), and generative spatial decoding that reaches near parity with dedicated detection heads. Separately, to address measurement-dependent diagnoses, we couple Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct with native tool-calling capabilities for invoking deterministic measurement tools, while retaining full visual access to the image. This hybrid inference yields +43.6 pp average F1 over perception-only baselines across five measurement-dependent conditions.
tldr: 该论文提出CARE-X，一个用于胸部X光报告的视觉语言模型，通过辅助监督和奖励对齐提升生成质量，并集成工具增强测量能力，但研究内容与推荐系统无关。
abstract_cn: 一个临床可用的胸部X光系统必须超越流畅的报告生成：它应当以可调节的决策阈值对发现进行分类，在空间上对其进行定位，并推导出许多诊断所依赖的解剖学测量值。当前的视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）即便涉及这些问题，也往往将其视为相互独立的任务，从而导致放射科医生的实际需求与生成模型所能提供的能力之间存在差距。我们提出了CARE-X，一种胸部X光视觉-语言模型，通过将辅助判别监督与奖励对齐生成相统一来缩小这一差距。CARE-X在其生成骨干网络之上增加了基于焦点损失的分类头与基于复合损失的定位头，并与语言建模目标共同训练。这种辅助监督不仅产生了具有可调节决策阈值和精确空间定位的判别性诊断预测，同时还提升了报告质量，为结构化预测与生成相互促进提供了证据。在此基础之上，解耦裁剪与动态采样策略优化（Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization, DAPO）利用任务特定的奖励信号来优化报告生成、视觉问答（visual question answering, VQA）和空间定位，直接优化实践中至关重要的临床质量指标。最终，CARE-X在四个报告生成基准的大多数指标上达到了最先进的性能，在ReXVQA上取得了94.0%的VQA准确率（较次优基线提升6.0个百分点），并且其生成式空间解码能力接近专用检测头的水平。此外，为应对依赖测量的诊断场景，我们将Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct与原生工具调用能力相结合，用于调用确定性的测量工具，同时保留对图像的完整视觉访问。这种混合推理方式在五种依赖测量的临床条件下，相较于仅依赖感知的基线，平均F1分数提升了43.6个百分点。

title: ParVL: Parallel Scaling and Expandable Compute Allocation for Multimodal LLMs
abstract: Existing scaling strategies for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically expand either model parameters or sequential inference computation, incurring substantial memory or latency overhead. More importantly, most existing methods fail to alter the rigid, fixed computation allocation between the Vision Transformer and the Large Language Model components, limiting task-specific optimization. To address this, we introduce the Parallel Vision-Language (ParVL) scaling framework for MLLMs, which scales parallel computation by reusing the existing ViT and LLM backbone parameters across multiple vision and language branches. This framework raises a central question: given a fixed backbone parameter budget, how should additional shared-backbone computation be allocated between the vision and language modalities? We instantiate each parallel computational stream with branch-specific prefix parameters over a shared backbone, and train the entire model end-to-end via full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on roughly 13B tokens. We systematically study the computation-allocation trade-off between the ViT encoder and LLM decoder. ParVL improves overall multimodal performance over same-recipe single-branch baselines, and the best evaluated vision--language allocation varies across tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/YangYangGirl/ParVL.
tldr: 该论文提出ParVL框架，通过并行扩展和可扩展计算分配来优化多模态大语言模型的性能，但未涉及推荐系统。
abstract_cn: 现有针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的扩展策略通常要么扩展模型参数，要么扩展序列推理计算量，从而带来显著的内存或延迟开销。更重要的是，大多数现有方法无法改变视觉Transformer（ViT）与大语言模型（LLM）组件之间固定且刚性的计算分配，从而限制了任务特定的优化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了面向MLLMs的并行视觉-语言（ParVL）扩展框架，该框架通过复用现有的ViT和LLM骨干参数，在多个视觉与语言分支上扩展并行计算。该框架引出一个核心问题：在给定固定骨干参数预算的情况下，额外的共享骨干计算应如何在视觉与语言模态之间进行分配？我们在共享骨干上为每条并行计算流实例化分支特定的前缀参数，并在约130亿个token上通过全参数监督微调对整个模型进行端到端训练。我们系统研究了ViT编码器与LLM解码器之间的计算分配权衡。ParVL在整体多模态性能上优于采用相同训练配方的单分支基线，且最优的视觉-语言计算分配因任务而异。代码已开源至 https://github.com/YangYangGirl/ParVL。

title: SocietyBench: Forecasting Counterfactual Social-World Evolution
abstract: Large language models (LLMs), and the agents built on top of them, are now benchmarked heavily on whether they can finish a task -- fix a bug, drive a browser, operate a GUI. A complementary social ability, namely how well a model understands and forecasts the way real social events unfold, has barely been measured. We introduce SocietyBench, an end-to-end benchmark that takes a one-line event topic, collects Web news and social-media posts across five platforms, distills them into a date-indexed timeline that keeps factual events and a public-opinion layer separate, and then turns every cutoff date on that timeline into an audited bank of forecasting questions. Questions are scored on two orthogonal 100-point axes: probability calibration and temporal accuracy. Before any model sees a timeline, a three-phase procedure replaces every named entity and shifts every date by a per-event constant, turning a real arc into a counterfactual social world -- structurally identical to what happened, but stripped of the surface labels a model could match against pre-training memory. On five heterogeneous events and 125 prediction points in Chinese and English editions, the strongest of six frontier LLMs reaches only 75.0 out of 100, against a trivial anchor of 50. The two axes come apart: a model can be calibration-strong but time-weak, or the reverse. Three agent frameworks built on a shared base model fail to improve on that base, and two model-free heuristics trail every LLM. Per-event gaps reach 21.4 points on a single axis, which is our main argument for evaluating on several events rather than one. All anonymized timelines, question banks, ground truth, and scoring code are released.
tldr: 该论文提出了SocietyBench基准，用于评估LLMs在反事实社会世界演变预测中的表现，发现最强模型得分仅75分，且校准和时间准确性存在分离。
abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）及其上构建的智能体，如今在基准测试中主要被评估的是它们能否完成某项任务——修复漏洞、驱动浏览器、操作图形界面。然而，一种互补性的社会能力，即模型理解并预测真实社会事件如何展开的能力，却几乎没有被衡量过。我们提出SocietyBench，一个端到端的基准测试框架：它接收一行事件主题，收集来自五个平台的网络新闻和社交媒体帖子，将其提炼为按日期索引的时间线，并将事实事件与公众舆论层分开存储；随后，时间线上的每个截止日期都被转化为一组经过审计的预测问题。问题在两个正交的百分制轴上评分：概率校准度与时间准确性。在任何模型看到时间线之前，一个三阶段流程会替换所有命名实体，并将每个日期按事件特定的常数进行平移，从而将真实事件弧转化为一个反事实的社会世界——其结构与真实发生的事件完全相同，但剥离了模型可能对照预训练记忆进行匹配的表面标签。在五个异质事件及中英文版本共125个预测点上，六个前沿LLM中最强的一个仅达到75.0分（满分100），而一个平凡锚点基线为50分。两个轴表现出明显分化：一个模型可能校准能力强但时间能力弱，或反之。三个基于同一基础模型构建的智能体框架未能超越该基础模型，而两种无模型启发式方法则落后于所有LLM。单一轴上的事件间差距最高达21.4分，这正是我们主张在多个事件上评估而非单一事件的主要原因。所有匿名化时间线、问题库、真实标签及评分代码均已公开。

title: WorldCup Arena: Prospective, Leakage-Free Evaluation of Frontier LLMs on a Live Tournament
abstract: Benchmarks that measure the forecasting ability of large language models are almost always retrospective: the event has happened, the answer is somewhere on the Web, and the evaluation must defend itself against memorisation. We report the opposite design. Over the 39 days of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, six frontier LLMs -- all with extended thinking and native server-side web search -- were asked before every kickoff, one match at a time, to fill in a seven-market prediction card for all 104 matches, plus 12 group winners and a pre-tournament outright pool; no answer existed when the question was asked, so the evaluation is leakage-free by construction rather than by filtering, and the frozen archive holds 4,494 scored predictions. What the tournament establishes is a set of behaviours the six systems share. On match outcome they average 63.9%, level with backing the bookmaker's favourite -- which is in fact what they usually do. They agree with one another far more often than they are right, so a majority vote adds nothing. They under-commit to draws and to goals, and crowd their scoreline picks onto a single prototypical result. Accuracy tracks how lopsided a fixture is rather than how much is known about it: it collapses in the closest ties, where the dossiers are richest, while questions about the tournament as a whole are answered well. On this task the current generation of frontier systems is not sharply differentiated: the standings hold up at the top and the bottom across the run and churn in the middle, and the margins stay narrow throughout. The briefing dossiers, fixtures and official results are released as a benchmark, together with the scoring code.
tldr: 该论文通过实时世界杯比赛预测评估了前沿LLM的预测能力，发现它们与博彩公司赔率相当，但缺乏区分度。
abstract_cn: 衡量大型语言模型预测能力的基准测试几乎总是回顾性的：事件已经发生，答案就在互联网的某个角落，评估必须防范记忆效应。我们报告的是相反的设计。在2026年国际足联世界杯的39天赛程中，六个前沿大语言模型——均具备扩展思维能力和原生服务端网络搜索——在每次开球前被要求逐场填写覆盖全部104场比赛的七市场预测卡，外加12个小组出线球队及赛前冠军总冠军池；问题提出时答案尚不存在，因此该评估从构造上而非通过过滤实现无泄漏，冻结的档案库共包含4，494条已计分预测。本届赛事揭示的是这六个系统共有的行为模式。在比赛结果预测上，它们平均准确率为63.9%，与押注博彩公司热门选项的水平相当——而这实际上也正是它们通常的做法。它们彼此之间的共识远高于其正确率，因此多数投票并无增益。它们对平局和进球数的预测趋于保守，并将比分预测集中于单一原型结果。预测准确度取决于赛事的悬殊程度，而非对其了解的多寡：在最势均力敌的比赛中准确率骤降，而恰恰是这些比赛拥有最丰富的资料档案；相比之下，关于整个赛事的宏观问题则回答得较好。在该任务上，当前这一代前沿系统并未表现出显著分化：排名在赛程中首尾两端保持稳定，中段则频繁变动，且差距始终狭窄。简报档案、赛程及官方结果连同计分代码一并作为基准测试发布。

title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
abstract: Recursive self-improvement requires agents to turn accumulated experience into better future behavior. Personal AI agents offer a concrete setting for studying this capability because they retain preferences, task histories, tool routines, and learned skills across sessions. Yet whether retained experience actually improves them over time has not been systematically tested. We introduce PAST-Bench, a benchmark designed to isolate this question. Each agent runs through ordered sequences of fresh-session tasks under matched conditions that turn retained experience on and off. It spans 26 scenarios and 204 episodes across memory, procedural reuse, information gathering, and update. We report both later-task gains and whether those gains follow the intended save, retrieve, and update pathway. Across seven base models and four agent frameworks, improvement is real but uneven across capabilities. Agents with the same headline gain can differ markedly in whether that gain is supported by evidence of the intended pathway. Guided by these findings, we develop Hermes+, which extends Hermes with five targeted interventions across stages of the agent loop. Hermes+ raises the average gain from retained experience and provides clearer pathway evidence, with its strongest improvement on tasks requiring outdated state to be replaced, although the effect remains capability- and model-dependent. Together, PAST-Bench and Hermes+ provide an evaluation and diagnostic foundation for studying how persistent agents can progress from retaining experience to systematically improving through it. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/PAST-Bench
tldr: The paper introduces PAST-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating recursive self-improvement in personal AI agents, and proposes Hermes+ to improve agents' ability to benefit from retained experience, but it is not related to recommendation systems.
abstract_cn: 递归式自我改进要求智能体将积累的经验转化为未来更优的行为。个人AI智能体为研究这一能力提供了具体场景，因为它们会在多次会话中保留偏好、任务历史、工具例程以及习得的技能。然而，保留的经验是否确实能随时间推移提升其表现，尚未得到系统性验证。我们引入PAST-Bench，一个专门用于隔离这一问题的基准测试。每个智能体在匹配条件下运行有序的新会话任务序列，通过开启或关闭经验保留来进行对照。该基准涵盖26个场景和204个片段，涉及记忆、程序复用、信息收集与更新四个方面。我们既报告后续任务的增益，也报告这些增益是否遵循预期的保存、检索与更新路径。在七个基础模型和四个智能体框架上，改进是真实存在的，但在不同能力上表现不均。具有相同总体增益的智能体，在增益是否得到预期路径证据支持方面可能存在显著差异。基于这些发现，我们开发了Hermes+，它在Hermes的基础上，针对智能体循环的各阶段引入了五项定向干预措施。Hermes+提高了从保留经验中获得的平均增益，并提供了更清晰的路径证据，其最强改进体现在需要替换过时状态的任务上，尽管效果仍依赖于具体能力和模型。总体而言，PAST-Bench和Hermes+为研究持久智能体如何从保留经验逐步走向系统性改进提供了评估与诊断基础。代码：https://github.com/Gen-Verse/PAST-Bench
