title: Agogic: Performance-Timed Music Tokens for LLM-Native Text-to-Symbolic-Music Generation
abstract: Text-to-music language models begin with a choice usually made by default: how to tokenize music. Normally entangled with backbone, data, and recipe, its effect has never been measured in isolation. We fix pretrained Qwen3.5 (0.8B-27B), data, budget, and decoding, and swap only the representation across seven tokenizations, anchoring texture metrics to each representation's model-free ceiling. The ordering is clean and surprising: representation, not model size, is the binding variable for distributional fidelity. Scaling the backbone 34x barely moves Frechet Music Distance (FMD), whereas switching representation halves it. PMT, a performance-resolution stream we release (10 ms timing, per-note velocity, multi-track texture; 609 symbols), reaches FMD 159 at 0.8B against 272-286 for beat grids (1.7-1.8x lower, up to 2.8x elsewhere; non-overlapping bootstrap CIs), so a 0.8B performance-resolution model beats a 27B beat grid. It reappears on a 26M from-scratch backbone and a second performance-resolution tokenizer: a property of the class, not one lucky vocabulary. Nor is it a finer-lattice artifact: snapping PMT's onsets to the beat grids' resolution still leaves it 67-129 FMD ahead of both (n=500). The effect is distributional; whether it is audible is a separate question, left open by our probe, with a human study pre-registered. Native caption adherence is weak but separable: a lightweight decode-time constraint doubles instrument-F1 (.28 to .60) and Correct-Key (.16 to .35) at no distributional cost. We release the harness, 25+ checkpoints, two corpora (86.6k aligned across caption/MIDI/ABC/audio; 6.25M captioned, the largest for music), and an imprinting diagnostic: published text-to-MIDI systems reproduce their training distribution near-invariant to the caption (72% vs. 71% chord-time on disjoint domains). The field's next representation claim can now be measured, not asserted.
tldr: The paper investigates how different music tokenizations affect LLM-based text-to-music generation, finding that representation choice significantly impacts distributional fidelity, and introduces a new performance-resolution tokenization (PMT) that outperforms beat grids even with smaller models.
abstract_cn: 文本到音乐的语言模型通常从一个默认的选择开始：如何对音乐进行分词。这一选择通常与主干网络、数据和训练方案纠缠在一起，其影响从未被单独衡量过。我们固定使用预训练的Qwen3.5（0.8B-27B）、数据、预算和解码方式，仅替换七种分词方案之间的表示形式，并将纹理指标锚定到每种表示的无模型上限。结果排序清晰且出人意料：决定分布保真度的关键变量是表示形式，而非模型规模。将主干网络扩大34倍几乎不改变弗雷歇音乐距离（FMD），而更换表示形式则使其减半。PMT——我们发布的一种演奏分辨率流（10毫秒定时、逐音符力度、多轨纹理；609个符号）——在0.8B规模下达到FMD 159，而节拍网格（1.7-1.8倍更低，其他情况下最高达2.8倍；非重叠自助法置信区间）为272-286，因此一个0.8B的演奏分辨率模型优于27B的节拍网格模型。这一优势在从头训练的26M主干网络和第二种演奏分辨率分词器上同样重现：这是该类表示的特性，而非某个幸运词汇表的偶然结果。这也不是更细网格的伪影：将PMT的起始时间对齐到节拍网格的分辨率后，其FMD仍领先两者67-129（n=500）。该效应是分布层面的；它是否可听是另一个问题，我们的探针未作定论，并已预先注册了一项人类研究。原生字幕遵循能力较弱但可分离：一个轻量级的解码时约束将乐器F1从.28提升至.60，正确调性从.16提升至.35，且不带来分布代价。我们发布了测试工具、25+个检查点、两个语料库（86.6k条在字幕/MIDI/ABC/音频间对齐；625万条带字幕，为音乐领域最大规模），以及一个印记诊断：已发表的文本到MIDI系统对其训练分布的再现几乎不受字幕影响（在不相交领域上和弦时间为72%对71%）。该领域下一个关于表示形式的论断，如今可以被测量，而非仅凭断言。

title: When Attention Goes Blind: Numerical Failure in ALiBi Positional Encodings
abstract: We identify a previously overlooked failure mode of ALiBi positional encoding: its linear bias scaling underflows floating-point precision, which zeroes out a large fraction of attention weights and renders the affected attention heads partially blind. We analyze this failure mode, characterize its impact, and examine four mitigation strategies. We further demonstrate its occurrence in state-of-the-art pretrained models based on ALiBi. Comprehensive pretraining experiments with 148M-parameter decoder models help us to disentangle its effects from out-of-context degradation. We find that ALiBi's failure mode can substantially impair token retrieval while having only a minor effect on standard decoder benchmarks. We propose four training-time mitigation strategies and evaluate them individually and in combinations, finding that log-scaled distances yield the most consistent improvements in passkey retrieval. Despite this problem, default ALiBi slopes remain a surprisingly strong baseline, particularly for needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. Based on these findings we provide concrete recommendations on how to train models with ALiBi.
tldr: The paper identifies a numerical underflow issue in ALiBi positional encodings that impairs token retrieval in transformer models, and proposes mitigation strategies.
abstract_cn: 我们识别出ALiBi位置编码中一个此前被忽视的失效模式：其线性偏置缩放会下溢浮点精度，导致大量注意力权重被置零，从而使受影响的注意力头部分失明。我们分析了这一失效模式，刻画了其影响，并考察了四种缓解策略。我们进一步证明了该失效模式在基于ALiBi的最新预训练模型中的出现。通过使用1.48亿参数解码器模型进行的全面预训练实验，我们将其影响与上下文外退化效应区分开来。我们发现，ALiBi的失效模式可能显著损害令牌检索能力，而对标准解码器基准测试的影响则较小。我们提出了四种训练时缓解策略，并分别及组合评估了它们的效果，发现对数缩放距离在密码检索中带来了最一致的改进。尽管存在这一问题，默认的ALiBi斜率仍然是一个出人意料的强基线，尤其是在大海捞针式检索中。基于这些发现，我们为使用ALiBi训练模型提供了具体建议。

title: string2string Studio: An Interactive, In-Browser Platform for String-to-String Algorithms
abstract: We present string2string Studio, an interactive in-browser platform for string-to-string analysis across natural language processing, computational biology, and the digital humanities. The system integrates six main modules (alignment, distance, similarity, search, generation metrics, and BLAST homology search), operating at character, word, token, line, and residue levels. Its C++-based algorithms compile to WebAssembly, so core operations run locally by default without any installation or data upload. The interface reports scores with their "evidence" (alignments, edit paths, metric matches, search hits, and homology traces), making methods inspectable, debuggable, and comparable on shared inputs. Internal benchmarks show speedups of up to 2,500x over the Python predecessor, faster global/local alignment than a general-purpose native C aligner, and exact agreement with independent references under declared settings. For homology search, the scoped client-side blastn path closely matches NCBI BLAST+ rankings and statistics under matched parameters. A curated showcase and Learn mode present canonical algorithms and metrics as reusable demonstrations. string2string Studio is open-source and freely available at string2string.org.
tldr: This paper introduces string2string Studio, an in-browser platform for string-to-string algorithms, but it is unrelated to recommender systems.
abstract_cn: 我们提出了string2string Studio，一个交互式的浏览器内平台，用于自然语言处理、计算生物学和数字人文领域的字符串到字符串分析。该系统集成了六个主要模块（比对、距离、相似度、搜索、生成指标和BLAST同源搜索），可在字符、单词、词元、行和残基级别进行操作。其基于C++的算法编译为WebAssembly，因此核心操作默认在本地运行，无需任何安装或数据上传。该界面报告得分及其“证据”（比对、编辑路径、指标匹配、搜索命中和同源痕迹），使得方法在共享输入上可检查、可调试且可比较。内部基准测试显示，与Python前身相比，速度提升高达2500倍，全局/局部比对速度快于通用原生C比对器，并且在声明设置下与独立参考结果完全一致。对于同源搜索，受限的客户端blastn路径在匹配参数下与NCBI BLAST+的排名和统计结果高度一致。精选展示和“学习”模式将经典算法和指标作为可复用的演示呈现。string2string Studio是开源的，可在string2string.org免费获取。

title: HalluTruthQA-4K: A Fine-Grained Corpus and Annotation Process for Arabic Hallucination Detection and Truth Verification
abstract: Large language models can generate fluent Arabic answers while introducing factual errors that are difficult to identify and verify. Existing Arabic hallucination resources often assign a binary label to an entire response, indicating whether it is hallucinated or non-hallucinated, but provide limited information about the exact erroneous content, the reason for the error, or the correct factual answer. We present HalluTruthQA-4K, an expanded version of the HalluTruthQA resource containing 4,000 expert-curated Arabic question-answering instances across four knowledge-intensive domains: Islamic knowledge, history, science, and geography. Serving as the official dataset for Track 2 of the HalluScoring 2026 shared task, HalluTruthQA-4K extends our original corpus to 4,000 instances. Each instance pairs an Arabic question with a model-generated response, a verified reference answer, and five plausible distractors. Hallucinated responses are additionally annotated with character-level erroneous spans, human-written explanations, and hierarchical hallucination types. The corpus contains 1,643 hallucinated and 2,357 non-hallucinated responses, with 1,843 annotated erroneous spans. We describe the resource construction and annotation methodology, including question selection, controlled answer generation, candidate construction, expert annotation, independent verification, adjudication, and quality control. We also document the annotation guidelines, taxonomy, data format, inter-annotator agreement, and corpus statistics. HalluTruthQA-4K provides a reusable resource for hallucination detection, span-level error localization, explanation generation, factual verification, and the broader evaluation of factual reliability in Arabic language models.
tldr: 该论文构建了一个包含4000个实例的阿拉伯语幻觉检测与事实核查数据集HalluTruthQA-4K，用于评估大语言模型在阿拉伯语问答中的事实可靠性。
abstract_cn: 大型语言模型能够生成流畅的阿拉伯语回答，但同时也会引入难以识别和验证的事实性错误。现有的阿拉伯语幻觉资源通常为整个回答分配一个二元标签，以指示其是否包含幻觉内容，但关于具体错误内容、错误原因或正确事实答案的信息却十分有限。我们提出了HalluTruthQA-4K，这是HalluTruthQA资源的扩展版本，包含4,000个由专家精心整理的阿拉伯语问答实例，覆盖四个知识密集型领域：伊斯兰知识、历史、科学和地理。作为HalluScoring 2026共享任务第二轨道的官方数据集，HalluTruthQA-4K将我们原有的语料库扩展至4,000个实例。每个实例将一个阿拉伯语问题与一个模型生成的回答、一个经过验证的参考答案以及五个合理的干扰项配对。幻觉回答还额外标注了字符级别的错误片段、人工撰写的解释以及层级化的幻觉类型。该语料库包含1,643个幻觉回答和2,357个非幻觉回答，共标注了1,843个错误片段。我们描述了资源构建和标注方法，包括问题选择、受控答案生成、候选构建、专家标注、独立验证、仲裁和质量控制。我们还记录了标注指南、分类体系、数据格式、标注者间一致性以及语料库统计信息。HalluTruthQA-4K为幻觉检测、片段级错误定位、解释生成、事实验证以及阿拉伯语语言模型事实可靠性的更广泛评估提供了可复用的资源。

title: ANNOTARES: A Dataset for Extracting Logical Structures from German Statutory Texts
abstract: The automatic structural analysis of legal texts is a cornerstone of legal technology, yet the extraction of their logical components remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce the task of identifying and segmenting legal conditions (Tatbestand) and legal consequences (Rechtsfolge) within German statutory texts. To support this task, we present ANNOTARES (Annotations of Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge Sequences), a novel dataset comprising German law texts with span-level annotations. Spanning three distinct legal codes, the dataset is designed to evaluate both domain-specific performance and cross-statute generalizability. We benchmark diverse architectural approaches: a rule-based baseline, CRFs, BiLSTMs, BiLSTM-CRF, and modern Transformer-based models, including BERT variants and LLM-based methods. Our results demonstrate that BERT and LLM-based models achieve superior performance in capturing the complex syntactic structures of legal language. We release our dataset to facilitate further research in automated legal reasoning.
tldr: This paper introduces ANNOTARES, a dataset for segmenting legal conditions and consequences in German statutes, and benchmarks various models, showing that BERT and LLM-based methods perform best.
abstract_cn: 法律文本的自动结构分析是法律技术的一个基石，然而，提取其逻辑组成部分仍然是一个重大挑战。在本文中，我们引入了在德国成文法文本中识别和切分法律要件（Tatbestand）与法律后果（Rechtsfolge）的任务。为支持这一任务，我们提出了ANNOTARES（Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge序列标注），一个包含德语法律文本及其跨度级标注的新型数据集。该数据集涵盖三部不同的法典，旨在评估领域特定性能以及跨法规的泛化能力。我们对多种架构方法进行了基准测试：基于规则的基线、CRFs、BiLSTMs、BiLSTM-CRF，以及现代基于Transformer的模型，包括BERT变体和基于LLM的方法。我们的结果表明，BERT和基于LLM的模型在捕捉法律语言复杂句法结构方面表现出更优的性能。我们发布该数据集，以促进自动化法律推理领域的进一步研究。

title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
abstract: Context lengths of language models (LMs) have dramatically increased, driven by the demands for in-context learning, self-improvement, and long-horizon agentic workflows. Existing long-context corpora, however, are dominated by books, academic articles, and code repositories, which are finite resources and often scarce in long-distance dependencies. In this work, we introduce OctoLong, a context engineering pipeline that instruments an AST parser, a language server backend, and a package manager to facilitate the recursive retrieval of code references, enabling the curation of dependency-rich code contexts of millions of tokens in length. We then train OctoLong-Instruct, a suite of capable long-context open LMs, derived from base models ranging in size from 600M to 14B parameters, via context-extension mid-training on a ~50B-token mixture containing ~6.2B tokens of OctoLong code contexts, followed by ~10B tokens of instruction tuning. Our training ablations and experimental evaluations against 18 state-of-the-art open-weight long-context LMs show that supplanting just 12% of traditional context-extension corpora with OctoLong data yields substantial gains in long-range retrieval, long-term state tracking, repository-level code understanding, and downstream agentic tasks, while also enhancing API usage in short-context coding scenarios.
tldr: The paper proposes OctoLong, a context engineering pipeline that leverages cross-repository code contexts to improve long-context modeling in language models, demonstrating gains in long-range retrieval and agentic tasks.
abstract_cn: 语言模型（LM）的上下文长度因上下文学习、自我改进以及长周期智能体工作流的需求而显著增加。然而，现有的长上下文语料库主要由书籍、学术文章和代码仓库构成，这些资源有限，且往往缺乏长距离依赖关系。在本研究中，我们引入了OctoLong，一种上下文工程流水线，它利用抽象语法树（AST）解析器、语言服务器后端和包管理器，促进代码引用的递归检索，从而能够整理出长度达数百万词元、富含依赖关系的代码上下文。随后，我们训练了OctoLong-Instruct，这是一系列能力强大的长上下文开源语言模型，源自参数规模从6亿到140亿不等的基础模型，通过在包含约62亿词元OctoLong代码上下文的约500亿词元混合语料上进行上下文扩展中期训练，再经过约100亿词元的指令微调完成。我们的训练消融实验以及对18个最先进的开源权重长上下文语言模型的实验评估表明，仅用OctoLong数据替代传统上下文扩展语料库的12%，即可在长距离检索、长期状态跟踪、仓库级代码理解以及下游智能体任务中取得显著提升，同时还能增强短上下文编码场景中的API使用能力。

title: Toward Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy for Benchmarking and Training Long-Horizon Reasoning
abstract: Long-horizon reasoning in recent LLMs demands that the model switch between distinct skills inside a reasoning chain, such as first doing a math derivation, then using the result to plan a schedule. We call such problems cross-skill long-horizon tasks: multi-step tasks whose steps require different reasoning skills and depend on earlier outputs. Existing benchmarks often evaluate individual skills, lacking a principled way to measure how well a model switches between skills. We address this gap from both the evaluation and training sides. We introduce Skill Entropy, a measure of the difficulty of switching from one skill to another. We then propose Skill^2-Bench, a benchmark of cross-skill long-horizon tasks built over 558 skills across 9 verifiable and open-ended domains. Each task is assigned a task-level skill-entropy score and grouped into three difficulty levels. Evaluating 8 frontier and 4 open-source models on Skill^2-Bench reveals a skill-switching gap: accuracy decreases on higher-entropy tasks. We then turn skill entropy from a benchmark scale into a training signal. We propose Skill-Entropy RL, an RL framework where the model predicts not only the answer at each step but also the skill used to produce it. The reward combines step-level correctness with a skill-entropy reward that measures the alignment between the model-predicted skill sequence and the gold skill sequence. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Qwen3-1.7B, Skill-Entropy RL improves the Skill^2-Bench score from 34.4% to 68.4% and from 14.6% to 40.1%, respectively, outperforming competitive baselines. The same pipeline can be applied to off-the-shelf training data such as OpenR1-Math, indicating that skill entropy is a reusable training signal. Code available at: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Skill-Entropy-RL
tldr: 该论文提出技能熵（Skill Entropy）来评估和训练LLM在长程推理中的技能切换能力，并构建了Skill^2-Bench基准，实验表明技能熵RL训练显著提升了模型在跨技能长程任务上的表现。
abstract_cn: 近期大语言模型中的长程推理要求模型在推理链中切换不同的技能，例如先进行数学推导，再利用推导结果来规划日程。我们将此类问题称为跨技能长程任务：即多步骤任务，其各步骤需要不同的推理技能，并依赖于先前步骤的输出。现有基准测试通常评估单一技能，缺乏一种系统性的方法来衡量模型在技能之间切换的能力。我们从评估和训练两个层面填补了这一空白。我们引入了技能熵（Skill Entropy），用于衡量从一种技能切换到另一种技能的难度。随后，我们提出了Skill²-Bench基准测试，该基准涵盖558种技能，覆盖9个可验证且开放式的领域，构建了跨技能长程任务。每项任务均被赋予一个任务级别的技能熵分数，并划分为三个难度等级。在Skill²-Bench上评估8个前沿模型和4个开源模型后，我们发现存在技能切换差距：在熵值较高的任务上，准确率有所下降。接着，我们将技能熵从基准测试的度量尺度转化为训练信号。我们提出了技能熵强化学习（Skill-Entropy RL）框架，在该框架中，模型不仅预测每一步的答案，还预测生成该答案所使用的技能。奖励函数将步骤级别的正确性与技能熵奖励相结合，后者衡量模型预测的技能序列与标准技能序列之间的一致性。在Qwen3-4B-Instruct和Qwen3-1.7B上，技能熵强化学习将Skill²-Bench分数分别从34.4%提升至68.4%，以及从14.6%提升至40.1%，优于多个竞争性基线方法。该训练流程同样适用于现成的训练数据（如OpenR1-Math），表明技能熵是一种可复用的训练信号。代码已开源：https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Skill-Entropy-RL

title: Predicting Brain Morphometry with MT-GNN: Mesh Evolution in Continuous Time with Graph-Based Metric Tensor Embeddings
abstract: Predicting how a subcortical structure's shape will evolve from a few prior scans could support prognosis and clinical-trial enrichment. Existing longitudinal mesh predictors either extrapolate shape trajectories via high-dimensional embeddings or regress vertex deformations directly. We instead predict the surface's intrinsic geometry in continuous time: a single per-structure graph network predicts the future per-vertex first fundamental form (metric tensor) for an arbitrary causal multiple-visit history and an arbitrary prediction horizon, conditioned on a Fourier encoding of the lead time. The predicted metric is decoded into a surface by a differentiable As-Rigid-As-Possible solver, and the model is trained end-to-end on the rigid-aligned vertex error. Training through the reconstruction keeps the decoded prediction a valid surface and consistently improves it. On 14 subcortical structures from the ADNI dataset, the proposed mesh evolution model (MT-GNN) predicts best among the evaluated methods at every horizon ($-2.29\%$ mean vertex error vs. the temporal mean, $p{=}6.1{\times}10^{-5}$, beating it on 14/14 structures), ahead of geodesic shape regression (DCM, $-0.19\%$) and a mesh transformer (TransforMesh, $-0.45\%$; $p{=}1.2{\times}10^{-4}$), with the lead widening as the horizon grows.
tldr: The paper proposes a graph-based neural network (MT-GNN) to predict the continuous-time evolution of subcortical brain structures' shape, achieving better prediction accuracy than existing methods.
abstract_cn: 预测皮层下结构形状如何从少数几次先前的扫描中演变，可能有助于预后判断和临床试验的富集。现有的纵向网格预测方法要么通过高维嵌入外推形状轨迹，要么直接回归顶点变形。我们转而预测表面在连续时间中的内在几何：一个单一的结构级图网络，基于领先时间的傅里叶编码，针对任意的因果多次就诊历史和任意的预测时间范围，预测每个顶点未来的第一基本形式（度量张量）。预测得到的度量通过一个可微分的“尽可能刚硬”（As-Rigid-As-Possible）求解器解码为表面，模型以刚性对齐的顶点误差进行端到端训练。通过重建进行训练既保证了解码后的预测是一个有效的表面，又持续提升了其性能。在来自ADNI数据集的14个皮层下结构上，所提出的网格演化模型（MT-GNN）在所有评估的时间范围内均预测最佳（平均顶点误差较时间均值改善−2.29%，p=6.1×10⁻⁵，在14/14个结构上均优于基线），领先于测地线形状回归（DCM，−0.19%）和网格变换器（TransforMesh，−0.45%；p=1.2×10⁻⁴），且随着时间范围的增大，优势进一步扩大。

title: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, but Adam Does
abstract: Gradient descent on a factored model $W = UV^\top$ is implicitly biased toward low-rank solutions, while Adam, starting from the same small initialization, is not. We trace the difference to the gauge symmetry of the loss, its invariance under $(U, V) \mapsto (UQ, VQ)$. Gradient flow's low-rank mechanism is available to an optimizer only if that optimizer is gauge-equivariant, a condition necessary for the transfer but not sufficient for low-rank recovery. Gradient descent, momentum, "shared-scalar" Adam, Muon, and Shampoo satisfy it. Adam, RMSProp, and the other coordinate-wise methods do not. A structure theorem characterizes the memoryless equivariant rules as exactly the Gram-determined left preconditioners, and a transfer theorem carries gradient flow's pathwise properties to common-scalar flows. We then sort nine update rules on underdetermined matrix sensing by recovery error against the planted ground truth. A one-parameter family from coordinate-wise to shared-scalar preconditioning restores the bias monotonically, isolating anisotropy as the cause. A "spectral schedule" reconciles two opposing reports about Muon: equal-rate updates recover exactly low-rank targets but lose their edge as the spectral tail grows. In transformers, Adam separates two gauge-equivalent initializations at the first step, where the equivariant optimizers stay at float precision, and ends with the per-head invariants $W_Q^\top W_K$ 56% apart in relative Frobenius distance, a gap no per-head rotation can close. On two hyperspectral datasets at matched training loss, gradient descent cuts held-out error by 43-44% at the lowest sampling density, and at lower effective rank. Basis choice is therefore not a tuning detail but a decision about which interpolant the optimizer selects.
tldr: 该论文揭示了Adam等坐标式优化器在矩阵分解中缺乏规范等变性，导致无法像梯度下降那样隐式偏向低秩解，从而影响泛化性能。
abstract_cn: 对因子化模型 \(W = UV^\top\) 的梯度下降隐式地偏向于低秩解，而Adam在相同的微小初始化下则不具备这一偏向。我们将这一差异追溯到损失的规范对称性，即其在变换 \((U, V) \mapsto (UQ, VQ)\) 下的不变性。梯度流的低秩机制仅当优化器具有规范等变性时才能被其利用，该条件是机制迁移的必要条件，但并非低秩恢复的充分条件。梯度下降、动量法、“共享标量”Adam、Muon和Shampoo满足这一条件，而Adam、RMSProp及其他逐坐标方法则不满足。一个结构定理将无记忆等变规则精确刻画为Gram矩阵决定的左预条件器，而一个迁移定理则将梯度流的路径性质推广至公共标量流。随后，我们在欠定矩阵感知任务中，依据相对于预设真实值的恢复误差，对九种更新规则进行了排序。从逐坐标到共享标量预条件的一参数族单调地恢复了低秩偏向，从而将各向异性确认为原因。一种“谱调度”调和了关于Muon的两份对立报告：等速率更新能精确恢复低秩目标，但随着谱尾增长而失去优势。在Transformer中，Adam在第一步就分离了两个规范等价的初始化，而等变优化器则保持在浮点精度内；最终，逐头不变量 \(W_Q^\top W_K\) 的相对Frobenius距离相差56%，这一差距无法通过任何逐头旋转来弥合。在两个高光谱数据集上，当训练损失匹配时，梯度下降在最低采样密度下将留出误差降低了43-44%，并获得了更低的有效秩。因此，基的选择并非调参细节，而是关于优化器选择何种插值函数的决策。

title: SSTQ:Privacy-Preserving Vector Quantization via Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant
abstract: Achieving local differential privacy in distributed optimization while maintaining low communication cost remains challenging. Existing vector quantization methods, such as vqSGD, use high-dimensional geometric constructions but incur unfavorable dimension-dependent variance. In this work, we propose Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant (SSTQ), a framework that combines overcomplete equal-norm tight frames, coordinate subsampling, and privacy-aware one-dimensional quantization. SSTQ includes two variants: a Flat Randomized Response version and a Metric-Aware Laplace version, the latter being better suited to higher codebook bit-width regimes. We show that SSTQ achieves optimal mean squared error scaling while using only $\lceil \log_2 N \rceil + b$ bits per client, where $N = Θ(d)$ is the frame size. We also derive a surrogate privacy-aware codebook objective that reduces the codebook-dependent MSE scaling from $O(4^b)$ to $O(2^b)$. Finally, we empirically evaluate SSTQ against established baselines on federated learning tasks using CIFAR-10 and Fashion-MNIST, demonstrating favorable utility and communication efficiency.
tldr: The paper proposes SSTQ, a privacy-preserving vector quantization framework for distributed optimization that achieves optimal MSE scaling with low communication cost, demonstrating improved utility and efficiency in federated learning tasks.
abstract_cn: 在分布式优化中实现局部差分隐私的同时保持低通信成本仍然具有挑战性。现有的向量量化方法，如vqSGD，利用高维几何构造，但会产生不利的、依赖于维度的方差。在本工作中，我们提出了子采样随机TurboQuant（SSTQ）框架，该框架结合了过完备等范数紧框架、坐标子采样以及隐私感知的一维量化。SSTQ包含两种变体：平坦随机化应答版本和度量感知拉普拉斯版本，后者更适用于较高码本位宽的场景。我们证明，SSTQ在仅使用每客户端$\lceil \log_2 N \rceil + b$比特的情况下实现了最优均方误差缩放，其中$N = Θ(d)$为框架大小。我们还推导了一个替代的隐私感知码本目标，将依赖于码本的均方误差缩放从$O(4^b)$降低至$O(2^b)$。最后，我们在使用CIFAR-10和Fashion-MNIST的联邦学习任务上，将SSTQ与既有基线进行了实证评估，展示了其优越的效用和通信效率。

title: Chained Recursive Language Models for Multi-Iteration Reasoning
abstract: Long context reasoning in large language models (LLMs) is usually constrained by the fact that a single inference trajectory has to simultaneously explore the context, store intermediate state, verify evidence, and produce the final answer. This becomes particularly difficult in tasks that require extraction, counting, ordering, or multi-hop reasoning, where an early mistake can propagate until the final response. In this work, we propose Chained Recursive Language Models (Chained RLM), an inference-time architecture, in which the same underlying model is called repeatedly as a sequence of fresh reasoning roots. Each root receives the original problem and context, but does not inherit the full conversational history. Instead, it receives a compact plain-text summary, a plain-text blackboard, and some durable task-specific artifacts written by predecessor roots. The motivation is to manage the context by chopping into partial tasks rather than one large inference response; in each staged computation, intermediate artifacts can be inspected, corrected, and extended by a later fresh inference by the same model. We describe the system model, handoff mechanism, artifact workspace, and evaluation protocol for this system. We study when fresh-context artifact continuation gives a measurable gain in accuracy over direct LLM answering even with recursive tool-calling.
tldr: The paper proposes Chained Recursive Language Models (Chained RLM), an inference-time architecture that calls the same LLM repeatedly with fresh contexts and compact summaries to improve multi-iteration reasoning, showing gains over direct answering in certain tasks.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）中的长上下文推理通常受到一个事实的制约，即单次推理轨迹必须同时探索上下文、存储中间状态、验证证据并生成最终答案。这在需要提取、计数、排序或多跳推理的任务中尤为困难，因为早期错误可能会一直传播到最终响应。在本工作中，我们提出了链式递归语言模型（Chained Recursive Language Models，Chained RLM），这是一种推理时架构，其中同一个底层模型被反复调用，作为一系列全新的推理根（fresh reasoning roots）。每个根接收原始问题和上下文，但不继承完整的对话历史。相反，它接收一份紧凑的纯文本摘要、一块纯文本黑板（plain-text blackboard），以及由前序根写入的若干持久性任务特定工件（durable task-specific artifacts）。其动机是通过将上下文切分为部分任务来管理上下文，而不是生成一次大型推理响应；在每个分阶段计算中，中间工件可以由同一模型后续的全新推理进行检查、纠正和扩展。我们描述了该系统的系统模型、交接机制、工件工作区以及评估协议。我们研究了在何种情况下，即使采用递归工具调用，全新上下文的工件延续也能在准确性上相对于直接LLM回答产生可测量的提升。

title: Robust and Efficient Motion Reasoning for Privacy-Aware Classroom Incident Recognition
abstract: Can computer vision help make classrooms safer? In this pilot study, we investigate privacy-aware and computationally efficient classroom incident recognition from CCTV-style observations. This setting remains underexplored, with limited benchmarks and few methods designed for the privacy, efficiency, and generalization demands of real-world deployment. We introduce a novel hybrid benchmark combining generative CCTV-style videos with real-world classroom pose data, and propose a lightweight, but robust motion-reasoning framework motivated by the observation that many incidents differ more in motion direction, speed, acceleration, and intensity than in pose alone. To that end, our method first constructs hierarchical kinematic representations of human actions. Our method then distills hierarchical, multi-order kinematic reasoning from a large teacher into a much smaller single-order student, enabling efficient per-person inference while preserving expressive motion understanding. Experiments show that our model outperforms substantially larger baselines at less than one-tenth of their computational cost, while also demonstrating stronger out-of-domain motion reasoning and zero-shot synthetic-to-real generalization. We will publicly release the benchmark, codebase, and supporting tools to facilitate further research in privacy-aware classroom safety.
tldr: This paper proposes a lightweight motion-reasoning framework for privacy-aware classroom incident recognition, demonstrating superior efficiency and generalization compared to larger baselines.
abstract_cn: 计算机视觉能否帮助提升课堂安全性？在这项试点研究中，我们探讨了从闭路电视（CCTV）风格观察中进行隐私感知且计算高效的课堂事件识别。该领域目前尚未得到充分探索，相关基准数据集有限，且专门针对实际部署中隐私、效率和泛化需求而设计的方法也较少。我们引入了一种新颖的混合基准，将生成式CCTV风格视频与真实课堂姿态数据相结合，并提出了一种轻量级但稳健的运动推理框架，其动机源于一个观察：许多事件在运动方向、速度、加速度和强度上的差异，往往比单纯姿态上的差异更为显著。为此，我们的方法首先构建人类动作的层次化运动学表示。随后，该方法将层次化、多阶运动学推理从大型教师模型蒸馏到规模小得多的单阶学生模型中，从而在保留丰富运动表达能力的同时，实现高效的逐人推理。实验表明，我们的模型在不到其十分之一计算成本的情况下，性能优于显著更大的基线模型，同时在域外运动推理和零样本合成到真实场景的泛化方面也展现出更强的能力。我们将公开发布该基准、代码库及配套工具，以促进隐私感知课堂安全领域的进一步研究。

title: DASyR-LLM: Domain-Aware Symbolic Regression with LLMs for Kinetic Model Discovery
abstract: Kinetic model discovery is a central challenge in chemical engineering, as accurate rate expressions are essential for understanding and controlling chemical and biological processes. Symbolic regression (SR) has emerged as a powerful data-driven approach for identifying interpretable kinetic models, but usually operates without domain knowledge, often exploring physicochemically implausible models. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue for injecting domain expertise into this search. Here, we introduce an LLM-guided SR framework, embedding an LLM module within an iterative SR algorithm for automated kinetic model discovery. The LLM performs two roles at each iteration: (1) a qualitative physicochemical critique of the best SR candidates, and (2) the proposal of new candidate rate expressions guided by the SR-generated models and embedded chemical knowledge. Our framework is evaluated on four in silico case studies of increasing complexity, spanning heterogeneous catalysis and bioprocess systems. Results show the LLM-guided framework reduces iterations to identify the ground-truth model by $41.7-79.3\%$ versus a state-of-the-art SR framework, with the LLM directly proposing the correct model structure in over half of the guided runs. In practical settings, where each iteration typically requires a new wet-lab experiment, this translates into a substantial reduction in experimental effort. Predictive performance on an independent validation set is equivalent between both approaches, with $R^2>0.98$ in all case studies. Ablation studies indicate that both the SR component and the LLM scale contribute to this performance, with a reduced-size LLM largely retaining discovery efficiency. These findings demonstrate that LLMs can effectively inject domain knowledge into scientific model discovery, paving the way toward fully automated, domain-aware kinetic modelling pipelines.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于LLM的符号回归框架，用于自动发现化学动力学模型，显著减少了实验迭代次数。
abstract_cn: 动力学模型发现是化学工程中的一个核心挑战，因为准确的速率表达式对于理解和控制化学及生物过程至关重要。符号回归（SR）已成为一种强大的数据驱动方法，用于识别可解释的动力学模型，但其通常在不引入领域知识的情况下运行，常常探索出物理化学上不合理的模型。大语言模型（LLM）为将领域专业知识注入这一搜索过程提供了一条有前景的途径。在此，我们提出了一种LLM引导的符号回归框架，将LLM模块嵌入迭代式SR算法中，以实现自动化动力学模型发现。LLM在每次迭代中承担两个角色：（1）对最佳SR候选模型进行定性物理化学评述；（2）在SR生成模型及内嵌化学知识的引导下，提出新的候选速率表达式。我们的框架在四个复杂度递增的计算机模拟案例研究中进行了评估，涵盖多相催化和生物过程系统。结果表明，与最先进的SR框架相比，LLM引导框架将识别真实模型所需的迭代次数减少了41.7%–79.3%，并且在超过一半的引导运行中，LLM直接提出了正确的模型结构。在实际应用中，每次迭代通常需要新的湿实验，这意味着实验工作量的大幅减少。两种方法在独立验证集上的预测性能相当，所有案例研究中的R²均大于0.98。消融研究表明，SR组件和LLM规模均对这一性能有所贡献，而缩小规模的LLM在很大程度上仍能保持发现效率。这些发现表明，LLM能够有效地将领域知识注入科学模型发现过程，为全自动化、领域感知的动力学建模流程铺平了道路。

title: Stable Density Ridges: Consistency and Convergence of Subspace Constrained Mean Shift
abstract: The Subspace Constrained Mean Shift (SCMS) algorithm is a popular nonparametric method for extracting density ridges, which serve as a low-dimensional representation of high-dimensional data. It is a widely held belief in the literature that SCMS trajectories converge to the classical density ridge, which we call the "static ridge", defined via the density gradient and the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the density's Hessian. In this paper, we demonstrate that this assumption does not hold in general, as the static definition fails to account for the rotation of the trailing eigenspace along the continuous flow of the algorithm's underlying vector field. To resolve this, we propose a paradigm shift by introducing the "stable ridge", a novel geometric structure defined through the lens of dynamical systems and the Jacobian of the projected density gradient. We prove that this stable ridge is the true theoretical target of the SCMS algorithm. Building upon this foundation, we develop a generalized SCMS framework utilizing a constant step size, establishing its uniform R-linear convergence and topological surjectivity onto the stable ridge. We further derive the rates of convergence for estimating the stable ridge in terms of the Hausdorff distance. Finally, we expose that the original SCMS algorithm suffers from polynomial-time computational complexity, which is caused by implicitly coupling the step size to the smoothing bandwidth via the Mean Shift operator, and demonstrate how our generalized framework provides a statistically consistent and more efficient solution.
tldr: 该论文提出稳定密度脊概念，证明子空间约束均值漂移算法收敛于稳定脊，并给出收敛速率和计算复杂度分析。
abstract_cn: 子空间约束均值漂移（SCMS）算法是一种流行的非参数方法，用于提取密度脊，这些密度脊作为高维数据的低维表示。文献中普遍认为，SCMS轨迹收敛于经典密度脊，我们称之为“静态脊”，该脊通过密度梯度以及密度Hessian矩阵的特征值和特征向量来定义。在本文中，我们证明这一假设在一般情况下并不成立，因为静态定义未能考虑算法底层向量场连续流动过程中尾随特征空间的旋转。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种范式转变，引入“稳定脊”，这是一种通过动力系统和投影密度梯度的Jacobian矩阵视角定义的新型几何结构。我们证明该稳定脊是SCMS算法的真实理论目标。在此基础之上，我们开发了一个采用恒定步长的广义SCMS框架，建立了其相对于稳定脊的一致R线性收敛性和拓扑满射性。我们进一步推导了在Hausdorff距离意义下估计稳定脊的收敛速率。最后，我们揭示原始SCMS算法存在多项式时间计算复杂度的问题，该问题源于通过均值漂移算子将步长与平滑带宽隐式耦合，并证明我们的广义框架如何提供一种统计上一致且更高效的解决方案。

title: Reward Structure Shapes the Interaction Between Episodic Exploration and Neural Memory in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: In partially observable reinforcement learning, agents face a dual bottleneck: they must explore to encounter rewarding states and retain that experience in memory to optimize their policies. Exploration bonuses and memory architectures are traditionally evaluated in isolation, leaving their interaction unmeasured, and standard notions of sparse reward conflate temporal signal density with what the reward actually supervises. We present a controlled study crossing episodic exploration bonuses with diverse neural memory architectures across three environments that vary how the content of memory is acquired. An identical bonus signal yields three distinct interaction patterns: it amplifies architectural capacity differences where memory content must be actively discovered and retained unsupervised; equalizes architectures to a shared ceiling where the content, once sought out, is a single reward-supervised cue; and is null where the observation stream is purely scheduled. Controlled reward manipulations verify that these patterns track reward structure rather than density: a dense reward neutralizes a bonus only if it directly supervises the required latent memory, and a small avoidable penalty on exploratory actions (leaving the optimum unchanged) induces policy convergence to suboptimal stationary states, which either bonus resolves. We then formalize reward sparsity with observation-anchored reward machines, separating structural sparsity (an automaton reproduces the return without the task-required history) from potential sparsity (the one-step reward misprices local exploratory actions); the resulting vocabulary organizes the three regimes by the retention burden each task exposes. Together, these results show exploration and memory are complements, not substitutes: a bonus induces exposure, and only memory converts exposure into return.
tldr: 该论文研究部分可观察强化学习中探索奖励与神经记忆架构的交互，发现奖励结构而非密度决定探索与记忆的互补关系。
abstract_cn: 在部分可观测的强化学习中，智能体面临双重瓶颈：它们必须进行探索以遇到有奖励的状态，并将该经验保留在记忆中以优化其策略。探索奖励与记忆架构传统上被孤立地评估，导致二者之间的交互作用未被测量，而标准的稀疏奖励概念也将时间信号密度与奖励实际监督的内容混为一谈。我们提出了一项受控研究，将情节式探索奖励与多种神经记忆架构在三类环境中交叉比较，这些环境在记忆内容的获取方式上有所差异。相同的奖励信号产生了三种截然不同的交互模式：在记忆内容必须被主动发现并无监督地保留的情况下，它放大了架构能力差异；在内容一旦被寻得即为单一奖励监督线索的情况下，它将各架构拉平至共同上限；而在观测流纯粹按计划安排的情况下，该信号则完全无效。受控奖励操作验证了这些模式追踪的是奖励结构而非密度：密集奖励只有在直接监督所需潜在记忆时才能中和探索奖励，而对探索性动作施加一个小的可避免惩罚（保持最优策略不变）则会导致策略收敛至次优的平稳状态，而任一奖励均可解决这一问题。随后，我们利用基于观测锚定的奖励机（observation-anchored reward machines）形式化稀疏奖励，将结构稀疏性（自动机无需任务所需历史即可复现回报）与潜在稀疏性（单步奖励错误定价局部探索动作）区分开来；由此产生的词汇体系根据每项任务所暴露的保留负担来组织上述三种模式。综合来看，这些结果表明探索与记忆是互补而非替代关系：奖励诱导暴露，而唯有记忆能将暴露转化为回报。

title: Representational separation between unitary and channel quantum generative models via shared classical randomness at shallow depth
abstract: Near-term quantum hardware limits circuit depth and often imposes geometrically local connectivity for quantum generative models, restricting the output distributions accessible to shallow unitary Born models. Introducing stochasticity into a unitary quantum Born model can improve the empirical generative performance of the resulting channel model and, for a restricted small-scale architecture, has been proven to represent a strictly larger family of distributions than its unitary counterpart. However, whether such randomness provides a provable separation at fixed shallow depth for arbitrarily large systems has remained open. Here, we show that shared classical randomness, a comparatively weak resource from entanglement theory, is sufficient to establish such a strict scalable representational separation over the corresponding shallow unitary Born model. More specifically, we augment bounded-connectivity shallow unitary circuits, followed by computational-basis measurements, with spatially separated local Pauli operations, whose joint application is controlled by a single classically sampled random bit. The resulting shallow-depth channel model generates long-range correlations in the classical output distribution that no purely unitary shallow-depth model with bounded connectivity can reproduce. For one-dimensional nearest-neighbour architectures, reproducing such distributions with a purely unitary model can require depth $Ω(N)$ in the worst case. We further show that measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC) provides a natural implementation of the required shared classical randomness through suitable adaptation of the random measurement outcomes. Numerical experiments on MBQC-based generative models support the analytical results.
tldr: 该论文证明了共享经典随机性可以在浅层深度下使信道量子生成模型严格超越酉模型，但该研究与推荐系统无关。
abstract_cn: 近期量子硬件限制了电路深度，并通常对量子生成模型施加几何局域连接性，从而限制了浅层幺正玻恩模型可访问的输出分布。将随机性引入幺正量子玻恩模型可以改善所得信道模型的经验生成性能，并且对于受限的小规模架构，已被证明能够表示比其幺正对应模型严格更大的分布族。然而，这种随机性是否能在固定浅层深度下为任意大规模系统提供可证明的分离性，仍然是一个未解问题。在此，我们表明，共享经典随机性——一种从纠缠理论角度来看相对较弱的资源——足以在相应浅层幺正玻恩模型上建立这种严格的可扩展表示分离。更具体地说，我们将有界连接性的浅层幺正电路（随后进行计算基测量）与空间分离的局域泡利操作相结合，这些操作的联合应用由单个经典采样的随机比特控制。由此产生的浅层信道模型在经典输出分布中生成了长程关联，而任何具有有界连接性的纯幺正浅层模型都无法重现这种关联。对于一维最近邻架构，使用纯幺正模型重现此类分布在最坏情况下可能需要深度$Ω(N)$。我们进一步表明，基于测量的量子计算（MBQC）通过适当调整随机测量结果，为所需的共享经典随机性提供了一种自然实现方式。基于MBQC的生成模型的数值实验支持了上述分析结果。

title: BnBERT-iPET: Sparse Few-Shot Language Modeling for Bengali via Lottery Ticket Pruning
abstract: Deep neural networks have shown impressive success in NLP tasks owing to their complex structure and huge number of edges. Achieving state-of-the-art performance in natural language processing with a large pre-trained model such as BERT is expensive and time-consuming, carries a large carbon footprint, and is difficult to realize on machines with minimal computational capability. This creates a barrier to training complex models for resource-constrained languages such as Bengali. However, in a complex neural model, not all edges are equally impactful, and the contributions of some of them can be neglected. Pruning promises to reduce the memory footprint of regular networks, shorten the training time of ever-growing networks, and increase inference efficiency without sacrificing comparable performance. In this work, we introduce BnBERT-iPET, a sparse few-shot language modeling approach for Bengali, and experimentally show that a lightweight few-shot-learned language model retaining only 10% of the edges of an initial model such as BERT can perform neck and neck with much larger models on challenging tasks for a resource-constrained language such as Bengali. By learning from few shots through iterative pattern exploiting training and achieving 90% sparsity with the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis pruning technique, our pruned BnBERT-iPET model proves to be a tough competitor to state-of-the-art language models such as Bangla Electra, Indic-BERT, and XLM-RoBERTa on downstream tasks over standard benchmark datasets of the Bengali language.
tldr: The paper proposes BnBERT-iPET, a pruned BERT model for Bengali that retains only 10% of edges and achieves competitive performance on downstream tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of pruning for resource-constrained languages.
abstract_cn: 深度神经网络凭借其复杂的结构和海量的连接边，在自然语言处理任务中取得了显著的成功。使用诸如BERT这样的大型预训练模型来实现自然语言处理的最先进性能，不仅成本高昂且耗时，还会产生巨大的碳足迹，并且难以在计算能力有限的机器上实现。这为资源受限语言（如孟加拉语）训练复杂模型设置了障碍。然而，在复杂的神经模型中，并非所有连接边都具有同等影响力，其中一些边的贡献可以被忽略。剪枝技术有望减少常规网络的内存占用，缩短不断增长的网络的训练时间，并在不牺牲可比性能的前提下提高推理效率。在本工作中，我们提出了BnBERT-iPET，一种针对孟加拉语的稀疏少样本语言建模方法，并通过实验证明，一个轻量级的少样本学习语言模型，仅保留初始模型（如BERT）10%的连接边，即可在资源受限语言（如孟加拉语）的挑战性任务上与远大于它的模型表现不相上下。通过迭代模式利用训练进行少样本学习，并借助“彩票假设”剪枝技术实现90%的稀疏度，我们剪枝后的BnBERT-iPET模型在孟加拉语标准基准数据集的下游任务中，被证明是Bangla Electra、Indic-BERT和XLM-RoBERTa等最先进语言模型的强劲竞争对手。

title: Multimodal Spatiotemporal Atmospheric Data Assimilation with Latent Flow-matching
abstract: Data assimilation (DA) uses Bayesian inference to update the state of a numerical forecast model with observed data. In this study, we propose a fundamentally different, unified approach to atmospheric data assimilation. We use latent video flow-matching to sample temporally consistent trajectories from a prior trained using ERA5 reanalysis (69 variables over an 8-day window). We also use posterior sampling to assimilate real observation sources, such as those from the NOAA Integrated Global Radiosonde Archive and the Integrated Surface Database. Because the prior generates a continuous trajectory, it naturally propagates information between observed and unobserved frames. Therefore, we can perform various DA tasks, such as filtering and smoothing, simply by changing the observed frames. Moreover, we generate full-state ensemble forecasts directly from sparse observations, achieving performance competitive with state-of-the-art observation-to-forecast models.
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于潜在视频流匹配的大气数据同化方法，通过生成连续轨迹实现滤波和平滑，并直接从稀疏观测生成集合预报，性能与最先进的观测到预报模型相当。
abstract_cn: 数据同化（Data Assimilation, DA）利用贝叶斯推断，通过观测数据更新数值预报模型的状态。在本研究中，我们提出了一种根本不同的、统一的方法来进行大气数据同化。我们使用潜视频流匹配（latent video flow-matching）从基于ERA5再分析资料（覆盖8天窗口内的69个变量）训练的先验模型中采样时间上一致的轨迹。同时，我们利用后验采样来同化真实观测源的数据，例如来自美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）综合无线电探空档案（Integrated Global Radiosonde Archive）以及综合地表数据库（Integrated Surface Database）的观测数据。由于先验模型生成连续的轨迹，它能够自然地在观测帧与非观测帧之间传播信息。因此，我们只需改变观测帧，即可执行各种数据同化任务，如滤波和平滑。此外，我们直接从稀疏观测生成全状态集合预报，其性能可与最先进的观测到预报模型相媲美。

title: MALT: Lightweight Curvature-Aware Muon via Diagonal Preconditioning
abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a promising alternative to AdamW for language model pretraining by orthogonalizing momentum matrices using Newton-Schulz iterations. Although Muon mitigates gradient anisotropy, it does not explicitly account for the curvature geometry of the loss landscape and may therefore remain sensitive to curvature anisotropy. We bridge this gap by proposing MALT (Muon Augmented by Lightweight Two-sided Preconditioning), which uses lightweight diagonal preconditioners to reduce the sensitivity of Muon to curvature anisotropy. Specifically, MALT uses two-sided diagonal preconditioners with low memory and computational overhead to approximately capture the curvature geometry of the loss landscape. It orthogonalizes the preconditioned momentum using Newton-Schulz iterations and maps the result back to define the update direction, while norm grafting controls the update magnitude. To improve the robustness of MALT to stochastic gradient noise, we further propose MALTER (MALT with Adaptive stEpsize Rescaling). Convergence guarantees are provided for MALT in the stochastic non-convex setting. Experiments on GPT-2 Small, Medium, and Large pretraining show that the proposed methods outperform Muon while maintaining nearly the same memory footprint and wall-clock time.
tldr: The paper proposes MALT, a lightweight curvature-aware optimizer that augments Muon with diagonal preconditioning to improve language model pretraining, achieving better performance than Muon with similar memory and time costs.
abstract_cn: 缪子（Muon）近期作为一种有前景的替代AdamW的优化器出现，用于语言模型预训练，其通过牛顿-舒尔茨（Newton-Schulz）迭代对动量矩阵进行正交化。尽管Muon缓解了梯度各向异性，但它并未显式考虑损失景观的曲率几何，因此可能仍对曲率各向异性敏感。我们通过提出MALT（Muon Augmented by Lightweight Two-sided Preconditioning，轻量双侧预条件增强的Muon）来弥合这一差距，该方法使用轻量对角预条件器以降低Muon对曲率各向异性的敏感性。具体而言，MALT采用具有低内存和计算开销的双侧对角预条件器，以近似捕获损失景观的曲率几何。它使用牛顿-舒尔茨迭代对预条件后的动量进行正交化，并将结果映射回以定义更新方向，同时通过范数嫁接（norm grafting）控制更新幅度。为了提高MALT对随机梯度噪声的鲁棒性，我们进一步提出了MALTER（MALT with Adaptive stEpsize Rescaling，自适应步长重标定的MALT）。在随机非凸设置下，为MALT提供了收敛性保证。在GPT-2 Small、Medium和Large预训练上的实验表明，所提出的方法优于Muon，同时保持几乎相同的内存占用和墙钟时间。

title: Learning When to Stop: Prefix-Optimal Dynamic Diffusion Policies for Continuous Control
abstract: Diffusion policies are a powerful policy class for continuous control, but their iterative denoising process creates a substantial computational bottleneck. Reducing this cost requires adapting the number of denoising steps to the difficulty of each action while preserving task performance. We introduce Prefix-Optimal Generative Policies (POGP), a framework that learns a prefix value function at every intermediate denoising step through a Bellman-style recursion over the denoising chain. The prefix value function serves two purposes: it provides an auxiliary training objective that encourages intermediate outputs to become high-quality actions, and it enables a test-time stopping rule that terminates denoising when additional steps are unlikely to produce meaningful improvement. Across four MuJoCo environments and comparisons with 12 baselines, POGP reduces the required number of denoising iterations by approximately 2.7-fold while retaining near-full task performance. Compared with state-of-the-art dynamic diffusion baselines, prefix training also improves final task performance by approximately 3.5%. These results indicate that supervising intermediate denoising steps is useful not only for adaptive early stopping, but also as an auxiliary objective that improves the learned policy.
tldr: 该论文提出Prefix-Optimal Generative Policies (POGP)框架，通过前缀值函数动态调整扩散模型的去噪步数，在连续控制任务中减少约2.7倍计算量并提升性能，但与推荐系统无关。
abstract_cn: 扩散策略是连续控制中一类强大的策略类别，但其迭代去噪过程造成了显著的计算瓶颈。降低这一成本需要在保持任务性能的同时，根据每个动作的难度调整去噪步数。我们引入了前缀最优生成策略（POGP），这是一个框架，通过在去噪链上建立贝尔曼风格的递归，学习每个中间去噪步骤的前缀价值函数。该前缀价值函数有两个用途：它提供了一个辅助训练目标，鼓励中间输出成为高质量动作；同时，它实现了一种测试时的停止规则，当额外的步骤不太可能产生有意义的改进时，即终止去噪过程。在四个MuJoCo环境中，并与12个基线进行比较，POGP将所需的去噪迭代次数减少了约2.7倍，同时保持了接近完整的任务性能。与最先进的动态扩散基线相比，前缀训练还将最终任务性能提高了约3.5%。这些结果表明，监督中间去噪步骤不仅有助于自适应提前停止，而且作为辅助目标也能改善学习到的策略。

title: Capability-Gated Planning: Cost-to-Goal Discovery and the Limits of Myopic Experiment Selection
abstract: Systems that automate scientific discovery must repeatedly decide which experiment to run, which hypothesis to test, which tool to build, and when to stop. Many systems make these decisions by maximizing a myopic score such as expected information gain per unit cost or a learned plausibility score. We identify a structural limitation of this approach. Some actions are constructive: they acquire an epistemic capability (an instrument, assay, pipeline, simulator, or abstraction) whose value lies not in the information returned immediately but in the future actions it makes available. When the least-cost route to a confident answer requires a chain of such constructions, a planner that scores actions only by information obtainable within a bounded horizon cannot value the first construction: it yields no information within the horizon and is dominated by any measurement with positive information, however small. We formulate goal-directed discovery as a stochastic shortest-path problem in belief space in which constructive experiments change the downstream action graph, and prove that for every lookahead depth d there is an instance on which every myopic information-maximizing planner has an unbounded approximation ratio, and a related instance on which it never reaches the goal. The mechanism is a capability-indistinguishability lemma: within the horizon, acquiring a capability can be observationally indistinguishable from paying for a null action. This establishes capability gating as a reachability axis of difficulty distinct from curvature (submodularity) and information order (adaptivity gaps). We introduce CG-Plan, an incremental replanner with a capability-aware cost-to-go heuristic h = h_cap + h_exp. In a controlled testbed, the performance gap appears only under gating, persists for every fixed horizon, and arises when near-miss hypotheses come from a data-consistent proposer.
tldr: 该论文研究自动化科学发现中的实验选择问题，提出能力门控规划（CG-Plan）方法，并证明近视信息最大化规划器在能力门控场景下存在结构性局限。
abstract_cn: 自动化科学发现的系统必须反复决定要运行哪个实验、检验哪个假设、构建哪个工具，以及何时停止。许多系统通过最大化短视得分（如单位成本的期望信息增益或学习到的合理性得分）来做出这些决策。我们识别出这种方法的一个结构性局限。某些行动是建设性的：它们获取一种认知能力（仪器、检测方法、流水线、模拟器或抽象），其价值不在于立即返回的信息，而在于它使未来行动成为可能。当通往可信答案的最低成本路径需要这样一系列建设时，仅根据有限视界内可获得的信息来评分的规划者无法评估第一个建设行动的价值：它在视界内不产生任何信息，因而被任何具有正信息的测量所支配，无论该信息多么微小。我们将目标导向的发现过程形式化为信念空间中的随机最短路径问题，其中建设性实验会改变下游行动图，并证明对于任意前瞻深度d，都存在一个实例，使得任何短视的信息最大化规划者在该实例上具有无界近似比，并且存在一个相关实例，该规划者在该实例上永远无法达到目标。其机制是一个能力不可区分性引理：在视界内，获取能力在观测上可能与支付空操作无法区分。这确立了能力门控作为一条与曲率（子模性）和信息顺序（自适应差距）不同的可达性难度轴。我们引入CG-Plan，一种具有能力感知的到达目标代价启发式h = h_cap + h_exp的增量重规划器。在受控测试平台上，性能差距仅在门控条件下出现，对每个固定视界持续存在，并且当接近命中的假设来自数据一致的提议者时出现。

title: Optimizing What Policies Learn From: Recoverability-aware Rollout Intervention Learning
abstract: Critic-free group-based reinforcement learning has become a scalable approach for post-training large language models. However, most existing methods allocate the same number of rollouts to every task and trajectory state, even though some rollouts provide much more useful learning signals than others. Recent work has started to treat rollout generation as an adaptive decision, but two important limitations remain. First, intervention strategies are often based on fixed heuristics and therefore cannot adjust as the policy changes during training. Second, these methods usually decide only how many rollouts to generate, without explicitly controlling where and how to intervene. To address these limitations, we propose Recoverability-Aware Intervention Learning (RAIL), a training-time framework that learns how to generate rollouts based on the improvement produced by each intervention. RAIL models intervention selection as an online contextual-bandit problem and trains a recoverability controller using intervention traces collected through a shadow-to-live procedure. This allows the controller to keep learning while the underlying policy evolves. We evaluate RAIL in terms of effectiveness, adaptivity, expressiveness, and efficiency. Across multiple settings, RAIL consistently improves performance under limited rollout budgets. These results show that recoverability-aware intervention provides a principled way to generate more informative and less redundant rollouts, leading to stronger learning signals during post-training.
tldr: The paper proposes a recoverability-aware intervention learning framework to optimize rollout generation for post-training large language models, improving training efficiency and effectiveness.
abstract_cn: 免批判器的基于组强化学习已成为大型语言模型后训练的一种可扩展方法。然而，现有的大多数方法为每个任务和轨迹状态分配相同数量的回滚，尽管某些回滚提供的学习信号远比其他回滚更有价值。近期研究已开始将回滚生成视为一种自适应决策，但仍存在两个重要局限。首先，干预策略通常基于固定启发式规则，因此无法随着训练过程中策略的变化而调整。其次，这些方法通常仅决定生成多少回滚，而未明确控制干预的位置和方式。为解决这些局限，我们提出了可恢复性感知干预学习（Recoverability-Aware Intervention Learning, RAIL），这是一种训练时框架，基于每次干预所产生的改进来学习如何生成回滚。RAIL将干预选择建模为在线上下文老虎机问题，并通过影子到实时的过程收集干预轨迹来训练可恢复性控制器。这使得控制器能够在底层策略演变的同时持续学习。我们从有效性、自适应性、表达力和效率四个方面对RAIL进行评估。在多种设置下，RAIL在有限回滚预算内持续提升了性能。这些结果表明，可恢复性感知干预为生成更具信息量且冗余更少的回滚提供了一种原则性方法，从而在后训练期间产生更强的学习信号。

title: MultiPathFormer: Towards a Foundation Model for Multipath Wireless Propagation
abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have enabled training of wireless foundation models, which aim to support tasks such as channel estimation, beam prediction, and localization based on wireless signals. Existing wireless foundation models typically pretrain on channel tensors using masked reconstruction over subcarriers, antennas, or time but ignore the physical characteristics of wireless propagation. In this work, we propose to instead use multipath propagation as the fundamental pretraining object. We present MultiPathFormer, an autoregressive foundation model that represents each transmitter-receiver link as an ordered sequence of continuous-valued path tokens and pretrains with next-path prediction. We introduce an Environmental RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) mechanism and a first-path codebook on top of the transformer backbone, leveraging environment knowledge to improve path statistics estimation like delay and power by up to 59%. MultiPathFormer pretrained on 27 environments transfers to unseen users and, after scenario-specific fine-tuning, outperforms training the corresponding models from scratch in new environments. Across downstream tasks, it outperforms SOTA channel-based foundation models, achieving 5.57 m mean localization error, 0.914 top-3 beam accuracy, 0.994 line-of-sight classification accuracy, and 0.561 channel estimation NMSE. These results show that path-level pretraining can learn reusable representations of wireless propagation.
tldr: 该论文提出MultiPathFormer，一种基于多径传播的无线基础模型，通过路径级预训练和检索增强生成，在信道估计、波束预测和定位等任务上优于现有方法。
abstract_cn: 机器学习的最新进展使得训练无线基础模型成为可能，这些模型旨在基于无线信号支持信道估计、波束预测和定位等任务。现有的无线基础模型通常利用子载波、天线或时间维度上的掩码重建在信道张量上进行预训练，但忽略了无线传播的物理特性。在本工作中，我们提出改用多径传播作为基本的预训练对象。我们提出了MultiPathFormer，一种自回归基础模型，它将每个发射机-接收机链路表示为连续值路径标记的有序序列，并通过下一路径预测进行预训练。我们在Transformer主干之上引入了环境RAG（检索增强生成）机制和首路径码本，利用环境知识将延迟和功率等路径统计估计性能提升高达59%。在27个环境中预训练的MultiPathFormer能够迁移到未见过的用户，并且在针对特定场景进行微调后，在新环境中的表现优于从头训练相应模型。在下游任务中，它超越了最先进的基于信道的基础模型，实现了5.57米的平均定位误差、0.914的top-3波束准确率、0.994的视距分类准确率以及0.561的信道估计归一化均方误差。这些结果表明，路径级预训练能够学习到无线传播的可复用表示。

title: Provable Limits and Certified Deferral for Verbalized Uncertainty in Small Language Models
abstract: Small open-weight language models increasingly run in private, offline, and cost-sensitive settings, where the key deployment question is not only what a model answers but when it should defer to a human. We study whether verbalized confidence can support risk-controlled deferral, evaluating eleven instruction-tuned models from three families, 0.5B to 14B parameters, on ARC-Challenge and TruthfulQA with 25,168 local predictions. Three theoretical results delimit what calibration can provide: strictly monotone calibration preserves the risk-coverage frontier and error-detection AUROC; temperature scaling cannot calibrate models whose confidence stays above one half while accuracy falls below it; and a Clopper-Pearson procedure converts a 200-question calibration set into a finite-sample risk certificate under an i.i.d. deployment assumption. Empirically, eight of 22 model-task pairs hit the temperature-scaling infeasibility floor within one percentage point of the predicted bound. Platt scaling reduces ECE to as low as 0.02, yet certified autonomy at a 20% risk budget is granted to only three model-task pairs and to none at 10%. We also identify and repair an answer-ordering artifact in the multiple-choice form of TruthfulQA. Calibration gives confidence semantics; certified deferral determines when small models are safe to use.
tldr: The paper studies whether verbalized confidence in small language models can support risk-controlled deferral, providing theoretical limits and empirical evidence that calibration alone is insufficient for safe autonomy.
abstract_cn: 小型开放权重语言模型日益在私有、离线及成本敏感的环境中运行，其关键部署问题不仅在于模型回答什么，更在于何时应将问题交由人类处理。我们研究了语言化置信度能否支持风险可控的延迟决策，评估了来自三个系列、参数量从0.5B到14B的十一个指令微调模型，在ARC-Challenge和TruthfulQA上共进行了25,168次本地预测。三个理论结果界定了校准所能提供的保障：严格单调校准保持风险覆盖率前沿和错误检测AUROC不变；温度缩放无法校准那些置信度始终高于0.5而准确率却低于0.5的模型；以及一种Clopper-Pearson方法可将包含200个问题的校准集转化为在独立同分布部署假设下的有限样本风险证书。实证结果显示，22个模型-任务组合中有8个在温度缩放不可行下限的一个百分点内达到预测边界。Platt缩放将期望校准误差（ECE）降至低至0.02，但在20%风险预算下，仅有三个模型-任务组合获得认证自主权，而在10%风险预算下则无一获得。我们还识别并修复了TruthfulQA多项选择形式中的答案排序伪影。校准赋予置信度语义；认证延迟则决定了小型模型何时可以安全使用。

title: MarsCast: Transfer Learning of AI Weather Foundation Models to Planetary Atmospheres
abstract: We investigate the transferability of Earth weather foundation models to planetary atmospheres by adapting the GraphCast graph neural weather forecasting model to Mars. While GraphCast achieves state-of-the-art performance for terrestrial forecasting, its applicability to non-Earth environments remains unexplored. Using the Mars Climate Database (MCD), which provides global atmospheric fields across vertical altitude levels (similar to Earth pressure levels), we evaluate zero-shot and fine-tuned GraphCast predictions of Martian temperature and wind fields. Zero-shot forecasts produce a surprisingly accurate depiction of current conditions but fail to reproduce diurnal variability and rapidly decay toward climatological mean states. To address this limitation, we fine-tune GraphCast using MCD variables and top-of-atmosphere solar radiation forcing while holding humidity constant. Fine-tuning enables rapid learning of Martian thermal variability. Within as few as 10 training epochs, the model begins to capture the diurnal cycle and forecasts up to 10 days reproduce seasonal and vertical temperature structure. Prediction quality improves with training sample size and exhibits sensitivity to seasonal initialization. These results demonstrate that Earth-trained AI weather models can be adapted to simulate Martian atmospheric dynamics, providing a pathway toward rapid planetary weather prediction to support mission operations, dust storm risk mitigation, and future human exploration.
tldr: 该论文研究将地球天气基础模型GraphCast迁移到火星大气预测，通过微调成功捕捉火星热力变化和昼夜循环，为行星天气预测提供新途径。
abstract_cn: 我们研究了地球天气基础模型向行星大气的可迁移性，通过将GraphCast图神经网络天气预报模型改编应用于火星。尽管GraphCast在地球预报中达到了最先进的性能，但其在非地球环境中的适用性此前尚未被探索。利用火星气候数据库（Mars Climate Database, MCD）——该数据库提供了跨垂直高度层（类似于地球气压层）的全球大气场——我们评估了零样本（zero-shot）和微调（fine-tuned）GraphCast对火星温度和风场的预测能力。零样本预报能够惊人地准确描绘当前状况，但无法再现昼夜变化，并迅速衰减至气候平均态。为解决这一局限，我们使用MCD变量和大气层顶太阳辐射强迫对GraphCast进行微调，同时保持湿度恒定。微调使模型能够快速学习火星的热力变化。仅需少至10个训练周期，模型便开始捕捉昼夜循环，且长达10天的预报能够再现季节性和垂直温度结构。预测质量随训练样本量的增加而提升，并对季节初始化表现出敏感性。这些结果表明，经过地球训练的AI天气模型可以被改编用于模拟火星大气动力学，为快速行星天气预报提供了一条路径，以支持任务运行、沙尘暴风险缓解以及未来人类探索。

title: SparseDitto: Customizing GPU Kernels for Different Sparsity Patterns with LLM-Based Agentic System
abstract:
Sparse matrix kernels are fundamental to scientific computing, graph analytics, and machine learning. Their GPU performance depends strongly on the input sparsity pattern and execution strategy. For the same SpMM on the same matrix, cuSPARSE exhibits a 350x performance gap between CSR and Blocked-ELL. Our study of multiple data formats, specialized systems, and sparse compilers shows that no single implementation consistently dominates across sparsity patterns and operators. This motivates a system that can adapt its representation, execution strategy, and hardware mapping to each workload and target GPU.
  We present SparseDitto, an LLM-based system that constructs a GPU kernel for each matrix, operator, and target GPU. SparseDitto supports SpMV, SpMM, and SpGEMM within a unified design framework. A lightweight additive model ranks established strategies using structural features of the input matrix. An architecture-aware planner then proposes several candidate designs. Coding and verification agents implement and refine them using measurements from the target GPU. Across three sparse operators and a diverse set of matrices, SparseDitto achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 2.68x over cuSPARSE on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, with a maximum of 146.61x. On an NVIDIA H200 GPU, it achieves 2.79x, with a maximum of 78.5x. Its generated SpMM kernels also accelerate full-batch GCN training by up to 3.39x.
tldr: SparseDitto uses an LLM-based agentic system to automatically generate GPU kernels for sparse matrix operations, achieving significant speedups over cuSPARSE.
abstract_cn:
稀疏矩阵内核是科学计算、图分析和机器学习的基础。它们在GPU上的性能强烈依赖于输入的稀疏模式和执行策略。对于同一矩阵上的同一SpMM操作，cuSPARSE在CSR和Blocked-ELL格式之间表现出高达350倍的性能差距。我们对多种数据格式、专用系统和稀疏编译器的研究表明，没有任何单一实现能够在所有稀疏模式和算子中持续占据优势。这促使我们构建一个能够针对每个工作负载和目标GPU自适应调整其表示、执行策略和硬件映射的系统。

我们提出了SparseDitto，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统，能够为每个矩阵、算子和目标GPU构建GPU内核。SparseDitto在统一的设计框架内支持SpMV、SpMM和SpGEMM。一个轻量级加性模型利用输入矩阵的结构特征对已有策略进行排序。随后，一个架构感知的规划器提出若干候选设计。编码与验证代理利用目标GPU上的测量结果实现并优化这些设计。在三种稀疏算子和多样化的矩阵集合上，SparseDitto在NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU上相对于cuSPARSE实现了2.68倍的几何平均加速，最高可达146.61倍。在NVIDIA H200 GPU上，其加速比达到2.79倍，最高可达78.5倍。其生成的SpMM内核还将全批量GCN训练加速了最多3.39倍。

title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
abstract: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified objective. We present Argus, a persistent, self-evolving runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer execute bounded missions over durable project state. Argus separates stable user intent from operational objectives, constraints, and verification criteria, and admits memories, skills, procedures, verifiers, routing decisions, and rejected routes only after role-owned review and, when available, task-native verification. Model weights remain fixed; self-evolution occurs through persistent runtime state and control policy, with autonomous execution between operator-owned escalation points. Across seven GPT-5.5 benchmark arenas, Argus achieves about 78% on SWE-Bench Pro versus 59% for Direct Copilot while using 1.41 times the aggregate tokens. After verification-gated self-evolution, mature SWE-Bench waves use 21% fewer solve-input tokens and 15% less active workflow time per task than startup waves, while recording 34 verifier recoveries and 22 strict review-loop rescues. Argus also reaches 76.8% on AARRI-Bench and a 28.0-point gap on mathematical data synthesis, with competitive GPU-kernel and language-model-training results. Beyond benchmarks, an optimized RWKV6 kernel was merged upstream; a multi-day mathematics campaign retained falsified routes and proof-backed frontier updates; and six paper pipelines completed 254 missions with 16 stage rollbacks. These results show that a fixed-weight, self-evolving harness can revise, recover, and accumulate verified approaches while producing structured trajectories for future supervised and reinforcement learning.
tldr: Argus is a persistent, self-evolving agentic runtime that improves long-horizon reasoning performance across benchmarks by separating intent from objectives and using verification-gated self-evolution.
abstract_cn: 长程推理需要一种智能体运行时，它能够在证据支持当前方法时持续执行，并在测量结果揭示失败、隐藏约束或目标设定错误时转向调整。我们提出了Argus，一种持久化、自我演化的运行时，其中Manager、Planner、Engineer和Reviewer在持久化的项目状态上执行有界任务。Argus将稳定的用户意图与操作目标、约束和验证标准分离，并且仅在经过角色所属的审查以及（若可用）任务原生验证之后，才接纳记忆、技能、程序、验证器、路由决策和被拒绝的路径。模型权重保持固定；自我演化通过持久化的运行时状态和控制策略实现，在操作者拥有的升级点之间自主执行。在七个GPT-5.5基准竞技场中，Argus在SWE-Bench Pro上达到约78%的准确率，而Direct Copilot为59%，同时使用的总token数为后者的1.41倍。经过验证门控的自我演化后，成熟的SWE-Bench批次相比启动批次，每个任务使用的求解输入token减少21%，活跃工作流时间减少15%，同时记录了34次验证器恢复和22次严格审查循环救援。Argus在AARRI-Bench上达到76.8%，在数学数据合成上拉开28.0个百分点的差距，并在GPU内核和语言模型训练方面取得了有竞争力的结果。除基准测试外，一个优化的RWKV6内核已被合并到上游；一项为期多天的数学活动保留了被证伪的路径和基于证明的前沿更新；六个论文流水线完成了254个任务，其中包含16次阶段回滚。这些结果表明，一个固定权重的自我演化框架能够修正、恢复并积累经过验证的方法，同时为未来的监督学习和强化学习生成结构化轨迹。

title: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains
abstract: Modern Greek is absent from NVIDIA's Nemotron retrieval models and from major multilingual retrieval benchmarks, despite being important for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in legal, energy, financial, and medical applications. We present an end-to-end adaptation of the Nemotron retrieval stack for Modern Greek, including corpus mining, synthetic supervision, retrieval model training, reranker adaptation, reader fine-tuning, and a new benchmark called HERA. Our study shows that a parameter-free BM25 baseline outperforms several off-the-shelf multilingual dense retrieval models on specialist Greek corpora. After fine-tuning on 65,773 Greek retrieval pairs, a Nemotron 1B embedder improves nDCG@10 from 0.362 to 0.835 and substantially outperforms its unadapted counterpart. The learned language competence transfers to general-domain Greek, although the advantage over BM25 remains domain-dependent. We further adapt a cross-encoder reranker and demonstrate consistent improvements across specialist domains. Finally, we LoRA-tune a Nemotron 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts reader for grounded generation, increasing judged answer correctness from 29.4% to 66.9% while significantly improving faithfulness and citation quality. We also introduce HERA, the first large-scale Greek benchmark for retrieval-augmented generation, and release our adapted models and benchmark to support future research on Greek-language RAG systems.
tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end adaptation of the Nemotron retrieval stack for Modern Greek, including corpus mining, retrieval training, reranker adaptation, and reader fine-tuning, achieving significant improvements in retrieval and generation quality on specialist domains, and introduces the HERA benchmark.
abstract_cn: 现代希腊语在NVIDIA的Nemotron检索模型以及主要的多语言检索基准中均未被涵盖，尽管其在法律、能源、金融和医疗应用中的检索增强生成（RAG）领域具有重要意义。我们提出了一种针对现代希腊语的Nemotron检索栈端到端适配方法，包括语料挖掘、合成监督、检索模型训练、重排序器适配、阅读器微调，以及一个新基准HERA。我们的研究表明，在专业希腊语语料上，无参数BM25基线优于若干现成的多语言稠密检索模型。在65,773个希腊语检索对上进行微调后，Nemotron 1B嵌入模型将nDCG@10从0.362提升至0.835，并显著优于其未适配版本。所学到的语言能力可迁移至通用领域的希腊语，尽管相对于BM25的优势仍依赖于领域。我们进一步适配了一个交叉编码器重排序器，并在各专业领域展示了持续的性能提升。最后，我们对Nemotron 30B-A3B混合专家（MoE）阅读器进行了LoRA微调以用于有依据生成，将判定答案正确率从29.4%提升至66.9%，同时显著改善了忠实度和引用质量。我们还引入了HERA——首个面向检索增强生成的大规模希腊语基准，并发布了我们适配的模型和基准，以支持未来关于希腊语RAG系统的研究。

title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has become a standard post-training approach for improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing methods draw privileged information from diverse input sources to guide self-distillation. Yet these designs overlook Modality Imbalance, a challenge inherent to MLLM reasoning. When textual information dominates generation, the model cannot fully integrate its multimodal input. Consequently, carefully designed privileged information remains underused, limiting the effectiveness of OPSD. To examine this limitation, we construct a Positive Teacher with the Zoom-In Image and a Negative Teacher with the Mask Image, which exhibit different degrees of Modality Imbalance. Changes in their reasoning correctness and token logits reveal that Modality Balance can itself serve as privileged information. Motivated by this finding, we introduce OPD-V, a visual OPSD paradigm that instantiates such information through the Positive Teacher and Negative Teacher. Positive Modality-Balance Logits Margins define a Modality-Balance Trust Region that selects the on-policy tokens used for self-distillation. Experiments across 6 benchmarks, 4 MLLM backbones, and 5 post-training methods show that OPD-V consistently improves reasoning performance while reducing training cost.
tldr: 该论文提出OPD-V方法，利用模态平衡作为特权信息，通过正负教师模型改进多模态大语言模型的视觉推理性能，在多个基准上验证了有效性。
abstract_cn: 基于策略的自蒸馏（On-Policy Self-Distillation, OPSD）已成为提升多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）视觉推理能力的标准后训练方法。现有方法从多样化的输入来源中提取特权信息以引导自蒸馏过程，然而这些设计忽视了多模态大语言模型推理中固有的挑战——模态失衡（Modality Imbalance）。当文本信息在生成过程中占据主导地位时，模型无法充分整合其多模态输入，导致精心设计的特权信息未被充分利用，从而限制了OPSD的有效性。为探究这一局限，我们构建了基于放大图像的正向教师（Positive Teacher）和基于掩码图像的负向教师（Negative Teacher），二者表现出不同程度的模态失衡。对其推理正确性与令牌对数（token logits）变化的分析表明，模态平衡本身即可作为一种特权信息。受此发现启发，我们提出了OPD-V，一种视觉OPSD范式，通过正向教师与负向教师实例化该信息。正向模态平衡对数边际（Positive Modality-Balance Logits Margins）定义了模态平衡信任区域（Modality-Balance Trust Region），用于筛选自蒸馏所需的基于策略令牌。在6个基准、4种MLLM骨干网络及5种后训练方法上的实验表明，OPD-V在降低训练成本的同时，持续提升了推理性能。

title: CoPlan: A Trustworthy Co-Intelligence Interface for Care Planning through Role-Based Contestable Argument Graphs
abstract: AI-supported care planning can help clinicians, patients, caregivers, and care teams coordinate complex decisions across clinical, functional, psychosocial, and environmental needs. However, many AI systems present recommendations as fixed outputs, limiting stakeholders' ability to inspect, challenge, and revise plans when they conflict with clinical judgment, patient values, or real-world feasibility. We present CoPlan - a Co-Intelligent and Contestable Interface for Human-AI Care Planning. CoPlan uses a multi-agent workflow in which specialized AI agents generate candidate interventions and supporting or challenging arguments, while human care planners can accept, reject, modify, or add arguments before final plan generation. Through this design, CoPlan combines co-intelligence, in which humans and AI agents contribute complementary expertise, with contestability, where recommendations remain open to inspection, revision, and justification. We demonstrate CoPlan in an aging-in-place care planning scenario. The system supports adaptive care team recruitment, role-based argument review, final care plan generation, and practical follow-up through scheduling agents. This work contributes a contestable care planning interface and a design framing for trustworthy human-AI care planning that preserves human agency and clinical accountability.
tldr: CoPlan通过多智能体协作和可争议的论证图，实现人类与AI共同制定护理计划，增强可检查性和可修改性，以支持可信赖的AI护理规划。
abstract_cn: 人工智能辅助的护理计划能够帮助临床医生、患者、照护者及护理团队在临床、功能、社会心理和环境需求之间协调复杂的决策。然而，许多人工智能系统将建议呈现为固定输出，限制了利益相关者在建议与临床判断、患者价值观或现实可行性相冲突时进行检查、质疑和修订计划的能力。我们提出了CoPlan——一种用于人机协同护理计划的共智与可争议界面。CoPlan采用多智能体工作流程，其中专门的AI智能体生成候选干预措施及支持性或质疑性论证，而人类护理规划者可以在最终计划生成之前接受、拒绝、修改或添加论证。通过这一设计，CoPlan将共智性（人类与AI智能体贡献互补的专业知识）与可争议性（建议保持开放以供检查、修订和论证）相结合。我们在居家养老护理计划场景中展示了CoPlan。该系统支持自适应护理团队招募、基于角色的论证审查、最终护理计划生成以及通过调度智能体实现的实用后续跟进。本研究贡献了一个可争议的护理计划界面，以及一种值得信赖的人机协同护理计划的设计框架，该框架保留了人类能动性和临床问责制。

title: ABSeeker: Training Long-Horizon Search Agents via Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment
abstract: Long-horizon search agents must make multiple sequential actions (steps) to search, retrieve, verify, and integrate evidence to reach a final answer. However, existing methods for training these agents typically treat all steps within a trajectory uniformly during both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), failing to distinguish useful actions from erroneous or redundant ones. In this paper, we propose Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment (ABC), a fine-grained credit assignment framework for training long-horizon search agents by converting sparse trajectory-level outcomes into dense step-level supervision that rewards useful actions (even in failed trajectories) while suppressing erroneous or redundant actions. Specifically, given a potentially obscure query and its corresponding ground-truth answer, ABC first performs Answer-Backtracked Clue Recovery, which traces back from the answer to recover intermediate clues required to solve the question. It then applies Clue-Anchored Step Scoring to evaluate each search step against these clues, converting sparse binary outcome supervision into dense step-level rewards. Based on these rewards, we develop ABC-SFT, which reweights the loss of each turn, and ABC-GRPO, which uses the step-level scores as rewards in GRPO. Building on this framework, we train ABSeeker based on Qwen3.5-4B with only 8.5k examples. ABSeeker achieves 37.3% on BrowseComp and 39.1% on BrowseComp-ZH. With context management, the scores further improve to 55.3% and 52.9%, respectively, significantly outperforming same-scale (4B) agents and even matching the performance of larger ones (approximately 30B). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of answer-backtracked step-level credit assignment for training long-horizon search agents.
tldr: The paper proposes Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment (ABC) to train long-horizon search agents by providing step-level rewards, achieving state-of-the-art performance on BrowseComp benchmarks.
abstract_cn: 长视野搜索智能体必须执行多个连续动作（步骤）来搜索、检索、验证并整合证据，以得出最终答案。然而，现有的训练此类智能体的方法通常在监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）过程中将轨迹中的所有步骤一视同仁，未能区分有用动作与错误或冗余动作。在本文中，我们提出答案回溯信用分配（Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment, ABC），这是一种细粒度的信用分配框架，用于训练长视野搜索智能体，通过将稀疏的轨迹级结果转化为密集的步骤级监督信号，奖励有用动作（即使在失败的轨迹中）同时抑制错误或冗余动作。具体而言，给定一个可能模糊的查询及其对应的标准答案，ABC首先执行答案回溯线索恢复（Answer-Backtracked Clue Recovery），从答案出发逆向追踪，恢复解答该问题所需的中间线索。随后，应用线索锚定步骤评分（Clue-Anchored Step Scoring）来评估每个搜索步骤与这些线索的匹配程度，将稀疏的二元结果监督转化为密集的步骤级奖励。基于这些奖励，我们开发了ABC-SFT，该方法对每一轮次的损失进行重新加权，以及ABC-GRPO，该方法在GRPO中使用步骤级分数作为奖励。在此框架基础上，我们仅使用8.5k个示例基于Qwen3.5-4B训练了ABSeeker。ABSeeker在BrowseComp上达到37.3%的准确率，在BrowseComp-ZH上达到39.1%。通过引入上下文管理，分数进一步提升至55.3%和52.9%，显著优于同规模（4B）智能体，甚至可与更大规模（约30B）的智能体性能相媲美。这些结果证明了基于答案回溯的步骤级信用分配在训练长视野搜索智能体方面的有效性。

title: Hierarchical Graph Memory for LLM Agents with Path-level Localization and Rewrite
abstract: Agents for long term reasoning require a memory that can be efficiently and effectively updated over time, as new facts and external feedback continue to arrive. Recently, graph memory has been adopted to offer structural organization for multi-hop retrieval and reasoning. However, existing methods store all memories in a flat graph, and accumulated historical memories can introduce irrelevant contexts and increase the cost of evidence selection during retrieval. Moreover, they typically update memory units independently, requiring repeated unit-wise rewrite to cover related changes. To address these issues, we propose HiGram, an evolving hierarchical graph memory framework with path-level localization and rewriting. Specifically, we first propose a hierarchical graph memory, which organizes the memory into coarse-to-fine architecture composed of upper-level nodes and MemoryUnits, thereby reducing the amount of irrelevant information during retrieval. We further propose MicroGraph-based path-level localization, which leverages query and update conditioned MicroGraphs to identify support subgraph and evidence path before rewrite. Finally, we propose a coordinated rewriting method that jointly revises intra-unit memory and inter-unit dependencies, enable valid dependency structures updating in the localized evidence path. Experiments on benchmarks for long-term conversational question answering and conflict-aware memory evaluation demonstrate that our method demonstrate substantial improvements over baselines in answer quality and token efficiency. Besides, our method improves answer accuracy and query-valid evidence selection under dynamic, static, and conditional conflicts.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种层次化图记忆框架HiGram，通过路径级定位和重写机制，提高了长期对话问答中智能体记忆的更新效率和答案质量。
abstract_cn: 面向长期推理的智能体需要一种能够随着新事实和外部反馈的持续到来而高效且有效地随时间更新的记忆机制。近年来，图记忆已被采用，以提供用于多跳检索和推理的结构化组织。然而，现有方法将所有记忆存储在一个平面图中，且累积的历史记忆可能引入不相关的上下文，并增加检索过程中证据选择的成本。此外，它们通常独立地更新记忆单元，需要重复的逐单元重写以覆盖相关变化。为解决这些问题，我们提出了HiGram，一种具有路径级定位与重写的演化式层次图记忆框架。具体而言，我们首先提出一种层次图记忆，将记忆组织为包含上层节点和记忆单元的由粗到细的架构，从而减少检索过程中不相关信息量。我们进一步提出基于微图的路径级定位方法，利用查询和更新条件化的微图在重写前识别支持子图和证据路径。最后，我们提出一种协调重写方法，联合修正单元内记忆与单元间依赖关系，使有效的依赖结构能够在定位到的证据路径中更新。在长期对话问答和冲突感知记忆评估基准上的实验表明，我们的方法在答案质量和令牌效率方面相较于基线有显著提升。此外，我们的方法在动态、静态和条件冲突下均提高了答案准确性和查询有效的证据选择能力。

title: Item Response Theory for AI Safety
abstract: Language models differ in how safely they behave and these differences are measured by safety benchmarks. But aggregated benchmark scores are hard to trust and interpret, because benchmarks duplicate one another, correlate heavily, and models may sandbag when they detect evaluation. To address these issues, we draw on Item Response Theory (IRT), a statistical toolkit for measuring these latents from performance on items with inferred psychometric properties. We fit IRT models to eight safety benchmarks across 192 language models, the largest psychometric analysis of LLM safety evaluations to date, and contribute three results. First, we find that three interpretable factors of refusal strictness, truthfulness, and contextual harm explain most of the variance between models across benchmarks. Second, psychometrically selected items recover full benchmark scores with lower error than random subsets of the same size, and roughly ten adaptively chosen items suffice for several individual benchmarks, cutting evaluation cost by 97-99%. Third, IRT supports audits of individual models, showing that it can be used to detect naive sandbagging and changes of model behind APIs. Overall, we show IRT is a ready-made toolkit for reading, reducing, and auditing safety benchmarks, which we recommend frontier labs and evaluators adopt.
tldr: This paper applies Item Response Theory to analyze and improve the evaluation of language model safety, demonstrating that IRT can reduce benchmark size, detect sandbagging, and audit model behavior.
abstract_cn: 语言模型在安全性行为上存在差异，这些差异通过安全基准进行衡量。然而，聚合的基准分数难以信任和解读，因为基准之间存在重复、高度相关，且模型在检测到评估时可能采取“沙袋策略”（sandbagging）。为解决这些问题，我们借鉴项目反应理论（Item Response Theory, IRT），这是一种从具有推断心理测量属性的项目表现中测量潜在特质的统计工具。我们将IRT模型应用于192个语言模型上的八个安全基准，这是迄今为止对LLM安全评估进行的最大规模心理测量分析，并贡献了三个结果。第一，我们发现拒绝严格性、真实性和情境危害这三个可解释因素解释了跨基准模型间的大部分方差。第二，心理测量学选择的项目以比相同规模随机子集更低的误差恢复完整基准分数，且约十个自适应选择的项目足以覆盖若干单个基准，将评估成本降低97%-99%。第三，IRT支持对单个模型的审计，表明其可用于检测朴素的沙袋策略以及API背后模型的变化。总体而言，我们证明IRT是一种现成的工具包，用于解读、精简和审计安全基准，我们建议前沿实验室和评估机构采用该方法。

title: VQ-VAD: Vector-quantized Motion Representation Learning for Human-centric Video Anomaly Detection
abstract: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is inherently challenging due to the scarcity of anomalies and the large visual variability in surveillance footage, including changes in lighting, viewpoint, and human appearance. To mitigate visual noise and address privacy concerns, recent work has shifted to pose-based VAD, which focuses on motion dynamics rather than raw video data. However, existing pose-based approaches model human behavior in continuous latent spaces, limiting their ability to learn compact motion patterns necessary for robust behavior analysis. We address this by proposing Vector-Quantized Video Anomaly Detection (VQ-VAD), a novel human-centric anomaly detection framework that learns discrete motion representations. VQ-VAD adapts Vector-Quantized GAN (VQ-GAN), originally developed for image generation, to operate on keypoint sequences and construct a motion codebook of normal behavior. Trained exclusively on normal motion sequences, VQ-VAD detects anomalies by identifying high reconstruction errors when an observed motion sequence cannot be mapped to the learned codebook. We conduct extensive experiments across three complementary evaluation settings, including in-domain, cross-domain, and cross-dataset generalization, on four anomaly detection benchmarks. VQ-VAD achieves strong in-domain accuracy (81.83% on HR-SHT [15]), effective cross-domain transfer from CMU Panoptic [14] (76.69% on HR-SHT [15] without retraining), and competitive cross-dataset robustness. The code base for this work is available at https://github.com/TeCSAR-UNCC/VQ-VAD.
tldr: The paper proposes VQ-VAD, a novel framework for human-centric video anomaly detection that learns discrete motion representations via vector quantization, achieving strong performance in in-domain, cross-domain, and cross-dataset settings.
abstract_cn: 视频异常检测（VAD）本质上具有挑战性，原因在于异常样本稀缺以及监控画面中巨大的视觉变异性，包括光照、视角和人体外观的变化。为减轻视觉噪声并解决隐私问题，近期研究已转向基于姿态的VAD，该方法侧重于运动动态而非原始视频数据。然而，现有的基于姿态的方法在连续潜在空间中建模人类行为，限制了其学习稳健行为分析所必需的紧凑运动模式的能力。针对这一问题，我们提出了向量量化视频异常检测（VQ-VAD），一种新颖的以人为中心的异常检测框架，用于学习离散运动表示。VQ-VAD将最初为图像生成开发的向量量化生成对抗网络（VQ-GAN）适配至关键点序列，并构建正常行为的运动码本。VQ-VAD仅使用正常运动序列进行训练，通过识别观测运动序列无法映射至所学码本时产生的高重建误差来检测异常。我们在四个异常检测基准上进行了跨三种互补评估设置的广泛实验，包括域内、跨域和跨数据集泛化。VQ-VAD在域内取得了强准确性（在HR-SHT [15]上达到81.83%），实现了从CMU Panoptic [14]的有效跨域迁移（无需重新训练即在HR-SHT [15]上达到76.69%），并展现出具有竞争力的跨数据集鲁棒性。本工作的代码库可在 https://github.com/TeCSAR-UNCC/VQ-VAD 获取。
