title: Confusion-Geometry Rebalancing for Long-Tailed Adversarial Training
abstract: Adversarial training under long tailed distributions suffers from a dual imbalance: the class imbalance skews the training objective toward head classes, and the adversarial inner maximization may further amplify this bias. Existing methods mitigate this issue by correcting class priors or adapting class wise robust supervision, yet they treat each class in isolation and fail to identify which boundaries drive long tailed collapse. We propose a Confusion Geometry Rebalancing method (CGRm) for long tail adversarial training, a plug in framework that leverages directed robust errors as training signals. CGRm leverages periodic robust evaluations to derive source class loss weights, class wise robust coefficients, and a directed confusion geometry graph. The method then couples feedback weighted robust optimization with graph guided margin correction, thereby boosting the robustness of vulnerable classes and sharpening the critical boundaries that drive long tailed performance degradation. Experiments on long tailed benchmarks show that CGRm achieves consistent robust performance gains over existing methods, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. We provide the code in the supplement.
tldr: The paper proposes a Confusion Geometry Rebalancing method (CGRm) to improve adversarial training under long-tailed distributions by leveraging directed robust errors and graph-guided margin correction, achieving consistent robustness gains.
abstract_cn: 在长尾分布下的对抗训练面临双重不平衡问题：类别不平衡使训练目标偏向头部类别，而对抗性内部最大化可能进一步放大这种偏差。现有方法通过修正类别先验或调整类别级鲁棒监督来缓解该问题，但它们孤立地处理每个类别，未能识别哪些边界导致了长尾崩溃。我们提出了一种用于长尾对抗训练的混淆几何再平衡方法（Confusion Geometry Rebalancing method, CGRm），这是一种即插即用的框架，利用有向鲁棒误差作为训练信号。CGRm利用周期性鲁棒评估来推导源类别损失权重、类别级鲁棒系数以及有向混淆几何图。随后，该方法将反馈加权鲁棒优化与图引导的边界修正相结合，从而提升脆弱类别的鲁棒性，并锐化导致长尾性能下降的关键边界。在长尾基准上的实验表明，CGRm相较于现有方法取得了持续的鲁棒性能提升，消融实验验证了各组成部分的贡献。我们在补充材料中提供了代码。

title: FedOrbit: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning for Non-IID LEO Satellite Constellations
abstract: Federated learning (FL) in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations is affected by non-IID data and irregular ground-station visibility, both driven by orbital geometry. Global aggregation performs poorly when orbit-level class distributions are disjoint, while strong personalisation can be excessive when these distributions overlap. We present FedOrbit, which combines continuous orbit-level training over inter-satellite links, class-aware hierarchical aggregation, quality-weighted feature aggregation with return-rate dampening, and adaptive feature decomposition based on inter-orbit class similarity. Across three remote-sensing benchmarks and two non-IID partitions, FedOrbit achieves the highest accuracy in five of six settings and is within $0.9$ percentage points of the best result in the sixth. The gains over the strongest baseline reach $16.1$ percentage points under Dirichlet partitioning and $8.6$ under pathological partitioning, with the smallest per-orbit accuracy spread in five of six settings.
tldr: 该论文提出FedOrbit方法，通过自适应个性化联邦学习解决LEO卫星星座中非IID数据和地面站可见性不规则的问题，在遥感基准上取得最优精度。
abstract_cn: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星星座中的联邦学习（FL）受到非独立同分布（non-IID）数据和不规则地面站可见性的影响，这两者均由轨道几何结构驱动。当轨道级别的类别分布不重叠时，全局聚合性能较差；而当这些分布重叠时，过度的个性化又可能显得多余。我们提出了FedOrbit，该方法结合了星间链路上的连续轨道级训练、类别感知的分层聚合、带返回率阻尼的质量加权特征聚合，以及基于轨道间类别相似性的自适应特征分解。在三个遥感基准数据集和两种non-IID划分方式下，FedOrbit在六种设置中的五种取得了最高准确率，并在第六种设置中与最佳结果的差距在0.9个百分点以内。与最强基线相比，在Dirichlet划分下准确率提升最高达16.1个百分点，在病理性划分下提升达8.6个百分点，且在六种设置中的五种中，各轨道间准确率离散度最小。

title: Deep Learning Imputation of Missing Radius of Maximum Winds (Rmax) Values in Tropical Cyclone Best-Track Data
abstract: Probabilistic coastal hazard assessments require accurate characterization of tropical cyclone (TC) parameters, yet datasets often contain missing records for the radius of maximum winds (Rmax), a key variable in Joint Probability Method analyses. This study evaluates data-driven approaches for Rmax imputation, including one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1DCNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and conventional machine learning models. We examine physics-informed input augmentation, temporal modeling, and transfer learning using synthetic RAFT and STORM datasets for pre-training and observational IBTrACS data for fine-tuning. Including the radius of 34-knot winds (R34) substantially improves performance across all model types. Temporal models achieve higher average correlations than non-temporal models despite using approximately an order of magnitude fewer samples, indicating better preservation of relative Rmax variability across storms. This advantage is more pronounced when R34 is unavailable, suggesting temporal information can partially compensate for missing storm-size predictors. Transfer learning does not improve performance, likely because synthetic datasets have lower and less variable Rmax distributions than IBTrACS. These findings demonstrate the potential of temporal deep learning for reconstructing incomplete TC records and highlight the importance of physics-informed inputs, observational data availability, and distributional consistency in coastal hazard assessment.
tldr: This paper evaluates deep learning and machine learning approaches for imputing missing Rmax values in tropical cyclone data, finding that temporal models and physics-informed inputs improve performance.
abstract_cn: 概率性海岸灾害评估要求对热带气旋（TC）参数进行精确刻画，然而数据集中常存在最大风速半径（Rmax）记录缺失的问题，而该变量在联合概率方法分析中至关重要。本研究评估了用于Rmax插补的数据驱动方法，包括一维卷积神经网络（1DCNNs）、长短期记忆（LSTM）网络以及传统机器学习模型。我们考察了物理信息输入增强、时间建模以及迁移学习，其中使用合成RAFT和STORM数据集进行预训练，并使用观测IBTrACS数据进行微调。纳入34节风速半径（R34）显著提升了所有模型类型的性能。尽管时间模型使用的样本数量约少一个数量级，但其平均相关性高于非时间模型，表明其能更好地保留风暴间Rmax的相对变异性。当R34不可用时，这一优势更为明显，提示时间信息可在一定程度上弥补风暴尺度预测因子缺失的问题。迁移学习未能提升性能，这可能是因为合成数据集的Rmax分布较IBTrACS更低且变异性更小。这些发现展示了时间深度学习在重建不完整TC记录方面的潜力，并强调了物理信息输入、观测数据可用性及分布一致性在海岸灾害评估中的重要性。

title: Activation Probes Surface Code-Security Signals that the Model's Output Misses
abstract: AI coding agents now write a growing share of production code, and human security review does not scale at the rate code is generated. The agents in widest use are closed-weight, so a deploying team cannot read their internals. It can instead run an open-weight model as a reviewer over the agent's output. That reviewer's activations are readable. We ask whether reading those activations recovers a security signal that simply asking the same reviewer misses. We fit a single linear probe per model on a corpus of paired vulnerable-and-fixed Python functions, then test it without retraining on real disclosed vulnerabilities whose weakness type the probe never saw in training, across five open-weight reviewer models. On the vulnerabilities fixed by changing a single function, the probe scores the vulnerable function above its fix on 61-67% of cases for every model, beating the 50% chance line. It also beats the same model's prompted YES/NO win-rate read from its logits, under every prompt we try. Asking the model for a written verdict, even with chain-of-thought, returns the same answer on the vulnerable and fixed function most of the time and so cannot tell them apart. Model activations carry a code-security signal that prompting the same model misses.
tldr: 该论文研究通过线性探针分析开放权重模型的激活值来检测代码安全漏洞，发现激活值能捕捉到模型输出中遗漏的安全信号。
abstract_cn: AI编码代理如今编写了越来越多的生产代码，而人工安全审查的速度无法跟上代码生成的速率。使用最广泛的代理是闭源的，因此部署团队无法读取其内部机制。作为替代，部署团队可以运行一个开源权重模型作为审查者，对代理的输出进行审查。该审查者的激活值是可读取的。我们研究的问题是：读取这些激活值是否能恢复仅通过询问同一审查者所无法获得的安全信号。我们在一个由成对的有漏洞和已修复的Python函数组成的语料库上，为每个模型拟合了一个线性探针，然后在不重新训练的情况下，对真实披露的漏洞进行测试，这些漏洞的弱点类型在训练中从未被探针见过，测试覆盖五个开源权重审查模型。对于通过修改单个函数即可修复的漏洞，探针在61-67%的案例中（针对每个模型）将漏洞函数评分高于其修复版本，超过了50%的随机水平。同时，在我们尝试的每种提示下，探针的表现也优于同一模型从逻辑值中读取的提示性“是/否”胜率。要求模型给出书面判定，即使采用思维链，在大多数情况下对漏洞函数和修复函数返回相同的答案，因此无法区分二者。模型激活值携带了提示同一模型所无法捕捉到的代码安全信号。

title: LoRA-based Adaptation Alone Is Not Enough: Understanding the Limits of Foundation Models for Face Presentation Attack Detection
abstract: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) aims to reliably detect a wide range of presentation attacks. While PAD methods achieve strong performance within individual datasets, their performance degrades under cross-dataset evaluation. Variations in sensors or lighting conditions can reduce the effectiveness of detectors from near-perfect to nearly random. Foundation models (FMs) have emerged as a promising alternative because typical PAD datasets, such as the MCIO benchmarks (MSU-MFSD, CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, and OULU-NPU), are small relative to the scale used for web-based pretraining. However, existing PAD systems primarily focus on CLIP-based foundation models, while overlooking other FMs with different architectures and training procedures. This study addresses this question by systematically evaluating 32 FMs. Zero-shot prompting achieves performance near chance across model families and scales. The vision encoders, when low-rankadapted (LoRA) with fewer than 1% trainable weights, achieve below 2% intra-dataset ACER in most cases, while cross-dataset ACER is substantially higher. LoRA primarily refines the decision boundary within a dataset, suggesting that pretrained representations and the adaptation dataset play a larger role in cross-dataset generalization than the evaluated lightweight adaptation strategy.
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates 32 foundation models for face presentation attack detection, finding that zero-shot prompting performs near chance and LoRA adaptation achieves low intra-dataset but high cross-dataset error, indicating limitations of lightweight adaptation for generalization.
abstract_cn: 人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）旨在可靠地检测各种呈现攻击。尽管PAD方法在单个数据集内表现出较强的性能，但在跨数据集评估下其性能会下降。传感器或光照条件的变化可能使检测器的性能从接近完美降至接近随机。基础模型（FMs）已成为一种有前景的替代方案，因为典型的PAD数据集（如MCIO基准：MSU-MFSD、CASIA-FASD、Replay-Attack和OULU-NPU）相对于基于网络的预训练规模而言较小。然而，现有的PAD系统主要关注基于CLIP的基础模型，而忽视了具有不同架构和训练过程的其他基础模型。本研究通过系统评估32种基础模型来解决这一问题。零样本提示（zero-shot prompting）在各模型家族和规模上的表现接近随机水平。视觉编码器在采用低秩适应（LoRA）且可训练权重少于1%的情况下，在大多数情况下可实现低于2%的数据集内ACER，而跨数据集ACER则显著更高。LoRA主要是在数据集内部优化决策边界，这表明预训练表示和适应数据集在跨数据集泛化中发挥的作用大于所评估的轻量级适应策略。

title: Satellite Trajectory Optimization via Proximal Policy Optimization for Space Debris Avoidance
abstract: Collision avoidance systems are commonly used to avoid fragmentation events occurring in Low-Earth Orbit (LEO) and Geosynchronous Equatorial Orbit (GEO). However, these events have been growing in frequency as orbital congestion worsens with the launch of megaconstellations. Consequently, conjunction alerts and collision risks are becoming increasingly common. Current practices, which are commonly manual or rule-based, have difficulty scaling to these worsening dynamic environments. To address this intensifying situation, we propose a reinforcement-learning policy for autonomous collision avoidance, trained via Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) along with an open-source, high-fidelity astrodynamics simulator for training and evaluation. In 1,000 deterministic GEO episodes, our agent achieves a 97.5% collision avoidance success rate, outperforming traditional controllers such as a rule-based baseline (20.7% success) and an impulsive delta-v planner baseline (27.5% success). To achieve these results, we designed a simulator to train and evaluate our agent, using real-world and simulated debris. We simulate Newtonian two-body dynamics using Sun/Moon third-body perturbations, fuel-dependent thrust, and configurable debris fields. The agent is trained with curriculum learning and shaped rewards oriented toward encouraging survival, adequate projected miss distance, and delta-v conservation. Finally, our evaluation consisted of a fully deterministic pipeline, including shared seeds, per-episode logs, and telemetry exports. Our work is a publicly available framework at https://purl.org/sat-trajectory-avoidance
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于近端策略优化的强化学习策略，用于自主规避空间碎片，在1000个GEO场景中实现了97.5%的碰撞避免成功率，优于传统方法。
abstract_cn: 碰撞规避系统通常用于避免低地球轨道（LEO）和地球同步赤道轨道（GEO）中发生的碎片碰撞事件。然而，随着巨型星座的发射导致轨道拥堵日益加剧，这些事件的发生频率不断上升。因此，交会警报和碰撞风险正变得越来越常见。当前的做法通常依赖人工操作或基于规则的方法，难以扩展到这些日益恶化的动态环境中。为应对这一日益严峻的形势，我们提出了一种基于强化学习的自主碰撞规避策略，该策略通过近端策略优化（PPO）算法进行训练，并配套一个开源、高保真度的天体动力学仿真器用于训练与评估。在1,000个确定性GEO场景中，我们的智能体实现了97.5%的碰撞规避成功率，优于传统控制器，如基于规则的基线（成功率为20.7%）和脉冲式Δv规划器基线（成功率为27.5%）。为实现这些结果，我们设计了一个仿真器来训练和评估我们的智能体，该仿真器使用了真实世界及模拟的碎片数据。我们模拟了牛顿二体动力学，并考虑了太阳/月球三体摄动、依赖燃料的推力以及可配置的碎片场。智能体通过课程学习和面向鼓励生存、足够的预计交会距离以及Δv节约的塑形奖励进行训练。最后，我们的评估由完全确定性的流程组成，包括共享随机种子、逐场景日志和遥测数据导出。我们的工作是一个公开可用的框架，网址为 https://purl.org/sat-trajectory-avoidance

title: KGCaRe: Explainable Complex Conditional Question Answering using Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction and Context Retrieval with LLMs
abstract:
Answering complex conditional questions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) remains a challenge, particularly in domain-specific contexts where general-purpose LLMs and RAG tend to underperform. We hypothesize that augmenting RAG with unstructured and structured knowledge, extracted from both documents and knowledge graphs (KGs), can improve reasoning and answer accuracy for such tasks.
  To test this, we propose KGCaRe, a hybrid approach that combines neural retrieval with symbolic reasoning over LLM-generated KGs. KGCaRe constructs a KG from documents using a multi-prompt extraction strategy and stores it in a graph database. Simultaneously, the documents are embedded into a vector store to enable neural retrieval. KGCaRe performs innovative iterative graph traversal guided by the LLM to extract relevant triples, prune irrelevant information, and uses additional clue entities to traverse the graph again if the initial traversal does not provide satisfactory context to generate the answer. The relevant triples extracted from the KG in path form, along with semantically retrieved text passages, are then fed into custom KGCaRe prompts to generate answers to the complex conditional questions with explanations.
  We evaluate KGCaRe on two complex conditional QA datasets. Our results on these datasets show that KGCaRe consistently outperforms existing baselines, including Vanilla LLM, Code Prompt, Text Prompt, Think-on-Graph, Vanilla RAG, and HybridContextQA, across multiple LLMs such as Mistral, Mixtral, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4o. We publicly release the software pipeline that we developed to implement the proposed KGCaRe approach.
tldr: The paper proposes KGCaRe, a hybrid approach combining neural retrieval and symbolic reasoning over LLM-generated knowledge graphs to improve complex conditional question answering, and demonstrates its effectiveness over baselines on two datasets.
abstract_cn:
使用大型语言模型（LLMs）和检索增强生成（RAG）回答复杂的条件性问题仍然是一项挑战，尤其是在特定领域背景下，通用型LLMs和RAG往往表现不佳。我们假设，通过将文档和知识图谱（KGs）中提取的非结构化与结构化知识增强到RAG中，可以提升此类任务的推理能力和答案准确性。
为验证这一假设，我们提出了KGCaRe，一种将神经检索与基于LLM生成的知识图谱上的符号推理相结合的混合方法。KGCaRe采用多提示词提取策略从文档中构建知识图谱，并将其存储在图数据库中。同时，文档被嵌入到向量存储中，以实现神经检索。KGCaRe执行由LLM引导的创新性迭代图遍历，以提取相关三元组、剪除无关信息，并在初始遍历未能提供生成答案所需的满意上下文时，利用额外线索实体再次遍历图。从知识图谱中以路径形式提取的相关三元组，连同语义检索到的文本段落，被输入到定制的KGCaRe提示词中，以生成带有解释的复杂条件性问题的答案。
我们在两个复杂的条件性问答数据集上评估了KGCaRe。在这些数据集上的结果表明，在多种LLM（如Mistral、Mixtral、GPT-3.5和GPT-4o）下，KGCaRe始终优于现有基线方法，包括Vanilla LLM、Code Prompt、Text Prompt、Think-on-Graph、Vanilla RAG和HybridContextQA。我们公开发布了用于实现所提出的KGCaRe方法的软件流水线。

title: Cultivar: A Contrastive and Locale-Oriented Translation Benchmark for Investigating Contamination and Localisation Robustness
abstract: Multilingual translation benchmarks are typically sourced in English and translated into other languages, treating language pairs as the unit of evaluation---a design that is prone to contamination over time and overlooks locale and cultural considerations. We therefore advocate for source-contrastive evaluation and instantiate it with Cultivar, a localised subset of FLORES, which enables locale-specific translation evaluation. When paired with unlocalised counterparts, performance discrepancy allows the probing of data contamination and localisation robustness. We benchmark 32 open-weight models and find that MT-specialised models are less robust, a few models potentially overfit FLORES, and models tend to translate US content better than that of other locales, regardless of language.
tldr: The paper introduces Cultivar, a locale-specific translation benchmark, to evaluate translation models for data contamination and localization robustness, finding that MT-specialized models are less robust and models generally perform better on US content.
abstract_cn: 多语言翻译基准通常以英语为源语言，并翻译成其他语言，将语言对作为评估单位——这种设计容易随着时间推移受到数据污染，且忽视了地域和文化因素。因此，我们提倡源语言对比评估，并通过Cultivar（FLORES的一个本地化子集）加以实现，从而支持针对特定地域的翻译评估。当与未本地化的对应版本配对使用时，性能差异可用于探测数据污染和本地化鲁棒性。我们对32个开放权重模型进行了基准测试，发现专用于机器翻译的模型鲁棒性较差，部分模型可能对FLORES存在过拟合，且无论语言如何，模型倾向于将美国内容翻译得比其他地域的内容更好。

title: Second-Order Muon Done Right: A Principled Marriage of Spectral Geometry and Curvature
abstract: Muon's polar update is exact for an unweighted spectral geometry. We introduce GO-MUON, which uses a matched data-dependent geometry and reuses it across several optimization steps. Conditioned on any positive-definite left and right maps, its raw update exactly solves the corresponding weighted spectral oracle; this statement is independent of how the maps are estimated or how recently they were refreshed. For softmax cross-entropy, we quantify when the observed-label backward factor approaches the model Fisher and generalized Gauss--Newton factor. We also show that four-step refresh nearly preserves the tracking delay of slowly changing geometry while increasing stationary factor noise, making lazy geometry a compute--statistics tradeoff rather than a denoising mechanism.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种改进的Muon优化器（GO-MUON），通过匹配数据依赖的几何结构并跨步骤复用，以更精确地解决加权谱Oracle问题，并分析了在softmax交叉熵下的性质。
abstract_cn: 缪子极坐标更新对于未加权的谱几何是精确的。我们引入GO-MUON，它使用匹配的数据依赖几何，并在多个优化步骤中重复利用该几何。在任意正定左映射和右映射的条件下，其原始更新精确求解相应的加权谱预言机；这一结论与映射的估计方式或刷新时间无关。对于softmax交叉熵，我们量化了观测标签反向因子何时逼近模型Fisher信息矩阵及广义Gauss–Newton因子。我们还表明，四步刷新几乎保持缓慢变化几何的跟踪延迟，同时增加平稳因子噪声，这使得惰性几何成为一种计算与统计之间的权衡，而非去噪机制。

title: ColluSkill: Adversarial Cross-Skill Composition for Evading Agent Skill Scanners
abstract: Agent skills are emerging as an important attack surface in LLM-based agent systems. Through an empirical study of existing skill scanners, we find that current defenses mainly inspect individual skills, leaving risks from cross-skill composition insufficiently examined. This creates a practical blind spot: multiple locally plausible skills may pass security checks while collectively forming a harmful workflow during agent execution. To investigate this threat, we propose ColluSkill, a collusive multi-skill-chain attack framework that decomposes a complete malicious intent into interdependent sub-payloads embedded in independently packaged skills. The attack does not rely on any single malicious skill, but emerges from the ordered composition of locally plausible behaviors through contextual dependencies, artifact passing, and execution handoffs. ColluSkill further employs LLM-based chain planning and scanner-feedback refinement to preserve chain-level attack semantics while reducing suspicious signals in individual sub-skills. To defend against such attacks, we propose ChainGuard, a context-aware skill-chain scanner that jointly analyzes a candidate skill and the skills already installed in the agent environment. ChainGuard reconstructs cross-skill dependencies, artifact flows, capability compositions, and downstream behaviors to identify risks that emerge only at the workflow level. Experiments on six representative skill scanners show that ColluSkill achieves an average attack success rate of 96.0% and consistently outperforms the evaluated single-skill and multi-skill attack baselines. Meanwhile, ChainGuard reduces the attack success rate to 22.5% while allowing 99.5% of benign workflows to pass, highlighting the importance of chain-level security analysis for agent skill ecosystems.
tldr: The paper proposes ColluSkill, a collusive multi-skill-chain attack framework that bypasses skill scanners in LLM-based agent systems, and ChainGuard, a defense that analyzes cross-skill dependencies to mitigate such attacks.
abstract_cn: Agent技能正逐渐成为基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统中一个重要的攻击面。通过对现有技能扫描器的实证研究，我们发现当前防御措施主要针对单个技能进行审查，未能充分考察跨技能组合所带来的风险。这造成了一个实际盲区：多个局部看似合理的技能可能通过安全检测，但在智能体执行过程中共同形成有害工作流。为探究这一威胁，我们提出了ColluSkill，一种共谋式多技能链攻击框架，该框架将完整的恶意意图分解为相互依赖的子载荷，并嵌入到独立打包的技能中。该攻击不依赖任何单个恶意技能，而是通过上下文依赖、工件传递和执行交接，在局部合理行为的按序组合中涌现出攻击效果。ColluSkill进一步利用基于LLM的链式规划与扫描器反馈优化，在保留链级攻击语义的同时，降低单个子技能中的可疑信号。为防御此类攻击，我们提出了ChainGuard，一种上下文感知的技能链扫描器，该扫描器联合分析候选技能及智能体环境中已安装的技能。ChainGuard重构跨技能依赖、工件流、能力组合及下游行为，以识别仅在工作流层面涌现的风险。在六种代表性技能扫描器上的实验表明，ColluSkill的平均攻击成功率达到96.0%，并持续优于所评估的单技能和多技能攻击基线。同时，ChainGuard将攻击成功率降至22.5%，同时允许99.5%的良性工作流通过，凸显了链级安全分析对智能体技能生态系统的重要性。

title: How Do Large Language Models Judge Social Attraction? Evidence from Theory-Grounded Persona Ratings Across Multiple LLMs and Humans
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to perform subjective evaluations traditionally made by humans, yet their validity as social judges remains unclear. This paper examines whether LLMs can assess social attraction from theory-grounded persona profiles constructed from ten psychological and relational constructs and organized into three tiers: socially attractive, socially mixed, and socially unattractive. We examine LLM ratings in two studies and compare them with human judgments in a third study. In Study 1, 34 LLMs rated 12 profiles across three repeated runs. Although some models tended to give higher or lower ratings overall, they showed strong stability across runs, consistent three-tier ordering, and high agreement in relative profile ordering. Study 2 examined sensitivity to gender presentation using six matched name-and-pronoun profile pairs and a separate pronoun-only test with a gender-neutral name, finding no significant effects in either analysis. In Study 3, 198 human participants evaluated the six matched profiles from Study 2. Their ratings reproduced the three-tier structure and followed a profile ordering consistent with that of the LLMs. However, LLMs rated attractive profiles more positively and unattractive profiles more negatively than humans, while neither group showed a significant overall effect of gender presentation.
tldr: This paper investigates whether large language models can assess social attraction from theory-grounded persona profiles, finding that LLMs show stable and consistent ratings that align with human judgments in relative ordering, though they exhibit more extreme ratings.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于执行传统上由人类完成的主观评估，但其作为社会评判者的有效性仍不明确。本文考察了LLMs是否能够基于从十个心理与关系构念构建、并划分为三个层级（社交吸引力高、社交吸引力混合、社交吸引力低）的理论驱动人格画像，来评估社交吸引力。我们在两项研究中检验了LLMs的评分，并在第三项研究中将其与人类判断进行比较。在研究1中，34个LLMs对12个画像进行了三轮重复评分。尽管某些模型在总体评分上倾向于偏高或偏低，但它们在多轮评分中表现出较强的稳定性、一致的三层级排序，以及在相对画像排序上的高度一致性。研究2通过六组匹配的姓名与代词画像对，以及一项使用性别中立姓名的仅代词测试，考察了对性别呈现的敏感性，两项分析均未发现显著效应。在研究3中，198名人类参与者评估了研究2中的六组匹配画像。他们的评分再现了三层级结构，并遵循了与LLMs一致的画像排序。然而，与人类相比，LLMs对吸引力高的画像评分更为积极，对吸引力低的画像评分更为消极，而两组均未表现出显著的性别呈现总体效应。

title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites
abstract: Training a language model suite classically requires training each model separately and serving them independently. We improve both training and inference efficiency by stacking sub-models of increasing size into a single nested architecture trained end-to-end. This Matryoshka training framework reduces the total parameter count of the suite, enables low-cost distillation from the largest to all smaller sub-models at every training step, and is well-suited for speculative decoding as the draft model is contained within the verifier. We validate our approach by training a Matryoshka suite comprising 500M, 1.5B, and 3B sub-models. Our suite is on par with independently trained baselines on benchmark performance and validation and out-of-domain perplexities, while using 36% less training compute and improving the throughput of speculative decoding by 14-26%. We also ablate key architectural choices, offering guidance for building strong Matryoshka LM suites.
tldr: The paper proposes a Matryoshka training framework for language model suites that stacks sub-models of increasing size into a single nested architecture, reducing training compute by 36% and improving speculative decoding throughput by 14-26% while maintaining performance.
abstract_cn: 训练一个语言模型套件通常需要分别训练每个模型并独立提供服务。我们通过将规模递增的子模型堆叠到一个端到端训练的统一嵌套架构中，同时提升了训练和推理效率。这一Matryoshka训练框架降低了套件的总参数量，使得在每一步训练中都能以极低成本从最大模型向所有较小子模型进行蒸馏，并且非常适合投机解码，因为草稿模型已包含在验证器之内。我们通过训练一个包含500M、1.5B和3B子模型的Matryoshka套件来验证该方法。我们的套件在基准性能、验证集以及域外困惑度上与独立训练的基线模型相当，同时减少了36%的训练计算量，并将投机解码的吞吐量提升了14-26%。我们还对关键架构选择进行了消融实验，为构建强大的Matryoshka语言模型套件提供了指导。

title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models
abstract: Predicting the answer to interventional ``what if'' questions --- the outcome of an action never taken --- requires a \emph{mechanistic}, causal model, not a curve fit; and learning such a model requires \emph{experiments}, because passive data leaves its mechanisms unidentified. Experiments are expensive, so the central problem is \emph{data efficiency}. We present the Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which couples a large language model (LLM), used as a \emph{proposer} of candidate structures, with standard Bayesian machinery --- sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) for parameter and structure posteriors, simulation-based inference (SBI) for intractable likelihoods, and value-of-information (VoI) for experiment design --- to discover latent mechanistic world models from few interventions. MDA operates in the M-open setting: when the truth lies outside the current hypothesis class, a predictive check flags the inadequacy and the proposer expands the hypothesis space with a new model whose parameters are then identified by designed experiments. We show that \emph{discovery and design reinforce}: the design step identifies the mechanism the discovery step proposes, and the identified mechanism improves predictions, enabling further discoveries from the remaining unexplained residuals. On three different benchmarks --- covering physics (\DPbench, \citep{wiemann2026discoverphysics}), chemistry (\CHEMbench, \citep{kabra2026autoscilab}) and biology (\HHbench, a new partially observed single-neuron electrophysiology benchmark we create) --- we show that MDA sets a new SOTA in terms of data-efficient model learning and reliable interventional forecasting ability.
tldr: The paper presents Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which combines LLMs with Bayesian inference and experiment design to efficiently discover mechanistic causal models from interventional data, achieving state-of-the-art results on physics, chemistry, and biology benchmarks.
abstract_cn: 预测干预性“假设”问题——即从未采取过的行动的结果——的答案，需要一种**机制性的**因果模型，而非曲线拟合；而学习这样的模型需要**实验**，因为被动数据无法识别其机制。实验成本高昂，因此核心问题在于**数据效率**。我们提出了模型发现智能体（Model Discovery Agent, MDA），它将大型语言模型（LLM）作为候选结构的**提议者**，与标准的贝叶斯工具——用于参数和结构后验的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）、用于难解似然的基于模拟的推断（SBI）以及用于实验设计的价值信息（VoI）——相结合，从而从少量干预中发现潜在的机制性世界模型。MDA在M-open设定下运行：当真实情况位于当前假设类之外时，预测性检查会标记出不足，提议者则用新模型扩展假设空间，该模型的参数随后通过设计的实验加以识别。我们表明，**发现与设计相互强化**：设计步骤识别出发现步骤所提议的机制，而被识别的机制又改善了预测，从而能够从剩余未解释的残差中实现进一步的发现。在三个不同的基准测试上——涵盖物理学（\DPbench, \citep{wiemann2026discoverphysics}）、化学（\CHEMbench, \citep{kabra2026autoscilab}）和生物学（\HHbench，我们创建的一个新的部分观测单神经元电生理学基准）——我们展示了MDA在数据高效的模型学习和可靠的干预性预测能力方面树立了新的最先进水平（SOTA）。

title: Adaptive Semantic Capacity Allocation for Parallel Generative Recommendation
abstract: Autoregressive semantic ID recommenders are constrained by expensive beam-search decoding, which limits the practical length of item identifiers. Parallel generation methods alleviate this bottleneck by predicting all semantic ID tokens simultaneously, enabling longer IDs. However, existing semantic ID methods still rely on manually predefined and homogeneous ID structures, where both the number of semantic slots and the codebook size of each slot are treated as fixed hyperparameters. This ignores the heterogeneous capacity demands of different semantic subspaces and may allocate prediction capacity to slots with limited utility. We show that uniformly expanding semantic slots can provide limited gains, indicating redundant capacity in homogeneous semantic IDs. We propose InforID, a lightweight adaptive semantic target construction framework for parallel generative recommendation. InforID allocates a fixed capacity budget across candidate semantic slots, thereby jointly determining the effective ID length and slot-specific codebook sizes. Experiments demonstrate improved recommendation accuracy under comparable capacity budgets while preserving one-step parallel prediction.
tldr: 本文提出InforID框架，通过自适应分配语义槽容量来优化并行生成推荐，在保持一步预测的同时提升推荐精度。
abstract_cn: 自回归语义ID推荐器受限于昂贵的集束搜索解码，这限制了物品标识符的实际长度。并行生成方法通过同时预测所有语义ID标记来缓解这一瓶颈，从而支持更长的ID。然而，现有的语义ID方法仍依赖于人工预定义且同质的ID结构，其中语义槽的数量及每个槽的码本大小均被视为固定超参数。这忽略了不同语义子空间在容量需求上的异质性，并可能将预测能力分配给效用有限的槽位。我们表明，均匀扩展语义槽仅能带来有限的增益，这揭示了同质语义ID中存在冗余容量。我们提出InforID，一种用于并行生成式推荐的轻量级自适应语义目标构建框架。InforID在候选语义槽之间分配固定的容量预算，从而联合确定有效的ID长度和槽特定的码本大小。实验表明，在可比较的容量预算下，InforID提升了推荐准确性，同时保持了一步并行预测的能力。

analysis.chinese_title: 并行生成式推荐的自适应语义容量分配
analysis.summary: 本文针对并行生成式推荐中语义ID结构手动预定义且同质化的问题，提出InforID框架。该框架将语义ID构建视为目标空间容量分配问题，通过贪心算法在候选语义槽间分配固定容量预算，自适应确定有效ID长度和每个槽的码本大小，移除零比特槽，保留异构语义ID。实验表明，InforID在四个数据集上优于现有方法，且保持一步并行预测效率。
innovations: 识别出语义ID推荐中手动预定义同质ID结构这一被忽视的局限。
提出InforID，一种轻量级自适应语义目标构建框架，用于并行生成式推荐。
通过自适应容量分配，联合确定有效ID长度和槽特定码本大小。
在保持并行预测优势的同时，提升推荐准确率。
analysis.methodology: 首先，利用OPQ将项目表示投影并划分为M个等大小子空间作为候选语义槽。然后，通过贪心算法分配总比特预算B，每次迭代选择边际重建损失减少最大的槽分配一个比特，直至预算耗尽。零比特槽被移除，保留槽的码本大小由分配的比特数决定。最后，使用Transformer解码器作为骨干，采用并行预测头预测各槽的语义ID，以多令牌预测损失训练，推理时以对数概率和作为评分。
analysis.key_results: 在Sports、Beauty、Toys和CDs四个数据集上，InforID在Recall@5、NDCG@5、Recall@10、NDCG@10指标上均优于或持平于基线方法，如RPG。在容量分配分析中，InforID相比PQ和OPQ取得更低的重建损失和更高的NDCG@10。预算敏感性分析显示性能随预算增加而提升但逐渐饱和。
strengths: 方法轻量且即插即用，不改变推理范式。
自适应容量分配能更好地匹配语义子空间的异构容量需求。
实验验证了方法的有效性，并进行了消融和敏感性分析。
limitations: 容量分配基于重建损失代理，可能未完全反映下游检索性能。
贪心分配可能不是全局最优。
实验仅在四个数据集上进行，泛化性有待验证。

title: Open Evaluation Agent: Efficient and Promptable Evaluation of Visual Generative Models
abstract: Recent advances in visual generative models have enabled high-quality image and video generation, but evaluating these models often demands sampling hundreds or thousands of images or videos, which is computationally expensive. Existing evaluation methods also rely on rigid pipelines that overlook specific user needs and provide numerical results without clear explanations. Mimicking how humans quickly form impressions of a model's capabilities from only a few samples, we propose the Evaluation Agent framework, which employs human-like strategies for efficient, dynamic, multi-round evaluations, offering detailed, user-tailored analyses. Given a natural-language evaluation request, the agent decomposes it into sub-aspects, generates targeted prompts, samples images or videos from the evaluated model, invokes suitable evaluation tools, and iteratively updates its plan from the observed evidence, covering both predefined benchmark dimensions and open-ended user concerns. The framework is thus efficient, promptable, explainable, and scalable across models and tools. Experiments show that Evaluation Agent reduces evaluation time to 10% of traditional methods while delivering comparable results. We further introduce Open Evaluation Agent (Open-EA) by constructing EA-CoT-10K, a corpus of history-conditioned step-level instruction-tuning records derived from multi-round evaluation rollouts, and training EA-3B from Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a local planning backbone that preserves the structured reasoning, tool invocation, and summary protocol of the API-based agent while reducing dependence on proprietary backbones. Experiments validate the API-based agent on established T2I/T2V benchmarks and open-ended queries, and evaluate Open-EA on four in-domain and three out-of-domain T2V generator families, showing partial cross-family transfer of the learned policy.
tldr: The paper proposes an Evaluation Agent framework for efficient and promptable evaluation of visual generative models, reducing evaluation time to 10% while maintaining comparable results.
abstract_cn: 视觉生成模型的最新进展使得高质量的图像和视频生成成为可能，但评估这些模型通常需要采样数百或数千张图像或视频，这在计算上代价高昂。现有的评估方法还依赖于僵化的流程，忽视了用户的具体需求，并且仅提供数值结果而缺乏清晰的解释。受人类仅通过少量样本便能快速形成对模型能力印象的方式启发，我们提出了评估代理（Evaluation Agent）框架，该框架采用类人策略进行高效、动态、多轮评估，并提供详细且针对用户需求的分析。给定一个自然语言评估请求，代理将其分解为多个子方面，生成有针对性的提示，从被评估模型中采样图像或视频，调用合适的评估工具，并根据观察到的证据迭代更新其计划，涵盖预定义的基准维度和开放式的用户关注点。该框架因此具有高效性、可提示性、可解释性，并可在模型和工具之间进行扩展。实验表明，评估代理将评估时间缩短至传统方法的10%，同时提供相当的结果。我们进一步通过构建EA-CoT-10K语料库（包含从多轮评估推演中得出的基于历史条件的逐步指令微调记录）引入了开放评估代理（Open-EA），并从Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct训练出EA-3B作为本地规划骨干模型，该模型保留了基于API代理的结构化推理、工具调用和总结协议，同时减少了对专有骨干模型的依赖。实验在已建立的T2I/T2V基准和开放式查询上验证了基于API的代理，并在四个域内和三个域外的T2V生成器家族上评估了Open-EA，显示出所学策略的部分跨家族迁移能力。

title: Hallucination-Free GUI Grounding via Regression-Free Layout-Aware Matching
abstract: GUI agents are shifting from metadata-dependent large language models to purely visual multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that operate directly on screenshots. The core task, GUI grounding, requires translating abstract user instructions into precise element coordinates. This task faces a persistent dual obstacle: conventional grounding models lack the semantic richness to interpret abstract instructions, while end-to-end MLLMs suffer from coordinate hallucinations caused by deficient fine-grained perception. We propose a regression-free framework where a frozen MLLM performs instruction parsing and a dedicated grounding model handles precise localization without learning any coordinate regression. A frozen MLLM first elaborates the abstract instruction into a structured visual description rich in layout cues. These descriptions are then fed to a novel Layout-Aware GUI Grounding Model, which performs regression-free localization by matching against layout-prior candidates, inherently suppressing hallucinations and avoiding expensive fine-tuning. The grounding model is trained with only Text/Icon binary labels, requiring no coordinate regression parameters. On ScreenSpot-Pro, our method achieves over 20% improvement in grounding accuracy over end-to-end systems; on Mind2Web, it raises success rate and element selection rate by more than 15%. These results demonstrate that decoupling instruction understanding from layout-aware localization effectively resolves the core challenges of GUI interaction.
tldr: The paper proposes a regression-free framework for GUI grounding that decouples instruction understanding from layout-aware localization, achieving significant accuracy improvements on ScreenSpot-Pro and Mind2Web.
abstract_cn: GUI代理正从依赖元数据的大型语言模型转向直接操作截图的纯视觉多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）。其核心任务——GUI接地（GUI grounding）——要求将抽象的用户指令转化为精确的元素坐标。这一任务面临持续的双重障碍：传统的接地模型缺乏解析抽象指令所需的语义丰富性，而端到端的多模态大模型则因细粒度感知不足而产生坐标幻觉。我们提出了一种免回归框架，其中冻结的MLLM负责指令解析，而专门的接地模型负责精确的定位，无需学习任何坐标回归。冻结的MLLM首先将抽象指令细化为包含丰富布局线索的结构化视觉描述。随后，这些描述被输入到一种新颖的布局感知GUI接地模型（Layout-Aware GUI Grounding Model）中，该模型通过与布局先验候选进行匹配来实现免回归定位，从本质上抑制了幻觉并避免了昂贵的微调。该接地模型仅使用文本/图标二值标签进行训练，无需任何坐标回归参数。在ScreenSpot-Pro上，我们的方法相比端到端系统在接地准确率上提升了超过20%；在Mind2Web上，其成功率和元素选择率均提高了15%以上。这些结果表明，将指令理解与布局感知定位解耦，能够有效解决GUI交互的核心挑战。

title: Predictive safety filter enhanced curriculum learning control for efficient vehicle dynamics controller
abstract: Recent advances in learning-based control have enabled impressive achievements in solving complex control problems in various domains. However, since learning-based control may not be able to realize safety-guaranties, it is of great importance to enhance safety and robustness while maintaining good performances. Take vehicle motion \& dynamics control as an example, in order to overcome the pain points of traditional methods such as heavy parameter calibration effort and learning-based control to bring better performance and efficiency in stability \& agility over prior work for state-based vehicle control tasks, in this work, our method aims to develop a curriculum learning controller enhanced with physics-based predictive safety filter. The validation is conducted with the Python-CarSim platform, demonstrating better improvements and scalability under various maneuvers.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合物理预测安全过滤器的课程学习控制器，用于提升车辆动力学控制的效率和安全性，并在Python-CarSim平台上验证了其优越性。
abstract_cn: 近年来，基于学习的控制在解决各领域复杂控制问题方面取得了显著成就。然而，由于基于学习的控制可能无法实现安全保障，因此在保持良好性能的同时增强安全性与鲁棒性显得尤为重要。以车辆运动与动力学控制为例，为克服传统方法中参数标定工作繁重等痛点，并利用基于学习的控制在前人基于状态的车辆控制任务中带来更好的性能与稳定性及敏捷性方面的效率提升，本工作旨在开发一种结合基于物理的预测性安全滤波器的课程学习控制器。验证在Python-CarSim平台上进行，展示了在各种 maneuvers（机动工况）下更好的改进效果与可扩展性。

title: Avalon-ToM-Bench: Evaluating Fine-Grained Theory of Mind via Asymmetric Game Mechanics
abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM) is essential for agent interactions, yet existing evaluations either rely on static scenarios that oversimplify mental-state reasoning or interactive settings that provide limited diagnostic insight. We present Avalon-ToM-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark that operationalizes ToM through the asymmetric-information mechanics of The Resistance: Avalon. Rather than evaluating end-to-end gameplay, it decomposes ToM into a 2$\times$2 taxonomy -- epistemic versus motivational reasoning crossed with inference versus action -- using human-crafted, perspective-constrained queries. Benchmarking 28 LLMs reveals three insights: 1) Reasoning, not knowledge. Models show strong game-rule comprehension but markedly weaker ToM abilities, isolating failures to social reasoning rather than missing domain knowledge. 2) Expression, not representation. Mechanistic analyses via linear probing and activation steering show that models frequently represent correct mental-state inferences in their hidden states but fail to express them during generation -- linear probes recover 77-82% accuracy versus 62-70% from the models' own chain-of-thought. 3) Policy, not deliberation. Dedicated reasoning training yields substantial improvements whereas test-time chain-of-thought provides only marginal gains (+11.0 versus +1.1 points on average), suggesting that robust ToM depends on a learned reasoning policy rather than increased inference-time deliberation.
tldr: The paper introduces Avalon-ToM-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating fine-grained Theory of Mind in LLMs, revealing that models often represent correct mental-state inferences but fail to express them, and that reasoning training improves ToM more than test-time deliberation.
abstract_cn: 心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）对于智能体之间的交互至关重要，然而现有评估要么依赖于将心理状态推理过度简化的静态场景，要么依赖于诊断信息有限的交互式设置。我们提出了Avalon-ToM-Bench，一个细粒度的基准测试，通过《抵抗组织：阿瓦隆》中的信息不对称机制来操作化心智理论。该基准并非评估端到端的游戏过程，而是将心智理论分解为一个2×2的分类体系——即认知推理与动机推理，分别与推断和行动交叉组合——并采用人工构建、视角受限的查询进行测试。对28个大语言模型（LLMs）的基准测试揭示了三点洞见：1）推理而非知识。模型展现出较强的游戏规则理解能力，但心智理论能力明显较弱，这将其失败归因于社会推理而非领域知识的缺失。2）表达而非表征。通过线性探针和激活引导进行的机制分析表明，模型经常在其隐藏状态中表征出正确的心理状态推断，但在生成过程中未能将其表达出来——线性探针的准确率达到77-82%，而模型自身思维链的准确率仅为62-70%。3）策略而非深思。专门的推理训练带来了显著提升，而测试时的思维链仅带来边际增益（平均提升+11.0分对+1.1分），这表明稳健的心智理论依赖于习得的推理策略，而非增加推理时的深思熟虑。

title: DUET: A Diversity-Quality Duet of Distillation Experts for Two-Step Video Generation
abstract: Diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation in recent years, but the high cost of iterative sampling hinders their practical deployment. Few-step distillation alleviates this cost, yet exposes a quality--diversity trade-off between its two dominant paradigms: trajectory-level distillation (e.g., sCM) favors diversity, whereas distribution-level distillation (e.g., DMD) favors quality. Targeting extreme two-step video generation, we introduce DUET, which reconciles the two paradigms through a noise-level duet of experts: an sCM expert takes the high-noise step to lay out diverse structure, and a DMD expert takes the low-noise step to refine appearance detail. Since the two experts are trained independently with their native objectives, DUET sidesteps the optimization difficulties of loss-level combinations and delivers quality and diversity jointly rather than trading one for the other. We further identify the relay interface and the high-noise stage as the remaining bottlenecks, and address them with RL-guided expert adaptation, yielding DUET+. With the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, DUET lifts the two-step quality of sCM close to the level of DMD while retaining nearly all of its structural diversity---about twice that of DMD---and DUET+ further improves overall quality while preserving this diversity advantage. Together, these results establish noise-level expert specialization as a simple, effective paradigm for reconciling diversity and quality in two-step video generation.
tldr: 该论文提出DUET方法，通过噪声级专家分工（sCM和DMD）在两步视频生成中同时提升质量和多样性，并利用RL引导的专家适应进一步优化。
abstract_cn: 扩散模型近年来已实现高质量的视频生成，但迭代采样的高昂成本阻碍了其实际部署。少步蒸馏缓解了这一成本，却在其两种主导范式之间暴露了质量与多样性之间的权衡：轨迹级蒸馏（如sCM）偏向多样性，而分布级蒸馏（如DMD）偏向质量。针对极端的二步视频生成，我们引入了DUET，通过噪声级别的专家二重奏来调和这两种范式：sCM专家负责高噪声步骤以铺陈多样化的结构，DMD专家负责低噪声步骤以细化外观细节。由于两位专家以各自原生目标独立训练，DUET规避了损失级组合的优化难题，同时实现质量与多样性，而非以牺牲一方换取另一方。我们进一步识别出中继接口和高噪声阶段为剩余瓶颈，并通过基于强化学习的专家适配加以解决，从而得到DUET+。以Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B为骨干网络，DUET将sCM的二步质量提升至接近DMD的水平，同时保留了其几乎全部的结构多样性——约为DMD的两倍——而DUET+在保持这一多样性优势的同时进一步提升了整体质量。综合来看，这些结果确立了噪声级专家特化作为一种简单有效的范式，用于调和二步视频生成中的多样性与质量。

title: NeuroRefiner: Morphology-Aware Multi-Agent Refinement for 3D Fluorescence Microscopy Neuron Segmentation
abstract: Accurate 3D neuron segmentation in fluorescence microscopy is critical for neuroscience. However, the sparse and elongated morphology of neurons poses significant challenges to existing segmentation methods. These methods struggle to preserve both local details and global topology, leading to fragmented results. To address this, we propose NeuroRefiner, a multi-agent system that formalizes the human expert workflow involving iterative global observation and local editing. Specifically, NeuroRefiner comprises three collaborative agents dedicated to diagnosing topological errors, generating correction instructions, and validating refinement quality. To facilitate agent instruction-guided segmentation refinement, we propose TopoRefineNet, a dedicated 3D U-Net-based tool that leverages cross-modality feature fusion to generate refined masks. Through multi-round agent reasoning and voxel-level editing, NeuroRefiner produces topologically more accurate segmentations with enhanced interpretability. Experiments on the BigNeuron, CWMBS, and ZBFWB datasets demonstrate that NeuroRefiner outperforms state-of-the-art methods, notably achieving a 3.02% improvement in F1 score on the challenging ZBFWB dataset.
tldr: The paper proposes NeuroRefiner, a multi-agent system for morphology-aware refinement of 3D neuron segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmark datasets.
abstract_cn: 荧光显微镜中神经元的三维精确分割对神经科学研究至关重要。然而，神经元稀疏且细长的形态对现有分割方法构成了重大挑战，这些方法难以同时保留局部细节和全局拓扑结构，导致分割结果碎片化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了NeuroRefiner，一个多智能体系统，将人类专家涉及迭代全局观察与局部编辑的工作流程形式化。具体而言，NeuroRefiner包含三个协作智能体，分别负责诊断拓扑错误、生成修正指令以及验证细化质量。为促进基于指令引导的分割细化，我们提出了TopoRefineNet，一种专用的基于3D U-Net的工具，利用跨模态特征融合生成细化掩膜。通过多轮智能体推理和体素级编辑，NeuroRefiner生成了拓扑上更准确且可解释性更强的分割结果。在BigNeuron、CWMBS和ZBFWB数据集上的实验表明，NeuroRefiner优于现有最先进方法，尤其在具有挑战性的ZBFWB数据集上，F1分数显著提升了3.02%。

title: Rethinking Self-Evolving Agents: Do We Still Need Prescribed Optimization Pipelines?
abstract: Self-evolving agents are usually built around prescribed optimization pipelines: the framework decides how to gather evidence, revise a persistent artifact, select candidates, and stop. We ask whether this task-specific procedure remains necessary when a frontier model acts as the optimizer. We introduce Open-Ended Optimization (OEO), which keeps the objective, permitted interactions, resource budget, data boundary, and evaluation fixed while allowing the optimizer to compose the improvement process online. We compare OEO with two complementary prescribed approaches: SkillOpt, a staged pipeline with bounded edits, and GEPA, a reflective evolutionary search. Across 14 head-to-head comparisons over 8 benchmark-target-model settings, GPT-5.5-driven OEO records 12 wins, 1 tie, and 1 narrow loss of 0.21 percentage points. It uses a median 34.3 percent of SkillOpt's configured target-interaction token budget. A one-shot, zero-interaction control shows that the gains are not explained by a single prior-driven rewrite. However, delegation has a capability boundary: SkillOpt outperforms OEO with a medium optimizer, and a weak optimizer cannot operate through the unchanged OEO interface. In the fully instrumented OEO-SkillOpt pair, trajectory analysis further shows that prescription changes how optimization proceeds more consistently than it changes final behavior. Together, these findings recast prescribed pipelines as capability-dependent scaffolding: essential constraints remain external, but a sufficiently capable optimizer can compose the route from measurable feedback to persistent improvement.
tldr: The paper proposes Open-Ended Optimization (OEO) to let a frontier model compose its own improvement process, showing that it outperforms prescribed pipelines with a capable optimizer, but the approach is not related to recommendation systems.
abstract_cn: 自进化智能体通常围绕预设的优化流程构建：该框架决定如何收集证据、修订持久化工件、选择候选方案以及何时停止。我们探究当前沿模型作为优化器时，这种任务特定的流程是否仍然必要。我们引入了开放式优化（Open-Ended Optimization, OEO），它保持目标、允许的交互、资源预算、数据边界和评估固定不变，同时允许优化器在线组合改进过程。我们将OEO与两种互补的预设方法进行比较：SkillOpt（一种具有受限编辑的分阶段流程）和GEPA（一种反思性进化搜索）。在8个基准-目标-模型设置下的14项头对头比较中，由GPT-5.5驱动的OEO取得了12胜、1平、1次以0.21个百分点微弱落败的成绩。它使用的目标交互令牌预算中位数为SkillOpt配置预算的34.3%。一次性、零交互的对照实验表明，这些收益并非由单一的、基于先验的重写所解释。然而，委派存在能力边界：SkillOpt在中等优化器下优于OEO，而弱优化器无法通过不变的OEO接口运作。在完全仪器化的OEO-SkillOpt配对中，轨迹分析进一步表明，预设改变优化过程的方式比改变最终行为的方式更为一致。综合来看，这些发现将预设流程重新定义为依赖能力的脚手架：必要的约束仍然外部化，但足够强大的优化器能够从可测量的反馈中组合出通往持久改进的路径。

title: PragMatch: Separating Pragmatic Incongruity from Cross-Modal Mismatch in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on multimodal benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they genuinely reason about relationships between images and text or rely on superficial correlations, known as shortcut learning. This question is particularly important for multimodal sarcasm detection, where successful prediction depends on recognizing pragmatic incongruity rather than treating sarcasm as simple image-text mismatch. We introduce PragMatch, a controlled benchmark of 3,000 image-text pairs derived from MMSD2.0, including original sarcastic examples and constructed literal and hard-negative pairs. We identify influential shortcut cues through systematic masking and evaluate their impact through targeted injection experiments. Our results show that LVLM predictions are sensitive to lexical, OCR-derived and stylistic cues, with injected surface signals causing substantial changes in model predictions despite unchanged underlying image-text relationships. Our findings reveal limitations in current LVLMs while PragMatch provides a systematic testbed for evaluating multimodal pragmatic reasoning beyond surface-level image-text alignment.
tldr: The paper introduces PragMatch, a benchmark to evaluate LVLMs' pragmatic reasoning in multimodal sarcasm detection, revealing that models rely on superficial cues rather than genuine understanding.
abstract_cn: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态基准测试中展现出强劲性能，然而它们是否真正理解图像与文本之间的关系，抑或依赖于表面相关性（即所谓的捷径学习），仍不明确。这一问题对于多模态讽刺检测尤为重要，因为成功的预测依赖于识别语用上的不协调，而非将讽刺简单视为图像与文本的不匹配。我们提出了PragMatch，一个基于MMSD2.0构建的受控基准数据集，包含3,000个图像-文本对，涵盖原始讽刺样本以及构造的字面配对和困难负样本。我们通过系统性掩码识别出关键的捷径线索，并通过定向注入实验评估其影响。结果表明，LVLMs的预测对词汇、OCR提取及风格化线索高度敏感，注入的表面信号在图像-文本底层关系不变的情况下，仍能显著改变模型预测。我们的发现揭示了当前LVLMs的局限性，同时PragMatch为评估超越表面图像-文本对齐的多模态语用推理提供了系统性测试平台。

title: Structured Phonological Representations for Audio-Articulatory rtMRI Speech Classification
abstract: Real-time MRI makes it possible to observe vocal-tract articulation during speech, but mapping these articulatory patterns to phonetic and phonological categories remains challenging. We investigate whether PhonoQ, an audio-based model trained to recognize structured phonological features, provides useful information for audio--articulatory modeling. Specifically, we extract representations from PhonoQ's Conformer module, whose training is shaped by supervision for manner, place, voicing, and vowel features. Using articulatory contours with synchronized audio-derived features, we compare WavLM-large and HuBERT-large baselines with models that incorporate PhonoQ-derived representations. Across unseen-speech and unseen-subject settings, these features improve macro-F1 for phonological targets including manner, place, voicing, vowel height, and vowel backness, and also improve fine-grained 39-phoneme classification. In a contour-only inference setting, audio-derived teacher supervision yields modest but consistent gains over contour-only training, indicating that phonological information from synchronized audio can be partially transferred to articulatory models. Finally, posterior analyses show interpretable surface-sensitive patterns consistent with flapping-like /t/ realizations, /t/-/r/ retraction or affrication, and nasal place assimilation.
tldr: The paper investigates whether phonological features from an audio-based model (PhonoQ) can improve audio-articulatory modeling for speech classification, showing consistent gains in phonological and phoneme classification.
abstract_cn: 实时MRI使得在语音过程中观察声道发音成为可能，但将这些发音模式映射到语音学和音系学类别中仍具挑战性。我们探讨了PhonoQ——一个基于音频训练的、用于识别结构化音系特征的模型——是否为音频-发音建模提供了有用信息。具体而言，我们提取了PhonoQ的Conformer模块中的表征，该模块的训练受到发音方式（manner）、发音部位（place）、清浊（voicing）及元音特征监督的影响。利用发音轮廓（articulatory contours）与同步的音频派生特征，我们将WavLM-large和HuBERT-large基线模型与纳入PhonoQ派生表征的模型进行了比较。在未见语音和未见受试者两种设置下，这些特征改善了音系目标的宏F1分数，包括发音方式、发音部位、清浊、元音高度和元音后位性，并同时改善了细粒度的39音素分类。在仅轮廓推断设置中，音频派生的教师监督相较于仅轮廓训练带来了适度但一致的提升，表明来自同步音频的音系信息可以部分迁移至发音模型。最后，后验分析显示了可解释的、对表层敏感的语音模式，与闪音化（flapping-like）/t/实现、/t/-/r/后移或塞擦化，以及鼻音部位同化现象一致。

title: REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies
abstract: Audio Description (AD) is a verbal narration of key visual content in videos, enabling access for visually impaired audiences. Unlike standard video captioning, AD is a structured editorial task: descriptions must be inserted into gaps in dialogue and must convey only what is needed to understand the narrative being told. However, existing approaches formulate AD generation in an artificial setting where both the content and timing of descriptions are pre-specified, reducing the task to clip-level captioning. They further rely on noisy transcription and alignment pipelines, and lack the rich parallel data required for modeling narrative context. We introduce a new formulation of AD generation in which models must jointly decide what to describe and when to do it. To support this, we present REFRAMED, a high-quality dataset of 2,023 videos that span 3,302 scenes from 206 movies, with professional AD transcripts (both American and British versions), professional subtitles and aligned screenplays. We also provide a manually curated challenge set that pairs full movies with multiple AD references, together with evaluation protocols that leverage dialogue gaps and multi-reference comparisons. Experiments with state-of-the-art AD systems and multimodal LLMs show that they outperform trivial baselines but fall far short of expert human performance. Our dataset and benchmark establish a new foundation for research on video understanding.
tldr: The paper introduces REFRAMED, a new dataset and benchmark for realistic audio description generation in movies, where models must decide what to describe and when, and shows that current systems fall short of human performance.
abstract_cn: 音频描述（AD）是对视频中关键视觉内容的语言叙述，使视障观众能够获取信息。与标准视频字幕生成不同，音频描述是一项结构化的编辑任务：描述必须插入对话间隙中，且只能传达理解叙事所需的内容。然而，现有方法在一种人为设定的环境中进行音频描述生成，其中描述的内容和时间均已预先指定，将任务简化为片段级字幕生成。这些方法还依赖于有噪声的转录和对齐流程，并且缺乏建模叙事语境所需的丰富平行数据。我们提出了一种新的音频描述生成框架，其中模型必须联合决定描述什么以及何时描述。为支持这一框架，我们推出了REFRAMED，一个包含206部电影中3,302个场景的2,023个视频的高质量数据集，配有专业音频描述文本（包括美国版和英国版）、专业字幕以及对齐的剧本。我们还提供了一个人工策划的挑战集，将完整电影与多个音频描述参考配对，并提供了利用对话间隙和多参考比较的评估协议。与最先进的音频描述系统和多模态大语言模型的实验表明，它们优于简单基线，但远未达到人类专家的表现。我们的数据集和基准为视频理解研究奠定了新的基础。

title: VeriForge: Mitigating Latent Knowledge Gaps in Narrative Drafting via Mixed-Initiative Scaffolding
abstract: Great fiction earns its verisimilitude through precise details, from how a longsword is gripped to pierce armor gaps to why a bleeding corpse cannot yet smell of decay, weaving domain expertise into the fabric of invented worlds. Current AI writing tools offer limited support for discovering and integrating unfamiliar domain knowledge into narrative. They require explicit queries that authors cannot formulate, generate finished prose that risks homogenizing voice, or assist only within the boundaries of what authors already know. We argue that AI should reveal latent knowledge gaps to writers while preserving their agency to transform discovered knowledge into authentic prose. Grounded in formative interviews with 9 fiction writers, we present VeriForge, a mixed-initiative writing system that divides cognitive labor so that the system assumes initiative over domain discovery while the author retains full initiative over narrative synthesis. VeriForge realizes this through three complementary mechanisms. Proactive inline highlighting flags potential knowledge gaps as authors draft. Dual-stream querying pairs conversational responses with source-anchored Knowledge Cards for direct fact extraction. A spatial Knowledge Canvas allows authors to organize and connect discovered knowledge across their writing. These mechanisms are powered by a graph-based retrieval-augmented generation pipeline grounded in domain-specific source materials. A within-subjects user study (N=12) provides preliminary evidence that this paradigm helps authors recognize previously overlooked knowledge gaps, supports creative exploration, and is perceived by expert raters to produce passages with stronger domain grounding in a controlled cold-start writing task.
tldr: This paper presents VeriForge, a mixed-initiative writing system that helps fiction writers discover and integrate unfamiliar domain knowledge by proactively highlighting knowledge gaps and providing source-anchored information, with a user study showing improved recognition of knowledge gaps and stronger domain grounding.
abstract_cn: 伟大的小说通过精确的细节获得其逼真性，从长剑如何握持以刺穿盔甲缝隙，到为何流血的尸体尚不能散发腐烂气味，将领域专业知识编织进虚构世界的肌理之中。当前的AI写作工具在发现并将陌生领域知识整合进叙事方面提供的支持十分有限。它们需要作者无法提出的明确查询，生成可能使声音同质化的成品散文，或仅在作者已知的边界内提供辅助。我们认为，AI应当向作者揭示潜在的知识空白，同时保留作者将所发现的知识转化为真实可信散文的自主权。基于对9位小说作家的形成性访谈，我们提出了VeriForge，一个混合主动式写作系统，它划分认知劳动，使系统在领域发现方面承担主动，而作者在叙事综合方面保留完全主动。VeriForge通过三种互补机制实现这一目标。主动式行内高亮在作者起草时标记潜在的知识空白。双流查询将对话式回应与基于来源的知识卡片配对，以支持直接的事实提取。空间化知识画布允许作者在其写作中组织并连接所发现的知识。这些机制由基于图的检索增强生成流水线驱动，该流水线以领域特定的源材料为基础。一项受试者内用户研究（N=12）提供了初步证据，表明这一范式能帮助作者识别先前被忽视的知识空白，支持创造性探索，并被专家评分者认为在受控冷启动写作任务中能产生领域根基更强的段落。

title: Modeling User Activity Preference by Leveraging User Spatial Temporal Characteristics in LBSNs
abstract: With the recent surge of location based social networks (LBSNs), activity data of millions of users has become attainable. This data contains not only spatial and temporal stamps of user activity, but also its semantic information. LBSNs can help to understand mobile users' spatial temporal activity preference (STAP), which can enable a wide range of ubiquitous applications, such as personalized context-aware location recommendation and group-oriented advertisement. However, modeling such user-specific STAP needs to tackle high-dimensional data, i.e., user-location-time-activity quadruples, which is complicated and usually suffers from a data sparsity problem. In order to address this problem, we propose a STAP model. It first models the spatial and temporal activity preference separately, and then uses a principle way to combine them for preference inference. In order to characterize the impact of spatial features on user activity preference, we propose the notion of personal functional region and related parameters to model and infer user spatial activity preference. In order to model the user temporal activity preference with sparse user activity data in LBSNs, we propose to exploit the temporal activity similarity among different users and apply nonnegative tensor factorization to collaboratively infer temporal activity preference. Finally, we put forward a context-aware fusion framework to combine the spatial and temporal activity preference models for preference inference. We evaluate our proposed approach on three real-world datasets collected from New York and Tokyo, and show that our STAP model consistently outperforms the baseline approaches in various settings.
journal: IEEE Transactions on Systems Man and Cybernetics Systems

abstract_cn: 随着基于位置的社交网络（LBSNs）的迅猛发展，数百万用户的日常活动数据已变得易于获取。这些数据不仅包含用户活动的时空标记，还蕴含了其语义信息。LBSNs有助于理解移动用户的时空活动偏好（STAP），进而支持一系列泛在应用，如个性化情境感知的位置推荐和面向群体的广告投放。然而，建模这种用户特定的STAP需要处理高维数据，即用户-位置-时间-活动四元组，这既复杂又常常面临数据稀疏性问题。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种STAP模型。该模型首先分别对空间活动偏好和时间活动偏好进行建模，然后采用一种原则性的方法将两者结合以进行偏好推断。为了刻画空间特征对用户活动偏好的影响，我们提出了个人功能区域的概念及相关参数，用以建模和推断用户的空间活动偏好。为了在LBSNs中利用稀疏的用户活动数据建模用户的时间活动偏好，我们提出利用不同用户间的时间活动相似性，并应用非负张量分解来协同推断时间活动偏好。最后，我们提出一个情境感知的融合框架，将空间与时间活动偏好模型结合以进行偏好推断。我们在从纽约和东京收集的三个真实世界数据集上评估了所提出的方法，结果表明我们的STAP模型在各种设置下均优于基线方法。

title: Cumulated gain-based evaluation of IR techniques
abstract: Modern large retrieval environments tend to overwhelm their users by their large output. Since all documents are not of equal relevance to their users, highly relevant documents should be identified and ranked first for presentation. In order to develop IR techniques in this direction, it is necessary to develop evaluation approaches and methods that credit IR methods for their ability to retrieve highly relevant documents. This can be done by extending traditional evaluation methods, that is, recall and precision based on binary relevance judgments, to graded relevance judgments. Alternatively, novel measures based on graded relevance judgments may be developed. This article proposes several novel measures that compute the cumulative gain the user obtains by examining the retrieval result up to a given ranked position. The first one accumulates the relevance scores of retrieved documents along the ranked result list. The second one is similar but applies a discount factor to the relevance scores in order to devaluate late-retrieved documents. The third one computes the relative-to-the-ideal performance of IR techniques, based on the cumulative gain they are able to yield. These novel measures are defined and discussed and their use is demonstrated in a case study using TREC data: sample system run results for 20 queries in TREC-7. As a relevance base we used novel graded relevance judgments on a four-point scale. The test results indicate that the proposed measures credit IR methods for their ability to retrieve highly relevant documents and allow testing of statistical significance of effectiveness differences. The graphs based on the measures also provide insight into the performance IR techniques and allow interpretation, for example, from the user point of view.

tldr: 该论文提出了基于累积增益的评估指标（CG、DCG、NDCG），用于在分级相关性判断下评估信息检索系统的排序效果，实验表明这些指标能有效反映系统检索高度相关文档的能力。
abstract_cn: 现代大型检索环境往往因其庞大的输出量使用户感到不知所措。由于所有文档对用户的相关性并不相同，因此应识别出高度相关的文档并将其排在首位进行展示。为了朝这一方向发展信息检索（IR）技术，有必要开发能够对信息检索方法检索高度相关文档的能力予以肯定的评估途径与方法。这可以通过将基于二元相关性判断的传统评估方法（即召回率和精确率）扩展到分级相关性判断来实现。或者，也可以开发基于分级相关性判断的新型度量方法。本文提出了几种新型度量方法，用于计算用户在检查检索结果至给定排序位置时所获得的累积增益。第一种方法沿排序结果列表累积所检索文档的相关性得分。第二种方法类似，但对相关性得分应用折扣因子，以降低后期检索文档的价值。第三种方法基于信息检索技术能够产生的累积增益，计算其相对于理想性能的表现。本文对这些新型度量方法进行了定义和讨论，并通过使用TREC数据的案例研究展示了其应用：针对TREC-7中20个查询的系统运行结果样本。作为相关性基础，我们采用了四级量表的新型分级相关性判断。测试结果表明，所提出的度量方法能够肯定信息检索方法在检索高度相关文档方面的能力，并允许对有效性差异进行统计显著性检验。基于这些度量方法绘制的图表还能深入揭示信息检索技术的性能，并允许从用户角度等进行解读。

title: Personalized point-of-interest recommendation by mining users' preference transition
abstract: Location-based social networks (LBSNs) offer researchers rich data to study people's online activities and mobility patterns. One important application of such studies is to provide personalized point-of-interest (POI) recommendations to enhance user experience in LBSNs. Previous solutions directly predict users' preference on locations but fail to provide insights about users' preference transitions among locations. In this work, we propose a novel category-aware POI recommendation model, which exploits the transition patterns of users' preference over location categories to improve location recommendation accuracy. Our approach consists of two stages: (1) preference transition (over location categories) prediction, and (2) category-aware POI recommendation. Matrix factorization is employed to predict a user's preference transitions over categories and then her preference on locations in the corresponding categories. Real data based experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art POI recommendation models by at least 39.75% in terms of recall.
journal: Proceedings of the 22nd ACM international conference on Information & Knowledge Management

abstract_cn: 基于位置的社会网络（LBSNs）为研究人员提供了丰富的数据，用以研究人们的在线活动与移动模式。此类研究的一项重要应用是提供个性化的兴趣点（POI）推荐，以增强LBSNs中的用户体验。以往的方法直接预测用户对位置的偏好，但未能揭示用户在不同位置之间的偏好转移规律。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的类别感知兴趣点推荐模型，该模型利用用户对位置类别的偏好转移模式来提高位置推荐的准确性。我们的方法包含两个阶段：（1）偏好转移（跨位置类别）预测，以及（2）类别感知的兴趣点推荐。采用矩阵分解来预测用户对类别的偏好转移，进而预测其对相应类别内位置的偏好。基于真实数据的实验表明，在召回率方面，我们的方法比现有最先进的兴趣点推荐模型至少提高了39.75%。

title: Are We Really Making Progress in Group Recommendation? Unmasking the Tie-Breaking Illusion
abstract: Recent group recommendation methods have reported strong improvements on standard benchmarks, but it remains unclear whether these gains always reflect genuine advances in modeling group preferences. In this paper, we show that several recent methods are affected by a systematic evaluation bias caused by the interaction between training-time score compression and evaluation-time deterministic tie-breaking. Specifically, an additional sigmoid transformation before the BPR objective can greatly increase tied top scores, making top-K metrics such as HR@K and NDCG@K highly sensitive to how ties are resolved. We revisit recent representative methods and their baselines on CAMRa2011 and Mafengwo under both group and user recommendation settings, and evaluate them with a tie-aware protocol that computes the exact expectation of HR@K and NDCG@K under uniform random tie-breaking. Our results show that many previously reported improvements shrink substantially under tie-aware evaluation, and the relative ranking of methods can change markedly. We further show that the additional sigmoid may act as implicit margin smoothing during optimization, and that temperature-scaled BPR can retain much of this benefit without inducing severe tie inflation. Overall, our findings highlight the importance of tie-aware evaluation for establishing reliable progress in group recommendation. The code is available at https://github.com/songduoma/TieAwareGroupRec.
tldr: 该论文揭示了群组推荐中因训练时分数压缩和评估时确定性平局打破导致的系统性评估偏差，并提出平局感知评估协议，发现许多先前报告的改进在平局感知评估下大幅缩水。
abstract_cn: 近期群体推荐方法在标准基准测试上取得了显著提升，但这些提升是否总是真实反映了群体偏好建模的实质性进展，目前仍不明确。本文表明，若干近期方法受到一种系统性评估偏差的影响，该偏差源于训练阶段分数压缩与评估阶段确定性平局打破之间的相互作用。具体而言，在BPR目标之前额外施加sigmoid变换会大幅增加并列最高分的数量，使得HR@K和NDCG@K等top-K指标对平局处理方式高度敏感。我们重新审视了近期代表性方法及其基线方法，在CAMRa2011和Mafengwo数据集上，分别针对群体推荐和用户推荐设置，采用平局感知评估协议进行评测，该协议在均匀随机平局打破假设下计算HR@K和NDCG@K的精确期望值。结果表明，许多先前报告的提升在平局感知评估下显著缩减，且方法的相对排名可能发生明显变化。我们进一步表明，额外的sigmoid可能在优化过程中起到隐式边际平滑的作用，而温度缩放BPR可以在不引发严重平局膨胀的情况下保留大部分该益处。总体而言，我们的发现强调了平局感知评估对于确立群体推荐领域可靠进展的重要性。代码可在 https://github.com/songduoma/TieAwareGroupRec 获取。

analysis.chinese_title: 我们在群体推荐方面真的取得进展了吗？揭开平局打破的幻象
analysis.summary: 本文揭示了近期群体推荐方法中存在的系统性评估偏差，该偏差源于训练时的分数压缩与评估时的确定性平局打破之间的交互作用。具体而言，在BPR目标前额外应用sigmoid变换会显著增加最高分平局，使得HR@K和NDCG@K等top-K指标对平局处理方式高度敏感。作者提出了平局感知评估协议，在均匀随机平局打破下计算指标的精确期望，并在CAMRa2011和Mafengwo数据集上对多种近期方法及基线进行了重评估。结果显示，许多先前报告的改进在平局感知评估下大幅缩水，方法排名也可能发生显著变化。此外，作者发现额外的sigmoid可能起到隐式边际平滑的作用，而温度缩放BPR可以在不引起严重平局膨胀的情况下保留大部分益处。研究强调了平局感知评估对于可靠评估群体推荐进展的重要性。
innovations: 揭示了群体推荐中因分数压缩与确定性平局打破交互导致的系统性评估偏差。
提出了平局感知评估协议，计算HR@K和NDCG@K在均匀随机平局打破下的精确期望。
通过受控重评估，证明许多近期方法的改进在平局感知评估下大幅缩水，且方法排名可能改变。
将BPR前的额外sigmoid解释为隐式边际平滑，并探索温度缩放BPR作为替代方案。
analysis.methodology: 本文采用理论分析和实证重评估相结合的方法。首先定义平局感知指标，然后复现多种近期群体推荐方法及其基线，在原始评估协议和平局感知协议下比较结果。通过统计最高分平局大小、频率等指标，分析评估偏差与平局的关系。最后，通过去除额外sigmoid或使用温度缩放BPR进行修正实验，验证假设。
analysis.key_results: 原始评估协议会高估性能，且高估程度与最高分平局大小正相关。例如，DHMAE在CAMRa2011群体推荐任务中HR@1从0.9782降至0.0002（-99.98%）。去除额外sigmoid后，许多受影响方法的平局感知性能提升，但基线仍具竞争力，近期方法不再具有一致优势。
strengths: 揭示了评估协议中一个被忽视但影响重大的问题，具有方法论贡献。
提出了平局感知评估协议，为可靠评估提供了工具。
通过大量实验验证了偏差的存在和影响，结果具有说服力。
提供了代码，便于复现和进一步研究。
limitations: 主要关注特定方法族（使用额外sigmoid的方法），可能不适用于所有群体推荐方法。
平局感知评估假设均匀随机平局打破，实际中可能并非如此。
修正实验仅去除额外sigmoid，未考虑其他潜在实现差异。
未提供所有实验的详细超参数设置，可能影响可复现性。
analysis.relevance_to_keywords: 本文与关键词“推荐系统”、“群体推荐”、“评估协议”、“平局打破”、“排名指标”高度相关。它直接针对群体推荐评估中的偏差问题，提出了新的评估方法，对推荐系统的可靠评估具有重要参考价值。

title: Role of Personality in Conversational Information Seeking
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for information seeking, where users find, compare, and evaluate information through dialogue. In this role, the assistant does more than retrieve or generate content: it shapes how users articulate constraints, ask follow-up questions, verify claims, and decide when an answer is sufficient for action. Yet little is known about how user personality, assistant personality, and task context jointly influence these interactions. We examine personality as a controllable variable in conversational information seeking and study its effects on user behaviour and interaction quality. We conducted a controlled within-subject study in which assistant personality and task type were experimentally varied, while participant personality was measured using Big Five scores. Twenty-six participants each completed three information-seeking tasks under three assistant personality conditions: extraverted, conscientious, and neutral. Tasks covered exploratory travel planning, comparative smartphone shopping, and verification-sensitive health and diet information seeking. Data included conversation logs, behavioural traces, post-interaction questionnaires, an exit questionnaire, and Big Five measures. The assistant conditions were behaviourally distinct: the extraverted assistant produced longer turns, the conscientious assistant elicited higher user word share and more turns, and the neutral baseline fell between them. The strongest effect was a task-by-assistant interaction on trust and delegation, with preferred styles varying by task. No global winner emerged, but participants strongly preferred style choice or adaptation. These findings position assistant personality as a context-sensitive interactional design variable rather than a globally optimisable system property.
tldr: 该论文通过受控实验研究助手人格和任务类型如何影响对话式信息寻求中的用户行为和交互质量，发现人格是情境敏感的设计变量而非全局最优属性。
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用于信息寻求场景，用户通过对话来查找、比较和评估信息。在这一角色中，助手不仅仅检索或生成内容，它还塑造了用户如何表达约束条件、提出后续问题、核实主张，以及判断何时答案已足以支持行动。然而，关于用户个性、助手个性以及任务情境如何共同影响这些交互，目前仍知之甚少。我们将个性视为对话式信息寻求中的一个可控变量，并研究其对用户行为和交互质量的影响。我们开展了一项受控的受试者内研究，其中助手个性和任务类型被实验性地变化，而参与者个性则通过大五人格评分进行测量。二十六名参与者分别在三种助手个性条件下完成了三项信息寻求任务：外向型、尽责型和中性型。任务涵盖探索性旅行规划、对比性智能手机购物，以及对验证敏感的健康与饮食信息寻求。数据包括对话日志、行为痕迹、交互后问卷、退出问卷以及大五人格测量结果。助手条件在行为上具有显著差异：外向型助手产生更长的对话轮次，尽责型助手引发更高的用户词占比和更多的对话轮次，而中性基线则介于两者之间。最强的效应是任务与助手之间的交互作用对信任和委托的影响，不同任务所偏好的风格各不相同。没有出现全局最优的助手风格，但参与者强烈偏好风格选择或自适应调整。这些发现将助手个性定位为一种情境敏感的交互设计变量，而非可全局优化的系统属性。

title: Multi-Level Evidence Aggregation for Robust Facial Phenotype Retrieval in Rare Genetic Disorder Prioritization
abstract:
AI-assisted facial phenotyping supports rare genetic disorder prioritization by retrieving visually similar diagnosed cases from facial image reference databases such as the GestaltMatcher Database (GMDB). Existing GestaltMatcher-based retrieval frameworks compare each test image with individual gallery images in a facial phenotype embedding space. However, this pointwise formulation does not fully exploit available evidence, because patients may have multiple images and disorders may be represented by multiple diagnosed gallery patients.
  We propose an inference-time multi-level evidence aggregation framework that improves facial phenotype retrieval without modifying the underlying GestaltMatcher-Arc encoder. The framework combines embedding-level patient aggregation of multiple images from the same individual, patient-weighted disorder centroids, and hybrid individual-centroid scoring to integrate test-patient observations, disorder-level gallery evidence, and local nearest-neighbor evidence.
  We evaluated the approach on GMDB v1.1.4 across disorders represented during training (GMDB-Freq), unseen disorders (GMDB-Rare), and multi-image patient subsets, using a unified gallery containing both GMDB-Freq and GMDB-Rare disorders. Multi-level evidence aggregation improved mean per-disorder top-$N$ retrieval accuracy across all evaluation subsets. Top-1 accuracy increased from 38.52% to 48.82% on GMDB-Freq and from 19.38% to 23.79% on GMDB-Rare. On multi-image subsets, top-1 accuracy increased from 46.12% to 60.94% on GMDB-Multi-Freq and from 18.54% to 26.71% on GMDB-Multi-Rare.
  These findings show that inference-time aggregation can improve next-generation facial phenotype retrieval without retraining the encoder, supporting a shift from isolated single-image matching toward multi-level aggregation of patient and disorder evidence for rare-disorder prioritization.
tldr: The paper proposes a multi-level evidence aggregation framework to improve facial phenotype retrieval for rare genetic disorder prioritization, achieving significant accuracy gains without retraining the encoder.
abstract_cn:
AI辅助的面部表型分析通过从面部图像参考数据库（如GestaltMatcher数据库，GMDB）中检索视觉上相似的已诊断病例，支持罕见遗传病的优先级排序。现有的基于GestaltMatcher的检索框架在面部表型嵌入空间中将每张测试图像与单个图库图像进行逐一比较。然而，这种逐点式表述未能充分利用现有证据，因为患者可能拥有多张图像，而疾病可能由多位已诊断的图库患者代表。

我们提出了一种推理时的多层级证据聚合框架，在不修改底层GestaltMatcher-Arc编码器的情况下改进面部表型检索。该框架结合了同一患者多张图像的嵌入级患者聚合、患者加权疾病质心，以及混合个体-质心评分，以整合测试患者观测、疾病级图库证据和局部最近邻证据。

我们在GMDB v1.1.4上评估了该方法，涵盖训练期间出现的疾病（GMDB-Freq）、未见过的疾病（GMDB-Rare）以及多图像患者子集，使用包含GMDB-Freq和GMDB-Rare疾病的统一图库。多层级证据聚合在所有评估子集上均提高了每种疾病的平均前$N$检索准确率。在GMDB-Freq上，Top-1准确率从38.52%提升至48.82%；在GMDB-Rare上，从19.38%提升至23.79%。在多图像子集上，GMDB-Multi-Freq的Top-1准确率从46.12%提升至60.94%，GMDB-Multi-Rare的Top-1准确率从18.54%提升至26.71%。

这些发现表明，推理时的聚合可以在不重新训练编码器的情况下改进下一代面部表型检索，支持从孤立的单图像匹配向患者与疾病证据的多层级聚合转变，以用于罕见病的优先级排序。

title: ConVAWG: A Retrieval-Grounded Framework for Controlled Synthetic Dialogue Generation in Violence Against Women and Girls
abstract: Synthetic dialogue generation offers a way to study conversational dynamics in sensitive domains where real data are difficult to access, release, or annotate. The underlying abuse may occur online or offline: threats and coercion can appear directly in messages, while behaviours such as surveillance, isolation, stalking, and physical violence may be planned, disclosed, or referred to conversationally. Privacy and legal constraints make it difficult the release of large-scale real conversation datasets; existing work has mostly focused on sentence-level toxicity of online abuses, leaving a gap in modelling abuse as a relational and temporally unfolding phenomenon. In this work, we focus on modelling Violence Against Women and Girls (VAWG) scenarios as multi-turn dialogues. We introduce ConVAWG, a retrieval-grounded framework for generating CPS-aligned synthetic VAWG chat dialogues. ConVAWG builds scenarios from persona seeds, demographic patterns reported by the UK Office for National Statistics, official crime definitions, and retrieved Domestic Homicide Review cases; converts them into hierarchical event timelines; generates multi-scene role-play dialogues; and applies targeted activation-steered toxicity control to appropriate utterances. We release over 6,000 multi-turn dialogue events across 200 scenarios with rich scenario-, event-, and turn-level metadata. Extensive human evaluation, LLM-as-Judge assessment, ablations, and downstream tasks show strong dialogue quality and domain fidelity.
tldr: The paper introduces ConVAWG, a retrieval-grounded framework for generating controlled synthetic dialogues in the domain of violence against women and girls, and demonstrates its effectiveness through human evaluation and downstream tasks.
abstract_cn: 合成对话生成为在难以获取、发布或标注真实数据的敏感领域中研究对话动态提供了一种途径。潜在的虐待行为可能发生在线上或线下：威胁和胁迫可能直接出现在消息中，而监视、隔离、跟踪和身体暴力等行为则可能在对话中被计划、披露或提及。隐私和法律限制使得发布大规模真实对话数据集变得困难；现有工作大多集中于线上虐待的句子级毒性，在将虐待建模为一种关系性的、随时间展开的现象方面存在空白。在本研究中，我们聚焦于将针对女性及女童的暴力（Violence Against Women and Girls, VAWG）场景建模为多轮对话。我们引入了ConVAWG，一个基于检索增强的框架，用于生成符合CPS（Crown Prosecution Service，英国皇家检察署）标准的合成VAWG聊天对话。ConVAWG从人物种子、英国国家统计局报告的 demographics 人口统计模式、官方犯罪定义以及检索到的家庭凶杀案审查案例中构建场景；将其转化为分层事件时间线；生成多场景角色扮演对话；并对适当的语句应用目标导向的激活调控毒性控制。我们发布了涵盖200个场景的6,000多个多轮对话事件，并附有丰富的场景级、事件级和轮次级元数据。广泛的人工评估、LLM-as-Judge（大语言模型作为评审）评估、消融实验及下游任务表明，该框架具有强大的对话质量和领域保真度。

title: Beyond a Bag of Features: Set-Level Instability in Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: Shani et al. (2026) show that LLM representations broadly recover human category boundaries, while failing to reflect fine-grained typicality structure. Their analysis uses cosine similarity over dense model representations. We revisit their approach using overlap over active sparse autoencoder (SAE) latent sets as a more interpretable similarity measure. We first verify that this set-level measure is meaningful: SAE latent sets can recover union-like compositional structure in controlled toy models and induce semantically coherent neighborhoods in natural text. Extending the human-concepts analysis to SAE set similarities, we find that SAE activation sets do not recover human category boundaries or within-category typicality more faithfully than dense embeddings or residual-stream states, but instead track model-internal similarity structure. To probe this gap further, we study active latent sets under well-controlled semantic modifications, revealing a substantial mismatch between human judgements of conceptual change and change in the SAE active set. We interpret this as evidence that, outside idealised settings, SAE features do not compose via simple bag-of-features semantics.
tldr: The paper investigates whether sparse autoencoder latent sets can recover human category boundaries and typicality structure, finding that they do not and instead reflect model-internal similarity, indicating that SAE features do not compose via simple bag-of-features semantics.
abstract_cn: Shani等人（2026）的研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）的表征大致能够还原人类的类别边界，但无法反映细粒度的典型性结构。他们的分析采用了基于稠密模型表征的余弦相似度方法。我们重新审视了其方法，改用稀疏自编码器（SAE）活跃潜在变量集合上的重叠度作为更具可解释性的相似度度量。我们首先验证了这一集合层面的度量具有意义：SAE潜在变量集合能够在受控的玩具模型中还原类似并集的组合结构，并在自然文本中诱导出语义上连贯的邻域。将人类概念分析扩展到SAE集合相似度后，我们发现SAE激活集合在还原人类类别边界或类别内典型性方面，并不比稠密嵌入或残差流状态更忠实，而是更倾向于追踪模型内部的相似性结构。为进一步探究这一差距，我们在严格受控的语义修改条件下研究了活跃潜在变量集合，结果揭示了人类对概念变化的判断与SAE活跃集合的变化之间存在显著的不匹配。我们将此解读为一种证据，表明在理想化情境之外，SAE特征并不能通过简单的词袋式语义进行组合。

title: How to Verify Consistency of Probabilistic Claims
abstract: When a probabilistic predictor answers many conditional-probability queries, are its answers self-consistent, and can this be verified in polynomial time? This problem is of interest for AI safety, where safety is derived from honesty about probabilistic predictions of unwanted outcomes potentially caused by an AI action. We construct an interactive PCP as follows. Let a predictive model be specified by a probability circuit P and a circuit Q which outputs confidence in predictions. Together, P and Q implicitly specify exponentially many probabilistic claims. We show a protocol in which a polynomial-time verifier can verify the approximate consistency of (P,Q). The verifier is given the pair of circuits (P,Q), which it evaluates at only a few points; alongside them it is given a proof oracle, an encoding of a witnessing probability distribution allegedly consistent with the predictions of (P,Q), which it reads at a few locations while interacting with a single untrusted prover. En route, we must ensure the existence of a sparse witnessing distribution consistent with the model's predictions. To do so, we first consider witness distributions for the consistency of explicit probabilistic claims, rather than claims specified by a predictor: say m claims, each of the form Pr[Y = 1 | X = x] = p, over n Boolean variables. Building on work initiated by Nilsson (Artif. Intell., 1986), we place l_2-approximate probabilistic consistency of explicit claims in NP, with certificates of length O(mn + log B) in the input bit-precision B; we further show how a small additive completeness-soundness gap removes the dependence on B. Together these results provide a complexity-theoretic foundation for certifying the self-consistency of probabilistic predictors. We view our interactive PCP as a first step toward training predictive models to prove their own consistency.
tldr: 该论文研究概率预测器回答条件概率查询时的自洽性验证问题，并构建了一个交互式PCP协议，使得多项式时间验证者能够验证预测器的近似一致性。
abstract_cn: 当一个概率预测器回答许多条件概率查询时，其答案是否自洽，并且能否在多项式时间内验证这一点？该问题对人工智能安全具有重要意义，因为安全性源于对人工智能行为可能引发的不良后果的概率预测的诚实性。我们构造了一个交互式概率可检验证明（PCP），具体如下。设一个预测模型由概率电路P和输出预测置信度的电路Q指定。P和Q共同隐式地指定了指数多个概率声明。我们展示了一个协议，在该协议中，多项式时间验证者可以验证(P,Q)的近似一致性。验证者获得电路对(P,Q)，并仅在少数几个点上对其进行求值；同时，验证者还获得一个证明预言机，即一个据称与(P,Q)的预测一致的见证概率分布的编码，验证者在与单个不可信证明者交互时，在少数几个位置读取该编码。在此过程中，我们必须确保存在一个稀疏的见证分布，与模型的预测一致。为此，我们首先考虑显式概率声明的一致性见证分布，而非由预测器指定的声明：假设有m个声明，每个声明形式为Pr[Y = 1 | X = x] = p，涉及n个布尔变量。基于Nilsson（Artif. Intell., 1986）开创的工作，我们将显式声明的l_2近似概率一致性置于NP中，其证书长度为O(mn + log B)，其中B为输入位精度；我们进一步展示了小的加法完备性-可靠性间隙如何消除对B的依赖。这些结果共同为认证概率预测器的自洽性提供了复杂性理论基础。我们将我们的交互式PCP视为训练预测模型以证明自身一致性的第一步。

title: A Quantum Roadmap for Softmax Attention: Exact Born-Rule Analogs for Softmax Attention on the Probability Simplex
abstract: The attention mechanism forms the foundation of many modern AI models such as the Transformer. In one subclass of problems where attention is used, inputs and outputs are bound to the probability simplex so that all outputs sum to one. In this setting, softmax attention admits an exact, component-by-component quantum realization. Attention scores are Hadamard-test statistics on block-encoded projections of amplitude-encoded inputs. The exponential softmax is the interior of a cosine-squared family generated by Born-rule measurement under an exact bijection, whose boundary expresses sparse attention with exact zeros at finite parameter values. The softmax temperature is a repetition count where post-selected measurement rounds realize discretized inverse temperature exactly. Value aggregation is a deterministic column-loading channel that dilates the column-stochastic value matrix. The gated residual is the preparation angle of a single ancilla, with the additive identity at a mixing angle of π/2. Every learnable parameter is a rotation-gate angle. The composed layer is exact in the infinite-shot limit with one measure-and-reload step per attention score; a fully-coherent variant is ε-approximate via quantum singular value transformation in the infinite depth limit. The algebraic core is machine-checked in Lean 4.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种在量子计算框架下精确实现softmax注意力的方法，利用Born规则和量子线路实现，但未涉及推荐系统。
abstract_cn: 注意力机制是许多现代人工智能模型（如Transformer）的基础。在一类使用注意力的问题中，输入和输出被约束在概率单纯形上，使得所有输出之和为一。在此设定下，softmax注意力允许一种逐分量精确的量子实现。注意力分数是对振幅编码输入的块编码投影进行Hadamard检验所得到的统计量。指数softmax是由Born规则测量在精确双射下生成的余弦平方族的内点，其边界在有限参数值处表达了具有精确零点的稀疏注意力。softmax温度是一个重复计数，其中后选择测量轮次精确实现离散化的逆温度。值聚合是一个确定性的列加载通道，它扩张了列随机的值矩阵。门控残差是单个辅助比特的制备角度，其加法单位元位于混合角π/2处。每个可学习参数都是一个旋转门角度。组合层在无限次测量极限下是精确的，每个注意力分数对应一步测量-重载过程；一个完全相干的变体通过量子奇异值变换在无限深度极限下是ε近似的。其代数核心已在Lean 4中经过机器验证。

title: MultiModal Code-Switching: Interleaving Visual Objects into Language for Explicit Object-Level Alignment
abstract: Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) predominantly rely on image-text pairs for modality alignment pretraining, mapping global image representations to long textual descriptions. However, this image-level alignment suffers from referential ambiguity: models struggle to infer the correspondences between multiple visual objects and textual entities from the global representation, leading to data inefficiency and suboptimal semantic grounding. To address this, we propose MultiModal Code-Switching (MMCS), a novel pretraining paradigm that provides explicit object-level supervision.
