title: G-TRAC: Graph-textual Representations Alignment for Cold-start Recommendations
abstract: The cold-start problem remains a significant challenge in recommendation systems, particularly for new users or unseen items with little to no historical data. Existing methods, including graph neural networks, often struggle in such scenarios. Inspired by the success of transformer models in natural language processing, we propose G-TRAC (Graph-Textual Representations Alignment for Cold-start Recommendations), a novel approach that integrates transformer-based textual modeling with graph neural networks. By effectively leveraging both textual and structural information, G-TRAC addresses cold-start challenges more effectively. Extensive experiments demonstrate its ability to enhance recommendation quality and generalize well across diverse scenarios.
semantic_scholar_tldr: G-TRAC (Graph-Textual Representations Alignment for Cold-start Recommendations), a novel approach that integrates transformer-based textual modeling with graph neural networks, addresses cold-start challenges more effectively.
tldr: G-TRAC proposes a graph-textual representation alignment method to address cold-start recommendations by integrating transformer-based textual modeling with graph neural networks, improving recommendation quality for new users and items.
abstract_cn: 冷启动问题仍然是推荐系统中的一个重大挑战，尤其是在面对缺乏历史数据的新用户或未见项目时。现有方法，包括图神经网络，在此类场景中往往表现不佳。受Transformer模型在自然语言处理领域取得成功的启发，我们提出了G-TRAC（面向冷启动推荐的图-文本表示对齐方法），这是一种将基于Transformer的文本建模与图神经网络相结合的新型方法。通过有效利用文本信息和结构信息，G-TRAC能够更有效地应对冷启动挑战。大量实验表明，该方法能够提升推荐质量，并在多种场景下具有良好的泛化能力。

title: Personalization in the Era of Super(?)-intelligence
abstract: For decades, the WSDM community has viewed personalization through the lens of collaborative filtering and predictive behavioral models. Today, we are witnessing a fundamental shift where AI systems promise to not just predict user intent, but to actively reason, plan, and create on our behalf. Instead of merely reinforcing our existing habits, these new approaches promise to surface insights we are blind to, guiding us toward discoveries that advance our personal journeys in new and unexpected ways. But are we truly on the verge of super-intelligent personalization?
semantic_scholar_tldr: This talk will trace the evolution of AI-driven personalization over the past few years -- from simple data augmenters for traditional recommendation pipelines, to recursive self-improvement of LLM-powered models, to complex personalized reasoning agents.
topics: Ethics and Social Impacts of AI
tldr: 该论文探讨了在超级智能时代，个性化推荐系统如何从预测用户意图转向主动推理和创造，以引导用户发现新见解，并质疑是否真正迎来超级智能个性化。
abstract_cn: 数十年来，WSDM（网络搜索与数据挖掘）学界一直通过协同过滤与预测性行为模型的视角来审视个性化技术。如今，我们正见证一场根本性的转变——人工智能系统不再仅仅预测用户意图，而是能够主动推理、规划并代我们进行创造。这些新方法不再只是强化我们已有的习惯，而是有望揭示我们视而不见的洞见，引导我们走向那些以新颖且出人意料的方式推进个人旅程的发现。然而，我们是否真的正处于超级智能个性化时代的边缘？

analysis.chinese_title: 超级（？）智能时代的个性化
analysis.summary: 本文探讨了WSDM社区长期以来通过协同过滤和预测行为模型进行个性化推荐的研究范式，指出当前AI系统正从预测用户意图转向主动推理、规划和创造，有望超越用户现有习惯，揭示盲点，引导用户走向新的发现。作者质疑我们是否真正处于超级智能个性化的边缘，并讨论了这种转变的潜在影响和挑战。
innovations: 提出个性化研究范式从预测到主动推理和创造的转变

title: FCN: Fusing Exponential and Linear Cross Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
abstract: As an important modeling paradigm in click-through rate (CTR) prediction, the Deep & Cross Network and its derivative models have gained widespread recognition, primarily due to their success in trade-off computational cost and performance. However, this paradigm typically depends on deep neural network (DNN) to implicitly learn high-order feature interactions, without explicitly modeling extremely high-order interactions due to concerns about model complexity. To address this limitation, we propose a novel model for CTR prediction, called the Fusing Cross Network (FCN), which consists of two sub-networks: the Exponential Cross Network (ECN) and the Linear Cross Network (LCN). Specifically, ECN explicitly captures extremely high-order feature interactions whose order increases exponentially with network depth, while LCN captures low-order feature interactions with linearly increasing order. By integrating these two sub-networks, FCN is able to explicitly model a broad spectrum of feature interactions, thereby eliminating the need to rely on implicit modeling by DNN. Moreover, we introduce a low-cost aggregation method that reduces the number of parameters by 50% and inference latency by 23%. Meanwhile, we propose a simple yet effective loss function, Tri-BCE, which provides tailored supervision signals for each sub-network. We evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of FCN on six public benchmark datasets and 16 baselines. Furthermore, we verify the effectiveness of the FCN on a real-world business dataset spanning seven days. The code, running logs, and detailed hyperparameter configurations are publicly available at https://github.com/salmon1802/FCN.
semantic_scholar_tldr: A novel model for CTR prediction, called the Fusing Cross Network (FCN), which consists of two sub-networks: the Exponential Cross Network (ECN) and the Linear Cross Network (LCN), which explicitly captures extremely high-order feature interactions whose order increases exponentially with network depth.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种融合指数和线性交叉网络的FCN模型，用于显式建模高阶特征交互，在多个数据集上提升了CTR预测的准确性和效率。
abstract_cn: 作为点击率（CTR）预测中一种重要的建模范式，Deep & Cross Network及其衍生模型因其在计算成本与性能之间取得良好平衡而获得广泛认可。然而，该范式通常依赖深度神经网络（DNN）隐式学习高阶特征交互，出于对模型复杂度的顾虑，并未显式建模极高阶交互。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种新颖的CTR预测模型，称为融合交叉网络（FCN），其由两个子网络组成：指数交叉网络（ECN）和线性交叉网络（LCN）。具体而言，ECN显式捕获极高阶特征交互，其交互阶数随网络深度呈指数增长，而LCN则以线性增长的阶数捕获低阶特征交互。通过整合这两个子网络，FCN能够显式建模广泛范围的特征交互，从而无需依赖DNN的隐式建模。此外，我们引入了一种低成本聚合方法，将参数数量减少50%，推理延迟降低23%。同时，我们提出了一种简单而有效的损失函数Tri-BCE，为每个子网络提供定制化的监督信号。我们在六个公开基准数据集和16个基线上评估了FCN的有效性和效率。此外，我们还在一个覆盖七天的真实业务数据集上验证了FCN的有效性。代码、运行日志及详细的超参数配置已公开于https://github.com/salmon1802/FCN。

title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
abstract: Recent work on distillation transfers the capabilities of large models to smaller ones often by updating the latter's parameters, through teacher forcing, on-policy distillation, and related training-time methods. In this paper, we ask whether such transfer can instead occur at test time. We study strong-to-weak scaffolding: whether a stronger builder model can construct inference-time harnesses that help a weaker target model solve tasks more reliably without any parameter updates. Using four representative Theory-of-Mind benchmarks, each builder model uses 5% of the data as a validation set to iteratively refine its harness over multiple rounds, after which the finalized harness is evaluated on the full test set. Empirically, this form of test-time capability transfer is highly effective, nearly doubling average target-model performance from 0.49 to 0.91. Our analysis shows that the gains come primarily from offloading unstable model reasoning into deterministic code, benchmark-specific routing, and strict answer-format enforcement, rather than from encouraging the target model to reason more extensively or sample more broadly. We further find that builder-model reasoning effort improves harness quality monotonically, platform effects are modest relative to the builder model's own capability, and weaker target models receive the largest gains. These results suggest that inference-time harness design is an important complement to conventional training-time distillation, enabling strong models to transfer cognitive structure to weaker models without retraining.
tldr: 本文提出了一种测试时能力迁移方法，通过强模型构建推理时脚手架来提升弱模型在Theory-of-Mind任务上的表现，无需参数更新，平均性能从0.49提升到0.91。
abstract_cn: 近期关于知识蒸馏的研究，通常通过教师强制、在线策略蒸馏及相关训练时方法，更新较小模型的参数，从而将大型模型的能力迁移至较小模型。本文探讨的是，这种迁移能否在测试时实现。我们研究了“从强到弱的脚手架”方法：即一个更强的构建模型能否构建推理时的辅助框架，帮助较弱的靶模型更可靠地解决问题，而无需任何参数更新。在四个具有代表性的心理理论基准测试中，每个构建模型使用5%的数据作为验证集，通过多轮迭代优化其辅助框架，最终确定的框架在完整测试集上进行评估。实验结果表明，这种测试时的能力迁移极为有效，靶模型的平均性能几乎翻倍，从0.49提升至0.91。我们的分析显示，性能提升主要源于将不稳定的模型推理过程卸载至确定性代码、针对基准的特定路由以及严格的答案格式约束，而非鼓励靶模型进行更深入的推理或更广泛的采样。我们进一步发现，构建模型的推理努力程度单调地提升辅助框架质量；平台效应相对于构建模型自身能力而言影响较小；较弱的靶模型获得的收益最大。这些结果表明，推理时辅助框架设计是对传统训练时蒸馏的重要补充，使强模型无需重新训练即可将认知结构迁移至弱模型。

title: Making Collaborative Signals Count: Graph-Aware Large Language Models for Sequential Recommendation
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely adopted as backbones for recommender systems. However, their language-centric pretraining makes it difficult to capture collaborative signals implicit in user-item interactions, which are crucial for personalized recommendation. Existing methods either inject collaborative representations produced by external recommenders or model only intra-sequence dependencies, limiting their ability to exploit global collaborative patterns. To address this limitation, we propose GALLM, a graph-aware LLM framework for sequential recommendation. GALLM constructs a collaborative graph over text tokens and item tokens, and models three types of relations: Text--Text relations for preserving semantic dependencies, Item--Text relations for aligning item tokens with their textual descriptions, and Item--Item relations derived from global item co-occurrence patterns. These relations are transformed into lightweight learnable attention biases and incorporated into the LLM attention mechanism, enabling collaborative-aware token interactions without introducing an additional graph encoder. Experiments on four real-world benchmarks show that GALLM achieves the best performance among the compared baselines, improving over the strongest baseline by 9.76\% on average in HR@5.
tldr: 提出图感知大语言模型GALLM，通过将协同图关系注入注意力机制，提升序列推荐性能，在四个基准上平均HR@5提升9.76%。
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）已被广泛用作推荐系统的骨干网络。然而，其以语言为中心的预训练方式难以捕捉用户-物品交互中隐含的协同信号，而这些信号对于个性化推荐至关重要。现有方法要么注入由外部推荐器生成的协同表示，要么仅建模序列内部依赖关系，这限制了它们利用全局协同模式的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出了GALLM，一种用于序列推荐的图感知大语言模型框架。GALLM在文本令牌和物品令牌之上构建协同图，并对三类关系进行建模：文本-文本关系用于保留语义依赖，物品-文本关系用于将物品令牌与其文本描述对齐，以及物品-物品关系源自全局物品共现模式。这些关系被转化为轻量级可学习的注意力偏置，并融入大语言模型的注意力机制中，从而在不引入额外图编码器的情况下实现协同感知的令牌交互。在四个真实世界基准数据集上的实验表明，GALLM在所有对比基线中取得了最佳性能，在HR@5指标上平均比最强基线提升了9.76%。

analysis.chinese_title: 让协同信号发挥作用：面向序列推荐的图感知大语言模型
analysis.summary: 本文提出GALLM，一种图感知的大语言模型框架，用于序列推荐。现有基于LLM的推荐系统难以捕捉用户-物品交互中的协同过滤信号，已有方法要么注入外部协同表示，要么仅建模序列内依赖，限制了全局协同模式的利用。GALLM在文本令牌和物品令牌上构建协同图，建模三种关系：文本-文本关系保留语义依赖，物品-文本关系对齐物品令牌与其文本描述，物品-物品关系来自全局物品共现模式。这些关系被转化为轻量可学习的注意力偏置，融入LLM注意力机制，实现协同感知的令牌交互，无需额外图编码器。在四个真实数据集上的实验表明，GALLM在HR@5上平均比最强基线提升9.76%。
innovations: 提出将协同图结构直接注入LLM注意力机制，通过轻量可学习的注意力偏置建模异构关系，无需外部图编码器。
构建包含文本-文本、物品-文本、物品-物品三种关系的协同图，其中物品-物品关系基于全局共现频率，捕捉跨序列的协同依赖。
设计关系感知的注意力注入方法，在保持LLM预训练语义能力的同时，增强协同信号建模。
在多个数据集和不同规模LLM上验证了方法的有效性和泛化性。
analysis.methodology: GALLM首先构建混合提示，将每个物品的文本描述和专用物品令牌结合。然后构建协同图，节点包括文本令牌和物品令牌，边包括三种关系：文本-文本（所有文本令牌对）、物品-文本（物品令牌与其文本令牌）、物品-物品（基于共现频率分桶）。在LLM的每一层，将关系类型映射为可学习的注意力偏置，加到注意力logits上，同时保留因果掩码。通过多层堆叠，实现隐式的图聚合。训练时仅微调少量参数（如物品令牌嵌入和注意力偏置），保持LLM主干不变。
analysis.key_results: GALLM在四个数据集（Toys、Clothing、Book、MovieLens）上均取得最佳性能，HR@5平均提升9.76%，NDCG@5平均提升7.62%。消融实验表明三种关系均有效，去除任一关系性能下降。注意力分析显示GALLM增强了物品-文本对齐和物品-物品协同注意力。
tech_stack: 协同图构建：全局共现频率、等频分桶
注意力偏置：可学习标量
优化：微调（LoRA或全参数？输入未明确，但提到仅少量可训练参数）
strengths: 创新性地将图结构直接融入LLM注意力，避免了外部图编码器的复杂性和表示对齐问题。
方法轻量，仅增加少量可训练参数，易于适配现有LLM架构。
在多个数据集和不同规模LLM上均取得一致提升，泛化性强。
消融实验和注意力分析验证了各组件和机制的有效性。
limitations: 协同图仅基于物品共现，未利用用户信息或高阶关系。
分桶数量等超参数需要调整，可能影响性能。
实验仅在四个数据集上进行，未覆盖更多领域。
未与更多最新方法（如2026年）比较，部分基线较旧。
analysis.relevance_to_keywords: 论文与序列推荐、LLM与推荐系统结合、生成式推荐高度相关，同时涉及协同过滤、图神经网络思想，但未涉及多模态、对话式推荐、排序重排、CTR预测等。

title: Redistribution-based Cost Inference Improves Sparse Safe Offline RL
abstract: Safe offline RL typically assumes access to dense per-step cost annotations, but in practice supervisors provide only trajectory-level stop-feedback: a binary signal at the first unsafe transition, with no per-step attribution. We frame this as a temporal credit assignment problem and propose the Redistribution-based Cost Inference (RCI) framework, which converts sparse stop-feedback into dense per-step costs via return decomposition, then trains a constrained offline policy on the augmented dataset. We show that return-equivalent redistribution preserves the feasible policy set and the optimal Lagrangian in a CMDP, establishing that the transformation is lossless in theory while yielding better-conditioned cost critic learning in practice. Experiments on highway driving and robotic manipulation demonstrate substantially lower violation rates than sparse and classifier-based baselines, with robustness to heterogeneous dataset compositions and label noise.
tldr: The paper proposes a Redistribution-based Cost Inference framework to convert sparse stop-feedback into dense per-step costs for safe offline RL, demonstrating lower violation rates in driving and manipulation tasks.
abstract_cn: 安全离线强化学习通常假设能够获取密集的逐步骤成本标注，但在实际应用中，监督者仅提供轨迹级别的停止反馈：即在第一个不安全转移处给出二元信号，且没有逐步骤的归因。我们将此问题定义为时间信用分配问题，并提出基于再分配的成本推断（RCI）框架，该框架通过回报分解将稀疏的停止反馈转换为密集的逐步骤成本，随后在增强数据集上训练受约束的离线策略。我们证明，回报等价的再分配能够保留约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）中的可行策略集和最优拉格朗日乘子，从而在理论上确立该变换是无损的，同时在实践中带来条件更优的成本评判器学习。在高速公路驾驶和机器人操作实验中的结果表明，相较于稀疏基线和基于分类器的基线，该方法显著降低了违规率，并且对异构数据集组成和标签噪声具有鲁棒性。

title: A Framework for Designing Reward Functions: From Objectives to Features to Human-Aligned Reward Functions
abstract: We present a formal process to enable non-experts to instantiate and iterate on human-aligned reward functions, i.e. reward functions that adhere to a given preference ordering over trajectories. Given a task described in natural language, our process produces a linear reward function in three steps: distill the task's objectives into a set of fundamental objectives and derive measurable outcome variables that capture those fundamental objectives, select a causally representative subset of outcome variables as the reward terms, and fit weights to those reward terms via preference elicitation. Our contributions describe the first step and formalize the latter two steps. The first is a guided workflow for deriving outcome variables. The second is a reduction of reward term selection to minimum-cost partial cover on a causal DAG, solved in polynomial time via max-flow. The third is a geometric framing of weight fitting as a convex feasibility problem iteratively narrowed by preference queries, solved by existing separation oracle methods. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first reward-design method that maintains a deterministically conflict-free feasible weight region, narrowed to a desired tolerance via a separation oracle with O(n log κ) preference queries.
tldr: This paper proposes a formal three-step process for non-experts to design human-aligned reward functions, involving deriving outcome variables, selecting causally representative reward terms via minimum-cost cover, and fitting weights via preference elicitation.
abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种形式化流程，使非专家能够实例化并迭代生成与人类对齐的奖励函数，即遵循给定轨迹偏好排序的奖励函数。给定一个以自然语言描述的任务，我们的流程通过三个步骤生成线性奖励函数：将任务目标提炼为一组基本目标，并推导出能够捕捉这些基本目标的可测量结果变量；从这些结果变量中选择一个具有因果代表性的子集作为奖励项；通过偏好 elicitation 拟合这些奖励项的权重。我们的贡献在于描述了第一步，并对后两步进行了形式化。第一步是一个用于推导结果变量的引导式工作流。第二步是将奖励项选择归约为因果有向无环图（DAG）上的最小成本部分覆盖问题，并通过最大流算法在多项式时间内求解。第三步是将权重拟合几何化为一个凸可行性问题，通过偏好查询逐步缩小可行域，并利用现有的分离预言机方法求解。据我们所知，这是首个保持确定性无冲突可行权重区域的奖励设计方法，该方法通过分离预言机以 O(n log κ) 次偏好查询将可行域缩小至所需容差。

title: Earth observation embeddings are effective sub-grid descriptors for probabilistic weather downscaling
abstract:
Global weather reanalyses and forecasts resolve the evolving atmospheric state on coarse grids, but site-specific applications require predictions at arbitrary locations where near-surface conditions also depend on unresolved terrain and land-surface properties. Existing probabilistic downscalers address this gap using hand-crafted topographic descriptors. We ask instead whether Earth observation foundation models can provide transferable sub-grid surface representations for probabilistic weather downscaling.
  We augment a convolutional conditional neural process that downscales coarse ERA5 reanalysis fields at ~25 km resolution with a learned local surface descriptor, obtained by compressing a patch of TESSERA embeddings at 10 m resolution. Although these embeddings summarise surface conditions over annual timescales, they improve downscaling of instantaneous 2 m temperature and 10 m wind speed by encoding persistent surface properties that capture a location's departure from the coarse-grid atmospheric state. Across five climatically diverse regions, the embedding improves point and probabilistic skill at stations held out in both space and time, overall improving CRPS skill by 11.5% for 2 m temperature and 6.2% for 10 m wind speed. We further analyse how its contribution differs by variable, finding that topography explains more of temperature's sub-grid structure, while TESSERA provides additional surface information for wind speed.
  These improvements persist when the coarse input is changed from ERA5 to forecasts from the Aurora AI forecasting model, and when predicting at newly deployed stations with no regional history. To our knowledge, this is the first evidence that long-timescale Earth-observation embeddings can support short-timescale weather downscaling where sub-grid departures are systematically structured by persistent surface properties.
tldr: 该论文提出利用地球观测基础模型的嵌入作为子网格描述符，提升概率天气降尺度的性能，在多个气候区域和站点上显著改善了温度与风速的预测技能。
abstract_cn:
全球天气再分析和预报在粗网格上解析不断演变的大气状态，但特定站点的应用需要在任意位置进行预测，而这些位置的近地表条件还取决于未解析的地形和陆面属性。现有的概率降尺度方法通过手工设计的地形描述符来解决这一问题。我们转而探讨地球观测基础模型能否为概率天气降尺度提供可迁移的亚网格地表表征。

我们增强了一个卷积条件神经过程，该过程将约25公里分辨率的粗分辨率ERA5再分析场进行降尺度，并引入一个学习得到的局地地表描述符，该描述符通过对10米分辨率的TESSERA嵌入块进行压缩获得。尽管这些嵌入在年际时间尺度上概括了地表条件，但它们通过编码能够捕捉某地点偏离粗网格大气状态的持久地表属性，改善了对瞬时2米气温和10米风速的降尺度效果。在五个气候多样的区域中，该嵌入在空间和时间上均被留出的站点上提升了点预测和概率预测技能，总体上使2米气温的CRPS技能提高了11.5%，10米风速提高了6.2%。我们进一步分析了其贡献如何因变量而异，发现地形对气温的亚网格结构解释更多，而TESSERA则为风速提供了额外的地表信息。

当粗输入从ERA5更换为Aurora AI预测模型的预报，以及在无区域历史的新部署站点进行预测时，这些改进仍然持续存在。据我们所知，这是首个证明长期时间尺度的地球观测嵌入能够支持短期天气降尺度的证据，其中亚网格偏差由持久地表属性系统性地结构化。

title: Calibration Bets on the Past: Post-Training Quantization for Financial Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: Financial forecasting models are typically developed in full precision, yet production deployment often requires low-precision inference to reduce memory and computational cost. Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables such deployment without retraining. However, reliable activation quantization requires calibration: activation ranges are estimated from historical data before deployment and then remain fixed during future inference. The importance of this deployment choice for financial forecasting remains poorly understood. We present a systematic study of activation calibration for PTQ in cross-sectional volatility forecasting on the S&P 500. Our evaluation covers seven representative neural architectures, eight walk-forward test years (2018-2025), and 560 trained models. We find that activation calibration has little effect at 8 bits but becomes the primary determinant of predictive performance at 4 bits. Under default absolute-maximum (abs-max) calibration, static 4-bit quantization of both weights and activations removes 11-62% of the full-precision mean information coefficient in affected architectures. Replacing abs-max with percentile calibration recovers 53-94% of this degradation in the four most affected architectures. The preferred activation range also varies across market periods. Narrow ranges improve resolution under typical market conditions but lose part of their advantage when test-period market dispersion exceeds the calibration history. These findings show that activation calibration is a first-class deployment decision for reliable 4-bit PTQ in financial forecasting. When substantial degradation remains, 8-bit activations or weight-only 4-bit quantization provide more robust deployment choices.
tldr: This paper systematically studies activation calibration for post-training quantization in financial volatility forecasting, finding that calibration choice significantly impacts 4-bit quantization performance and recommending percentile calibration to recover accuracy.
abstract_cn: 金融预测模型通常以全精度开发，但在生产部署中往往需要低精度推理以降低内存和计算成本。训练后量化（PTQ）使得无需重新训练即可实现此类部署。然而，可靠的激活量化需要校准：激活范围在部署前根据历史数据估计，并在后续推理过程中保持固定。这一部署选择对金融预测的重要性至今仍缺乏深入理解。我们对标普500指数横截面波动率预测中的PTQ激活校准进行了系统性研究。我们的评估涵盖七种代表性神经架构、八个前推测试年份（2018—2025年）以及560个训练模型。研究发现，激活校准在8位精度下影响甚微，但在4位精度下成为预测性能的主要决定因素。在默认绝对最大值（abs-max）校准下，权重和激活的静态4位量化使受影响架构的全精度平均信息系数损失11%—62%。将abs-max替换为百分位数校准，在受影响最严重的四种架构中可恢复53%—94%的退化。此外，最优激活范围随市场时期不同而变化。较窄的范围在典型市场条件下可提高分辨率，但当测试期市场离散度超过校准历史时，其优势会部分丧失。这些发现表明，激活校准是金融预测中实现可靠4位PTQ的一级部署决策。当退化仍然显著时，8位激活或仅权重量化的4位方案提供了更稳健的部署选择。

title: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL
abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning for human-AI interaction typically relies on a single large language model to simulate user behavior. We show that this approach systematically fails to generalize, and trace the failure to simulator collapse: because the simulator LLM is mode-collapsed, an LLM policy trained against it overfits to narrow strategies that exploit the simulator's dominant mode, and such a policy transfers poorly to unseen simulators and real users. We formalize this collapse theoretically and propose two complementary solutions, one at inference time and one at training time. The inference-time solution, Verbalized Sampling, broadens the simulator's behavior by sampling from a verbalized response distribution, reducing mode collapse. The training-time solution, Co-Training, jointly optimizes the policy against a population of trainable simulators, preventing it from overfitting to any single simulator's mode. We validate both solutions on three multi-turn benchmarks: Persuasion for Good, $τ^2$-bench, and CooperBench. Verbalized Sampling improves held-out success by up to 9% over single-simulator RL, and Co-Training pushes gains further to 14%; the human study shows similar gain on real users. Both solutions preserve the policy diversity that collapses under single-simulator RL. To support further work in this direction, we release SCOPE, an open-source framework for Population Co-Training multi-agent RL. More broadly, our results suggest that the diversity of the training environment, not only the policy, is critical to the generalization of multi-turn RL to real-world deployment.
tldr: The paper identifies simulator collapse in multi-agent RL with a single LLM simulator and proposes Verbalized Sampling and Co-Training to improve generalization to real users.
abstract_cn: 多智能体强化学习在人机交互中的典型做法，是依赖单个大型语言模型来模拟用户行为。我们发现，这种方法在泛化方面系统性失败，并将其原因追溯至模拟器坍缩：由于模拟器大语言模型发生模式坍缩，针对该模拟器训练出的语言模型策略会过度拟合于利用模拟器主导模式的狭窄策略，而此类策略在迁移至未见过的模拟器及真实用户时表现不佳。我们从理论上形式化了这一坍缩现象，并提出了两种互补的解决方案，一种用于推理阶段，另一种用于训练阶段。推理阶段的方案——言语化采样，通过从言语化响应分布中采样来拓宽模拟器的行为范围，从而减少模式坍缩。训练阶段的方案——协同训练，则针对一组可训练的模拟器群体联合优化策略，防止其过度拟合于任何单一模拟器的模式。我们在三个多轮基准上验证了这两种方案：Persuasion for Good、τ²-bench 和 CooperBench。与单模拟器强化学习相比，言语化采样将保留集上的成功率提升了最多9%，而协同训练进一步将增益推高至14%；人工研究在真实用户上也显示出类似的提升。两种方案均保持了在单模拟器强化学习下会发生坍缩的策略多样性。为支持该方向的进一步研究，我们发布了SCOPE，一个用于群体协同训练多智能体强化学习的开源框架。更广泛地，我们的结果表明，训练环境的多样性——而不仅仅是策略本身——对于多轮强化学习向真实世界部署的泛化至关重要。

title: Regime-Gated Residual Mixture-of-Experts for Cross-Sectional Volatility Forecasting
abstract: Financial volatility is regime dependent, yet incorporating regime information into neural networks can also destabilize training. This paper asks where such information should enter a neural cross-sectional volatility forecasting model. We study five-day realized-volatility forecasts for 1,027 U.S. equities using a rolling walk-forward evaluation framework in which information, model capacity, hyperparameter tuning, and random seeds are matched across architectures. We propose RG-ResMoE, a regime-gated residual mixture-of-experts architecture in which regime information is used only for expert routing rather than for direct forecasting. The base predictor models volatility from stock features, while a gating network uses regime state variables to route residual corrections. RG-ResMoE consistently outperforms a capacity-matched MLP in both forecasting accuracy and training stability in the main U.S. study. Similar gains are observed on an independent Japanese panel. The integration pathway is decisive: appending the same regime variables directly to the forecasting input degrades both predictive performance and training stability, whereas restricting them to the routing gate improves accuracy and Value-at-Risk calibration. Hard routing consistently underperforms soft routing. The results suggest that, in compact neural volatility forecasting models, the primary value of mixture-of-experts models lies less in increasing model capacity than in controlling how nonstationary regime information influences prediction.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种制度门控残差混合专家模型（RG-ResMoE），用于横截面波动率预测，通过将制度信息仅用于专家路由而非直接预测，提高了预测准确性和训练稳定性。
abstract_cn: 金融波动具有体制依赖性，然而将体制信息纳入神经网络也可能破坏训练的稳定性。本文探讨的是，此类信息应被引入神经横截面波动率预测模型的哪个环节。我们采用滚动前推评估框架，对1,027只美国股票的五日已实现波动率进行预测，在该框架中，信息、模型容量、超参数调优及随机种子在各架构间均保持匹配。我们提出RG-ResMoE，一种体制门控残差混合专家架构，其中体制信息仅用于专家路由，而非直接用于预测。基础预测器根据股票特征建模波动率，而门控网络则利用体制状态变量来路由残差修正。在美国主要研究中，RG-ResMoE在预测准确性和训练稳定性方面均持续优于容量匹配的多层感知机（MLP）。在独立的日本股票面板上也观察到了类似的改进效果。整合路径至关重要：将相同的体制变量直接附加到预测输入中会降低预测性能和训练稳定性，而将其限制在路由门控中则能提升准确性和风险价值（VaR）校准效果。硬路由始终逊于软路由。结果表明，在紧凑型神经波动率预测模型中，混合专家模型的主要价值与其说在于增加模型容量，不如说在于控制非平稳体制信息对预测的影响方式。

title: An Efficient Near-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial $m$-Set Bandits
abstract:
We study adversarial combinatorial bandits with $m$-set actions, where at each round the learner selects $m$ out of $d$ items and observes only the aggregate loss of the selected items. The resulting action set contains $K=\binom{d}{m}$ elements and can therefore be exponentially large. Nevertheless, the loss of every action is determined by the same $d$-dimensional vector of item losses. We propose a computationally efficient algorithm that exploits this structure without explicitly enumerating the action set. Against adaptive non-anticipating adversaries, it guarantees, with probability at least $1-δ$, regret against the best fixed action of \[
  R_T =
  O\left(\sqrt{dT\log(K/δ)}\right). \] This matches the high-probability regret bound of the finite-action EXP3-KW algorithm of Zimmert and Lattimore, whose direct implementation may require exponential space. Our algorithm instead represents each sampling distribution with $d$ parameters and runs in polynomial time without enumerating the action set. Thus, it resolves the open problem posed by Maiti et al.
tldr: This paper proposes a computationally efficient near-optimal algorithm for adversarial m-set bandits, achieving the same regret bound as EXP3-KW but with polynomial time complexity, resolving an open problem.
abstract_cn:
我们研究具有$m$-集合动作的对抗性组合赌博机问题，其中在每个回合，学习者在$d$个物品中选择$m$个，并且仅观察所选物品的聚合损失。由此产生的动作集合包含$K=\binom{d}{m}$个元素，因此可能呈指数级增长。然而，每个动作的损失由相同的$d$维物品损失向量决定。我们提出了一种计算高效的算法，该算法利用了这一结构，而无需显式枚举动作集合。针对自适应的非预期对手，该算法保证，在至少$1-\delta$的概率下，相对于最佳固定动作的遗憾为\[
  R_T =
  O\left(\sqrt{dT\log(K/\delta)}\right). \] 这与Zimmert和Lattimore提出的有限动作EXP3-KW算法的高概率遗憾界相匹配，而该算法的直接实现可能需要指数级空间。相比之下，我们的算法用$d$个参数表示每个采样分布，并在不枚举动作集合的情况下以多项式时间运行。因此，它解决了Maiti等人提出的开放问题。

title: ScreenShot: A Foundation Model for Few-Shot Combination Drug Screening
abstract: Treating patients with combinations of drugs reduces the risk of resistance to any individual drug. Finding effective combinations is difficult because the large search space makes combinatorial screens prohibitively expensive, time consuming, and often technically infeasible. Predictive models can fill this gap, yet existing methods typically require molecular profiling of each sample and per-cohort training, limiting their applicability when time and tissue are scarce. To address this challenge, we introduce ScreenShot, a hierarchical transformer pretrained on 40 drug screening datasets covering 3,700 drugs and 6,000 biological samples, whose architecture mirrors the nested structure of screening data. Given a few-shot context of observations from a new patient, ScreenShot predicts the response of the sample to combination therapies through in-context learning, operating directly on functional measurements with no fine-tuning and no molecular profiling. On four held-out datasets, ScreenShot outperforms all baselines in both prediction accuracy and identification of selectively effective treatments. ScreenShot's internal representations are directly useful for experimental design: we use them to drive a weighted k-means++ active learning strategy that selects which experiments to run, achieving the same hit detection as uniform screening with a third of the budget. Source code and interactive dashboard: https://github.com/tansey-lab/screenshot.
tldr: ScreenShot是一个层次Transformer模型，通过上下文学习在少样本条件下预测新患者的药物组合反应，无需分子谱分析或微调，并在四个数据集上优于基线，同时利用内部表示进行主动学习以降低实验成本。
abstract_cn: 联合使用多种药物治疗患者可降低对任一单一药物产生耐药性的风险。然而，寻找有效的药物组合十分困难，因为庞大的搜索空间使得组合筛选在成本上过于高昂、耗时过长，且往往在技术上不可行。预测模型可以弥补这一缺口，但现有方法通常需要对每个样本进行分子谱分析，并针对每个队列单独训练，这限制了它们在时间和组织样本稀缺时的适用性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了ScreenShot——一个在覆盖3，700种药物和6，000个生物样本的40个药物筛选数据集上预训练的分层Transformer模型，其架构镜像了筛选数据的嵌套结构。给定来自新患者的少量观测样本作为上下文，ScreenShot通过上下文学习直接基于功能测量数据预测该样本对联合治疗的反应，无需微调，也无需分子谱分析。在四个保留数据集中，ScreenShot在预测准确性和识别选择性有效治疗方面均优于所有基线方法。ScreenShot的内部表示可直接用于实验设计：我们利用这些表示驱动一种加权k-means++主动学习策略来选择应开展的实验，从而以三分之一的预算实现与均匀筛选相同的命中检测效果。源代码和交互式仪表板：https://github.com/tansey-lab/screenshot。

title: Learning-Based Behavior Planning for Automated Driving: Real-World Integration and Deployment
abstract: Recent research in machine and deep learning has shown the potential of learningbased motion planning approaches to improve the driving behavior of automated vehicles, especially in complex environments. However, their complex nature and lack of transparency can hinder explainability and trustworthiness and complicate safety assurance. Motivated by these challenges, we propose a hybrid planning architecture that combines the advantages of machine learning with the verifiability and the determinism of classical approaches. Specifically, we developed a deep neural network to interpret complex traffic scenes and propose driving behavior, while an optimization-based supervision layer validates this proposal and enforces explicit drivability and safety constraints. We evaluate the learned planner's driving behavior in open-loop studies on real-world urban data, discuss system integration aspects for stable closed-loop operation, and report results from real-world deployment on our research vehicle karl..
tldr: 该论文提出了一种混合规划架构，结合深度学习与优化方法，用于自动驾驶行为规划，并在真实车辆上进行了部署验证。
abstract_cn: 近年来，机器学习与深度学习领域的研究表明，基于学习的运动规划方法在提升自动驾驶车辆驾驶行为方面具有潜力，尤其是在复杂环境中。然而，这些方法本身的复杂性及缺乏透明度，可能妨碍其可解释性与可信度，并使安全保证变得复杂。针对这些挑战，我们提出了一种混合规划架构，该架构结合了机器学习的优势与传统方法在可验证性和确定性方面的优点。具体而言，我们开发了一个深度神经网络来解读复杂交通场景并提出驾驶行为，同时，一个基于优化的监督层对该提议进行验证，并强制执行明确的可行性与安全性约束。我们在真实城市数据的开环研究中评估了所学习规划器的驾驶行为，讨论了实现稳定闭环运行所需的系统集成方面的问题，并报告了在我们的研究车辆karl上实际部署的结果。

title: HYDRA: Hyperbolic Dynamic Representation Architecture for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) enhance nonlinear function approximation by replacing scalar weights with learnable univariate functions. However, assigning an independent function to every connection results in substantial parameter redundancy, limiting their scalability and efficiency. To reduce this redundancy, we introduce \textbf{HY}perbolic \textbf{D}ynamic \textbf{R}epresentation \textbf{A}rchitecture (HYDRA), a parameter-efficient hyperbolic extension of KAN that combines spline-based functional learning with representations in the Poincaré ball. HYDRA maps vector-valued inputs into a bounded hyperbolic latent space, performs KAN-style updates in tangent space, and employs a low-rank prototype block to share functional transformations across hidden dimensions. The resulting hyperbolic representations provide a structured radial coordinate for interpretation, while radius control improves training stability by preventing boundary saturation. Extensive experiments across eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that HYDRA consistently achieves competitive or superior predictive performance while improving parameter efficiency and representation interpretability.
tldr: 该论文提出HYDRA，一种参数高效的KAN超双曲扩展，通过低秩原型块和双曲表示提高预测性能和可解释性，但研究内容与推荐系统无关。
abstract_cn: Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）通过将标量权重替换为可学习的单变量函数，增强了非线性函数逼近能力。然而，为每条连接分配独立函数会导致大量参数冗余，限制了其可扩展性和效率。为减少这种冗余，我们引入了**双曲动态表示架构**（HYDRA），这是一种参数高效的KAN双曲扩展，结合了样条函数学习与Poincaré球中的表示。HYDRA将向量值输入映射到有界双曲潜在空间，在切空间中进行KAN式更新，并采用低秩原型块在隐藏维度间共享函数变换。由此产生的双曲表示为解释提供了结构化的径向坐标，同时半径控制通过防止边界饱和提高了训练稳定性。在八个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，HYDRA在提升参数效率和表示可解释性的同时，始终能达到具有竞争力或更优的预测性能。

title: How to Spend Your Oracle Budget: Practical Guidance for Protein Structure Prediction Models
abstract: Foundation models for protein structure prediction remain unreliable on certain targets. External oracles can flag and correct these failures, but biological oracles are expensive, making oracle budget a critical constraint. Existing guidance methods, such as FK-steering, DPO, and Best K-of-N sampling, differ in how they spend this budget, yet no systematic comparison exists to guide method selection. To bridge this gap, we benchmark these methods alongside the recently proposed Optimisation Over Outputs (O3), which applies off-the-shelf optimisers within a generative model's latent subspace. We extend the usage of O3 to protein structure prediction models. Overall, our work provides the first practical reference for oracle budget-aware guidance. Our evaluation on two protein targets, calmodulin (1CLL) and E. coli aspartate transcarbamoylase (9EEH), reveals that no single method consistently dominates across all budgets and oracles. Specifically, O3 proves most effective at low oracle budgets, while FK-steering and DPO demonstrate improved performance as the budget increases. We distil these findings into actionable recommendations for practitioners operating under real-world oracle-budget constraints.
tldr: The paper benchmarks oracle budget guidance methods for protein structure prediction models, finding that O3 is best at low budgets while FK-steering and DPO improve with higher budgets, providing practical recommendations.
abstract_cn: 用于蛋白质结构预测的基础模型在某些目标上仍然不够可靠。外部预言机可以标记并纠正这些失败，但生物预言机成本高昂，使得预言机预算成为关键约束。现有的引导方法，如FK-steering、DPO和Best K-of-N采样，在如何分配这一预算上有所不同，但目前尚无系统性比较来指导方法选择。为填补这一空白，我们将这些方法与近期提出的输出空间优化（O3）方法进行基准测试，后者在生成模型的潜在子空间内应用现成优化器。我们将O3的使用扩展到蛋白质结构预测模型。总体而言，我们的工作为预言机预算感知引导提供了首个实用参考。我们在两个蛋白质靶标——钙调蛋白（1CLL）和大肠杆菌天冬氨酸转氨甲酰酶（9EEH）上的评估表明，没有任何单一方法能在所有预算和预言机条件下持续占优。具体而言，O3在低预言机预算下表现最为有效，而FK-steering和DPO则随预算增加展现出更优性能。我们将这些发现提炼为面向实际预言机预算约束下从业者的可操作建议。

title: DreamFly: Causal Memory and Receding-Horizon Diffusion Planning for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
abstract: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to integrate visual evidence over time, plan future actions, and determine when it has reached a navigation goal under partial observability. Although recent VLA models offer a promising perception-to-action paradigm, adapting them to aerial navigation remains challenging due to limited historical context, short planning horizons, and unreliable implicit termination. To address these challenges, we propose DreamFly, a diffusion-based aerial VLN framework built on Dream-VLA. DreamFly introduces a causally aligned historical memory that augments the current visual representation using only observations preceding the current decision step, enabling temporal reasoning without future information leakage. We further formulate navigation as receding-horizon diffusion planning, where the policy predicts a $K$-step action chunk but executes only the first action before replanning. This plan-$K$, execute-one strategy uses future actions as auxiliary planning targets while preserving closed-loop visual feedback. Finally, LiteStop estimates the stop probability directly from action logits at the initial all-mask state, decoupling explicit termination from action generation. Experiments on the OpenFly benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements in seen and unseen environments. DreamFly achieves 32.04%/29.46% SR and 28.22%/23.54% SPL on the test-seen/test-unseen splits, respectively, outperforming all compared methods on both metrics while attaining the lowest navigation error. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly modeling historical context, future action structure, and explicit termination for aerial VLN.
tldr: 该论文提出DreamFly框架，通过因果记忆和滚动时域扩散规划解决航空视觉语言导航中的历史上下文有限、规划视野短和终止不可靠问题，在OpenFly基准上取得最优性能。
abstract_cn: 航空视觉-语言导航（Aerial VLN）要求具身智能体在部分可观测条件下，随时间整合视觉证据、规划未来动作，并判断是否已达到导航目标。尽管近期提出的VLA模型提供了一种有前景的感知-动作范式，但由于历史上下文有限、规划视野较短以及隐式终止不可靠，将其适配到航空导航仍面临挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出DreamFly，一种基于Dream-VLA的扩散式航空VLN框架。DreamFly引入了一种因果对齐的历史记忆模块，仅利用当前决策步骤之前的观测来增强当前视觉表示，从而在不泄露未来信息的前提下实现时序推理。我们进一步将导航建模为滚动时域扩散规划，其中策略预测一个$K$步动作块，但仅执行第一个动作后即重新规划。这种“规划$K$步、执行一步”的策略将未来动作作为辅助规划目标，同时保持闭环视觉反馈。最后，LiteStop直接从初始全掩码状态下的动作logits中估计停止概率，将显式终止判断与动作生成解耦。在OpenFly基准上的实验表明，该方法在可见与不可见环境中均取得了一致的性能提升。DreamFly在测试可见/测试不可见划分上分别实现了32.04%/29.46%的SR和28.22%/23.54%的SPL，在两个指标上均优于所有对比方法，同时取得了最低的导航误差。这些结果证明了联合建模历史上下文、未来动作结构以及显式终止对于航空VLN的有效性。

title: Constructing Dynamic Master Logic Models as Knowledge Graphs for Complex System Diagnostics Using Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
abstract: Dynamic Master Logic (DML) provides a hierarchical framework for representing system behavior by linking functional objectives to underlying structural elements. However, DML construction typically relies on expert interpretation of technical documentation, limiting scalability for complex systems. This study presents a framework for automated construction of DML models from system descriptions and their representation as Knowledge Graphs (KG-DML), using Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Large Language Models as enabling tools. Building on prior work with small-scale systems, the framework extends automated KG-DML construction and evaluation to substantially larger and more complex systems. Model construction proceeds across the DML hierarchy using targeted retrieval while preserving functional dependencies and explicit logical relationships. The resulting KG-DML supports diagnostic reasoning, safety assessment, upward failure propagation, and downward dependency tracing. A multi-level validation methodology evaluates layer-specific precision and recall, logical gate consistency, and overall structural integrity. Application to the Low-Pressure Coolant Injection system of a decommissioned Boiling Water Reactor demonstrates consistent reconstruction across repeated runs. The results show that automated KG-DML construction can transform technical documentation into executable functional models for diagnostic and reliability analysis.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用检索增强生成和大语言模型自动构建动态主逻辑知识图谱的方法，用于复杂系统的诊断和可靠性分析，并验证了其在核反应堆冷却系统上的有效性。
abstract_cn: 动态主逻辑（DML）提供了一种分层框架，通过将功能目标与底层结构要素相连接来表示系统行为。然而，DML的构建通常依赖于专家对技术文档的解读，这限制了其在复杂系统中的可扩展性。本研究提出了一种框架，用于从系统描述中自动构建DML模型，并将其表示为知识图谱（KG-DML），利用检索增强生成和大语言模型作为支撑工具。在先前针对小规模系统研究的基础上，该框架将自动化KG-DML构建与评估扩展至规模更大、复杂度更高的系统。模型构建过程沿DML层级结构进行，采用定向检索，同时保留功能依赖关系和显式逻辑关联。所生成的KG-DML支持诊断推理、安全评估、向上故障传播分析以及向下依赖追踪。一种多层次验证方法评估了各层级的精确率与召回率、逻辑门一致性以及整体结构完整性。将该方法应用于一座退役沸水反应堆的低压冷却剂注入系统，结果表明在多次重复运行中模型重建具有一致性。研究结果显示，自动化KG-DML构建能够将技术文档转化为可执行的功能模型，用于诊断与可靠性分析。

title: Class Activation Mapping in Explainable Computer Vision: A Method-Centered Review of CNN, Transformer, and Foundation-Model-Era Visual Explanations
abstract: Class activation mapping (CAM) is one of the most widely used visual explanation families in explainable artificial intelligence. Its purpose is intuitive: it converts internal model evidence into a heatmap that highlights the image regions, convolutional channels, tokens, or patches that support a target class or concept. Since the first CAM formulation in 2016, the field has moved far beyond global-average-pooled CNN classifiers. CAM-style methods now include gradient-based post-hoc explanations, gradient-free score and ablation methods, high-resolution upscaling, weakly supervised localization and segmentation, transformer token attribution, causal and debiasing methods, and foundation-model-era approaches that use CLIP, DINO, SAM, or feature-distribution comparisons. This review synthesizes a strict corpus of 57 method-centered papers published from 2016 onward. The paper develops a taxonomy that separates methods by attribution mechanism, architectural dependence, and evaluation objective. It then reviews gradient-based CAMs, recent and hybrid CAM-style methods, and model-based or architecture-aware methods. Across the corpus, the main trend is clear: the field is shifting from explaining one class score in one low-resolution CNN layer toward comparative, multi-layer, probabilistic, token-aware, and foundation-model-aware explanations. At the same time, evaluation remains fragmented. Faithfulness, localization, robustness, computational cost, and human trust are often measured with different protocols. The review therefore emphasizes not only what each method contributes, but also which gap it leaves open and which later methods attempt to close that gap.
tldr: 该论文综述了类激活映射（CAM）方法在可解释计算机视觉中的发展，从CNN到Transformer和基础模型时代，并提出了一个按归因机制、架构依赖和评估目标分类的体系，指出该领域正从单一低分辨率层解释转向比较性、多层、概率性、令牌感知和基础模型感知的解释，但评估协议仍然分散。
abstract_cn: 类激活映射（Class activation mapping, CAM）是可解释人工智能中应用最广泛的视觉解释方法家族之一。其目标直观明了：将模型内部证据转化为热力图，突出显示支持某一目标类别或概念的图像区域、卷积通道、词元或图像块。自2016年首个CAM公式提出以来，该领域已远远超越了基于全局平均池化的CNN分类器。CAM类方法现已涵盖基于梯度的事后解释、无梯度评分与消融方法、高分辨率上采样、弱监督定位与分割、Transformer词元归因、因果与去偏方法，以及利用CLIP、DINO、SAM或特征分布比较的基础模型时代方法。本综述整合了自2016年以来发表的57篇以方法为核心的严格文献语料。本文提出了一种分类体系，按归因机制、架构依赖性和评估目标对方法进行区分。随后，综述回顾了基于梯度的CAM方法、近期及混合型CAM类方法，以及基于模型或架构感知的方法。纵观整个语料，主要趋势清晰可见：该领域正从解释单个低分辨率CNN层中的单一类别分数，转向比较性、多层、概率性、词元感知及基础模型感知的解释。与此同时，评估仍然零散不统一。忠实性、定位精度、鲁棒性、计算成本及人类信任度往往采用不同的协议进行度量。因此，本综述不仅强调每种方法的贡献，还指出其遗留的空白以及后续方法试图填补这些空白的努力。

title: Beyond Trial-and-Error: Agentic Optimization for Image-to-Video Adherence
abstract: Modern black-box Image-to-Video (I2V) models offer powerful capabilities in automated content creation, yet their lack of fine-grained control and reliability presents significant challenges in professional workflows. Their inherent stochasticity causes minor variations in textual prompts or hyperparameters to yield drastically different outputs often necessitating inefficient, brute-force trial-and-error processes. To address these limitations, we introduce the ``Agentic Self-Improvement" framework, which reframes video synthesis into a closed-loop, goal-directed optimization. Our framework systematically navigates the generation parameter space using a novel two-stage approach. In the first stage, an iterative prompt optimization loop uses a multimodal Large Language Model (mLLM) to refine the input prompt. This refinement implements two automated evaluations: Davidsonian Scene Graph (DSG) queries ensure semantic adherence, and Common Mistake Questions (CMQ) for artifact detection. At the second stage, we use Bayesian optimization to efficiently co-optimize stochastic seeds and CFG scales. This search is guided by a suite of quality metrics, including the novel Video-Text Adherence (VTA) score derived from the DSG and CMQ evaluations. Our framework significantly outperforms unguided search methods: in human preference studies, videos generated via our agentic approach were strongly preferred over baseline outputs, achieving win rates up to 69\%. This work provides a practical and extensible methodology for enhancing the predictability and control of state-of-the-art video generation models, moving the field beyond speculative curiosities toward reliable, production-ready tools.
tldr: This paper proposes an agentic self-improvement framework to optimize image-to-video generation by iteratively refining prompts and co-optimizing seeds and CFG scales, achieving up to 69% win rate in human preference studies.
abstract_cn: 现代黑盒图像到视频（Image-to-Video, I2V）模型在自动化内容创作中展现出强大的能力，但其缺乏细粒度控制与可靠性，给专业工作流程带来了显著挑战。其固有的随机性导致文本提示或超参数的微小变化可能产生截然不同的输出，往往需要低效的暴力试错过程。为应对这些局限，我们提出了“智能体自我改进”（Agentic Self-Improvement）框架，将视频合成重构为闭环、目标导向的优化过程。该框架采用一种新颖的两阶段方法，系统性地遍历生成参数空间。在第一阶段，迭代式提示优化循环利用多模态大语言模型（multimodal Large Language Model, mLLM）对输入提示进行精炼。该精炼过程实现了两种自动化评估：戴维森场景图（Davidsonian Scene Graph, DSG）查询确保语义一致性，以及常见错误问题（Common Mistake Questions, CMQ）用于伪影检测。在第二阶段，我们采用贝叶斯优化对随机种子和CFG尺度进行高效协同优化。该搜索过程由一系列质量指标引导，其中包括基于DSG与CMQ评估所提出的新颖视频-文本一致性（Video-Text Adherence, VTA）评分。我们的框架显著优于无引导搜索方法：在人类偏好研究中，通过智能体方法生成的视频相较于基线输出获得强烈偏好，胜率高达69%。本工作为增强最先进视频生成模型的可预测性与可控性提供了一种实用且可扩展的方法论，推动该领域从推测性探索迈向可靠、可投入生产的工具。

title: VAKRA: Evaluating Multi-Hop Reasoning Across APIs and Retrieval Under Tool-Use Policies
abstract: Agents deployed in enterprise settings must reason across structured APIs and document collections, yet existing benchmarks evaluate these capabilities in isolation. We introduce VAKRA (e\textbf{V}aluating \textbf{A}PI and \textbf{K}nowledge \textbf{R}etrieval \textbf{A}gents), a benchmark of over $8{,}000$ executable APIs across $62$ domains with tasks spanning three settings of increasing difficulty: diverse API interaction styles, multi-hop reasoning over structured APIs, and multi-source reasoning with natural-language tool-use policy constraints. Correctness is verified by re-executing predicted tool calls against live APIs, accommodating multiple valid paths. Using a fixed ReAct harness to isolate model capabilities from agent architecture, we evaluate frontier and open-weight models and find that even the best model achieves only 70.4\% on single-hop endpoint-style tasks and drops to 50--51\% on compositional APIs; performance degrades by over 50\% as reasoning depth increases, and policy-constrained questions expose severe failures (as low as 2.4\% on unanswerable queries). Trace analysis shows failures concentrate at language-mediated reasoning - entity disambiguation, cross-source grounding, rather than tool invocation mechanics. Code is available https://github.com/IBM/VAKRA. Dataset is available https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/VAKRA
tldr: VAKRA is a benchmark for evaluating multi-hop reasoning across APIs and retrieval under tool-use policies, showing that even the best models struggle with compositional and policy-constrained tasks.
abstract_cn: 在企业环境中部署的智能体必须在结构化API与文档集合之间进行推理，然而现有基准测试往往将这两类能力割裂评估。我们提出VAKRA（评估API与知识检索智能体），这是一个涵盖62个领域、包含超过8000个可执行API的基准测试，其任务跨越三种难度递增的场景：多样化的API交互风格、结构化API上的多跳推理，以及结合自然语言工具使用策略约束的多源推理。正确性通过针对实时API重新执行预测的工具调用来验证，并兼容多种有效路径。我们采用固定的ReAct框架以隔离模型能力与智能体架构的影响，评估了前沿模型与开源模型，发现即便最优模型在单跳端点式任务上的准确率也仅为70.4%，在组合式API任务上则降至50–51%；随着推理深度增加，性能下降超过50%，而策略约束型问题则暴露出严重缺陷（在不可回答查询上准确率低至2.4%）。轨迹分析表明，失败主要集中在语言中介的推理环节——实体消歧、跨源信息锚定，而非工具调用机制本身。代码已开源：https://github.com/IBM/VAKRA。数据集已公开：https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/VAKRA

title: Structural Silence: When AI Infrastructure Fails Speakers of Underrepresented Languages
abstract:
Artificial intelligence tools for education and language support are increasingly framed as scalable responses to access gaps in under-resourced communities. Yet the infrastructure underlying these tools, including training corpora, tokenization schemes, evaluation benchmarks, and deployment architectures, can systematically disadvantage speakers of underrepresented languages before a model is trained.
  This paper examines these structural barriers through Bengali, one of the world's most widely spoken languages, focusing on AI-assisted education in low-connectivity environments. We identify four interlocking failures: a severe web presence gap, with Bengali accounting for less than 0.5% of global web content despite representing nearly 4% of the global population; a 67:1 training-token deficit between English and Bengali in major multilingual corpora; a tokenization penalty associated with Bengali's alphasyllabary script that compounds the data deficit through higher token fertility; and connectivity exclusion, with individual internet penetration at 36.5% in rural areas compared with 71.4% in urban areas.
  These failures reflect longstanding resource-allocation decisions, institutional priorities, and design defaults that did not center underrepresented languages in mainstream AI development. We argue that dataset scarcity should be understood as a structural barrier rather than an isolated technical limitation, and that offline-first design should be treated as an equity-oriented infrastructure strategy. We conclude with directions for linguistics and AI research aimed at reducing these structural inequalities.
tldr: 该论文探讨了AI基础设施如何系统性边缘化低资源语言使用者，以孟加拉语为例揭示了数据、tokenization和连接性方面的结构性不平等，并提出了面向公平的离线优先设计策略。
abstract_cn:
用于教育和语言支持的人工智能工具日益被视为应对资源匮乏社区获取差距的可扩展解决方案。然而，支撑这些工具的基础设施，包括训练语料库、分词方案、评估基准和部署架构，可能在模型训练之前就系统性地使使用人数较少的语言使用者处于不利地位。

本文通过孟加拉语——世界上使用最广泛的语言之一——来审视这些结构性障碍，重点关注低连接环境下的AI辅助教育。我们识别出四个相互关联的失效环节：严重的网络存在差距，孟加拉语占全球人口近4%，却仅占全球网络内容的不到0.5%；主要多语言语料库中英语与孟加拉语之间67:1的训练词元差距；与孟加拉语元音附标文字相关的分词惩罚，该文字通过更高的词元繁殖率加剧了数据赤字；以及连接性排斥，农村地区个人互联网普及率为36.5%，而城市地区为71.4%。

这些失效反映了长期以来的资源分配决策、制度优先事项和设计默认值，这些因素未将使用人数较少的语言置于主流AI发展的中心位置。我们认为，数据集稀缺应被理解为一种结构性障碍，而非孤立的技术局限，并且离线优先设计应被视为一种以公平为导向的基础设施策略。最后，我们提出旨在减少这些结构性不平等的语言学和AI研究方向。

title: A Neighborhood Attention Transformer Network for Enhanced 3D Segmentation of the Left Anterior Descending Artery
abstract: Background: Accurate segmentation of the Left Anterior Descending (LAD) artery in 3D free-breathing, non-contrast CT is critical for cardiac dose sparing in thoracic radiotherapy. The LAD is extremely small, has poor soft-tissue contrast, and varies substantially across patients; even manual contours show limited inter-observer agreement, underscoring the ambiguity of the vessel boundaries. Purpose: To develop a transformer-based framework that improves LAD delineation in low-contrast, imbalanced CT through local-global context modeling and uncertainty-guided optimization. Methods: We propose NA-UNETR, a 3D transformer-based segmentation model whose Neighborhood Attention (NA) and Dilated NA (DiNA) blocks jointly capture fine structural detail and long-range context. Given the scarcity of annotated LAD data, the model is pretrained on 1,000 CTA volumes of general coronary anatomy and fine-tuned with LoRA-based parameter-efficient adaptation on 20 free-breathing institutional CT scans. A composite Dice-Focal and Hausdorff loss, dynamically balanced via homoscedastic uncertainty, improves overlap and boundary accuracy. Results: NA-UNETR reached 45.64% Dice, 38.16 mm HD95, and 10.01 mm ASD, improving Dice by 3.10 percentage points over nnU-Net and reducing HD95 by 2.96 mm relative to Swin UNETR, with the strongest boundary accuracy among all models and improved centerline stability. On ImageCAS it achieved 79.49% Dice, 8.89 mm HD95, and 1.02 mm ASD. Ablations confirmed that residual blocks, variable kernels, and uncertainty-weighted loss each contributed. Conclusions: NA-UNETR balances local precision and global context for thin, low-contrast LAD structures, offering a computationally efficient framework for substructure-level cardiac segmentation in radiotherapy planning.
tldr: The paper proposes a neighborhood attention transformer network (NA-UNETR) for enhanced 3D segmentation of the left anterior descending artery in CT images, achieving improved Dice and boundary accuracy compared to existing methods.
abstract_cn: 背景：在三维自由呼吸、非增强CT中对左前降支（Left Anterior Descending, LAD）动脉进行精确分割，对于胸部放疗中的心脏剂量保护至关重要。LAD血管极为细小，软组织对比度差，且在不同患者间差异显著；即使由人工勾画，观察者间一致性也有限，这凸显了血管边界本身的模糊性。目的：开发一种基于Transformer的框架，通过局部-全局上下文建模和不确定性引导优化，提升低对比度、类别不平衡条件下LAD的分割性能。方法：我们提出NA-UNETR，一种基于Transformer的三维分割模型，其邻域注意力（Neighborhood Attention, NA）和膨胀邻域注意力（Dilated NA, DiNA）模块共同捕捉精细结构细节与长程上下文信息。鉴于LAD标注数据稀缺，模型先在1,000例包含通用冠状动脉解剖结构的CTA体数据上进行预训练，随后通过基于LoRA的参数高效微调策略，在20例自由呼吸的机构内CT扫描数据上进行适配。采用由Dice-Focal损失与Hausdorff损失组成的复合损失函数，并通过同方差不确定性进行动态平衡，以提升重叠率与边界精度。结果：NA-UNETR取得了45.64%的Dice系数、38.16 mm的HD95和10.01 mm的ASD，相较于nnU-Net将Dice提升了3.10个百分点，相较于Swin UNETR将HD95降低了2.96 mm，在所有模型中展现出最强的边界精度和更优的中心线稳定性。在ImageCAS数据集上，其Dice达到79.49%，HD95为8.89 mm，ASD为1.02 mm。消融实验证实，残差块、可变卷积核以及不确定性加权损失均对性能提升有所贡献。结论：NA-UNETR在细薄、低对比度的LAD结构分割中实现了局部精度与全局上下文的平衡，为放疗计划中的亚结构级心脏分割提供了一种计算高效的框架。

title: Convergent Detour Hijacking: Task-Preserving Resource Amplification in Skill-Based LLM Agents
abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on third-party skills, using natural-language descriptions for selection and instruction bodies for planning. This progressive-disclosure design exposes two sequential control points to untrusted publishers: a static skill may steer an otherwise correct task onto an unnecessarily costly trajectory. Prior work studies selection manipulation, malicious skill instructions, and tool-chain resource amplification largely separately, leaving their end-to-end composition unclear. We introduce Convergent Detour Hijacking (CDH), a text-only, runtime-independent attack that couples these stages. Under shared semantic cover, a description establishes relevance during selection, while an aligned body reuses that rationale to fabricate plausible dependencies during planning. CDH attracts an attacker-controlled coordinator alongside legitimate skills, recruits unnecessary benign skills into a bounded detour, and then re-enters the original route to preserve task completion. We evaluate it across multiple LLM backends and 491 held-out tasks under single-task and multi-turn conditions. On DeepSeek-V4-Pro, the matched coordinator is selected in 80.02% of tasks; among coordinator-hit runs that complete tasks, token consumption and end-to-end execution time increase by 66.91% and 92.45%, respectively, while aggregate task completion remains comparable. Thus, correct outcomes do not guarantee trajectory integrity or cost safety.
tldr: The paper introduces Convergent Detour Hijacking, a text-only attack on LLM agents that inflates resource usage while preserving task completion, demonstrating that correct outcomes do not guarantee trajectory integrity.
abstract_cn: LLM智能体日益依赖第三方技能，通过自然语言描述进行选择，并依据指令主体进行规划。这种渐进式披露设计向不可信的发布者暴露了两个顺序控制点：一个静态技能可能将原本正确的任务引导至不必要的高成本轨迹上。先前的研究大多分别探讨了选择操纵、恶意技能指令以及工具链资源放大问题，而未明确其端到端的组合效应。我们提出了一种名为“收敛性绕行劫持”（Convergent Detour Hijacking, CDH）的攻击方法，这是一种纯文本、运行时无关的攻击，将上述阶段耦合起来。在共享语义掩护下，描述在技能选择阶段建立相关性，而对齐的指令主体则在规划阶段复用该理由以制造看似合理的依赖关系。CDH将攻击者控制的协调器技能与合法技能一同吸引进来，招募不必要的良性技能进入一个有界的绕行路径，然后重新进入原始路线以保持任务完成。我们在多个LLM后端以及491个保留任务上，在单任务和多轮条件下进行了评估。在DeepSeek-V4-Pro上，匹配的协调器在80.02%的任务中被选中；在协调器命中且完成任务的运行中，令牌消耗和端到端执行时间分别增加了66.91%和92.45%，而总体任务完成率保持相当。因此，正确的结果并不能保证轨迹的完整性或成本的安全性。

title: Diagram-MMU: A Multi-Modal Benchmark for Scientific Diagrams
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been growing the capability for scientific writing and collaboration. For example, OpenAI Prism is a free workspace for scientific writing and collaboration. One important feature in Prism is turning scientific diagrams directly into LaTeX TikZ code. In this paper, we build a benchmark, Diagram-MMU, a multi-modal benchmark designed to assess MLLMs' ability for scientific diagram parsing and understanding. Diagram-MMU features 3.7k curated diagrams and 18.3k human-validated questions across six domains. It evaluates MLLMs on three tasks common in vibe writing workspaces: diagram-to-code parsing, diagram-to-code editing, and diagram question answering, alongside agentic settings per task. The evaluation of 12 MLLMs reveals that diagram-to-code tasks are more challenging than diagram question answering: models can reason well over diagrams but struggle to parse and edit them, underscoring the need for methods to enhance MLLMs' capability in diagram-to-code generation. Under agentic settings, most models improve parsing and editing performance but degrade on question answering, while Claude-4.6 Opus consistently improves across all three tasks. Project Page: https://vi-ocean.github.io/projects/diagram-mmu.
tldr: 该论文构建了一个名为Diagram-MMU的多模态基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在科学图表解析、编辑和问答任务上的能力，发现模型在图表到代码生成方面表现较弱，而智能体设置能提升解析和编辑性能。
abstract_cn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在科学写作与协作方面的能力持续增强。例如，OpenAI Prism 是一个用于科学写作与协作的免费工作空间，其重要功能之一是将科学图表直接转换为 LaTeX TikZ 代码。本文构建了一个名为 Diagram-MMU 的多模态基准，旨在评估 MLLMs 在科学图表解析与理解方面的能力。Diagram-MMU 包含 3.7 千张精选图表和 18.3 千条人工验证的问题，覆盖六个领域。该基准在三种常见的“氛围写作”工作空间任务上评估 MLLMs：图表到代码解析（diagram-to-code parsing）、图表到代码编辑（diagram-to-code editing）以及图表问答（diagram question answering），并针对每项任务设置了智能体（agentic）场景。对 12 个 MLLMs 的评估显示，图表到代码任务比图表问答更具挑战性：模型能够较好地理解图表内容，但在解析和编辑图表方面存在困难，这凸显了增强 MLLMs 图表到代码生成能力的必要性。在智能体场景下，大多数模型在解析和编辑任务上表现提升，但在问答任务上有所下降，而 Claude-4.6 Opus 在所有三项任务上均持续改进。项目页面：https://vi-ocean.github.io/projects/diagram-mmu。

title: An Agentic Workflow for Legacy HPC Modernization: Converting the Two-Electron-Integral Core of GAMESS
abstract:
Modernizing legacy Fortran is a problem of volume: the transformations are individually routine, but the codebases can be enormous, and across much of computational science the work simply goes undone. We propose an agentic workflow that takes this work on at production scale, and we set out to measure how far such delegation can reach. In this work, three prompt-specialized agent roles operate under a version-controlled specification that the agents themselves authored and revised, while humans hold a small number of gates. The arrangement is kept safe by an exact verification oracle inherited from the domain, and the boundary of safe delegation lies exactly where that oracle stops seeing.
  We apply the proposed workflow in a case study, converting the two-electron-integral routines of GAMESS (General Atomic and Molecular Electronic Structure System), a mature quantum-chemistry package with a 48-year development history, from fixed-form Fortran 77 to free-form Fortran 2008. The scope of this work was twelve source files, 56,448 lines, and 225 subroutines for computing electron repulsion integrals. The agents ran as three Claude Code roles in isolated worktrees, and the work spanned four Claude model generations. Because the GAMESS group ships a standard test suite whose printed energies its user community treats as canonical, we could adopt bit-for-bit reproduction of those energies as the merge criterion, where a deviation in the twelfth decimal place counts as a failure rather than drift. All twelve source files pass a 51-test validation battery comprising the 49 standard GAMESS tests and two additional calculations, and across 612 test runs the number of chemistry-relevant differences is zero, and every file also passes the Jenkins tests that are used for continuous integration.
tldr: The paper proposes an agentic workflow using LLM-based agents to convert legacy Fortran code in GAMESS to modern Fortran, achieving bit-for-bit reproducibility of test results.
abstract_cn:
将遗留的Fortran代码现代化是一个规模问题：各项转换本身是常规操作，但代码库可能极其庞大，而在计算科学的许多领域中，这项工作往往被搁置。我们提出了一种能够以生产规模承担此任务的智能体工作流，并着手衡量这种委派能达到何种程度。在本研究中，三个针对提示词专门化的智能体角色在一个版本控制的规范下运作，该规范由智能体自身编写和修订，而人类仅掌握少量关键节点。该安排通过源自领域内的精确验证预言机来确保安全，而安全委派的边界恰好止于该预言机无法覆盖之处。

我们将所提出的工作流应用于一个案例研究，将GAMESS（通用原子与分子电子结构系统）——一个拥有48年开发历史的成熟量子化学软件包——的双电子积分例程从固定格式的Fortran 77转换为自由格式的Fortran 2008。本工作范围涵盖十二个源文件、56,448行代码以及用于计算电子排斥积分的225个子程序。智能体以三个Claude Code角色在隔离的工作树中运行，工作跨越了四代Claude模型。由于GAMESS团队发布了一套标准测试套件，其输出的能量值被用户社区视为权威基准，我们因此采用这些能量的逐位精确复现作为合并标准，其中第十二位小数的偏差即被视为失败而非漂移。所有十二个源文件均通过了包含49项标准GAMESS测试及两项额外计算的51项验证测试组，在612次测试运行中，与化学相关的差异数量为零，且每个文件也通过了用于持续集成的Jenkins测试。

title: VICBench: A Multi-Language Benchmark for Code Vulnerability Detection
abstract: Evaluating security vulnerability detection tools requires benchmark datasets with vulnerability-inducing commits (VICs) - the commits that first introduce vulnerabilities into codebases. VICs are essential for determining the full range of vulnerable software versions. Existing vulnerability datasets suffer from limited programming language coverage, restricted patch complexity, and narrow project scope. Through our dual annotation by human experts and an agentic workflow, we create a benchmark - VICBench - of 100 verified VICs for 100 CVEs across 88 projects in Python, Java, and C++, covering 48 CWE types. VICBench features complex real-world vulnerability fixes averaging 38.6 lines and corresponding VICs of 252.5 lines - significantly larger than prior work. Our evaluation shows that state-of-the-art algorithms V-SZZ and LLM4SZZ achieve only 33.3%-40.1% F1, confirming that using existing approaches still entails significant manual effort. VICBench enables robust evaluation of vulnerability detection approaches.
tldr: The paper introduces VICBench, a multi-language benchmark for code vulnerability detection, and evaluates existing detection methods, showing they achieve low F1 scores.
abstract_cn: 评估安全漏洞检测工具需要包含漏洞引入提交（VICs）的基准数据集——这些提交是首次将漏洞引入代码库的提交。VICs对于确定所有易受攻击的软件版本至关重要。现有的漏洞数据集存在编程语言覆盖有限、补丁复杂度受限以及项目范围狭窄等问题。通过人类专家与代理工作流的双重标注，我们构建了一个基准数据集——VICBench，其中包含88个项目中100个CVE对应的100个经过验证的VICs，涵盖Python、Java和C++三种编程语言，覆盖48种CWE类型。VICBench具有复杂的真实世界漏洞修复，平均修复规模为38.6行，对应的VICs平均为252.5行——显著大于先前的工作。我们的评估表明，最先进的算法V-SZZ和LLM4SZZ仅达到33.3%-40.1%的F1分数，证实使用现有方法仍需大量人工投入。VICBench能够支持对漏洞检测方法进行稳健的评估。

title: HAMP-LIC: Hessian-Aware Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Learned Image Compression
abstract: Use this plain-text version for the arXiv abstract field: Learned image compression (LIC) models achieve strong rate-distortion performance but are hindered by high computational complexity and encoding-decoding mismatches across heterogeneous hardware platforms. Uniform fixed-precision quantization alleviates these issues but suffers severe quality degradation at low bit widths because it ignores differences in the quantization sensitivities of individual layers. To enable efficient and accurate low-bit deployment of pretrained LIC models, we propose HAMP-LIC, a Hessian-aware mixed-precision post-training quantization (PTQ) framework with a four-stage optimization strategy. First, block-wise sensitivity is estimated from the Hessian trace to capture second-order importance. Second, a task-aware refinement module adjusts these sensitivities by jointly considering quantization distortion and rate-distortion performance. Third, guided by the refined sensitivity profile, bit widths are allocated under a global model-size constraint to balance efficiency and reconstruction quality. Finally, block-wise reconstruction using a small calibration set further suppresses quantization error. Experiments on representative LIC models, including Minnen2018 and Cheng2020, demonstrate that HAMP-LIC achieves up to 4.85x model compression with as little as 0.59% BD-rate loss. It consistently outperforms existing fixed- and mixed-precision PTQ methods across multiple datasets while completely eliminating cross-platform encoding-decoding errors.
tldr: The paper proposes HAMP-LIC, a Hessian-aware mixed-precision post-training quantization framework for learned image compression, achieving up to 4.85x model compression with minimal BD-rate loss.
abstract_cn: 学习型图像压缩（LIC）模型在率失真性能上表现出色，但受限于高计算复杂度以及异构硬件平台上的编码-解码不匹配问题。统一固定精度量化虽能缓解上述问题，但在低位宽下因忽略各层量化敏感性的差异，会导致严重的质量退化。为实现预训练LIC模型的高效且精确的低比特部署，我们提出HAMP-LIC，一种基于Hessian感知的混合精度训练后量化（PTQ）框架，并采用四阶段优化策略。首先，通过Hessian迹估计块级敏感性，以捕捉二阶重要性信息。其次，任务感知细化模块通过联合考虑量化失真与率失真性能来调整这些敏感性。第三，在细化后的敏感性分布指导下，在全局模型大小约束下分配位宽，以平衡效率与重建质量。最后，利用小型校准集进行块级重建，进一步抑制量化误差。在代表性LIC模型（包括Minnen2018和Cheng2020）上的实验表明，HAMP-LIC在仅损失0.59% BD-rate的情况下，实现了最高4.85倍的模型压缩。在多个数据集上，它持续优于现有的固定精度和混合精度PTQ方法，同时完全消除了跨平台的编码-解码误差。

title: How Organizations Use AI: Evidence from ChatGPT
abstract: We study how organizations use frontier generative AI by linking ChatGPT Enterprise account records to usage, worker roles, task classifications, and public-company financial data through March 2026. These linked data enable a privacy-preserving analysis of adoption, worker roles, and message-level tasks at scale: for instance, the worker-level sample we analyze at the six-month adoption horizon includes over 1,500 organizations and over 17 million messages. We document four facts about enterprise AI adoption and use. First, ChatGPT Enterprise usage has grown rapidly due to a combination of new firm adoption and growing intensity among existing adopters. Second, U.S.-based public company adoption is concentrated among larger, more valuable, and more R&D- and SG&A-intensive firms. Third, active use within adopting firms spans job functions and seniority levels, with especially high usage intensity among early-career workers. Fourth, ChatGPT Enterprise usage encompasses a broad range of knowledge work tasks, including writing, technical work, communication, and information synthesis. In aggregate, these results suggest that firms differ widely in the speed, breadth and purpose of their enterprise AI adoption, and that they are still actively learning how to integrate AI into organizational workflows.
tldr: This paper studies how organizations adopt and use ChatGPT Enterprise, finding that adoption is concentrated among larger, more R&D-intensive firms, usage spans job functions and seniority levels, and tasks include writing, technical work, communication, and information synthesis.
abstract_cn: 我们通过将ChatGPT Enterprise账户记录与使用情况、员工角色、任务分类以及截至2026年3月的上市公司财务数据相关联，研究组织如何使用前沿生成式AI。这些关联数据使得我们能够在规模化层面进行保护隐私的采用情况、员工角色及消息级任务分析：例如，在六个月采用时间窗口内，我们分析的员工级样本涵盖超过1,500家组织和超过1,700万条消息。我们记录了关于企业AI采用与使用的四个事实。第一，ChatGPT Enterprise的使用增长迅速，这既源于新企业的采用，也源于现有采用者使用强度的不断提升。第二，美国上市公司的采用集中于规模更大、市值更高、研发及销售与管理费用（SG&A）投入更密集的企业。第三，采用企业内部的实际使用跨越了职能和职级，其中早期职业阶段员工的使用强度尤为突出。第四，ChatGPT Enterprise的使用涵盖了广泛的知识工作任务，包括写作、技术工作、沟通和信息综合。总体而言，这些结果表明，企业在企业AI采用的速度、广度和目的上存在显著差异，并且它们仍在积极探索如何将AI整合到组织工作流程中。

title: Few-Shot Ordinal Learning for Day-Wise Freshness Estimation with Hyperspectral Fish Images
abstract: Non-destructive food quality assessment has increasingly benefited from hyperspectral imaging (HSI), which captures spectral signatures linked to biochemical changes during storage. Estimating day-wise freshness, however, remains challenging owing to strong inter-fillet variability and scarce labelled data per product. All existing deep learning approaches for HSI-based freshness prediction operate under full supervision, requiring densely annotated training sets that are costly to obtain at the individual-product level. We introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first few-shot learning framework for HSI-based food quality estimation. Each fillet defines a distinct episodic task, and a CORAL-style ordinal prediction head captures the ranked nature of freshness progression through cumulative threshold modelling. Biologically grounded monotonicity and embedding smoothness constraints further guide predictions toward plausible trajectories. On a 16-day salmon HSI dataset under a strict unseen-fillet protocol, our method achieves a mean absolute error of 1.58 days and 2-day accuracy of 72.3% with only three labelled days per fillet, substantially outperforming scalar regression and label-distribution baselines under an identical unseen-fillet protocol.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于高光谱图像的少样本序数学习框架，用于估计鱼类逐日新鲜度，在16天鲑鱼数据集上实现了平均绝对误差1.58天和2天准确率72.3%。
abstract_cn: 非破坏性食品质量评估日益受益于高光谱成像（HSI）技术，该技术能够捕获与储存期间生化变化相关的光谱特征。然而，由于鱼片间存在显著的变异性以及每个产品上标注数据稀缺，按天估算新鲜度仍具挑战性。现有所有基于HSI的新鲜度预测深度学习方法均在完全监督下运行，需要密集标注的训练集，而在单个产品层面获取此类标注成本高昂。我们首次提出了，据我们所知，一种基于HSI的食品质量估计的小样本学习框架。每个鱼片定义了一个独特的情景任务，且采用CORAL风格的序数预测头，通过累积阈值建模捕捉新鲜度进程的排序特性。生物学上合理的单调性约束和嵌入平滑性约束进一步引导预测朝向合理的轨迹。在严格的未见鱼片协议下，基于16天鲑鱼HSI数据集，我们的方法在每片仅使用三个标注日的情况下，实现了1.58天的平均绝对误差和72.3%的2天准确率，在相同的未见鱼片协议下显著优于标量回归和标签分布基线方法。

title: Domain-Aware Lightweight Spectral-Grouped Convolutions for Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Classification
abstract: Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) offers nondestructive assessment of fish freshness by detecting biochemical alterations across spectral bands. However, conventional deep learning approaches do not fully address the particular characteristics of HSI data, such as spectral dominance over spatial textures, ordinal label structure, and a small number of training samples. We propose SGNet (Spectral-Grouped Network), a lightweight architecture that separates spectral and spatial feature extraction using grouped convolutions and a depthwise spatial pathway. A dual attention mechanism that couples channel-wise squeeze-and-excitation with spatial gating adaptively highlights informative features. SGNet achieves 97.8% classification accuracy and 0.64 days mean absolute error (MAE) with just 4.75M parameters when tested on our newly developed 16-day refrigerator-stored salmon fillet dataset. Ablation studies validate the contribution of each component, while comparisons demonstrate a five- to eighteen-fold parameter reduction relative to ResNet-50 and Vision Transformers. Our findings indicate that domain-aware design supports precise, real-time freshness prediction for industrial implementation.
tldr: The paper proposes SGNet, a lightweight spectral-grouped convolutional network for fish freshness classification using hyperspectral imaging, achieving high accuracy with reduced parameters.
abstract_cn: 高光谱成像（HSI）通过检测光谱波段中的生化变化，能够对鱼类新鲜度进行无损评估。然而，传统的深度学习方法并未充分应对高光谱数据的特有特征，例如光谱信息对空间纹理的主导性、标签的有序结构以及训练样本数量有限等问题。我们提出了SGNet（光谱分组网络），一种轻量级架构，通过分组卷积和深度可分离空间路径将光谱与空间特征提取分离。一种将通道级压缩-激励与空间门控相结合的双重注意力机制，能够自适应地突出信息丰富的特征。在我们新构建的为期16天冰箱储存的三文鱼鱼片数据集上测试时，SGNet实现了97.8%的分类准确率和0.64天的平均绝对误差（MAE），且仅需4.75M参数。消融研究验证了各组件的贡献，而对比实验表明，相较于ResNet-50和视觉Transformer，参数数量减少了五到十八倍。我们的研究结果表明，领域感知设计能够支持精确、实时的新鲜度预测，适用于工业实施。

title: SCOUT: Unlocking Enhanced Spatial Reasoning via Structured Chain-of-Thought and Multi-Objective Process Reward
abstract: Existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibits a critical bottleneck in robust spatial reasoning. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) methods aim to close this gap with verifiable outcomes, yet they suffer from poor credit assignment across intermediate reasoning steps. Concurrently, structured reasoning approaches overlook the critical depth perception necessary for comprehensive 3D understanding. To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT (Structured Chain-Of-Thought Utilizing Process-Supervised RL Training). Specifically, we design a structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) framework that explicitly models 3D environmental perception to ensure robust spatial understanding and reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a novel RL algorithm featuring multi-objective process rewards and a tailored advantage estimation method, facilitating fine-grained credit assignment across distinct segments of the reasoning trajectory. To support our framework, we develop SCOUT-24k, a structured spatial reasoning CoT dataset synthesized through a customized pipeline. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SCOUT-3B improves upon baseline models by 16.85% and 6.3% on general spatial benchmarks and complex spatial reasoning tasks respectively. Notably, our larger SCOUT-7B even outperforms GPT-4o by a margin of 4.28%. Moreover, despite being trained exclusively on single image, SCOUT-7B exhibits robust out-of-domain generalization to multi-image and video scenarios. These empirical results render SCOUT as a critical step towards next generation of spatially-aware VLMs.
tldr: The paper proposes SCOUT, a structured Chain-of-Thought and multi-objective process reward RL method to enhance spatial reasoning in VLMs, achieving significant improvements over baselines and GPT-4o.
abstract_cn: 现有的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在稳健的空间推理方面表现出关键瓶颈。最近的强化学习（RL）方法旨在通过可验证的结果来缩小这一差距，但它们在中间推理步骤中面临信用分配不佳的问题。与此同时，结构化推理方法忽视了全面3D理解所必需的深度感知。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了SCOUT（利用过程监督的RL训练的结构化思维链）。具体而言，我们设计了一个结构化思维链（CoT）框架，显式建模3D环境感知，以确保稳健的空间理解和推理。此外，我们引入了一种新颖的RL算法，具备多目标过程奖励和定制化的优势估计方法，从而促进推理轨迹不同部分之间的细粒度信用分配。为支持我们的框架，我们通过定制化流程合成了SCOUT-24k，一个结构化空间推理CoT数据集。大量评估表明，SCOUT-3B在通用空间基准和复杂空间推理任务上分别比基线模型提升了16.85%和6.3%。值得注意的是，我们更大的SCOUT-7B甚至以4.28%的优势超越了GPT-4o。此外，尽管仅在单图像上训练，SCOUT-7B在多图像和视频场景中展现出强大的域外泛化能力。这些实证结果使SCOUT成为迈向下一代空间感知VLM的关键一步。

title: Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge
abstract: Large language models are increasingly trained and deployed with long contexts that span documents, code repositories, and interaction histories. This scaling reflects the implicit assumption that training on longer contexts will only help the model by exposing it to richer evidence. We challenge this view by studying how the context window shapes a model's mode of learning, shifting it between parametric internalization and contextualization. We propose the Information Abundance Paradox, which hypothesizes that abundant relevant information in the training context can reduce the incentive to encode that information parametrically, thereby increasing reliance on context. In pretraining with long documents, increasing the context window improves language modeling, natural language understanding, and closed-book MCQA only up to an intermediate optimum, after which performance consistently declines. In supervised fine-tuning, more task-relevant train-time context improves performance with supporting context, but reduces robustness when context is absent or misleading at test time. Our analysis suggests that this behavior arises when longer context provides a lower complexity solution. Mechanistically, training with informative context shifts gradient pressure from feed-forward networks, often linked to parametric knowledge, toward attention modules, and causal interventions show that this shift increases reliance on context during inference. Overall, these findings support the Information Abundance Paradox and suggest that scaling toward near-infinite context is not simply a matter of supplying more data, even when high-quality long-context data is abundant.
tldr: The paper proposes the Information Abundance Paradox, showing that training LLMs with longer contexts can reduce parametric knowledge encoding and hurt performance when context is absent or misleading, challenging the assumption that more context is always beneficial.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型越来越多地被训练和部署于跨越文档、代码库和交互历史的长上下文环境中。这种扩展反映了一种隐含假设，即基于更长上下文的训练只会通过向模型提供更丰富的证据而对其有所帮助。我们通过研究上下文窗口如何塑造模型的学习模式，使其在参数化内化与情境化之间切换，来挑战这一观点。我们提出“信息丰裕悖论”，该悖论假设训练上下文中大量相关信息会降低模型以参数化方式编码这些信息的动机，从而增加对上下文的依赖。在使用长文档进行预训练时，增加上下文窗口仅在达到一个中间最优值之前能改善语言建模、自然语言理解和闭卷多项选择问答的性能，超过该最优值后性能持续下降。在监督微调中，更多与任务相关的训练时上下文能提升在有支持性上下文情况下的表现，但在测试时上下文缺失或具有误导性时，则会降低鲁棒性。我们的分析表明，当较长上下文提供了一种更低复杂度的解决方案时，这种行为便会出现。从机制上看，使用信息丰富的上下文进行训练会将梯度压力从前馈网络（通常与参数化知识相关）转向注意力模块，而因果干预实验表明，这种转变增加了推理过程中对上下文的依赖。总体而言，这些发现支持了信息丰裕悖论，并表明向近乎无限的上下文扩展并非仅仅是提供更多数据的问题，即使高质量的长上下文数据十分充裕也是如此。

title: NetlistBench: Evaluating LLM Reliability in SPICE Netlist Recognition and Manipulation
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in circuit design workflows, yet their reliability on simulator-facing SPICE netlist recognition and manipulation remains poorly understood and is rarely separated from high-level design reasoning. Although netlists are textual, they encode structured circuit objects through topology and parameters. We present \textbf{NetlistBench}, a structure-verified benchmark for SPICE netlist recognition and manipulation. NetlistBench contains 2,342 cases across 24 task families, covering parameter and connectivity recognition and edits, hierarchical operations, equivalence judgment, and long-horizon compound editing. Model outputs are evaluated by a deterministic structure-aware oracle. Across six non-thinking LLMs, performance varies substantially with operation-level structural complexity. Simple local edits reach $96\%$--$100\%$ accuracy, while device addition drops to $41\%$--$83\%$ and equivalence judgment to $49\%$--$90\%$. Enabling reasoning substantially improves weaker models but does not eliminate structure-preservation failures, with performance still degrading sharply as the edit horizon increases. NetlistBench identifies netlist reliability as a distinct bottleneck for trustworthy LLM-based circuit design automation.
tldr: The paper introduces NetlistBench, a benchmark to evaluate LLM reliability in SPICE netlist recognition and manipulation, revealing that performance varies with structural complexity and reasoning improves but does not eliminate failures.
abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在电路设计流程中的应用日益广泛，但其在面向仿真器的SPICE网表识别与操作方面的可靠性仍缺乏深入理解，且很少与高层设计推理相分离。尽管网表是文本形式的，但它们通过拓扑结构和参数编码了结构化的电路对象。我们提出了\textbf{NetlistBench}，一个用于SPICE网表识别与操作的结构化验证基准。NetlistBench包含24个任务族下的2,342个案例，涵盖参数与连接性识别及编辑、层次化操作、等价性判断以及长时程复合编辑。模型输出由确定性的结构感知预言机进行评估。在六种非推理型LLMs中，性能随操作级结构复杂度显著变化。简单的局部编辑准确率达到$96\%$--$100\%$，而器件添加降至$41\%$--$83\%$，等价性判断降至$49\%$--$90\%$。启用推理功能可显著提升较弱模型的表现，但并未消除结构保持失败的问题，且随着编辑时程的增加，性能仍急剧下降。NetlistBench将网表可靠性识别为基于LLM的可信电路设计自动化中的一个独立瓶颈。

title: M-Net: Integrating Spectral Features and Physical Field Operators into Deep Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: Purpose: Deep learning-based medical image segmentation has achieved remarkable success, yet purely data-driven approaches often fail to exploit the rich mathematical structure inherent in medical images. We investigate whether explicit mathematical inductive biases, specifically matrix spectral analysis and vector calculus operators, can enhance segmentation beyond data-driven learning alone. Methods: We propose M-Net (Math-Augmented Network), which integrates three complementary mathematical priors into U-Net: (1) continuous spectral features derived from the condition number of centered local pixel matrices, providing a differentiable measure of texture ill-conditioning; (2) physical field operators (divergence and a discrete curl-like boundary irregularity operator) computed from image gradient fields, capturing focal intensity extrema and edge non-smoothness; and (3) a Math-Attention Gate (MAG) that adaptively fuses mathematical features with CNN-extracted deep features at skip connections. Results: Experiments on three benchmarks (LiTS, KiTS, and BraTS) show that M-Net achieves Dice scores of 78.42%, 76.15%, and 83.67%, outperforming baseline U-Net by 12.37%, 3.52%, and 5.55% on liver, kidney, and brain tumor segmentation, respectively. Ablations reveal that the condition-number feature contributes a 2.14% gain over binary invertibility features, while MAG adds 1.45% over simple concatenation. Conclusion: M-Net establishes that mathematical inductive biases provide effective complementary information for medical image segmentation. The continuous condition-number feature offers superior gradient information over discrete alternatives, and MAG preserves these priors throughout the network. This work opens avenues for integrating linear algebra and vector calculus into deep architectures for medical imaging.
tldr: The paper proposes M-Net, a deep learning model that integrates spectral features and physical field operators into U-Net for medical image segmentation, achieving improved Dice scores on liver, kidney, and brain tumor datasets.
abstract_cn: 目的：基于深度学习的医学图像分割已取得显著成功，然而纯数据驱动的方法往往未能充分利用医学图像中固有的丰富数学结构。我们研究显式的数学归纳偏置，特别是矩阵谱分析和向量微积分算子，是否能在数据驱动学习之外进一步提升分割性能。方法：我们提出M-Net（数学增强网络），将三种互补的数学先验集成到U-Net中：（1）基于中心化局部像素矩阵条件数的连续谱特征，提供纹理病态性的可微度量；（2）由图像梯度场计算的物理场算子（散度和类离散旋度的边界不规则性算子），捕捉局灶性强度极值和边缘非平滑性；（3）数学注意力门（MAG），在跳跃连接处自适应地将数学特征与CNN提取的深度特征融合。结果：在三个基准数据集（LiTS、KiTS和BraTS）上的实验表明，M-Net在肝脏、肾脏和脑肿瘤分割上的Dice分数分别达到78.42%、76.15%和83.67%，较基线U-Net分别提升12.37%、3.52%和5.55%。消融实验显示，条件数特征相较于二值可逆性特征带来2.14%的提升，而MAG相较于简单拼接额外增加1.45%的增益。结论：M-Net证明数学归纳偏置为医学图像分割提供了有效的互补信息。连续条件数特征相较于离散替代方案具有更优的梯度信息，且MAG在整个网络中保留了这些先验。本研究为将线性代数和向量微积分集成到医学影像深度架构中开辟了新途径。

title: Machine Learning-Based Cyber Defense for Cloud Infrastructure: An Adaptive Deep Q-Network Architecture for Intelligent Intrusion Detection and Automated Threat Mitigation
abstract: With the increasing complexity of cyber assaults in cloud environments, adaptable security solutions are needed that can support real-time detection and autonomous response. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning-based dynamic cyber defense framework. We deploy a Deep Q-Network (DQN) to train effective defensive strategies to counteract the evolving cyberattacks. We leverage the CICIDS2017 dataset for model creation and the UNSW-NB15 dataset for external validation, involving preprocessing of data, feature engineering, and adaptive policy learning. We compare the proposed DQN with decision tree, support vector machine, random forest, XGBoost, and multilayer perceptron models. The proposed DQN achieves an accuracy of 99.72%, a precision of 99.68%, a recall of 99.65%, an F1-score of 99.66%, and an ROC-AUC of 0.999, while the false positive rate is 0.31%, the false negative rate is 0.35%, and the detection latency is 15 ms. The framework achieved 99.54% attack mitigation rate, demonstrating strong adaptive and real-time defensive capabilities.
