abstract_cn: 一个持久的假设认为，图分析需要专门构建的图引擎，而关系型系统不适合处理关联数据。我们对此持相反观点，尤其是针对企业实际运行的工作负载。由图查询语言驱动的列式关系引擎，在分析型图查询上能够匹配甚至超越原生图引擎，并且——关键的是——能够扩展到内存图引擎失效之后的范围。我们进一步论证，节点/边属性图并非对关联数据更忠实的建模，而是对关系表中已经显式存在的关系的一种重新编码；在查询时重建这些关系纯属额外开销。我们提出ClickGraph及其Databricks方言版本DeltaGraph，这些系统将Cypher直接翻译到原生关系模式——即已存在的表、列和外键——并在ClickHouse、Databricks上就地执行，或对湖仓文件进行进程内处理，无需导入数据，也无需独立集群。由于输出是普通SQL，性能不佳的查询是一个开放的优化面：可以重写查询，也可以扩展引擎本身。我们用一个对等系统自己发布的基准测试来支持这一论点，在该测试中，列式引擎比Neo4j快两到四个数量级，并提供跨LDBC社交网络基准套件的可复现测量结果。

title: When Guardrails Look Effective: Construct Validity Failures in LLM Agent Commerce Evaluation
abstract: Interactive simulations increasingly evaluate policies in markets populated by language-model agents. Their outputs can look economic---prices, profits, consumer surplus, and welfare---without instantiating the behavior named in the claim. We audit this risk in a multi-turn buyer--seller testbed for configurable hotel transactions. An initial implementation reported welfare gains from two marketplace guardrails of +87.4, +35.0, and +28.8 across a Qwen2.5 1.5B--14B ladder. It also gave guarded and unguarded agents different offer schemas and choice procedures. Holding the schema and buyer chooser fixed changes the paired contrasts to +7.2, -13.9, and +23.8. The four largest 14B single-generation effects averaged +229; after three generations per profile-condition, they averaged +37.6 (95% bootstrap interval [-34.2, 109.3]), while generation residuals account for 49.9% of variation in this post-hoc probe. A seller-incentive check is non-monotone: increasing profit pressure produces less profit than the default seller prompt. Scripted positive controls show why this matters. A profit-maximizing seller already attains first-best welfare, so guardrails mostly redistribute and reduce welfare; they create welfare only when the seller is explicitly programmed to force inefficient bundles. We contribute a construct-validity contract separating incentive validity, protocol isolation, stochastic stability, and welfare accounting, and returning INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE before substantive policy claims. In our case, the original estimate is INVALID under protocol isolation, while the controlled study remains INCONCLUSIVE under incentive validity and stochastic stability. The case does not show that guardrails are ineffective; it shows their apparent value is unidentified until the simulated agents and protocol pass these checks.
tldr: The paper investigates construct validity failures in evaluating LLM agent commerce simulations, showing that apparent welfare gains from guardrails are not robust to protocol changes and stochastic variability, thus questioning the validity of such evaluations.
abstract_cn: 交互式模拟越来越多地用于评估由语言模型智能体构成的市场中的政策。其输出看起来具有经济意义——价格、利润、消费者剩余和福利——却并未实例化这些论断所命名的行为。我们在一个面向可配置酒店交易的多轮买卖双方测试平台中审计了这一风险。初始实现报告称，在Qwen2.5 1.5B至14B的规模阶梯上，两项市场护栏带来的福利增益分别为+87.4、+35.0和+28.8。该实现还赋予受护栏与未受护栏智能体不同的报价模式（schema）和选择程序。在固定模式与买方选择器不变的情况下，配对对比结果变为+7.2、-13.9和+23.8。四个最大的14B单次生成效应平均为+229；而在每个档案-条件下进行三次生成后，其平均值降至+37.6（95%自助法区间为[-34.2, 109.3]），同时生成残差解释了这一事后探针中49.9%的变异。一项卖方激励检验呈非单调性：增加利润压力所产生的利润低于默认卖方提示词下的利润。脚本化阳性对照实验说明了这一问题的严重性。利润最大化的卖方本已能达到最优福利，因此护栏主要起到再分配和降低福利的作用；只有当卖方被明确编程为强制推行低效捆绑组合时，护栏才会创造福利。我们提出了一项构念效度契约，将激励效度、协议隔离、随机稳定性和福利核算区分开来，并在实质性政策论断之前返回“无效”（INVALID）或“不确定”（INCONCLUSIVE）的判定。在本案例中，原始估计在协议隔离下被判定为无效，而受控研究在激励效度和随机稳定性下仍属不确定。该案例并不表明护栏无效；而是表明，在模拟智能体和协议通过这些检验之前，其表面价值无法被识别。

title: TempCloze: Can Video-LLMs Identify the Missing Middle?
abstract: Temporal reasoning benchmarks for Video-LLMs are often mediated by language, leaving room for linguistic shortcuts from option wording, answer correlations, or language priors. To reduce such shortcuts, we introduce TempCloze, a video cloze benchmark for evaluating visual temporal reasoning in Video-LLMs. Given the beginning and ending clips of a video, models must identify the true missing middle from four candidates. TempCloze contains 1,521 carefully filtered videos from seven sources, mainly long-take and egocentric videos. We construct same-source distractors along three dimensions: Semantic asks what event should happen, Alignment probes when it should occur, and Progression tests how it should unfold, while shared scenes and objects reduce appearance cues. Our evaluation of 10 proprietary and 21 open-source Video-LLMs reveals Alignment as the primary bottleneck: models often recognize plausible semantic content and local event progression but struggle with temporal alignment. We further conduct error pattern and behavioral sensitivity analyses on TempCloze-Mixed and TempCloze-Hard with four representative models to examine where errors arise and how candidate order, context direction, visible span, frame density, and test-time scaling influence model choices.
tldr: The paper introduces TempCloze, a video cloze benchmark to evaluate temporal reasoning in Video-LLMs, and finds that models struggle with temporal alignment.
abstract_cn: 视频大语言模型的时间推理基准往往通过语言中介，从而为选项措辞、答案相关性或语言先验带来的语言捷径留下了空间。为减少此类捷径，我们引入了TempCloze，一个用于评估视频大语言模型中视觉时间推理的视频完形填空基准。给定视频的开头和结尾片段，模型必须从四个候选项中识别出真正缺失的中间部分。TempCloze包含来自七个来源的1,521个经过精心筛选的视频，主要涉及长镜头和第一人称视角视频。我们沿三个维度构建了同源干扰项：语义维度考察应发生什么事件，对齐维度探测事件应何时发生，进展维度测试事件应如何展开，同时共享场景和物体以减少外观线索。我们对10个专有和21个开源视频大语言模型的评估显示，对齐是主要瓶颈：模型通常能识别合理的语义内容和局部事件进展，但在时间对齐方面存在困难。我们进一步在TempCloze-Mixed和TempCloze-Hard上对四个代表性模型进行了错误模式和行为敏感性分析，以考察错误产生的来源，以及候选顺序、上下文方向、可见跨度、帧密度和测试时缩放如何影响模型选择。

title: GlossoGen: Emergent Language in Complex Multi-Agent LLM Interactions
abstract: The growing rate at which LLM agents interact with one another raises key questions about language evolution in multi-LLM-agent settings, with implications for safety and monitorability as well as for linguistic accounts of LLMs. To address these questions, we introduce GlossoGen, a novel platform for studying multi-agent language evolution in complex scenarios. Within GlossoGen, we build the SaveVeyru scenario, which requires agents with partial information to communicate under pressure. We find that language evolution does occur between LLM agents, that the resulting languages are compositional and morphologically productive, and that they deviate from the LLMs' English prior in ways that render them incomprehensible to humans. Moreover, we identify several qualities essential to this evolution: pressure towards efficiency; the strength of the models backing the agents; and access to a "postmortem" stage in which agents can agree on linguistic conventions. Importantly, we observe that different conditions govern the transmission of language to new agents. Specifically, we find that agents learn new languages from usage alone, take an active role in this learning, and that while stronger models are required for novel language emergence, weaker models can learn an existing language once it has emerged. Taken together, our results indicate that current LLMs have the potential for cumulative cultural evolution -- previously attested only in humans -- with mixed populations of agents developing capacities that go beyond their lowest common denominator.
tldr: 该论文介绍GlossoGen平台，研究复杂多智能体LLM交互中语言的涌现，发现语言演化具有组合性和形态生产力，且与人类语言不同，并探讨了影响语言演化的因素。
abstract_cn: LLM代理之间互动速率的不断增长，引发了关于多LLM代理环境中语言演化的关键问题，这对安全性与可监控性以及LLM的语言学解释都具有重要意义。为应对这些问题，我们引入了GlossoGen，一个用于研究复杂场景下多代理语言演化的新型平台。在GlossoGen中，我们构建了SaveVeyru场景，该场景要求拥有部分信息的代理在压力下进行沟通。我们发现，LLM代理之间确实会发生语言演化，所产生的语言具有组合性和形态能产性，并且它们偏离了LLM的英语先验，其方式使人类无法理解。此外，我们识别出对这种演化至关重要的几个特质：对效率的压力；支撑代理的模型强度；以及能够进入“事后”阶段，使代理可以就语言惯例达成一致。重要的是，我们观察到不同条件支配着语言向新代理的传递。具体而言，我们发现代理仅从使用中学习新语言，在这一学习过程中扮演主动角色，并且虽然新语言的出现需要更强的模型，但较弱的模型在语言一旦出现后也能学习现有语言。综合来看，我们的结果表明，当前的LLM具有累积文化演化的潜力——此前仅在人类中被证实——混合代理群体所发展的能力超越了其最低共同点。

title: Defense-as-Skill: Evolving Runtime Guard Skill for Skill-Augmented Agents
abstract: Skill-augmented agents load reusable skills as persistent runtime context, improving task performance but also giving malicious skills a durable channel for steering future actions. Such skills may leak secrets, corrupt code, bypass approvals, or stage data for exfiltration only after a concrete user task and workspace state make the unsafe action appear useful. This makes pre-install vetting insufficient and calls for runtime, task-conditioned protection. We propose Defense-as-Skill, a defense paradigm that implements the runtime guard itself as an installable, inspectable, and editable skill. Our guard, SkillSonar, runs alongside untrusted task skills and checks sensitive actions against the user's task boundary, routing each action to an allow, replan, or confirmation decision without modifying the underlying agent runtime. To study this setting, we construct SCOPE-R, a task-conditioned dataset covering 6 risk families and 21 sub-categories, with 206 attack-confirmed malicious instances and 43 benign tasks. We then improve SkillSonar on the SCOPE-R training subset using runtime guard-skill evolution, a Monte-Carlo Tree Search procedure that evolves the on-disk guard skill from feedback on the rollouts. Across Claude Code and OpenClaw, the evolved guard substantially reduces attack success while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off. On repeated GLM-5 runs, SkillSonar reduces ID ASR from 0.482 to 0.104 and OOD ASR from 0.606 to 0.115. Further analyses demonstrate transfer across victim models, held-out risk families, and external benchmarks, as well as retained protection against adaptive attackers. Ablations further show that explicit safety responsibility assignment and the skill-native representation are both important to the observed gains.
tldr: The paper proposes Defense-as-Skill, a runtime guard skill for skill-augmented agents to protect against malicious skills, and demonstrates its effectiveness in reducing attack success rates while maintaining utility.
abstract_cn: 技能增强型智能体将可复用技能作为持久运行时上下文加载，这提升了任务性能，但也为恶意技能提供了影响未来行动的持久通道。此类技能可能在具体用户任务与工作区状态使不安全行为看似有用之后，才泄露机密、破坏代码、绕过审批或为数据外传做准备。这使得安装前审查不足以应对，亟需运行时且以任务为条件的防护机制。我们提出“技能即防御”（Defense-as-Skill）范式，将运行时防护本身实现为一种可安装、可检查且可编辑的技能。我们的防护模块SkillSonar与不受信任的任务技能并行运行，依据用户任务边界检查敏感操作，将每个操作路由至允许、重新规划或确认决策，而无需修改底层智能体运行时。为研究该场景，我们构建了SCOPE-R数据集，这是一个任务条件化数据集，覆盖6个风险族和21个子类别，包含206个经攻击确认的恶意实例和43个良性任务。随后，我们利用运行时防护技能进化（一种蒙特卡洛树搜索过程，根据回放反馈进化磁盘上的防护技能）在SCOPE-R训练子集上改进SkillSonar。在Claude Code和OpenClaw上，进化后的防护显著降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了良好的安全-效用权衡。在重复的GLM-5运行中，SkillSonar将ID攻击成功率从0.482降至0.104，OOD攻击成功率从0.606降至0.115。进一步分析表明，该防护可跨受害者模型、保留风险族及外部基准迁移，并对自适应攻击者保持有效防护。消融实验进一步显示，明确的安全责任分配与技能原生表示对观察到的性能提升均至关重要。

title: Harness-of-Harness: Multi-Day Autonomous Software Development with Continual Improvement
abstract: This paper studies autonomous software development, in which LLM-based coding agents transform high-level requirements into complete, functional, and usable software systems without human intervention. We introduce Harness-of-Harness (HoH), a framework that enables coding agents to continually improve software during autonomous development. HoH operates on existing coding-agent harnesses, and organizes their executions into iterative planning-coding-testing loops. To sustain improvement across loops, HoH balances repair with capability growth, scopes development into small and verifiable increments, separates implementation-time testing from independent evaluation, and constrains verifiable outputs rather than prescribing agent workflows. It progressively exposes deliverables, role-specific tools, and skills, encourages reuse rather than recreation, and maintains versioned project histories. On GameCraft-Bench, FrontierSWE, and ProgramBench, three harness-model pairs (Codex with GPT-5.5, OpenCode with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Pi with MiniMax-M3), HoH consistently outperforms the corresponding standalone harnesses, achieving an average relative gain of 52.25 percent and a maximum gain of 82.86 percent after three iterations. In a multi-day deployment with more than 70 iterations, HoH autonomously develops a first-person-shooter game, featuring a coherent storyline, fully implemented core mechanics, human-playable experience, polished visuals and integrated audio. Github: https://github.com/Flesymeb/HarnessOfHarness Project Page: https://flesymeb.github.io/HarnessOfHarness/
tldr: This paper proposes Harness-of-Harness (HoH), a framework that enables LLM-based coding agents to continually improve software during autonomous development, achieving significant performance gains on benchmarks and successfully developing a complex game over multiple days.
abstract_cn: 本文研究了自主软件开发问题，其中基于大语言模型的编码智能体能够在无需人工干预的情况下，将高层次需求转化为完整、功能可用且可实际运行的软件系统。我们提出了“Harness-of-Harness”（HoH）框架，该框架使编码智能体能够在自主开发过程中持续改进软件。HoH 运行于现有的编码智能体框架（harness）之上，并将其执行过程组织为迭代式的“规划—编码—测试”循环。为在循环中维持持续改进，HoH 在修复与能力增长之间取得平衡，将开发任务细分为小而可验证的增量模块，将实现阶段的测试与独立评估相分离，并约束可验证的输出而非规定智能体的工作流程。它逐步暴露交付物、角色专属工具和技能，鼓励复用而非重新创建，并维护带版本管理的项目历史。在 GameCraft-Bench、FrontierSWE 和 ProgramBench 三个基准上，针对三组“框架—模型”组合（Codex 搭配 GPT-5.5、OpenCode 搭配 DeepSeek-V4-Pro，以及 Pi 搭配 MiniMax-M3），HoH 均持续优于对应的独立框架，在三次迭代后实现了平均 52.25% 的相对提升，最大提升达 82.86%。在一次超过 70 次迭代的多日部署中，HoH 自主开发了一款第一人称射击游戏，该游戏具备连贯的故事情节、完整实现的核心机制、可人工游玩的体验、精致的视觉效果以及集成的音频。GitHub：https://github.com/Flesymeb/HarnessOfHarness 项目主页：https://flesymeb.github.io/HarnessOfHarness/

title: Parsing the Stream: A Live Trace Model for Long-Horizon Agents and Their Observers
abstract: A long-horizon agent's trace outgrows both of its consumers: the human observer monitoring the run, and the agent itself, whose bounded context the trace must be folded back into. We present a live trace model, an append-only event ledger folded incrementally into typed run state and compiled into per-consumer views, and evaluate it for both consumers against deterministic ground truth. For the observer side, evaluated with an LLM reader as proxy, the compiled view answers monitoring questions using approximately 14x and 15x fewer input tokens (by reader) and at 5-7x lower cost than a budget-capped single-call reading of the raw trace, with higher accuracy (0.85-0.87 versus 0.48). Because the questions were co-designed with the view schema, we treat the token and cost reduction, conditional on schema coverage, as the transferable result. For the agent, on 120-link sequential-dependency tasks, mechanisms that maintain the task's running statistic in per-step state succeed where full-context prompting fails (30/30 versus 8/30 under a clean protocol, n=30, labeled descriptive owing to benchmark-system co-development); a prompt-level scratchpad matches the fold's accuracy at lower cost, and a two-arm decomposition attributes the fold's accuracy to its deterministic aggregate and its cost advantage to its compactness. The fold's remaining value over cheaper alternatives is deterministic auditability and serving the observer from the same state. We derive eleven candidate requirements for trace folding from observed failures and delimit them with an order-sensitive task family on which the fold ceases to help. Code, benchmarks, a regenerable synthetic corpus, and all workbench traces are released.
tldr: The paper proposes a live trace model for long-horizon agents that folds event logs into compact views, reducing token usage and cost for LLM-based observers while maintaining accuracy, and demonstrates its effectiveness for agent state maintenance.
abstract_cn: 长时程智能体的运行轨迹对其两类使用者的规模而言均会超出其承载能力：一类是监控运行过程的人类观察者，另一类是智能体自身——其有界上下文必须将轨迹重新折叠回去。我们提出一种实时轨迹模型，即一种仅追加的事件账本，逐步折叠为类型化的运行状态，并编译为面向各使用者的视图，并针对两类使用者以确定性基准真值对其进行评估。在观察者一侧，以LLM阅读器作为代理进行评估时，编译后的视图回答监控问题所需的输入token数约为原始轨迹预算受限单次调用的1/14至1/15（按阅读器计），成本降低5至7倍，且准确率更高（0.85–0.87对比0.48）。由于问题与视图模式是共同设计的，我们将token和成本降低视为在模式覆盖前提下的可迁移结果。在智能体一侧，针对120条链式依赖任务，在逐步状态中维护任务运行统计量的机制在完整上下文提示失败的情况下取得成功（在干净协议下为30/30对比8/30，n=30，因基准系统共同开发而标注为描述性结果）；提示级草稿纸在较低成本下达到与折叠相当的准确率，而双臂分解表明，折叠的准确率归因于其确定性聚合，成本优势则归因于其紧凑性。与更廉价的替代方案相比，折叠的剩余价值在于其确定性可审计性，以及从同一状态服务观察者的能力。我们从观察到的失败中推导出轨迹折叠的十一条候选需求，并通过一个对顺序敏感的任务族对其加以界定，在该任务族中折叠不再起作用。代码、基准、可再生成的合成语料库以及所有工作台轨迹均已发布。

title: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
abstract: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence of the student being imitated. We present StudentSim, a training framework that turns sparse per-student data into individualized simulators through pooled training followed by per-student specialization. The resulting simulators both mirror a student's own responses and update them under tutor guidance. We also introduce StudentSimEval, a standardized protocol covering 60 students across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, using public learner datasets with de-identified records shared for research. StudentSimEval measures behavioral fidelity (F), or how well a simulator matches a student's responses, and guidance responsiveness (R), or how readily it updates under tutor guidance, with all methods fit and evaluated on the same records. Across all three domains, StudentSim outperforms GPT-5.4 on both metrics. In chess, StudentSim reaches F=0.51 and R=0.91, compared with 0.23 and 0.72 for GPT-5.4 and 0.45 and 0.27 for Maia2. As a proof of concept, using StudentSim as a reward model for tutor reinforcement learning produces a chess tutor that expert humans rate as more accurate, better-guided, and more personalized than a no-RL baseline and a tutor trained against a GPT-5.4 simulator reward. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim.
tldr: This paper introduces StudentSim, a framework for training individualized LLM-based student simulators that accurately mimic student responses and adapt to tutor guidance, demonstrating improvements over general LLMs in chess, language writing, and math.
abstract_cn: AI辅导系统在能够适应每位学生的优势、劣势及偏好指导方式时最为有效，但关于何种指导方式对何种学生有效，从真实学习者中收集证据既稀少、缓慢又成本高昂。学生模拟器可作为代理提供此类信号，然而现有方法存在局限：状态追踪模型能拟合学生行为，但难以处理解释或纠正信息；而大语言模型角色扮演虽能流畅遵循指导，却无法可靠匹配所模拟学生的能力水平。我们提出StudentSim，一种训练框架，通过池化训练后接逐学生特化，将稀疏的每学生数据转化为个性化模拟器。所生成的模拟器既能反映学生自身的回答，也能在辅导指导下更新这些回答。我们还引入StudentSimEval，一种标准化协议，覆盖国际象棋、第二语言英语写作和数学三个领域的60名学生，使用公开的学习者数据集，其中包含经去标识化处理并共享用于研究的记录。StudentSimEval衡量行为保真度（F），即模拟器匹配学生回答的程度，以及指导响应度（R），即模拟器在辅导指导下更新的容易程度，所有方法均在相同记录上进行拟合和评估。在全部三个领域中，StudentSim在两项指标上均优于GPT-5.4。在国际象棋中，StudentSim达到F=0.51和R=0.91，而GPT-5.4为0.23和0.72，Maia2为0.45和0.27。作为概念验证，将StudentSim用作辅导强化学习的奖励模型，所生成的国际象棋辅导系统被专家人类评估为比无强化学习基线和针对GPT-5.4模拟器奖励训练的辅导系统更准确、指导更优且更具个性化。代码可在https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim获取。

title: Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Quality-Adjusted Deployment Economics
abstract: Extracting structured fields from hundreds of millions of documents annually remains costly in regulated industries: bespoke OCR cascades cover only a fraction of workflows, privacy rules preclude external models, and existing open-source VLMs that clear quality thresholds cost more to serve than human annotation. We present a deployed document-understanding system built on a Mixture-of-Experts VLM (35B total, 3B active), fine-tuned on in-house production data mixed with open-domain documents curated by a Difficulty-Aware pipeline for layout diversity, fact-extractability, and cross-model consistency. Fitting on a single H100 and serving heterogeneous workflows via prompting, the model leads all deployable (non-reasoning) baselines up to an order of magnitude larger. A quality-adjusted cost analysis, with confirmation and correction costs calibrated from production telemetry, shows it reduces expected costs by over 80% against the human baseline and by more than 50% against the best competing open-source model, while larger baselines remain economically unviable.
tldr: The paper presents a deployed document-understanding system using a Mixture-of-Experts VLM with difficulty-aware data curation and quality-adjusted cost analysis, achieving significant cost reductions, but it is unrelated to recommendation systems.
abstract_cn: 在受监管行业中，每年从数亿份文档中提取结构化字段仍然成本高昂：定制化的OCR流水线仅能覆盖部分工作流，隐私规则排除了外部模型的使用，而现有通过质量门槛的开源视觉语言模型（VLM）其服务成本甚至高于人工标注。我们提出了一套已部署的文档理解系统，其基于混合专家视觉语言模型（总参数量35B，激活参数量3B），并在内部生产数据与开放域文档的混合数据上进行微调，其中开放域文档由一条“难度感知”流水线筛选，以确保版面多样性、事实可提取性和跨模型一致性。该系统可部署于单张H100 GPU上，并通过提示词（prompting）方式服务异构工作流，其性能领先所有可部署（非推理型）基线模型，即便这些基线模型的规模大至其十倍。基于质量调整后的成本分析，并结合从生产遥测中校准的确认与纠错成本，该系统相较人工基线可降低预期成本超过80%，相较表现最佳的竞品开源模型降低超过50%，而更大规模的基线模型在经济上仍不可行。

title: From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix
abstract: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges. Rather than optimising all objectives jointly, which introduces cross-domain reward interference, we train a separate GRPO expert per axis and merge them via two-stage SLERP. Each expert's reward exposes a distinct failure mode, namely semantic collapse, over-calling, and verbosity hacking, each requiring a domain-specific fix. In non-reasoning mode the recipe surpasses a ${\sim}7\times$ larger by total parameters baseline on the in-house Arena with 69.6 to 65.8, instruction following with 0.85 to 0.83, and function-calling with 0.79 to 0.77, while lifting general dialogue benchmarks. The model absorbs 50% of platform traffic, 116M requests per month, at a fraction of the serving cost.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种通过GRPO专家和SLERP合并来训练自托管LLM的方法，以覆盖企业内部请求分布，在非推理模式下以更小模型超越更大基线，并吸收50%平台流量。
abstract_cn: 数据驻留约束迫使企业自行托管大型语言模型（LLM），但持续采用新模型而不淘汰旧模型的做法会扩大服务集群规模，从而碎片化有限的GPU资源池。我们通过生产环境错误分析，沿三个维度——指令遵循、函数调用及内部任务分布——识别并弥合质量差距，将来自200多个内部应用的流量整合至单一模型。质量通过按生产流量分层、并由确定性验证器或经校准的LLM评判器评分的离线基准进行追踪。为避免多目标联合优化所引入的跨领域奖励干扰，我们为每个维度分别训练一个GRPO专家模型，并通过两阶段SLERP进行合并。每个专家的奖励函数暴露了不同的失败模式，即语义坍缩、过度调用及冗长性攻击，每种模式均需针对性的领域修复方案。在非推理模式下，该方案在内部Arena基准上以69.6对65.8的总参数量超越约7倍规模的基线模型，指令遵循得分0.85对0.83，函数调用得分0.79对0.77，同时提升了通用对话基准表现。该模型以极低的服务成本吸收了平台50%的流量，即每月1.16亿次请求。

title: A systematic Approach to constructing a Chance-and-Risk Matrix for Semiconductor Supply Chains
abstract: Semiconductor supply chains face escalating risks from geopolitical tensions, geographic concentration, and rapid technological shifts, yet no scalable system continuously extracts, structures, and prioritizes risk intelligence from public corporate disclosures. We present an end-to-end pipeline that retrieves corporate documents for semiconductor companies and uses large language models (LLMs) to extract the risks and opportunities they describe. It organizes these into a knowledge graph linking each item to its category, sources, and related events, then merges duplicates and ranks them with a three-layer mechanism combining an algorithmic formula, an LLM relevance adjustment, and expert validation. Applied to five companies across the value chain, the pipeline produces 76,207 scored items, of which an independent check finds 92.6% valid. The automated rankings match expert judgment at an average Spearman correlation of 0.55 for risks and 0.72 for opportunities, and the resulting matrices identify trade restrictions as the dominant cross-company risk.
tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline using LLMs to extract and rank risks and opportunities from semiconductor corporate disclosures, constructing a chance-and-risk matrix for supply chain management.
abstract_cn: 半导体供应链正面临地缘政治紧张、地理集中化以及技术快速变革所带来的日益严峻的风险，然而目前尚无一套可扩展的系统能够从公开企业披露中持续提取、结构化并优先排序风险情报。我们提出了一种端到端流水线，用于检索半导体企业的公司文件，并利用大语言模型（LLMs）提取其中所述的风险与机遇。该系统将这些信息组织为知识图谱，将每个条目与其类别、来源及相关事件相链接，随后进行重复项合并，并通过一种三层机制进行排序，该机制结合了算法公式、LLM相关性调整以及专家验证。将该流水线应用于价值链上的五家企业后，共生成76,207个已评分的条目，其中独立核查发现92.6%为有效条目。自动化排序与专家判断的平均Spearman相关系数在风险方面为0.55，在机遇方面为0.72，所得矩阵显示贸易限制是跨企业的主要共性风险。

title: SDARE-Bench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Conversational Stigma Detection and Response in Dyadic and Group Dialogue
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in advice seeking and decision making that may affect social judgements. Despite stigma's profound effects on people and communities, benchmarks remain scarce. Existing general-domain evaluations typically rely on static prompts and fixed-format tasks, overlooking conversational contexts and audience effects in everyday communication. To address these gaps, we introduce SDARE-Bench, the first scenario-based benchmark evaluating both stigma detection and open-ended response generation in LLMs, comprising 1,138 dyadic queries and 1,388 group dialogue. Empirical results across 8 LLMs consistently demonstrate poor identification of stigma components, especially in group dialogues. In open-ended response generation, stigma expression was substantially higher in group settings than in dyadic, with weaker resistance to stigma and more unrealistic advice. Responses were evaluated using a classifier trained on 1,392 human annotated responses. In constructed group pressure settings, stigma expression rates further increased to a striking average of 97.5%. Our findings identify stigma response as a recurring LLM safety vulnerability, especially in socially complex conversational contexts.
tldr: 该论文提出了SDARE-Bench基准，评估LLM在双人和群体对话中的污名检测与回应生成能力，发现LLM在群体对话中污名表达率极高，存在安全漏洞。
abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于建议咨询和决策过程中，这些过程可能影响社会判断。尽管污名对个人和社区具有深远影响，但相关基准仍然稀缺。现有的通用领域评估通常依赖静态提示和固定格式任务，忽视了日常交流中的对话情境和受众效应。为弥补这些不足，我们引入了SDARE-Bench，这是首个基于情境的基准，用于评估LLMs中的污名检测和开放式回应生成，包含1，138个双人对话查询和1，388个群体对话。对8个LLMs的实证结果一致显示，其对污名组成部分的识别能力较差，尤其在群体对话中表现更弱。在开放式回应生成中，群体情境下的污名表达显著高于双人情境，且对污名的抵制力较弱，提供的建议也更为不切实际。回应通过一个基于1，392条人工标注回应训练的分类器进行评估。在人为构建的群体压力情境下，污名表达率进一步上升至惊人的平均97.5%。我们的研究结果将污名回应确定为LLMs反复出现的安全漏洞，尤其是在社会复杂性较高的对话情境中。

title: Knowledge Distillation During Mid-Training Favors Reasoning over Factual Recall
abstract: Logit-based knowledge distillation (KD) is used to train smaller language models (LMs) via supervision from stronger teachers, but whether its benefits are consistent across training stages remains unclear. Through controlled experiments, we find that forward Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation--the standard KD formulation--with post-trained teachers behaves fundamentally differently during mid-training, an intermediate phase of self-supervised learning on curated corpora. Surprisingly, while forward KD simultaneously improves reasoning and factual recall during pre-training relative to standard next-token prediction (NTP), it instead slows factual recall acquisition during mid-training despite continued reasoning gains. We trace this stage dependence to an asymmetry in teacher confidence across data domains and the student's evolving knowledge state: teachers are more confident on procedural than knowledge-intensive data, while students acquire low-entropy factual knowledge earlier in training. To mitigate this imbalance, we propose Switch Distillation, a simple mid-training objective that distills on tokens where the teacher is confident, using teacher predictive entropy as a lightweight routing signal, and otherwise falls back to cross-entropy. Switch Distillation consistently outperforms existing distillation objectives across teacher sizes. Relative to standard NTP, it achieves 1.61-1.71x the reasoning performance and 1.13-1.19x the knowledge and commonsense performance while preserving 96.7-96.8% of factual recall. Crucially, these benefits persist after post-training: Switch Distillation closes the factual recall gap while maintaining 1.25-1.32x and 1.13-1.20x gains in reasoning and knowledge and commonsense, respectively.
tldr: 该论文研究知识蒸馏在语言模型训练中的阶段依赖性，提出Switch Distillation方法以平衡推理和事实回忆，但内容与推荐系统无关。
abstract_cn: 基于逻辑的知识蒸馏（KD）被用于通过更强教师的监督来训练较小的语言模型（LMs），但其收益是否在训练各阶段保持一致仍不明确。通过受控实验，我们发现，使用后训练教师的前向Kullback-Leibler（KL）蒸馏——即标准KD形式——在中期训练（即对精选语料库进行自监督学习的中间阶段）中表现出根本不同的行为。令人惊讶的是，尽管前向KD在预训练阶段相对于标准下一词预测（NTP）同时提升了推理能力和事实回忆能力，但在中期训练中，它却减慢了事实回忆的获取，尽管推理能力仍在持续提升。我们将这种阶段依赖性归因于教师在不同数据领域上的置信度不对称以及学生不断演变的知识状态：教师在程序性数据上的置信度高于知识密集型数据，而学生在训练早期便获取了低熵的事实性知识。为缓解这种不平衡，我们提出了切换蒸馏（Switch Distillation），一种简单的中期训练目标：在教师置信度高的词元上进行蒸馏，使用教师预测熵作为轻量级路由信号，否则回退到交叉熵损失。切换蒸馏在多种教师规模下均持续优于现有蒸馏目标。相对于标准NTP，它在推理性能上达到1.61-1.71倍，在知识和常识性能上达到1.13-1.19倍，同时保留了96.7%-96.8%的事实回忆能力。至关重要的是，这些收益在后训练后依然持续：切换蒸馏弥合了事实回忆差距，同时在推理、知识及常识方面分别保持了1.25-1.32倍和1.13-1.20倍的增益。

title: Algorithmic Publicity and the Right to a Fair Trial
abstract: This article examines how social media and AI-driven algorithmic publicity affect the right to a fair trial in Australian criminal jury proceedings. It outlines the common law and statutory controls on prejudicial publicity, including sub judice contempt, permanent stays, jury directions and evidentiary discretions, and shows how they operate in leading High Court and appellate decisions and recent law reform work. It then explains how search engines, social media feeds, recommender systems, synthetic media and generative AI, through engagement-optimised ranking and amplification, undermine broadcast-era assumptions about juror exposure. Drawing on empirical research on juror psychology, media effects and juror internet use, the article evaluates the practical capacity of safeguards such as contempt, stays (including delay, change of venue and sequestration), judge-alone trials and directions where prejudicial material is persistent, searchable and personalised. It argues for a robust fair-trial standard paired with a more candid account of digital exposure. Building on developments in the UK, EU, US, China and Estonia, it proposes doctrinal and procedural refinements, narrowly targeted platform duties and court-supervised AI monitoring tools to preserve jury trial and open justice while maintaining credible fair-trial guarantees in an algorithmic information environment.
topics: Ethics and Social Impacts of AI
tldr: 论文研究社交媒体和AI驱动的算法公开性如何影响澳大利亚刑事陪审团审判中的公平审判权，并提出了法律和程序上的改进建议。
abstract_cn: 本文探讨了社交媒体和人工智能驱动的算法公开性如何影响澳大利亚刑事陪审团程序中的公正审判权。文章概述了普通法和成文法对偏见性公开性的控制措施，包括诉讼期间藐视法庭罪、永久性中止诉讼、陪审团指示和证据裁量权，并展示了这些措施在高等法院和上诉法院的主要判决以及近期法律改革工作中的运作方式。随后，文章解释了搜索引擎、社交媒体信息流、推荐系统、合成媒体和生成式人工智能如何通过以参与度为导向的排序和放大机制，削弱了广播时代关于陪审员接触信息的假设。基于对陪审员心理、媒体效应和陪审员互联网使用的实证研究，文章评估了在偏见性材料具有持续性、可搜索性和个性化特征时，藐视法庭、中止诉讼（包括延期、变更审判地点和隔离陪审团）、法官单独审判和指示等保障措施的实际能力。文章主张确立一个强有力的公正审判标准，同时对数字信息接触进行更为坦率的说明。在借鉴英国、欧盟、美国、中国和爱沙尼亚相关发展的基础上，文章提出了学说和程序上的完善建议，包括精准定位的平台义务和法院监督下的人工智能监控工具，以在算法信息环境中维护陪审团审判和公开司法，同时保持可信的公正审判保障。
